        cs.cs_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM high_value_items) AND
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tpcds.store_returns sr3
            WHERE sr3.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND sr3.sr_return_amt > 1000
        )
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        i.i_brand,
        s.s_store_name,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        s.s_store_sk
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    i_brand,
    s_store_name,
    hd_buy_potential,
    store_sk,
    num_orders,
    total_net_paid,
    avg_coupon_amt,
    total_return_amt,
    min_sales_price,
    max_sales_price,
    store_total_return_amt
FROM main_query
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dr.d_date)
    WHERE dr.d_date < DATE '2022-01-31'
),
store_processed AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_market_desc,
        s.s_tax_percentage,
        s.s_closed_date_sk,
        lt.store_suffix
    FROM store s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT regexp_extract(s.s_store_id, '^A{2,}(.+)$') AS store_suffix
    ) AS lt
    WHERE s.s_store_id LIKE 'AAAA%'
      AND regexp_like(s.s_market_desc, '(children|bars|level|video)')
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        dr.d_date,
        date_trunc('month', dr.d_date) AS month_start,
        sp.s_store_id,
        sp.s_market_desc,
        sp.s_tax_percentage,
        sp.store_suffix,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_email_address,
        regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@([^\\.]+)\\.', 1) AS email_domain,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_range dr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_processed sp ON dr.d_date_sk = sp.s_closed_date_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 0
      AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@%'
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        s_store_id,
        s_market_desc,
        s_tax_percentage,
        store_suffix,
        email_domain,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        AVG(hd_income_band_sk) AS avg_income_band
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY month_start, s_store_id, s_market_desc, s_tax_percentage, store_suffix, email_domain
)
SELECT
    month_start,
    s_store_id,
    s_market_desc,
    s_tax_percentage,
    store_suffix,
    email_domain,
    distinct_customers,
    total_return_amount,
    total_return_quantity,
    avg_income_band,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY month_start) AS month_seq,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY s_store_id, month_start
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address,
        c.c_birth_month,
        c.c_birth_country,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_dep_count,
        CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$') AS email_domain
    FROM
        customer c
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
            ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        REGEXP_LIKE(c.c_email_address, '^.*@example\\.com$')
        AND c.c_last_name LIKE 'A%'
        AND c.c_birth_month BETWEEN 1 AND 6
        AND cd.cd_dep_count >= 2
)
SELECT
    fc.full_name,
    fc.email_domain,
    SUBSTRING(s.s_store_name, 1, 10) AS store_name_prefix,
    s.s_store_name,
    dc.d_year,
    dc.d_month_seq,
    COUNT(cr.cr_order_number) AS total_returns,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost,
    (SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk) AS customer_total_refund_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr3
            WHERE cr3.cr_refunded_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
              AND cr3.cr_return_amount > 200
        ) THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS high_value_flag
FROM
    filtered_customers fc
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim dc
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk
WHERE
    s.s_store_name IS NOT NULL
    AND s.s_store_name LIKE '%Super%Store%'
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(s.s_store_name, '^.*Super.*Store.*$')
GROUP BY
    fc.full_name,
    fc.email_domain,
    SUBSTRING(s.s_store_name, 1, 10),
    s.s_store_name,
    dc.d_year,
    dc.d_month_seq
ORDER BY
    total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series (d_date_sk, d_date, d_weekend) AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_weekend
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2023-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_weekend
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, ds.d_date)
    WHERE ds.d_date < DATE '2023-01-31'
),
store_channel AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date AS sale_date,
        'Store' AS channel,
        CASE WHEN ds.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
        COALESCE(SUM(ss.ss_net_profit), 0) AS net_profit
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ds.d_date, ds.d_weekend
),
web_channel AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date AS sale_date,
        'Web' AS channel,
        CASE WHEN ds.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
        COALESCE(SUM(ws.ws_net_profit), 0) AS net_profit
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ds.d_date, ds.d_weekend
),
catalog_channel AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date AS sale_date,
        'Catalog' AS channel,
        CASE WHEN ds.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
        COALESCE(-SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS net_profit
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ds.d_date, ds.d_weekend
),
combined AS (
    SELECT sale_date, channel, day_type, net_profit FROM store_channel
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sale_date, channel, day_type, net_profit FROM web_channel
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sale_date, channel, day_type, net_profit FROM catalog_channel
)
SELECT
    c.sale_date,
    c.channel,
    c.day_type,
    SUM(c.net_profit) AS total_net_profit
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT sale_date, channel, day_type, net_profit
    FROM combined
) c
GROUP BY c.sale_date, c.channel, c.day_type
ORDER BY c.sale_date, c.channel

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE dr.d_date_sk < (
        SELECT MAX(d_date_sk)
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_date <= DATE '2022-12-31'
    )
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.r_reason_desc,
    u.total_net_loss,
    u.distinct_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        total_net_loss,
        distinct_tickets AS distinct_count
    FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        total_net_loss,
        distinct_orders AS distinct_count
    FROM web_agg
) u
ORDER BY u.total_net_loss DESC

WITH sales_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        'customer_sales' AS metric_type,
        sum(ss.ss_net_paid) AS metric_value,
        concat('Domain:', regexp_extract(min(c.c_email_address), '@([A-Za-z0-9.-]+)$')) AS metric_detail
    FROM
        store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
        JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '^.*@example\\.com$')
        AND c.c_last_name LIKE 'A%'
    GROUP BY
        d.d_year
),
sites_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        'website_openings' AS metric_type,
        count(*) AS metric_value,
        concat('Prefix:', substring(min(w.web_site_id), 1, 3)) AS metric_detail
    FROM
        web_site w
        JOIN date_dim d ON w.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        regexp_like(w.web_name, 'Shop|Store')
        AND w.web_site_id LIKE 'WWW%'
    GROUP BY
        d.d_year
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM sales_by_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM sites_by_year
) combined
ORDER BY year DESC, metric_type
LIMIT 100

WITH inv_summary AS (
    SELECT inv.inv_item_sk,
           inv.inv_date_sk,
           SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_date_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    d.d_date,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    MAX(s.total_quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_quantity,
    'catalog' AS sales_channel,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p WHERE p.p_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk) AS promo_count
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN inv_summary s
    ON s.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   AND s.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31'
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, d.d_date

UNION ALL

SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    d.d_date,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    MAX(s.total_quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_quantity,
    'web' AS sales_channel,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p WHERE p.p_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk) AS promo_count
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN inv_summary s
    ON s.inv_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
   AND s.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31'
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, d.d_date

ORDER BY d_date DESC, total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    filtered_customers AS (
        SELECT
            c.c_customer_sk,
            c.c_customer_id,
            c.c_first_name,
            c.c_last_name,
            c.c_birth_year,
            c.c_birth_month,
            c.c_birth_day,
            c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
            c.c_current_cdemo_sk
        FROM
            tpcds.customer c
        WHERE
            c.c_birth_month = 5
            AND c.c_birth_day > 10
            AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1990
            AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
            AND c.c_last_name IN ('Morris', 'Fournier')
    ),
    demographics_union AS (
        SELECT
            cd.cd_demo_sk,
            cd.cd_gender,
            cd.cd_marital_status,
            cd.cd_credit_rating,
            cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
            cd.cd_purchase_estimate
        FROM
            tpcds.customer_demographics cd
        WHERE
            cd.cd_gender = 'M'
            AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            cd.cd_demo_sk,
            cd.cd_gender,
            cd.cd_marital_status,
            cd.cd_credit_rating,
            cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
            cd.cd_purchase_estimate
        FROM
            tpcds.customer_demographics cd
        WHERE
            cd.cd_gender = 'F'
            AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Low Risk'
    )
SELECT
    c.c_last_name,
    d.cd_gender,
    edu.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS num_customers,
    SUM(d.cd_purchase_estimate) AS total_purchase_estimate,
    AVG(d.cd_dep_employed_count) AS avg_dep_employed,
    MIN(c.c_birth_year) AS min_birth_year,
    MAX(c.c_birth_year) AS max_birth_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.cd_credit_rating = 'High Risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_customers
FROM
    filtered_customers c
    INNER JOIN demographics_union d
        ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = d.cd_demo_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cd2.cd_education_status
        FROM tpcds.customer_demographics cd2
        WHERE cd2.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS edu
WHERE
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.customer_demographics cd3
        WHERE cd3.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
          AND cd3.cd_dep_employed_count >= 3
    )
    AND d.cd_dep_employed_count >= 2
    AND d.cd_marital_status = 'S'
GROUP BY
    c.c_last_name,
    d.cd_gender,
    edu.cd_education_status
ORDER BY
    total_purchase_estimate DESC,
    num_customers DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH full_joined AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
        cust.c_first_name,
        cust.c_last_name,
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk,
        cust_ref.c_first_name AS ref_first_name,
        cust_ref.c_last_name AS ref_last_name,
        cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM call_center cc
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer cust
        ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer cust_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_ref.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_call_center_sk IS NOT NULL OR cr.cr_call_center_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    cc_name,
    r_reason_desc,
    CASE 
        WHEN cr_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN cr_net_loss BETWEEN 1001 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category,
    cr_return_amount,
    cr_return_quantity,
    cr_returned_date_sk,
    (SELECT avg(cr2.cr_net_loss)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_reason_sk = f.cr_reason_sk) AS avg_net_loss_for_reason,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound
FROM full_joined f
WHERE f.r_reason_desc ILIKE '%Lost my job%'
  AND f.cr_net_loss > 1000
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr3
        WHERE cr3.cr_returning_customer_sk = f.cr_returning_customer_sk
          AND cr3.cr_reason_sk <> f.cr_reason_sk
          AND cr3.cr_returned_date_sk = f.cr_returned_date_sk
    )
UNION ALL
SELECT
    cc_name,
    r_reason_desc,
    CASE 
        WHEN cr_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN cr_net_loss BETWEEN 1001 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category,
    cr_return_amount,
    cr_return_quantity,
    cr_returned_date_sk,
    (SELECT avg(cr2.cr_net_loss)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_reason_sk = f.cr_reason_sk) AS avg_net_loss_for_reason,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound
FROM full_joined f
WHERE f.r_reason_desc ILIKE '%unauthoized purchase%'
  AND f.cr_net_loss <= 1000
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr3
        WHERE cr3.cr_returning_customer_sk = f.cr_returning_customer_sk
          AND cr3.cr_reason_sk <> f.cr_reason_sk
          AND cr3.cr_returned_date_sk = f.cr_returned_date_sk
    )
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_sales_agg AS (
   SELECT
       d.d_date AS sales_date,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
       ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
       ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
       hd_bill.hd_buy_potential AS bill_buy_potential,
       hd_ship.hd_buy_potential AS ship_buy_potential,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
       CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_return_amount,
       CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS reason_desc,
       'catalog_sales' AS source_type
   FROM catalog_sales cs
   RIGHT JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
   LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
   LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
   LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
   LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
   WHERE d.d_date >= DATE '2000-01-01' AND d.d_date < DATE '2001-01-01'
   GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
),

web_sales_agg AS (
   SELECT
       d.d_date AS sales_date,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
       ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
       ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
       hd_bill.hd_buy_potential AS bill_buy_potential,
       hd_ship.hd_buy_potential AS ship_buy_potential,
       SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
       CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_return_amount,
       CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS reason_desc,
       'web_sales' AS source_type
   FROM web_sales ws
   JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
   LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
   LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
   LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
   LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
   WHERE d.d_date >= DATE '2000-01-01' AND d.d_date < DATE '2001-01-01'
   GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
),

returns_agg AS (
   SELECT
       d_ret.d_date AS sales_date,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
       ca_refund.ca_state AS refund_state,
       ca_return.ca_state AS return_state,
       hd_refund.hd_buy_potential AS refund_buy_potential,
       hd_return.hd_buy_potential AS return_buy_potential,
       CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_sales_amount,
       SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
       r_desc.r_reason_desc,
       'catalog_return' AS source_type
   FROM catalog_returns cr
   JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
   JOIN date_dim d_ret ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
   LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
   LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_refund ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refund.ca_address_sk
   LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_return ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
   LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_refund ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund.hd_demo_sk
   LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_return ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_return.hd_demo_sk
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT r.r_reason_desc
       FROM reason r
       WHERE r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
       LIMIT 1
   ) AS r_desc
   WHERE d_ret.d_date >= DATE '2000-01-01' AND d_ret.d_date < DATE '2001-01-01'
   GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,11
)

SELECT
    sales_date,
    w_warehouse_name,
    ship_mode_type,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) AS sum_sales_amount,
    SUM(total_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source_type) AS dis

WITH RECURSIVE date_chain AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_chain dc
        ON d.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dc.d_date)
    WHERE d.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-31'
), filtered_intersect AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_quantity > 10
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cs_order_number FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_sales_price > 100
)
SELECT
    cs.cs_order_number,
    d.d_date,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_brand,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    s.s_store_name,
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    CASE
        WHEN cd.cd_marital_status = 'M' THEN 'Married'
        WHEN cd.cd_marital_status = 'S' THEN 'Single'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS marital_category,
    cs.cs_quantity,
    cs.cs_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3day_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_name ORDER BY cs.cs_net_paid DESC) AS store_sales_rank,
    (SELECT SUM(cs2.cs_net_paid)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk) AS total_item_sales_to_date,
    wr.wr_return_quantity,
    wr.wr_net_loss
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_chain dc
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 1998
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
    AND cs.cs_sales_price > 20
    AND cc.cc_division_name = 'Furniture'
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000
    AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
    AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#1'
    AND cs.cs_order_number IN (SELECT cs_order_number FROM filtered_intersect)
ORDER BY cs.cs_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE sales_hierarchy AS (
    -- Anchor member: base rows meeting the filters
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number               AS cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid                  AS cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk              AS cs_sold_date_sk,
        d.d_year                        AS d_year,
        cc.cc_name                      AS cc_name,
        w.w_warehouse_name              AS w_warehouse_name,
        cd.cd_gender                    AS cd_gender,
        cr.cr_return_amount             AS cr_return_amount,
        wr.wr_return_amt                AS wr_return_amt,
        ws.web_name                     AS web_name,
        1                               AS level
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
       AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
       AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND w.w_gmt_offset = -6.00
      AND ws.web_class = 'Unknown'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive member: repeat rows up to 5 levels deep
    SELECT
        sh.cs_order_number,
        sh.cs_net_paid,
        sh.cs_sold_date_sk,
        sh.d_year,
        sh.cc_name,
        sh.w_warehouse_name,
        sh.cd_gender,
        sh.cr_return_amount,
        sh.wr_return_amt,
        sh.web_name,
        sh.level + 1
    FROM sales_hierarchy sh
    WHERE sh.level < 5
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        sh.cc_name,
        sh.d_year,
        SUM(sh.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(COALESCE(sh.cr_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(sh.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sh.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM sales_hierarchy sh
    GROUP BY sh.cc_name, sh.d_year
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        a.cc_name,
        a.d_year,
        a.total_net_paid,
        a.total_return_amount,
        a.distinct_orders,
        AVG(a.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_year) AS avg_net_paid_by_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_year ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC) AS rn
    FROM aggregated a
    WHERE a.total_net_paid > (
        SELECT AVG(b.total_net_paid)
        FROM aggregated b
        WHERE b.d_year = a.d_year
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    f.cc_name,
    f.d_year,
    f.total_net_paid,
    f.total_return_amount,
    f.distinct_orders,
    f.avg_net_paid_by_year,
    f.rn,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr3
        WHERE cr3.cr_returned_date_sk IN (
            SELECT d2.d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim d2
            WHERE d2.d_year = f.d_year
        )
    ) AS returns_in_year
FROM final f
ORDER BY f.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        s.s_manager,
        s.s_gmt_offset,
        COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amt,
        COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS return_transactions
    FROM store_returns sr
    RIGHT OUTER JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE s.s_manager LIKE '%John%'
      AND regexp_like(s.s_manager, '^J')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p
          JOIN date_dim d_p ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_p.d_date_sk
          WHERE regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '.*Discount.*')
            AND year(d_p.d_date) = year(s.s_rec_start_date)
      )
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_manager, s.s_gmt_offset
)
SELECT
    sr.s_store_id,
    sr.s_store_name,
    CONCAT(sr.s_city, ', ', sr.s_state) AS store_location,
    SUBSTRING(sr.s_manager FROM 1 FOR 5) AS manager_prefix,
    CASE
        WHEN sr.s_gmt_offset >= 0 THEN 'East'
        ELSE 'West'
    END AS region_category,
    CASE
        WHEN sr.total_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss'
        ELSE 'Profit'
    END AS net_status,
    sr.total_return_amt,
    sr.total_net_loss,
    sr.return_transactions,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.s_state ORDER BY sr.total_return_amt DESC) AS state_rank
FROM store_ret sr
HAVING sr.total_return_amt > 5000
ORDER BY sr.total_return_amt DESC, sr.s_store_name
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_store_sk AS sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_cdemo_sk AS sr_cdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_addr_sk AS sr_addr_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    FROM
        store_sales ss
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        store_returns sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
),
sales_without_returns AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number
    FROM store_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT sr_ticket_number
    FROM store_returns
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_last_name,
    cd.cd_gender,
    ca.ca_state,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_full.ss_ext_sales_price, 0)) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_full.ss_net_profit, 0)) AS total_sales_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_full.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr_full.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_sales_tickets,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = sr_full.ss_sold_date_sk
    ) AS returns_for_customer_and_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(sr_full.ss_net_profit, 0)) DESC) AS rn
FROM
    sales_returns sr_full
    LEFT JOIN customer c
        ON sr_full.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON sr_full.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca
        ON sr_full.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON sr_full.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE
    c.c_salutation = 'Mr.'
    AND s.s_tax_percentage > 0.07
    AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax > 500
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sales_without_returns snr
        WHERE snr.ss_ticket_number = sr_full.ss_ticket_number
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_last_name,
    cd.cd_gender,
    ca.ca_state
HAVING
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_full.ss_net_profit, 0)) > 1000
ORDER BY
    total_sales_profit DESC,
    rn
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT DATE '1998-01-01' AS d
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d + INTERVAL '1' DAY FROM date_range WHERE d < DATE '1998-01-31'
)
SELECT
    d.d_date,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_item_sk,
    cc.cc_division_name,
    wsite.web_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_order_cnt,
    AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS max_return_amount_for_item,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) AS daily_store_sales_cnt
FROM
    catalog_returns cr
JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    AND wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date = dr.d
WHERE
    d.d_date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND d.d_date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
    AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
    AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND wsite.web_class = 'E'
    AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    AND ss.ss_quantity > 5
    AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
GROUP BY
    d.d_date,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_item_sk,
    cc.cc_division_name,
    wsite.web_name,
    sm.sm_type
HAVING
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 10000
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) >= 5
ORDER BY
    total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_union AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS entity_sk,
        'store' AS entity_type,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity AS quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number AS ticket_number,
        NULL AS ship_mode_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws.ws_web_site_sk AS entity_sk,
        'web' AS entity_type,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity AS quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk,
        NULL AS ticket_number,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year AS sale_year,
    CASE
        WHEN su.entity_type = 'store' THEN s.s_store_name
        ELSE we.web_name
    END AS sales_entity_name,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    SUM(su.net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt,
    AVG(su.net_profit) AS avg_profit_per_tx,
    (SELECT SUM(su2.net_profit)
     FROM sales_union su2
     WHERE su2.entity_sk = su.entity_sk
       AND su2.entity_type = su.entity_type) AS entity_total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(su.net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(su.net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM sales_union su
LEFT OUTER JOIN store s
    ON su.entity_type = 'store' AND su.entity_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN web_site we
    ON su.entity_type = 'web' AND su.entity_sk = we.web_site_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON su.ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON su.sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion p
    ON su.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN date_dim d_promo_start
    ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN date_dim d_promo_end
    ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_sales
    ON su.hd_sk = hd_sales.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd_sales.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON su.item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
       AND su.ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
LEFT OUTER JOIN date_dim d_return
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN household_demographics hd_return
    ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_return.hd_demo_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN store st_ret
    ON sr.sr_store_sk = st_ret.s_store_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN date_dim d_store_closed
    ON st_ret.s_closed_date_sk = d_store_closed.d_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN date_dim d_web_open
    ON we.web_open_date_sk = d_web_open.d_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN date_dim d_web_close
    ON we.web_close_date_sk = d_web_close.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2001
GROUP BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    CASE
        WHEN su.entity_type = 'store' THEN s.s_store_name
        ELSE we.web_name
    END,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_current_price,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        p.p_cost,
        s.s_state,
        tss.t_shift,
        tss.t_minute,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        w_cr.w_state,
        hd_ss.hd_vehicle_count,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim tss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = tss.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ss ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_inv.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refunded.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_returning ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_returning.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd_ss.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE
        tss.t_shift = 'first'
        AND tss.t_minute >= 5
        AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND w_cr.w_state = 'TX'
        AND cr.cr_return_amount > 100.00
        AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 10
        AND hd_ss.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
        AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
)
SELECT
    s_state,
    i_category,
    t_shift,
    SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    AVG(cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
    SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
    MIN(i_current_price) AS min_price,
    MAX(i_current_price) AS max_price,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS total_inventory,
    (SELECT MAX(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i_item_sk) AS max_promo_cost
FROM base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (s_state, i_category, t_shift)
ORDER BY s_state, i_category, t_shift
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS distinct_promos,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_paid)
        FROM tpcds.store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    ) AS avg_store_net_paid
FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
JOIN tpcds.store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN tpcds.promotion p
  ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer c
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
  ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
  ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
  ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r_sr
  ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
  ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r_cr
  ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
  ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r_wr
  ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND ss.ss_sales_price > 50.00
  AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451910 AND 2452000
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (s.s_store_name, p.p_promo_name),
    (s.s_store_name),
    (p.p_promo_name),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC, s.s_store_name ASC, p.p_promo_name ASC

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales cs)
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        cc.cc_state,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        p.p_promo_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS return_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ss_sold_time_sk FROM store_sales) ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ws_sold_time_sk, ws_web_page_sk, ws_order_number FROM web_sales) ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_range)
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 0
      AND cc.cc_country = 'United States'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
             td.t_hour,
             cc.cc_state,
             ib.ib_income_band_sk,
             ib.ib_lower_bound,
             ib.ib_upper_bound,
             p.p_promo_id
)
SELECT
    bs.cs_sold_date_sk,
    bs.t_hour,
    bs.cc_state,
    bs.p_promo_id,
    bs.total_net_paid,
    bs.total_net_profit,
    bs.order_cnt,
    bs.return_cnt,
    (bs.total_net_profit / NULLIF(bs.order_cnt, 0)) AS avg_profit_per_order,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = bs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS daily_sales_transactions
FROM base_sales bs
WHERE bs.total_net_paid > 1000
  AND bs.return_cnt < 5
HAVING (bs.total_net_profit / NULLIF(bs.order_cnt, 0)) > 50
ORDER BY bs.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE numbers AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM numbers WHERE n < 100
)
SELECT
    i_item_s.i_item_id,
    i_item_s.i_product_name,
    cd_store.cd_gender AS store_customer_gender,
    cd_bill.cd_gender AS bill_customer_gender,
    cd_ship.cd_gender AS ship_customer_gender,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_transactions,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
    ) AS site_order_count
FROM
    store_sales ss
    JOIN item i_item_s
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i_item_s.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_store
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_store.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_store_alt
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_store_alt.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i_item_s.i_item_sk
    JOIN item i_item_w
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i_item_w.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site1
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site1.web_site_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site2
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site2.web_site_sk
WHERE
    i_item_s.i_current_price > 20.00
    AND ws_site1.web_company_name = 'pri'
GROUP BY
    i_item_s.i_item_id,
    i_item_s.i_product_name,
    cd_store.cd_gender,
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    cd_ship.cd_gender,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws_site1.web_company_name
HAVING
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 1000
ORDER BY
    total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE bucket_cte AS (
   SELECT 0 AS bucket_start
   UNION ALL
   SELECT bucket_start + 5000
   FROM bucket_cte
   WHERE bucket_start + 5000 <= 20000
),

distinct_reasons AS (
   SELECT DISTINCT r_reason_desc, r_reason_id
   FROM reason
),

filtered_join AS (
   SELECT
       wr.wr_return_quantity,
       wr.wr_return_amt,
       wr.wr_return_tax,
       wr.wr_net_loss,
       wr.wr_reason_sk,
       r.r_reason_desc,
       r.r_reason_id,
       map(
           array['quantity','amount'],
           array[CAST(wr.wr_return_quantity AS double), CAST(wr.wr_return_amt AS double)]
       ) AS metrics_map
   FROM web_returns wr
   JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
   WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
     AND wr.wr_return_amt > 0
     AND wr.wr_net_loss > 0
     AND wr.wr_return_tax BETWEEN 0 AND 1000
     AND r.r_reason_id LIKE 'AAAAAAA%'
     AND r.r_reason_desc IS NOT NULL
),

unnested_metrics AS (
   SELECT
       f.r_reason_desc,
       f.r_reason_id,
       f.wr_return_quantity,
       f.wr_return_amt,
       mt.key   AS metric_name,
       CAST(mt.value AS double) AS metric_value,
       f.wr_net_loss
   FROM filtered_join f
   CROSS JOIN UNNEST(f.metrics_map) AS mt (key, value)
),

agg_per_reason_metric AS (
   SELECT
       u.r_reason_desc,
       u.r_reason_id,
       u.metric_name,
       SUM(u.metric_value)                     AS total_metric,
       COUNT(*)                                 AS cnt_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.wr_return_quantity)    AS distinct_qty,
       SUM(u.wr_net_loss)                      AS total_net_loss
   FROM unnested_metrics u
   GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
       (u.r_reason_desc, u.r_reason_id, u.metric_name),
       (u.r_reason_desc, u.r_reason_id),
       ()
   )
),

final AS (
   SELECT
       a.r_reason_desc,
       a.r_reason_id,
       a.metric_name,
       a.total_metric,
       a.cnt_rows,
       a.distinct_qty,
       a.total_net_loss,
       CASE WHEN a.total_metric > (
                SELECT MAX(total_metric) FROM agg_per_reason_metric
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                                      AS is_max_total_metric,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_metric DESC)                    AS metric_rank,
       SUM(a.total_metric) OVER ()                                   AS grand_total_metric
   FROM agg_per_reason_metric a
   LEFT JOIN distinct_reasons dr
       ON a.r_reason_desc = dr.r_reason_desc
      AND a.r_reason_id   = dr.r_reason_id
   WHERE a.total_metric IS NOT NULL
     AND a.total_metric > 0
),

bucketed_final AS (
   SELECT
       f.r_reason_desc,
       f.r_reason_id,
       f.metric_name,
       f.total_metric,
       f.cnt_rows,
       f.distinct_qty,
       f.total_net_loss,
       f.is_max_total_metric,
       f.metric_rank,
       f.grand_total_metric,
       b.bucket_start
   FROM final f
   JOIN bucket_cte b
       ON f.total_metric >= b.bucket_start
      AND f.total_metric <  b.bucket_start + 5000
)
SELECT
   bf.r_reason_desc,
   bf.r_reason_id,
   bf.metric_name,
   bf.total_metric,
   bf.cnt_rows,
   bf.distinct_qty,
   bf.total_net_loss,
   bf.is_max_total_metric,
   bf.metric_rank,
   bf.grand_total_metric,
   bf.bucket_start
FROM bucketed_final bf
WHERE bf.is_max_total_metric = 1
   OR bf.metric_rank <= 10
ORDER BY bf.total_metric DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
  sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
      ws.ws_ship_customer_sk,
      ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
      ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
      ws.ws_web_page_sk,
      ws.ws_web_site_sk,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
      SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
      AVG(ws.ws_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY
      ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
      ws.ws_ship_customer_sk,
      ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
      ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
      ws.ws_web_page_sk,
      ws.ws_web_site_sk
  ),
  union_customers AS (
    SELECT cust.c_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, 'MaleGroup' AS grp
    FROM customer cust
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
      ON cust.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'M'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cust.c_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, 'FemaleGroup' AS grp
    FROM customer cust
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
      ON cust.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F'
  ),
  ws_unnested AS (
    SELECT
      sa.*,
      metric,
      val
    FROM sales_agg sa
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY['total_net_profit','total_quantity','avg_ext_tax']) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(metric, idx)
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[
        CAST(sa.total_net_profit AS double),
        CAST(sa.total_quantity AS double),
        CAST(sa.avg_ext_tax AS double)
      ]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(val, idx2)
    WHERE idx = idx2
  )
SELECT
  ws_un.metric,
  ws_un.val AS metric_value,
  ws_un.total_net_profit,
  ws_un.total_quantity,
  ws_un.avg_ext_tax,
  ws.web_site_id,
  ws.web_name,
  cust_bill.c_customer_id,
  cust_bill.c_first_name,
  cust_bill.c_last_name,
  cd_bill.cd_gender AS billing_gender,
  cd_ship.cd_gender AS shipping_gender,
  CASE
    WHEN ws_un.total_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'High'
    WHEN ws_un.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS profit_tier,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk) AS total_returns,
  (SELECT uc.grp FROM union_customers uc WHERE uc.c_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk LIMIT 1) AS customer_group,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.web_site_id ORDER BY ws_un.total_net_profit DESC) AS site_rank
FROM ws_unnested ws_un
JOIN customer cust_bill
  ON ws_un.ws_bill_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer cust_ship
  ON ws_un.ws_ship_customer_sk = cust_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
  ON ws_un.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
  ON ws_un.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp
  ON ws_un.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site ws
  ON ws_un.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk
JOIN customer cust_wp
  ON wp.wp_customer_sk = cust_wp.c_customer_sk
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret
      ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk
      AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 10
)
ORDER BY ws.web_site_id, site_rank

SELECT 
  base.t_hour,
  base.t_am_pm,
  base.i_brand,
  base.i_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT base.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN base.ss_quantity > 0 THEN base.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS total_store_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN base.ws_quantity > 0 THEN base.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS total_web_sales,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN base.ss_quantity > 0 THEN base.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) +
   SUM(CASE WHEN base.ws_quantity > 0 THEN base.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END)) AS combined_sales,
  AVG(CASE WHEN base.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN base.ws_net_paid END) AS avg_preferred_net_paid,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN base.ws_quantity > 0 THEN base.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) >
         SUM(CASE WHEN base.ss_quantity > 0 THEN base.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'Web > Store'
    ELSE 'Store >= Web'
  END AS sales_channel_comparison,
  (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit)
   FROM store_sales ss2
   WHERE ss2.ss_sold_time_sk IN (
       SELECT t2.t_time_sk
       FROM time_dim t2
       WHERE t2.t_hour = base.t_hour
         AND t2.t_am_pm = base.t_am_pm
   )
  ) AS avg_store_profit_by_hour
FROM (
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      ws.ws_order_number,
      ws.ws_quantity,
      ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
      ws.ws_net_paid,
      ws.ws_net_profit,
      sm.sm_type,
      td.t_time_sk,
      td.t_hour,
      td.t_am_pm,
      i.i_brand,
      i.i_category,
      i.i_product_name,
      p.p_promo_name,
      p.p_discount_active,
      c.c_customer_sk,
      c.c_birth_country,
      c.c_birth_year,
      c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
      cd.cd_gender,
      cd.cd_marital_status,
      wp.wp_autogen_flag,
      wp.wp_char_count,
      wsite.web_name,
      ss.ss_quantity AS ss_quantity,
      ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS ss_ext_sales_price,
      ss.ss_net_paid AS ss_net_paid,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS ss_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_country IN ('KOREA', 'CHILE', 'URUGUAY')
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1995
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
  )
  SELECT * FROM base
) base
GROUP BY
  base.t_hour,
  base.t_am_pm,
  base.i_brand,
  base.i_category
ORDER BY combined_sales DESC

WITH store_return_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_customer_sk) AS unique_customers,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
        SUM(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(r.r_reason_desc, '(?i)damage') THEN sr.sr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS damage_net_loss,
        MAX(REGEXP_EXTRACT(r.r_reason_desc, '(\\d+)')) AS extracted_reason_code
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_returns sr ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE s.s_city LIKE 'A%'
      AND d.d_year = 2020
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 50000
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10000
)
SELECT
    srs.s_store_id,
    srs.s_store_name,
    CONCAT(srs.s_city, ', ', srs.s_state) AS store_location,
    srs.unique_customers,
    srs.total_net_loss,
    srs.avg_net_loss,
    srs.damage_net_loss,
    srs.extracted_reason_code,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = srs.s_store_sk
          AND d2.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2023-12-31') AS returns_2023_count
FROM store_return_stats srs
ORDER BY srs.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

   JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_ref

   JOIN customer_address ca_wr_ret
       ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_wr_ret.ca_address_sk
   JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_ret
       ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ret.cd_demo_sk
   LEFT JOIN date_dim d_p_start

   LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ss_date
       ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss_date.d_date_sk
),
filtered AS (
   SELECT *
   FROM base
   WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 1917
     AND sm_type = 'AIR'
     AND p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
agg AS (
   SELECT
      d_year,
      d_month_seq,
      s_store_id,
      CASE WHEN p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_channel,
      SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
      SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
      SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns,
      SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
   FROM filtered
   GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
      (d_year, d_month_seq, s_store_id, CASE WHEN p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' ELSE 'Other' END),
      (d_year, d_month_seq, s_store_id),
      (d_year, d_month_seq),
      (d_year)
   )
)
SELECT *
FROM (
   SELECT
      d_year,
      d_month_seq,
      s_store_id,
      promo_channel,
      total_sales,
      total_profit,
      total_catalog_returns,
      total_store_returns,
      total_web_returns,
      distinct_tickets,
      total_sales / NULLIF(distinct_tickets, 0) AS avg_sales_per_ticket
   FROM agg
   WHERE total_sales > 1000
      OR total_profit > 500
      OR total_catalog_returns > 100
) a
EXCEPT
SELECT
   d_year,
   d_month_seq,
   s_store_id,
   promo_channel,
   total_sales,
   total_profit,
   total_catalog_returns,
   total_store_returns,
   total_web_returns,

   total_sales / NULLIF(distinct_tickets, 0) AS avg_sales_per_tic

WITH all_data AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        t_ss.t_hour,
        t_ss.t_am_pm,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_current_price,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        r.reason_desc AS return_reason,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            WHEN cr.cr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 2
            WHEN wr.wr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END AS return_type,
        COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    WHERE i.i_current_price > 100
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (5, 6, 7)
      AND t_ss.t_am_pm = 'PM'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= 500
),
sales_only AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_brand,
        s_store_name,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS ship_mode,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS return_reason,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit,
        SUM(total_net_loss) AS net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        0 AS return_type_flag
    FROM all_data
    WHERE return_type = 0
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_brand, s_store_name)
),
returns_aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_brand,
        s_store_name,
        ship_mode_type AS ship_mode,
        return_reason,
        0 AS profit,
        SUM(total_net_loss) AS net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        return_type AS return_type_flag
    FROM all_data
    WHERE return_type <> 0
    GROUP BY CUBE (i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, ship_mode_type, return_reason, return_type)
)
SELECT
    category,
    brand,
    store,
    ship_mode,
    return_reason,
    profit,
    net_loss,
    txn_count,
    return_type_flag,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    SUM(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS category_net_loss_total
FROM (
    SELECT
        i_category AS category,
        i_brand AS brand,
        s_store_name AS store,
        ship_mode,
        return_reason,
        profit,

WITH unioned AS (
    -- First SELECT for year 2000
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS store_id,
        s.s_state AS store_state,
        p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
        d_common.d_year AS year,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        ib.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower_bound,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS catalog_sales_amount,

    FROM

        JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk

        JOIN catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_common.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
