WITH RECURSIVE date_range(cur_date, max_date) AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.d_date) AS cur_date, MAX(d.d_date) AS max_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cur_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY, max_date
    FROM date_range
    WHERE cur_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY <= max_date
),
sales_union AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS sales_date,
        'store' AS channel,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
        s.s_state AS state
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS sales_date,
        'web' AS channel,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ws_site.web_state AS state
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dr.cur_date AS sales_date,
        COALESCE(su.channel, 'NoSales') AS channel,
        COALESCE(su.state, 'UNKNOWN') AS state,
        COALESCE(SUM(su.net_paid), 0) AS total_net_paid,
        COALESCE(SUM(su.net_profit), 0) AS total_net_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(SUM(su.net_profit), 0) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
            WHEN COALESCE(SUM(su.net_profit), 0) < 0 THEN 'Negative'
            ELSE 'Zero'
        END AS profit_status
    FROM date_range dr
    LEFT JOIN sales_union su ON su.sales_date = dr.cur_date
    GROUP BY dr.cur_date, su.channel, su.state
)
SELECT
    sales_date,
    channel,
    state,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    profit_status
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY sales_date DESC, channel, state
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk                AS date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_color,
        i.i_current_price,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        ca.ca_state,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        wr.wr_return_quantity                AS wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt                     AS wr_return_amt,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand              AS inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON d.d_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE i.i_color = 'red'
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High'
      AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
),
agg1 AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_category,
        w_warehouse_name,
        SUM(cr_return_amount)    AS sum_cr_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS sum_cr_return_qty,
        SUM(wr_return_amt)      AS sum_wr_return_amt,
        SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS sum_wr_return_qty,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS sum_inventory_qty
    FROM base
    GROUP BY d_year, i_category, w_warehouse_name
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_category,
    w_warehouse_name,
    sum_cr_return_amount,
    sum_cr_return_qty,
    sum_wr_return_amt,
    sum_wr_return_qty,
    sum_inventory_qty,
    (sum_cr_return_amount + sum_wr_return_amt) / NULLIF(sum_inventory_qty, 0) AS amt_per_inventory_ratio
FROM agg1
HAVING sum_cr_return_amount > 1000
ORDER BY sum_cr_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hours AS (
    SELECT t_time_sk, t_hour
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_hour = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT td.t_time_sk, td.t_hour
    FROM hours h
    JOIN time_dim td ON td.t_hour = h.t_hour + 1
    WHERE h.t_hour < 23
),
addr_parts AS (
    SELECT
        ca_address_sk,
        ca_city,
        ca_state,
        ARRAY[ca_city, ca_state] AS city_state_arr
    FROM customer_address
),
store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk AS return_time_sk,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        ap.city_state_arr
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN addr_parts ap ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ap.ca_address_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
),
web_ret AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk AS return_time_sk,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        ap.city_state_arr
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN addr_parts ap ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ap.ca_address_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
),
combined_returns AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_ret
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_ret
)
SELECT
    cr.return_date_sk,
    cr.return_time_sk,
    cr.c_first_name,
    cr.c_last_name,
    cr.reason_desc,
    cr.net_loss,
    loc_part AS location_component,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM combined_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.c_customer_sk = cr.c_customer_sk
          AND cr2.return_date_sk = cr.return_date_sk
    ) AS daily_return_count
FROM combined_returns cr
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cr.city_state_arr) AS t(loc_part)
JOIN time_dim td ON cr.return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN hours h ON td.t_hour = h.t_hour
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss2
    WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = cr.c_customer_sk
      AND ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = cr.return_date_sk
)
GROUP BY
    cr.return_date_sk,
    cr.return_time_sk,
    cr.c_first_name,
    cr.c_last_name,
    cr.reason_desc,
    cr.net_loss,
    loc_part
HAVING SUM(cr.net_loss) > 1000
ORDER BY cr.return_date_sk DESC, cr.return_time_sk ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = (SELECT MIN(d2.d_date) FROM date_dim d2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next ON d_next.d_date = date_add('day', 1, ds.d_date)
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
           ss.ss_sold_time_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_time_sk
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store_sales_agg sa
    WHERE sa.d_date_sk NOT IN (
        SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 5000
    )
),
catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_cr_return_amount,
           SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_cr_net_loss,
           COUNT(*) AS cr_return_cnt,
           cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
           cr.cr_reason_sk,
           cr.cr_returned_time_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk, cr.cr_returned_time_sk
),
web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_wr_return_amount,
           SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_wr_net_loss,
           COUNT(*) AS wr_return_cnt,
           wr.wr_web_page_sk,
           wr.wr_reason_sk,
           wr.wr_returned_time_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk, wr.wr_reason_sk, wr.wr_returned_time_sk
),
items_without_returns AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk FROM store_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cr_item_sk FROM catalog_returns
)
SELECT
    ds.d_date,
    ds.d_year,
    ds.d_month_seq,
    fs.total_sales,
    fs.total_profit,
    fs.sales_cnt,
    cr_agg.total_cr_return_amount,
    cr_agg.total_cr_net_loss,
    cr_agg.cr_return_cnt,
    wr_agg.total_wr_return_amount,
    wr_agg.total_wr_net_loss,
    wr_agg.wr_return_cnt,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_city,
    w.w_state,
    w.w_zip,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    tr.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_without_returns) AS total_items_without_returns
FROM date_series ds
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk, cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS cr_demo
LEFT JOIN filtered_store_sales fs ON ds.d_date_sk = fs.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns_agg cr_agg ON ds.d_date_sk = cr_agg.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns_agg wr_agg ON ds.d_date_sk = wr_agg.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cr_agg.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN reason tr ON cr_agg.cr_reason_sk = tr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr_agg.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sa ON fs.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sa.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr_agg.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr_demo.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr_demo.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE ds.d_year = 1999
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 3 AND 7
  AND t_sa.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
ORDER BY ds.d_date DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT 2451000 AS d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date_sk + 1 FROM date_seq WHERE d_date_sk < 2451005
),
stores_no_return AS (
    SELECT ss_store_sk AS s_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT sr_store_sk
    FROM store_returns
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_seq)
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    d_sales.d_year,
    d_closed.d_year AS closed_year,
    p.p_promo_name,
    cp_start.cp_department,
    cp_end.cp_department AS end_department,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    SUM(sa.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(sa.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    SUM(sa.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    CASE WHEN SUM(sa.ss_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS return_ticket_count,
    MAX(inv_l.total_inventory) AS total_inventory,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS web_return_order_count
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN date_dim d_sales ON sa.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON sa.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d_closed ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
JOIN promotion p ON sa.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON sa.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp_start ON cp_start.cp_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp_end ON cp_end.cp_end_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = sa.ss_ticket_number
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory
    FROM inventory inv2
    WHERE inv2.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
) AS inv_l
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr_excl
    WHERE sr_excl.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
)
AND s.s_store_sk IN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM stores_no_return)
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    d_sales.d_year,
    d_closed.d_year,
    p.p_promo_name,
    cp_start.cp_department,
    cp_end.cp_department,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ib.ib_lower_bound
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_range AS (
    SELECT 1000 AS t_time_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t_time_sk + 1 FROM time_range WHERE t_time_sk < 1010
),
catalog_sales_summary AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        'Catalog' AS source,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS revenue,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS rn
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_range tr ON td.t_time_sk = tr.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 18
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 1000
),
store_returns_summary AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        'StoreReturn' AS source,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS revenue,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS profit,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_range tr ON td.t_time_sk = tr.t_time_sk
    WHERE r.r_reason_id LIKE 'AAAAAAA%'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 18
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 500
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_item_desc,
    source,
    revenue,
    profit,
    num_transactions,
    rn
FROM (
    SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, source, revenue, profit, num_transactions, rn
    FROM catalog_sales_summary
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, source, revenue, profit, num_transactions, rn
    FROM store_returns_summary
) combined
ORDER BY revenue DESC, profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH agg_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss_ticket_number,
        SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM tpcds.store_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2452000
    GROUP BY ss_ticket_number
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    SUM(ssagg.total_net_paid) AS sum_store_sales_net_paid,
    SUM(ssagg.total_net_profit) AS sum_store_sales_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS sum_return_net_loss,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sum_catalog_net_profit,
    (SUM(ssagg.total_net_profit) - SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) + SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)) AS total_net_gain,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_coupon_amt)
     FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs2
     WHERE cs2.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS avg_coupon_amt
FROM
    agg_store_sales ssagg
JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
    ON ssagg.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN tpcds.customer c
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE
    c.c_birth_year > 1970
    AND sr.sr_return_amt > 100
    AND cs.cs_coupon_amt > 200
GROUP BY ROLLUP (c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name)
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id NULLS LAST,
    total_net_gain DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        SUM(cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost > 30.0
      AND cs_coupon_amt < 2000.0
      AND cs_ext_tax > 20.0
      AND cs_quantity >= 1
    GROUP BY cs_warehouse_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs_net_paid) > 10000.0
),
warehouse_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        w_warehouse_sk,
        w_warehouse_id,
        w_warehouse_name,
        w_city,
        w_state,
        w_warehouse_sq_ft,
        w_county,
        w_country,
        w_gmt_offset
    FROM tpcds.warehouse
    WHERE w_country = 'United States'
      AND w_state IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX', 'IL')
      AND w_warehouse_sq_ft > 5000
      AND w_county LIKE '%County'
)

SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_city,
    wa.total_net_paid,
    wa.avg_ext_tax,
    wa.total_coupon_amt,
    wa.sales_cnt,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cs.cs_ext_tax)
        FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        WHERE cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
          AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = (
                SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_sold_date_sk)
                FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs2
                WHERE cs2.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
          )
    ) AS max_ext_tax_recent
FROM warehouse_filtered w
JOIN sales_agg wa ON wa.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE wa.total_net_paid > 50000.0
  AND w.w_city NOT LIKE 'A%'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_city,
    wa.total_net_paid,
    wa.avg_ext_tax,
    wa.total_coupon_amt,
    wa.sales_cnt,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cs.cs_ext_tax)
        FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        WHERE cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
          AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = (
                SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_sold_date_sk)
                FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs2
                WHERE cs2.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
          )
    ) AS max_ext_tax_recent
FROM warehouse_filtered w
JOIN sales_agg wa ON wa.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE wa.total_net_paid <= 50000.0
  AND w.w_city LIKE 'A%'
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_flags AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status,
        p.p_response_target
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_response_target > 0
)
SELECT
    ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_key,
    d.d_date AS sold_date,
    s.s_store_name AS location_name,
    i.i_item_id AS item_id,
    i.i_product_name AS product_name,
    ss.ss_quantity AS quantity,
    ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price,
    CASE WHEN ss.ss_coupon_amt > 0 THEN 'Coupon' ELSE 'No Coupon' END AS coupon_flag,
    pf.promo_status AS promo_status,
    l.max_net_paid AS max_net_paid
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promo_flags pf ON ss.ss_promo_sk = pf.p_promo_sk
WHERE ss.ss_net_paid > 1000
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer c
        WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
          AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    )
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT max(ss2.ss_net_paid) AS max_net_paid
    FROM store_sales ss2
    WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
) l
UNION ALL
SELECT
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_key,
    d.d_date AS sold_date,
    cc.cc_name AS location_name,
    i.i_item_id AS item_id,
    i.i_product_name AS product_name,
    cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
    cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price,
    CASE WHEN cs.cs_coupon_amt > 0 THEN 'Coupon' ELSE 'No Coupon' END AS coupon_flag,
    pf.promo_status AS promo_status,
    l.max_net_paid AS max_net_paid
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promo_flags pf ON cs.cs_promo_sk = pf.p_promo_sk
WHERE cs.cs_net_paid > 1000
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer c
        WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
          AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    )
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT max(cs2.cs_net_paid) AS max_net_paid
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
) l
ORDER BY sold_date DESC, max_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk               AS c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name                AS c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name                 AS c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address             AS c_email_address,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)         AS total_catalog_profit,
        COUNT(*)                      AS catalog_order_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(c.c_first_name, '^A')
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 5000
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM catalog_returns cr
           WHERE cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
       )
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk               AS c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name                AS c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name                 AS c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address             AS c_email_address,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)         AS total_web_profit,
        COUNT(*)                      AS web_order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_last_name LIKE 'S%'
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 5000
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM web_returns wr
           WHERE wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
       )
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.c_customer_sk,
        ca.c_first_name,
        ca.c_last_name,
        ca.c_email_address,
        ca.total_catalog_profit,
        ca.catalog_order_cnt,
        NULL                           AS total_web_profit,
        NULL                           AS web_order_cnt
    FROM catalog_agg ca
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        wa.c_customer_sk,
        wa.c_first_name,
        wa.c_last_name,
        wa.c_email_address,
        NULL                           AS total_catalog_profit,
        NULL                           AS catalog_order_cnt,
        wa.total_web_profit,
        wa.web_order_cnt
    FROM web_agg wa
)
SELECT
    CONCAT(comb.c_first_name, ' ', comb.c_last_name)                         AS full_name,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(comb.c_email_address, '^([^@]+)')                         AS email_user,
    COALESCE(comb.total_catalog_profit, 0) + COALESCE(comb.total_web_profit, 0) AS total_profit,
    COALESCE(comb.catalog_order_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(comb.web_order_cnt, 0)   AS total_orders,
    SUBSTRING(comb.c_first_name, 1, 1)                                      AS first_initial,
    (
        SELECT AVG(p.total_profit)
        FROM (
            SELECT COALESCE(total_catalog_profit, 0) + COALESCE(total_web_profit, 0) AS total_profit
            FROM combined
        ) p
    )                                                                        AS avg_total_profit,
    t.num
FROM combined comb
CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) AS t(num)
WHERE COALESCE(comb.total_catalog_profit, 0) + COALESCE(comb.total_web_profit, 0) > (
        SELECT AVG(p.total_profit)
        FROM (
            SELECT COALESCE(total_catalog_profit, 0) + COALESCE(total_web_profit, 0) AS total_profit
            FROM combined
        ) p
    )
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
  SELECT (SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales) AS sales_date_sk,
         (SELECT MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales) AS max_sales_date_sk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sales_date_sk + 1, max_sales_date_sk
  FROM date_series
  WHERE sales_date_sk + 1 <= max_sales_date_sk
),
sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    ss.ss_net_profit,
    ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
    st.s_store_id,
    st.s_store_name,
    st.s_city,
    st.s_state,
    p.p_promo_name,
    regexp_extract(p.p_promo_name, '([0-9]{2,4})', 1) AS promo_code
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_series ds ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ds.sales_date_sk
  JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '[0-9]{2,4}')
    AND st.s_store_name LIKE 'Store %'
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    concat(s_store_name, ' - ', s_city, ', ', s_state) AS store_full_name,
    promo_code,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
FROM sales_filtered
GROUP BY s_store_id, s_store_name, s_city, s_state, promo_code
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_sk,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_quantity > 5 THEN 'HighQty' ELSE 'LowQty' END AS qty_bucket,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
    MIN(cr.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
    MAX(cr.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee,
    (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk) AS avg_return_amount_by_warehouse
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN customer_address ca_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
  JOIN warehouse w
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  JOIN inventory i
    ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE
    cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax > 500
    AND cr.cr_fee < 30
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%price%'
    AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    AND ca_refunded.ca_country = 'United States'
  GROUP BY ROLLUP (w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, r.r_reason_desc,
    CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_quantity > 5 THEN 'HighQty' ELSE 'LowQty' END)
)
SELECT
  agg.w_warehouse_name,
  agg.r_reason_desc,
  agg.qty_bucket,
  agg.distinct_orders,
  agg.total_return_amount,
  agg.avg_return_amount,
  agg.min_return_amount,
  agg.max_return_amount,
  agg.total_fee,
  agg.avg_return_amount_by_warehouse,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY agg.total_return_amount DESC) AS warehouse_rank
FROM agg
WHERE agg.total_return_amount > (
    SELECT AVG(a2.total_return_amount)
    FROM agg a2
    WHERE a2.w_warehouse_name = agg.w_warehouse_name
  )
ORDER BY agg.w_warehouse_name ASC, agg.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE
inv_base AS (
    SELECT
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inv_warehouse_sk) AS rn
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
),
inventory_cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        total_quantity,
        total_quantity AS cum_quantity,
        rn
    FROM inv_base
    WHERE rn = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        b.inv_warehouse_sk,
        b.total_quantity,
        ic.cum_quantity + b.total_quantity AS cum_quantity,
        b.rn
    FROM inv_base b
    JOIN inventory_cumulative ic ON b.rn = ic.rn + 1
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        ic.cum_quantity,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_image_count,
        wp.wp_char_count,
        wp.wp_rec_start_date,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM inventory_cumulative ic
    JOIN warehouse w ON ic.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        w.w_warehouse_name = 'Plain'
        AND wp.wp_image_count >= 5
        AND wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        w_warehouse_sk,
        w_warehouse_name,
        cum_quantity,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY w_warehouse_sk, w_warehouse_name, cum_quantity
    HAVING SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) > 10000
)
SELECT
    w_warehouse_sk,
    w_warehouse_name,
    cum_quantity,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    avg_profit,
    sales_transactions
FROM final_agg
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE
    date_range_jan AS (
        SELECT DATE '2021-01-01' AS d_date
        UNION ALL
        SELECT date_add('day', 1, d_date) FROM date_range_jan WHERE d_date < DATE '2021-01-31'
    ),
    date_range_feb AS (
        SELECT DATE '2021-02-01' AS d_date
        UNION ALL
        SELECT date_add('day', 1, d_date) FROM date_range_feb WHERE d_date < DATE '2021-02-28'
    )
SELECT
    customer_id,
    sales_year,
    total_sales,
    promo_count,
    store_count,
    total_return_amount,
    last_purchase_date
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        d.d_year AS sales_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS promo_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS store_count,
        (SELECT SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)
         FROM store_returns sr
         WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS total_return_amount,
        (SELECT MAX(d2.d_date)
         FROM date_dim d2
         JOIN store_sales ss2 ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
         WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS last_purchase_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_range_jan drj ON drj.d_date = d.d_date
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr
            WHERE cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        )
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr
            WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0
        )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, d.d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        d.d_year AS sales_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS promo_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS store_count,
        (SELECT SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)
         FROM store_returns sr
         WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS total_return_amount,
        (SELECT MAX(d2.d_date)
         FROM date_dim d2
         JOIN store_sales ss2 ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
         WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS last_purchase_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_range_feb drf ON drf.d_date = d.d_date
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr
            WHERE cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        )
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr
            WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0
        )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, d.d_year
) AS combined
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE month_series AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_month_seq = (
          SELECT MIN(d2.d_month_seq)
          FROM tpcds.date_dim d2
          WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d_next.d_date_sk,
        d_next.d_date,
        d_next.d_year,
        d_next.d_month_seq
    FROM month_series ms
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_next
        ON d_next.d_date = date_add('month', 1, ms.d_date)
    WHERE d_next.d_year = 2001
)
SELECT
    ms.d_year,
    ms.d_month_seq,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    CONCAT(i.i_color, '-', i.i_size) AS color_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) AS promo_discount_total,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_zip LIKE '7%' THEN cs.cs_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit_zip_start_7
FROM month_series ms
JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ms.d_date_sk
JOIN tpcds.item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
WHERE
    REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '\\d{3}')
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
          AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ms.d_date_sk
    )
GROUP BY
    ms.d_year,
    ms.d_month_seq,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_color,
    i.i_size
ORDER BY
    ms.d_year,
    ms.d_month_seq,
    total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH per_income_band AS (
    SELECT
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        COUNT(hd.hd_demo_sk) AS household_count,
        SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicles,
        AVG(hd.hd_dep_count) AS avg_deps
    FROM household_demographics hd
    RIGHT OUTER JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
        AND hd.hd_dep_count BETWEEN 3 AND 8
    WHERE ib.ib_upper_bound <= 70000
    GROUP BY ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
)
SELECT
    ib_income_band_sk,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    household_count,
    total_vehicles,
    avg_deps,
    total_vehicles * 1.0 / NULLIF(household_count, 0) AS vehicles_per_household,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_vehicles DESC) AS vehicle_rank,
    SUM(household_count) OVER (
        ORDER BY total_vehicles DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_households
FROM per_income_band
WHERE household_count > 0
HAVING total_vehicles > 5
    AND avg_deps >= 4
    AND ib_upper_bound >= 40000
ORDER BY total_vehicles DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_list_price > 100
      AND cs.cs_quantity BETWEEN 2 AND 10
      AND cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk IN (5166, 5651, 6126)
      AND cs.cs_call_center_sk IN (40, 25)
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS earliest_sold_date_sk,
    MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS latest_sold_date_sk,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs_sub.cs_net_paid)
        FROM catalog_sales cs_sub
        WHERE cs_sub.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    ) AS avg_net_paid_center,
    MAX(l.max_ext_sales_price_center) AS max_ext_sales_price_center
FROM filtered_sales cs
LEFT JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
   AND cc.cc_sq_ft > 0
   AND cc.cc_hours = '8AM-4PM'
   AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
INNER JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE sm.sm_code = 'AIR'
  AND sm.sm_contract LIKE 'A5%'
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MAX(cs_lat.cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_ext_sales_price_center
    FROM catalog_sales cs_lat
    WHERE cs_lat.cs_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
) AS l
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    cc.cc_call_center_sk
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 50000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH avg_promo AS (
    SELECT avg(p_cost) AS avg_cost
    FROM promotion
)
SELECT store_name,
       year,
       month,
       metric_type,
       total_amount,
       avg_cost
FROM (
    SELECT s.s_store_name AS store_name,
           d.d_year AS year,
           d.d_moy AS month,
           'sales' AS metric_type,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_amount,
           ap.avg_cost
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN avg_promo ap ON TRUE
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2002
      AND s.s_country = 'United States'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p2
          WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
            AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_store_name, d.d_year, d.d_moy), metric_type, ap.avg_cost
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 10000

    UNION ALL

    SELECT s.s_store_name AS store_name,
           d.d_year AS year,
           d.d_moy AS month,
           'returns' AS metric_type,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_amount,
           ap.avg_cost
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN avg_promo ap ON TRUE
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2002
      AND s.s_country = 'United States'
      AND ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_store_name, d.d_year, d.d_moy), metric_type, ap.avg_cost
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 5000
) AS combined
ORDER BY store_name, year, month, metric_type
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT DATE '1998-01-01' AS cur_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cur_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_range
    WHERE cur_date < DATE '1998-06-30'
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CAST('Catalog' AS VARCHAR) AS sales_channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date = dr.cur_date
    INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        WHERE cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
          AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CAST('Web' AS VARCHAR) AS sales_channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date = dr.cur_date
    INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        WHERE cr.cr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
          AND cr.cr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    )
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.i_item_sk,
        ca.i_item_id,
        ca.i_item_desc,
        ca.total_profit,
        ca.sales_channel
    FROM catalog_agg ca
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        wa.i_item_sk,
        wa.i_item_id,
        wa.i_item_desc,
        wa.total_profit,
        wa.sales_channel
    FROM web_agg wa
)
SELECT
    c.i_item_id,
    c.i_item_desc,
    c.total_profit,
    c.sales_channel,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = c.i_item_sk
    ) AS total_returns
FROM combined c
WHERE c.total_profit > (
    SELECT AVG(total_profit) * 2
    FROM combined
)
ORDER BY c.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT inv.inv_date_sk,
           SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    GROUP BY inv.inv_date_sk
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_net_paid,
           SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_web_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    d_sold.d_year,
    cp.cp_department,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_net_paid,
    COALESCE(wsa.total_web_net_paid, 0) AS total_web_net_paid,
    COALESCE(ia.total_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS total_quantity_on_hand,
    COALESCE(wsa.total_web_quantity, 0) AS total_web_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cust_bill.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_billing_customers,
    AVG(cs.cs_sales_price) AS avg_catalog_sales_price
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer cust_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer cust_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = cust_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory_agg ia ON ia.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales_agg wsa ON wsa.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
                              AND wsa.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
GROUP BY s.s_store_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, d_sold.d_year, cp.cp_department
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 1000000
ORDER BY total_catalog_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE fy_years AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_fy_year) AS fy_year
    FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fy_year + 1
    FROM fy_years
    WHERE fy_year < (SELECT MAX(d_fy_year) FROM date_dim)
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT d.d_fy_year AS fy_year,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS metric,
           'web_sales' AS source,
           MIN(regexp_extract(wp.wp_url, '^https?://([^/]+)', 1)) AS domain
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(wp.wp_url, '^https?://www\\.[a-z]+\\.com')
          AND wp.wp_type LIKE 'A%'
    GROUP BY d.d_fy_year
),
store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT d.d_fy_year AS fy_year,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS metric,
           'store_returns' AS source,
           CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS domain
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE s.s_store_name LIKE '%Store%'
          AND regexp_like(s.s_state, '^[A-Z]{2}$')
    GROUP BY d.d_fy_year
),
combined_metrics AS (
    SELECT fy_year, metric, source, domain FROM web_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fy_year, metric, source, domain FROM store_returns_agg
)
SELECT 
    cm.fy_year,
    CONCAT('FY ', CAST(cm.fy_year AS VARCHAR)) AS fiscal_year_label,
    cm.source,
    cm.metric,
    cm.domain,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cm.fy_year, cm.source) AS rn,
    SUBSTRING(cm.source, 1, 3) AS src_abbrev,
    (SELECT AVG(metric) FROM combined_metrics cm2 WHERE cm2.source = cm.source) AS avg_metric_for_source,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM promotion p
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON p.p_start_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_fy_year = cm.fy_year
          AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    ) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS promo_active_in_year
FROM combined_metrics cm
JOIN fy_years f ON cm.fy_year = f.fy_year
WHERE cm.metric > 0
ORDER BY cm.fy_year, cm.source, rn

WITH sales_union AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax AS net_paid,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AS bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk AS ship_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk AS ship_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk AS bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_addr_sk AS ship_addr_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS web_page_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
)
SELECT
    p.promo_name,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    t.t_hour,
    ib.ib_income_band_sk,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    SUM(s.net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    AVG(s.quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bill_cust.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_bill_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ship_cust.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_ship_customers
FROM sales_union s
JOIN time_dim t
    ON s.sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON s.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON s.ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON s.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer bill_cust
    ON s.bill_customer_sk = bill_cust.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer ship_cust
    ON s.ship_customer_sk = ship_cust.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON s.web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN customer wp_cust
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = wp_cust.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON s.bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ship
    ON s.ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON s.bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON s.ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
    ON s.bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
    ON s.ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE ib.ib_upper_bound >= 150000
GROUP BY p.promo_name, sm.sm_type, t.t_hour, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amt
  FROM store_returns
),
high_estimate_returns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.d_year,
    cd.cd_gender,
    CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category,
    sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
    c.c_customer_id
  FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
  JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 5000
    AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1998
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM customer_demographics cd_cur
      WHERE cd_cur.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
        AND cd_cur.cd_gender = 'M'
    )
),
low_estimate_returns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.d_year,
    cd.cd_gender,
    CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category,
    sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
    c.c_customer_id
  FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
  JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate <= 5000
    AND d.d_year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1998
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(u.d_year, -1) AS year,
  COALESCE(u.cd_gender, 'All') AS gender,
  COALESCE(u.return_category, 'All') AS return_category,
  SUM(u.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
  ROUND(AVG(u.sr_return_amt_inc_tax), 2) AS avg_return_amount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
  CASE WHEN SUM(u.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) > overall.avg_return_amt THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS return_vs_overall_avg,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(u.return_category) = 0 THEN 'Detail' ELSE 'Subtotal' END AS level
FROM (
  SELECT d_year, cd_gender, return_category, sr_return_amt_inc_tax, c_customer_id
  FROM high_estimate_returns
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d_year, cd_gender, return_category, sr_return_amt_inc_tax, c_customer_id
  FROM low_estimate_returns
) u
CROSS JOIN overall_avg overall
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  (u.d_year, u.cd_gender, u.return_category),
  (u.d_year, u.cd_gender),
  (u.d_year),
  ()
)
ORDER BY year DESC, gender, return_category

WITH sales_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
item_sales AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_product_name, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_brand = 'Brand#12'
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    ws.web_site_id,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_catalog_discount,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_store_discount,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM promotion p3
        WHERE p3.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM date_dim d3
              WHERE d3.d_date_sk = p3.p_start_date_sk
                AND d3.d_year = d.d_year
          )
    ) AS promo_count_in_year
FROM
    catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN sales_dates d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN item_sales i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE
    w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND cc.cc_city = 'Glendale'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND cs.cs_quantity >= 5
    AND ss.ss_quantity >= 2
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_page wp
        WHERE wp.wp_web_page_id = 'wp_12345'
          AND wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    ws.web_site_id,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    d.d_year
ORDER BY
    total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE year_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS yr FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT yr + 1 FROM year_range WHERE yr < (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
        'sales' AS source,
        (SELECT avg(i2.i_current_price) FROM item i2) AS avg_item_price,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS sales_category,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv
            WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        ) AS in_stock
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN year_range y ON d.d_year = y.yr
    GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_item_id
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 1000
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_returns,
        COUNT(*) AS returns_cnt,
        'returns' AS source,
        (SELECT avg(i2.i_current_price) FROM item i2) AS avg_item_price,
        CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 5000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS returns_category,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv
            WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        ) AS in_stock
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN year_range y ON d.d_year = y.yr
    GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_item_id
    HAVING SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 500
)
SELECT
    combined.year,
    combined.item_id,
    combined.source,
    combined.category,
    combined.returns_category,
    combined.avg_item_price,
    combined.in_stock,
    combined.metric_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY combined.year ORDER BY combined.metric_amount DESC) AS rn
FROM (
    SELECT
        year,
        item_id,
        source,
        sales_category AS category,
        NULL AS returns_category,
        avg_item_price,
        in_stock,
        total_sales AS metric_amount
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        year,
        item_id,
        source,
        NULL AS category,
        returns_category,
        avg_item_price,
        in_stock,
        total_returns AS metric_amount
    FROM returns_agg
) AS combined
ORDER BY combined.year DESC, rn
LIMIT 100

WITH site_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_site_id,
        ws.web_name,
        ws.web_gmt_offset,
        d_open.d_year AS open_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(wp.wp_char_count) AS total_char_count,
        AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_per_page,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM web_page wp2
            WHERE wp2.wp_creation_date_sk = ws.web_open_date_sk
              AND wp2.wp_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
        ) AS recent_pages_on_open_date
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim d_open
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ws.web_gmt_offset BETWEEN -8 AND 0
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 40000
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 150000
      AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
      AND d_open.d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_gmt_offset, d_open.d_year
),
above_avg AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM site_metrics
    WHERE total_char_count > (
        SELECT AVG(total_char_count) FROM site_metrics
    )
),
low_customers AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM site_metrics
    WHERE distinct_customers < 5
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM above_avg
    EXCEPT
    SELECT * FROM low_customers
) result
ORDER BY total_char_count DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    inventory_agg AS (
        SELECT inv_warehouse_sk,
               SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
    ),
    returns_rn AS (
        SELECT sr.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY sr_customer_sk
                   ORDER BY sr_returned_date_sk DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM store_returns sr
    )
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    cd.cd_gender,
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_description,
    sm.sm_type,
    w.w_city,
    w.w_state,
    iag.total_qty_on_hand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    MIN(cr.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
    MAX(cr.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount,
    MAX(rr.rn) AS latest_return_rank,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_sales_price)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS max_customer_sales_price,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND sr2.sr_return_amt > 1000
    ) AS high_value_return_count
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN returns_rn rr
  ON rr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
 AND rr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
  ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN call_center cc
  ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN inventory_agg iag
  ON iag.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
  ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr
  ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_page wp
  ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE
    cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND w.w_country = 'United States'
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
  AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
  AND cr.cr_refunded_cash > 500.00
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    cd.cd_gender,
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_description,
    sm.sm_type,
    w.w_city,
    w.w_state,
    iag.total_qty_on_hand
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_state,
    d.d_year,
    d.d_month_seq,
    p.p_promo_name,
    CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_category,
    ss.ss_net_profit,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    cr.cr_net_loss,
    wr.wr_net_loss,
    c.c_customer_sk,
    ss.ss_quantity,
    d.d_date
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
)
SELECT
  s_state,
  d_year,
  d_month_seq,
  p_promo_name,
  profit_category,
  SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit,
  SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_web_net_profit,
  SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
  SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
  AVG(ss_quantity) AS avg_store_quantity,
  MIN(d_date) AS min_date,
  MAX(d_date) AS max_date
FROM joined_data
GROUP BY ROLLUP (
  s_state,
  d_year,
  d_month_seq,
  p_promo_name,
  CASE WHEN ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END
)
ORDER BY s_state, d_year, d_month_seq, p_promo_name, profit_category

WITH RECURSIVE sales_cte AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_ship_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_call_center_sk,
           cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
           cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity,
           cs.cs_sales_price,
           cs.cs_net_paid,
           cs.cs_order_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_ship_addr_sk,
           cs.cs_call_center_sk,
           cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
           cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
           cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_quantity,
           cs.cs_sales_price,
           cs.cs_net_paid,
           cs.cs_order_number
    FROM sales_cte cs
    WHERE FALSE
)
SELECT 
    i.i_category AS category,
    cp.cp_type AS catalog_type,
    w.w_state AS warehouse_state,
    t.t_hour AS hour_of_day,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    SUM(s.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(s.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(s.cs_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.i_units = 'Case' THEN s.cs_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS case_units_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders
FROM sales_cte s
JOIN time_dim t
    ON s.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON s.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON s.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON s.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON s.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i
    ON s.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = s.cs_order_number
JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
   AND wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE 
    i.i_units = 'Case'
    AND i.i_manager_id = 23
    AND cp.cp_type = 'quarterly'
    AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
GROUP BY 
    i.i_category,
    cp.cp_type,
    w.w_state,
    t.t_hour,
    cc.cc_name
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT 2450000 AS d_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_sk + 1 FROM date_range WHERE d_sk < 2450010
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk                AS date_sk,
        site.web_name                     AS site_name,
        w.w_state                         AS state,
        ca.ca_country                     AS country,
        cp.cp_department                  AS department,
        ws.ws_quantity                    AS ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price             AS ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt            AS ws_ext_discount_amt,
        cr.cr_return_amount               AS cr_return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_amt                  AS sr_return_amt,
        w.w_warehouse_id                  AS w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk                  AS w_warehouse_sk
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_sk
    JOIN web_site site
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_sk
           AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
           AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
           AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_sk
    WHERE
        site.web_tax_percentage = 0.12
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 10
        AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 500
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr_excl
            WHERE sr_excl.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
              AND sr_excl.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
              AND sr_excl.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_sk
        )
),
distinct_warehouses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w_warehouse_id FROM base
),
sales_and_returns AS (
    SELECT
        site_name,
        state,
        'web_sales'        AS src,
        ws_ext_sales_price AS amount,
        ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount,
        1                  AS txn_cnt
    FROM base
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        site_name,
        state,
        'catalog_returns' AS src,
        cr_return_amount  AS amount,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS discount,
        1                 AS txn_cnt
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    site_name,
    state,
    src,
    SUM(amount)            AS total_amount,
    SUM(discount)          AS total_discount,
    SUM(txn_cnt)           AS total_transactions,
    (SELECT AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) FROM base) AS avg_discount_all,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distinct_warehouses) AS distinct_warehouse_cnt
FROM sales_and_returns
GROUP BY ROLLUP (site_name, state, src)
ORDER BY site_name ASC NULLS LAST,
         state ASC NULLS LAST,
         src ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_cs.d_year AS year,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS orders,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS store_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amt,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_quantity,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_quantity,
        AVG(hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count,
        SUM(cs.cs_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_total,
        SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS web_sales_total
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    -- Store returns linked on the same sale date, time, demo, and address
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
        AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
        AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
        AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    -- Web sales linked on the same sale date, time, demo, and address
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site site_ws ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site_ws.web_site_sk
    -- Web returns linked to the corresponding web sale
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        d_cs.d_year = 2001
        AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
        AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
        AND hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count > 1
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 2
    GROUP BY
        d_cs.d_year,
        cc.cc_name,
        p.p_promo_name
)
SELECT
    year,
    call_center,
    promo,
    orders,
    sales_net_profit,
    web_net_profit,
    (sales_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY (sales_net_profit + web_net_profit) DESC) AS revenue_rank,
    (sales_net_profit + web_net_profit) / NULLIF(
        (SELECT SUM(inner.sales_net_profit + inner.web_net_profit)
         FROM sales_agg AS inner
         WHERE inner.year = sales_agg.year),
        0) AS profit_share
FROM sales_agg
WHERE (sales_net_profit + web_net_profit) > (
    SELECT AVG(sales_net_profit + web_net_profit) FROM sales_agg
)
ORDER BY year, revenue_rank

/*
Goal: Aggregate sales, returns, and promotion usage per customer while joining all TPC‑DS tables, reusing dimensions under different aliases, using a scalar subquery and an anti‑join to exclude catalog orders that have a return.
*/
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number)                         AS num_catalog_orders,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)                                         AS total_catalog_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)                                       AS total_catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)                                 AS total_catalog_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id)                               AS distinct_catalog_promotions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm1.sm_ship_mode_id)                         AS distinct_catalog_ship_modes,
    COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt), 0)                         AS total_store_return_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0)                           AS total_web_return_net_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p_ws.p_promo_id)                            AS distinct_web_promotions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm2.sm_ship_mode_id)                         AS distinct_web_ship_modes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id)                          AS distinct_web_pages_visited,
    (SELECT MAX(ws_sub.ws_sold_date_sk)
         FROM web_sales ws_sub
        WHERE ws_sub.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS last_web_sold_date_sk
FROM
    catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm1
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm1.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r_cat
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cat.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm3
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm3.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w2
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm2
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_ws
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p_ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site webs
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = webs.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r_web
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_web.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_store
        ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_store.r_reason_sk
WHERE
    NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr2
         WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    )
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_state
ORDER BY
    total_catalog_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr_call_center_sk,
        cr_returned_date_sk,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_cr_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_cr_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND cr_return_amount > 0
      AND cr_return_tax > 0
    GROUP BY cr_call_center_sk, cr_returned_date_sk
),
distinct_warehouses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT inv_warehouse_sk
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    s.s_store_name AS store_name,
    ws.web_name AS web_site_name,
    d.d_year,
    cat.total_cr_return_amount,
    cat.total_cr_net_loss,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM catalog_agg cat
JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cat.cr_call_center_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cat.cr_returned_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sr.sr_hdemo_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cat.cr_warehouse_sk
JOIN distinct_warehouses dw ON dw.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p ON p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2000
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND wp.wp_image_count > 3
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    s.s_store_name,
    ws.web_name,
    d.d_year,
    cat.total_cr_return_amount,
    cat.total_cr_net_loss
HAVING SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 1000
ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, total_store_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

goal: Analyze total catalog sales, catalog returns, web returns, and aggregated store sales by year, item category, brand, call‑center state, catalog page number and return reason, while filtering on a specific year, brand, market, catalog page and household income band.

query: |
  WITH distinct_reasons AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT r_reason_sk, r_reason_desc
      FROM reason
  ),
  store_sales_agg AS (
      SELECT
          ss.ss_item_sk,
          ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
          SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_total,
          COUNT(*) AS store_sales_cnt,
          AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity_store
      FROM store_sales ss
      JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      WHERE d.d_year = 2001
        AND ss.ss_quantity > 5
      GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  )
  SELECT
      d_sold.d_year,
      i.i_category,
      i.i_brand,
      cc.cc_state,
      cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
      r.r_reason_desc,
      SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_total,
      SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_returns_total,
      SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_returns_total,
      SUM(ss_agg.store_sales_total) AS store_sales_total,
      COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
      AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
      MIN(cs.cs_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
      MAX(cs.cs_sales_price) AS max_sales_price
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
  JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
  JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
  JOIN distinct_reasons r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_sales_agg ss_agg ON ss_agg.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND ss_agg.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
    AND i.i_brand_id = 12
    AND cc.cc_mkt_id = 2
    AND cp.cp_catalog_page_number = 10
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
  GROUP BY
      d_sold.d_year,
      i.i_category,
      i.i_brand,
      cc.cc_state,
      cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
      r.r_reason_desc
  ORDER BY catalog_sales_total DESC
  LIMIT 100
