goal: Identify high‑loss store returns, rank them per address and reason, compare each with the worst web return that occurred at the same time, and compute related loss metrics.

query: |
  SELECT
      sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
      sr.sr_net_loss,
      ca_store.ca_city,
      ca_store.ca_state,
      r_store.r_reason_desc AS store_reason_desc,
      CASE
          WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 100 THEN 'High Loss'
          WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Medium Loss'
          ELSE 'No Loss'
      END AS loss_category,
      (
          SELECT avg(sr2.sr_net_loss)
          FROM store_returns sr2
          WHERE sr2.sr_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
      ) AS avg_loss_by_reason,
      best_wr.best_wr_net_loss,
      best_wr.best_wr_reason_desc,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_store.ca_address_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_net_loss DESC) AS store_return_rank,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r_store.r_reason_desc ORDER BY sr.sr_net_loss DESC) AS reason_return_rank,
      (
          SELECT avg(sr_sub.sr_return_quantity)
          FROM store_returns sr_sub
          WHERE sr_sub.sr_addr_sk = sr.sr_addr_sk
      ) AS avg_quantity_by_address
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN customer_address ca_store
      ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_store.ca_address_sk
  JOIN reason r_store
      ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_store.r_reason_sk
  JOIN time_dim td_store
      ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td_store.t_time_sk
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
          wr.wr_net_loss AS best_wr_net_loss,
          r_web.r_reason_desc AS best_wr_reason_desc
      FROM web_returns wr
      JOIN reason r_web
          ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_web.r_reason_sk
      WHERE wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td_store.t_time_sk
      ORDER BY wr.wr_net_loss DESC
      LIMIT 1
  ) AS best_wr
  WHERE sr.sr_return_tax > 5.0
    AND sr.sr_return_ship_cost < 500.0
    AND ca_store.ca_state = 'CA'
    AND sr.sr_net_loss > (
        SELECT avg(sr6.sr_net_loss)
        FROM store_returns sr6
        WHERE sr6.sr_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
    )
  ORDER BY sr.sr_net_loss DESC

WITH
    sales_returns AS (
        SELECT
            cs.cs_order_number,
            cs.cs_item_sk,
            cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
            cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
            cs.cs_net_profit,
            cs.cs_quantity,
            cr.cr_return_amount,
            cr.cr_return_quantity,
            i.i_item_id,
            i.i_product_name,
            i.i_brand,
            i.i_category,
            sm.sm_type,
            cc.cc_name            AS call_center_name,
            cp.cp_description     AS catalog_page_desc,
            t_sold.t_time         AS sold_time,
            t_ret.t_time          AS return_time
        FROM
            catalog_sales cs
            JOIN time_dim t_sold
                ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
            JOIN customer_address ca_bill
                ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
            JOIN customer_address ca_ship
                ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
            JOIN call_center cc
                ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
            JOIN catalog_page cp
                ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
            JOIN ship_mode sm
                ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
            JOIN warehouse w
                ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
            JOIN item i
                ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            JOIN promotion p
                ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
            LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
                ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
            LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ret
                ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk
            LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_refunded
                ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
            LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_returning
                ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
            LEFT JOIN call_center cc_ret
                ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_ret.cc_call_center_sk
            LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp_ret
                ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp_ret.cp_catalog_page_sk
            LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_ret
                ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_ret.sm_ship_mode_sk
            LEFT JOIN warehouse w_ret
                ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_ret.w_warehouse_sk
            LEFT JOIN item i_ret
                ON cr.cr_item_sk = i_ret.i_item_sk
    ),
    inventory_agg AS (
        SELECT
            inv.inv_item_sk,
            SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
        FROM
            inventory inv
        GROUP BY
            inv.inv_item_sk
    )
SELECT
    sr.i_item_id,
    sr.i_product_name,
    sr.i_brand,
    sr.i_category,
    sr.sm_type,
    SUM(sr.cs_net_profit)                                 AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.cr_return_amount, 0))                AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.cr_return_quantity, 0))              AS total_return_quantity,
    ia.total_on_hand,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p_sub WHERE p_sub.p_item_sk = sr.cs_item_sk) AS promotion_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(sr.cs_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.cr_return_amount, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END                                                   AS profit_status
FROM
    sales_returns sr
    LEFT JOIN inventory_agg ia
        ON sr.cs_item_sk = ia.inv_item_sk
GROUP BY
    sr.i_item_id,
    sr.i_product_name,
    sr.i_brand,
    sr.i_category,
    sr.sm_type,
    ia.total_on_hand
ORDER BY
    total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

/* Goal: Analyze sales and return performance per item and promotion channel, ranking items by sales and returns, and providing subtotals using ROLLUP. The query joins all eight TPC‑DS tables, applies multiple filters, uses a recursive CTE to generate a date range, expands promotion channels with UNNEST, employs window functions, combines sales and return aggregates with UNION ALL, and limits the result to the top 100 rows. */
WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT 2450118 AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < 2450118 + 30
),
promo_channels AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        split(p.p_channel_details, ',') AS channel_arr
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_start_date_sk BETWEEN 2450118 AND 2450531
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_current_price,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_employees,
        cp.cp_department,
        sm.sm_type,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        p.p_promo_name
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_range dr ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_current_price > 100
      AND cc.cc_employees > 50
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        bd.i_item_id,
        bd.i_product_name,
        ch.channel,
        SUM(bd.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(bd.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(bd.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM base_data bd
    JOIN promo_channels pc ON bd.cs_promo_sk = pc.p_promo_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(pc.channel_arr) AS t(channel)
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (bd.i_item_id, bd.i_product_name, ch.channel)
),
sales_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        channel,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        avg_discount,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM sales_agg
),
-- Aggregate returns per item (returns are treated as a separate ‘channel’)
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        bd.i_item_id,
        bd.i_product_name,
        'RETURN' AS channel,
        SUM(bd.sr_return_amt) AS total_sales,
        SUM(bd.sr_net_loss) AS total_profit,
        CAST(NULL AS double) AS avg_discount
    FROM base_data bd
    WHERE bd.sr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (bd.i_item_id, bd.i_product_name, channel)
),
returns_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        channel,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        avg_discount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_item_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM returns_agg
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM sales_ranked
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns_ranked
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    channel,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    avg_discount,
    sales_rank
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

WITH return_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_brand,
    r1.r_reason_desc AS catalog_reason_desc,
    r2.r_reason_desc AS web_reason_desc,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_catalog_qty,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_web_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS catalog_return_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS web_return_orders
  FROM
    item i
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    JOIN reason r1 ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r1.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN reason r2 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
  WHERE
    cr.cr_fee > 10
    AND cr.cr_fee < 50
    AND cr.cr_reversed_charge BETWEEN 50 AND 400
    AND cr.cr_ship_mode_sk IN (1, 2, 4, 16)
    AND ws.ws_ext_tax > 20
    AND ws.ws_ext_list_price > 5000
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (i.i_item_id, i.i_brand, r1.r_reason_desc, r2.r_reason_desc),
      (i.i_item_id, i.i_brand),
      ()
    )
)
SELECT
  ra.i_item_id,
  ra.i_brand,
  ra.catalog_reason_desc,
  ra.web_reason_desc,
  ra.total_catalog_net_loss,
  ra.total_web_net_loss,
  (ra.total_catalog_net_loss + ra.total_web_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
  ra.total_catalog_qty,
  ra.total_web_qty,
  ra.catalog_return_orders,
  ra.web_return_orders,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r_sub.r_reason_sk)
     FROM reason r_sub
    WHERE r_sub.r_reason_desc LIKE '%price%') AS price_related_reason_count,
  (SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wr2.wr_net_loss)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     JOIN item i2 ON cr2.cr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
     JOIN web_returns wr2 ON wr2.wr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk) AS total_combined_net_loss_all
FROM
  return_aggregates ra
WHERE
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM catalog_sales cs3
     WHERE cs3.cs_item_sk = (
           SELECT i3.i_item_sk
             FROM item i3
            WHERE i3.i_item_id = ra.i_item_id
            LIMIT 1)
       AND cs3.cs_net_paid < 0
  )
ORDER BY
  total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE numbers AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM numbers WHERE n < 5
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax,
        ss.ss_ext_tax,
        hd.hd_buy_potential
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE 
        regexp_like(hd.hd_buy_potential, '^\d{1,4}-\d{1,4}$')
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential LIKE '%-%'
        AND CAST(regexp_extract(hd.hd_buy_potential, '(\d+)-(\d+)', 1) AS integer) < CAST(regexp_extract(hd.hd_buy_potential, '(\d+)-(\d+)', 2) AS integer)
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM numbers n WHERE ss.ss_quantity = n.n
        )
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        hd_buy_potential,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS num_tickets,
        SUM(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_tax,
        MIN(ss_ext_tax) AS min_tax,
        MAX(ss_ext_tax) AS max_tax
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY hd_buy_potential
)
SELECT 
    hd_buy_potential,
    num_tickets,
    total_net_paid_inc_tax,
    avg_tax,
    min_tax,
    max_tax,
    regexp_extract(hd_buy_potential, '(\d+)-(\d+)', 1) AS low_range,
    regexp_extract(hd_buy_potential, '(\d+)-(\d+)', 2) AS high_range,
    CONCAT('Potential_', REPLACE(hd_buy_potential, '-', '_')) AS buy_potential_label
FROM agg
WHERE total_net_paid_inc_tax > (SELECT AVG(total_net_paid_inc_tax) FROM agg)
ORDER BY total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date AS dt
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = (SELECT MIN(d_date) FROM date_dim)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_add('day', 1, dt) AS dt
    FROM date_series
    WHERE dt < (SELECT MAX(d_date) FROM date_dim)
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS sale_date,
        'store' AS channel,
        i.i_category AS category,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(inv_l.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS quantity_on_hand
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS inv_l ON TRUE
    GROUP BY d.d_date, i.i_category
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS sale_date,
        'web' AS channel,
        i.i_category AS category,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(inv_l.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS quantity_on_hand
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS inv_l ON TRUE
    GROUP BY d.d_date, i.i_category
),
union_sales AS (
    SELECT sale_date, channel, category, net_profit, quantity_on_hand FROM store_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sale_date, channel, category, net_profit, quantity_on_hand FROM web_sales_agg
),
sales_with_all_dates AS (
    SELECT
        ds.dt AS sale_date,
        us.channel,
        us.category,
        COALESCE(us.net_profit, 0) AS net_profit,
        COALESCE(us.quantity_on_hand, 0) AS quantity_on_hand
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN union_sales us ON ds.dt = us.sale_date
)
SELECT
    sale_date,
    channel,
    category,
    SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
FROM sales_with_all_dates
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (sale_date, channel, category),
    (sale_date, channel),
    (sale_date),
    ()
)
ORDER BY sale_date DESC, channel, category
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_month_seq
    FROM   date_dim
    WHERE  d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk,
           d.d_date,
           d.d_month_seq
    FROM   date_series ds
    JOIN   date_dim d ON d.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE  d.d_date <= DATE '2001-12-31'
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_division,
        i.i_brand,
        ds.d_month_seq AS month,
        'bill' AS role,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)               AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_quantity)                AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MIN(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)       AS min_discount,
        MAX(cs.cs_ext_sales_price)        AS max_sales_price
    FROM   catalog_sales cs
    JOIN   date_series ds        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk   = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN   time_dim t            ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk   = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN   call_center cc        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN   catalog_page cp       ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN   warehouse w           ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk   = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN   item i                ON cs.cs_item_sk        = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN   customer c_bill       ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN   customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN   customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN   household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN   store s               ON s.s_closed_date_sk   = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN   web_site ws           ON ws.web_open_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    WHERE  ds.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND  cc.cc_division = 2
      AND  i.i_brand = 'Brand#23'
      AND  ca_bill.ca_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY
        cc.cc_division,
        i.i_brand,
        ds.d_month_seq,
        'bill'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cc.cc_division,
        i.i_brand,
        ds.d_month_seq AS month,
        'ship' AS role,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)               AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_quantity)                AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MIN(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)       AS min_discount,
        MAX(cs.cs_ext_sales_price)        AS max_sales_price
    FROM   catalog_sales cs
    JOIN   date_series ds        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk   = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN   time_dim t            ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk   = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN   call_center cc        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN   catalog_page cp       ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN   warehouse w           ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk   = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN   item i                ON cs.cs_item_sk        = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN   customer c_ship       ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    JOIN   customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN   customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN   household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN   store s               ON s.s_closed_date_sk   = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN   web_site ws           ON ws.web_open_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    WHERE  ds.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND  cc.cc_division = 2
      AND  i.i_brand = 'Brand#23'
      AND  ca_ship.ca_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY
        cc.cc_division,
        i.i_brand,
        ds.d_month_seq,
        'ship'
) AS combined
ORDER BY month, role

WITH intersected_customers AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_int1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_int1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_int1.d_year = 2001
    INTERSECT
    SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d_int2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_int2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_int2.d_year = 2001
),
except_customers AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_ex1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_ex1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_ex1.d_year = 2001
    EXCEPT
    SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d_ex2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ex2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_ex2.d_year = 2001
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    c.c_customer_id,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_category,
    cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship,
    sr.sr_net_loss,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk) AS total_paid_per_customer,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk) DESC) AS sales_rank,
    CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS sale_value_flag,
    lr.recent_returns,
    CASE WHEN lr.recent_returns > 0 THEN 'RETURNER' ELSE 'NON_RETURNER' END AS return_status,
    CASE
        WHEN c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT c_customer_sk FROM intersected_customers) THEN 'BOTH'
        WHEN c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT c_customer_sk FROM except_customers) THEN 'SALES_ONLY'
        ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS customer_group
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON ss.ss_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS recent_returns
    FROM store_returns sr_l
    WHERE sr_l.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
      AND sr_l.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
) AS lr ON TRUE
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND i.i_category = 'Women'
  AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 500
ORDER BY sales_rank, total_paid_per_customer DESC
LIMIT 100

    ),
    stores_without_returns AS (
        SELECT s.s_store_sk
        FROM store s
        EXCEPT
        SELECT DISTINCT sr.sr_store_sk FROM store_returns sr
    )
SELECT
    sa.i_item_id,
    sa.i_category,
    sa.d_year,
    sa.total_web_sales,
    sa.total_web_profit,
    sa.total_returns,
    sa.total_inventory_on_hand,
    ca.cat_total_sales,
    ca.cat_total_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.i_category ORDER BY sa.total_web_sales DESC) AS rn_category,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_ext_sales_price)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = sa.i_item_sk
          AND ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = (
              SELECT d_sub.d_date_sk
              FROM date_dim d_sub
              WHERE d_sub.d_year = sa.d_year
                AND d_sub.d_month_seq = 1
              LIMIT 1
          )
    ) AS avg_jan_sales
FROM
    sales_agg sa
    JOIN category_agg ca ON sa.i_category = ca.i_category
WHERE
    NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr3
        WHERE sr3.sr_item_sk = sa.i_item_sk
          AND sr3.sr_return_quantity > 10
    )
    AND (sa.store_sk IS NULL OR sa.store_sk NOT IN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM stores_without_returns))
ORDER BY
    ca.cat_total_sales DESC,
    sa.total_web_sales DESC,
    sa.i_item_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    d_sold.d_year AS sales_year,
    i.i_category AS category,
    st.s_store_name AS store_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_sales_net_paid,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS web_sales_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_net_paid,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_catalog_quantity,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_quantity,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_web_quantity,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_quantity,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ws_sub.ws_quantity)
        FROM web_sales ws_sub
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws_sub.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_year = d_sold.d_year
          AND ws_sub.ws_item_sk IN (
                SELECT i2.i_item_sk
                FROM item i2
                WHERE i2.i_category = i.i_category
          )
    ) AS ws_qty_category_year
FROM
    catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws_site.web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_return ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ret ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_ret.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer c_return ON cr.cr_returned_customer_sk = c_return.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret ON cr.cr_returned_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON cr.cr_returned_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
WHERE
    c_bill.c_customer_sk NOT IN (
        SELECT c2.c_customer_sk
        FROM customer c2
        WHERE c2.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    )
    AND d_sold.d_year = 2000
GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (d_sold.d_year, i.i_category, st.s_store_name)
HAVING
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 10000
ORDER BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    st.s_store_name

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        d_sold.d_year AS year,
        d_sold.d_moy AS month,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS return_loss,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity_sold,
        cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_cr_returned ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr_returned.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr_returned ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr_returned.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc_cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_cr.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
                        AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                        AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c_ws_bill ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_bill ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
                         AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wr_returned ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_returned.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_wr_returned ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr_returned.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_wr ON wr.wr_ship_mode_sk = sm_wr.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_wr ON wr.wr_warehouse_sk = w_wr.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_inv.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_promo_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_promo_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2000
      AND i.i_brand_id = 100
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        month,
        promo_name,
        SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(return_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(quantity_sold) AS total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(return_qty) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(inv_quantity) AS total_inventory,
        SUM(CASE WHEN profit_flag = 'Profit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS profit_rows,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY year, month, promo_name
    HAVING SUM(net_paid) > 10000
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    promo_name,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    total_return_loss,
    total_quantity_sold,
    total_return_qty,
    total

WITH inv_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_date_sk,
           inv_item_sk,
           inv_warehouse_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_date_sk, inv_item_sk, inv_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    ib.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
    ib.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
    date_format(d_sold.d_date, '%Y-%m') AS sold_month,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(inv_agg.total_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS store_return_tickets,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS web_return_orders,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cs2.cs_quantity)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_bill_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
          AND cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    ) AS customer_daily_quantity
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
  ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c_bill
  ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_ship
  ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
  ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
  ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
  ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN call_center cc
  ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p
  ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_start
  ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_end
  ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
  AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_store
  ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_store.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
  ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
  AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_web_return
  ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_web_return.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_web_refund
  ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_web_refund.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_web_returning
  ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_web_returning.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
  ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation
  ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wp_access
  ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site ws
  ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_site_open
  ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_site_open.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_site_close
  ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_site_close.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_open
  ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_closed
  ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_closed.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_c_first_shipto
  ON c_bill.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_c_first_shipto.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_c_first_sales
  ON c_bill.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_c_first_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_current
  ON c_bill.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_current.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN inv_agg
  ON inv_agg.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
  AND cs.cs_quantity > (
        SELECT AVG(cs3.cs_quantity)
        FROM catalog_sales cs3
        WHERE cs3.cs_bill_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    )
GROUP BY cc.cc_name, p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_type, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, date_format(d_sold.d_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_name,
        w.w_city,
        cc.cc_division,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        MIN(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS min_qty_on_hand,
        MAX(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_qty_on_hand,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM
        tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN tpcds.warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN tpcds.inventory i ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk IN (2701385, 3240382, 4806430)
        AND cs.cs_ext_list_price > 2000.00
        AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt < 100.00
        AND cc.cc_division IN (1, 2, 5)
        AND cc.cc_rec_end_date = DATE '2000-12-31'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand >= 850
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tpcds.inventory i2
            WHERE i2.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
              AND i2.inv_quantity_on_hand < 600
        )
    GROUP BY
        cc.cc_name,
        w.w_city,
        cc.cc_division
)
SELECT
    cc_name,
    w_city,
    cc_division,
    total_net_paid,
    avg_discount,
    total_quantity,
    min_qty_on_hand,
    max_qty_on_hand,
    order_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_division ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS division_rank,
    SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_division ORDER BY total_net_paid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid
FROM
    sales_agg
ORDER BY
    total_net_paid DESC,
    division_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH cs_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_manager,
    cd_bill.cd_gender AS bill_gender,
    hd_bill.hd_buy_potential AS bill_buy_potential,
    promo_cs.p_promo_name AS catalog_promo_name,
    promo_ss.p_promo_name AS store_promo_name,
    t.t_hour,
    wp_lateral.wp_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_transactions,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid
FROM cs_base cs
-- Customer dimensions for billing
INNER JOIN customer c_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
-- Customer dimensions for shipping
INNER JOIN customer c_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
-- Promotion linked to catalog sales
LEFT JOIN promotion promo_cs
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = promo_cs.p_promo_sk
-- Time dimension (shared bridge for catalog and store sales)
INNER JOIN time_dim t
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
-- Store sales rows that occurred at the same time slot
INNER JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
-- Store information
INNER JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
-- Promotion linked to store sales (second alias)
LEFT JOIN promotion promo_ss
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = promo_ss.p_promo_sk
-- Lateral join to fetch a web page record for the billing customer
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT wp.wp_type
    FROM web_page wp
    WHERE wp.wp_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS wp_lateral
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_manager,
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    hd_bill.hd_buy_potential,
    promo_cs.p_promo_name,
    promo_ss.p_promo_name,
    t.t_hour,
    wp_lateral.wp_type
ORDER BY total_store_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_tax,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_current_price,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        cr.cr_fee,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_tax
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE
        cr.cr_fee > 30
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
        AND wr.wr_return_amt > 0
        AND sm.sm_carrier IN ('USPS','DHL')
        AND i.i_current_price > 20
),
carrier_dim AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sm_carrier
    FROM ship_mode
    WHERE sm_carrier IN ('USPS','DHL')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        b.i_category,
        cd.sm_carrier,
        SUM(b.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
        SUM(b.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit
    FROM base_sales b
    CROSS JOIN carrier_dim cd
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (b.i_category, cd.sm_carrier),
        (b.i_category),
        (cd.sm_carrier),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.i_category,
    a.sm_carrier,
    a.total_catalog_profit,
    a.total_web_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN a.total_catalog_profit > overall.avg_catalog_profit THEN 'Above Avg Catalog'
        ELSE 'Below Avg Catalog'
    END AS catalog_perf_vs_avg,
    CASE
        WHEN a.total_web_profit > overall.avg_web_profit THEN 'Above Avg Web'
        ELSE 'Below Avg Web'
    END AS web_perf_vs_avg,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_catalog_profit DESC) AS catalog_profit_rank,
    GROUPING_ID(a.i_category, a.sm_carrier) AS grouping_id
FROM agg a
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        AVG(total_catalog_profit) AS avg_catalog_profit,
        AVG(total_web_profit) AS avg_web_profit
    FROM agg
    WHERE i_category IS NOT NULL
      AND sm_carrier IS NOT NULL
) overall
ORDER BY a.total_catalog_profit DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE rec_dates AS ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date FROM date_dim d_next JOIN rec_dates r ON d_next.d_date = date_add('day', 1, r.d_date) WHERE r.d_date < DATE '2022-01-07' ) SELECT s.s_store_name, p.p_promo_name, wp.wp_type, d.d_year, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE
