WITH RECURSIVE years_cte AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS year FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1
    FROM years_cte
    WHERE year + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT d.d_year AS year,
           cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS entity_id,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS amount,
           'sales' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, cs.cs_warehouse_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT d.d_year AS year,
           sr.sr_store_sk AS entity_id,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS amount,
           'returns' AS source
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, sr.sr_store_sk
),
unioned AS (
    SELECT year, entity_id, amount, source FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year, entity_id, amount, source FROM returns_agg
)
SELECT
    y.year,
    u.entity_id,
    u.source,
    SUM(u.amount) AS total_amount
FROM years_cte y
LEFT JOIN unioned u ON y.year = u.year
GROUP BY CUBE (y.year, u.entity_id, u.source)
ORDER BY y.year DESC, u.entity_id, u.source
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    hd.hd_demo_sk AS demo_sk,
    d.d_year AS ship_year,
    CASE 
        WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN 'No Vehicle'
        WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count <= 2 THEN 'Few Vehicles'
        ELSE 'Many Vehicles'
    END AS vehicle_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS customer_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN hd.hd_vehicle_count ELSE 0 END) AS total_vehicles,
    AVG(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower,
    MAX(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS max_income_upper,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN ib.ib_upper_bound = (SELECT MAX(ib2.ib_upper_bound) FROM income_band ib2)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_income_band_customer_cnt
FROM tpcds.customer c
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
  ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
  ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN tpcds.date_dim d
  ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2002
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
  AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
GROUP BY ROLLUP (
    hd.hd_demo_sk,
    d.d_year,
    CASE 
        WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN 'No Vehicle'
        WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count <= 2 THEN 'Few Vehicles'
        ELSE 'Many Vehicles'
    END
)
ORDER BY demo_sk, ship_year, vehicle_category
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the earliest sold date key in catalog_sales
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales) AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive step: generate the next integer date key until the maximum
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < (SELECT MAX(cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales)
),
union_sales AS (
    -- Sales from the catalog channel (customers with high purchase estimate)
    SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid,
           i.i_category AS category,
           'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 3000
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr
          WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
            AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
      )
    UNION ALL
    -- Sales from the web channel (customers with lower purchase estimate)
    SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid,
           i.i_category AS category,
           'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate <= 3000
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr
          WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
            AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
      )
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT us.date_sk,
           us.channel,
           sum(us.net_paid) AS total_net_paid
    FROM union_sales us
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.date_sk = us.date_sk
    GROUP BY us.date_sk, us.channel
    HAVING sum(us.net_paid) > (
        SELECT avg(cd.cd_purchase_estimate)
        FROM customer_demographics cd
    )
)
SELECT a.date_sk,
       a.channel,
       a.total_net_paid,
       row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.date_sk ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC) AS channel_rank
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        cs_ship_date_sk AS ship_date_sk,
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_sk,
        cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        ws_ship_date_sk AS ship_date_sk,
        ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_sk,
        ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ws_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM web_sales
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        s.sold_date_sk,
        s.ship_date_sk,
        s.warehouse_sk,
        s.ship_mode_sk,
        s.bill_customer_sk,
        s.item_sk,
        s.net_profit,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address,
        i.i_item_desc,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_suite_number,
        sm.sm_type
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customer c
        ON s.bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON s.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON s.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON s.ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@example\\.com$')
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '\\b[0-9]{3}\\b')
      AND w.w_suite_number LIKE 'Suite %'
)
SELECT
    f.w_warehouse_name,
    f.sm_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.item_sk) AS distinct_items,
    SUM(f.net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    MIN(regexp_extract(f.i_item_desc, '([A-Z]{2,})', 1)) AS sample_code,
    MIN(substr(f.i_item_desc, 1, 10)) AS item_desc_prefix
FROM filtered f
GROUP BY f.w_warehouse_name, f.sm_type
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_autogen AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        CASE WHEN wp.wp_char_count >= 5000 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Small' END AS page_size_category,
        'AutoGen' AS source_label,
        COUNT(*) AS total_pages,
        SUM(wp.wp_char_count) AS total_chars,
        AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_chars_per_page
    FROM tpcds.customer c
    JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_country IN ('CHILE', 'NICARAGUA')
        AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'Y'
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tpcds.web_page wp2
            WHERE wp2.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND wp2.wp_char_count > 6000
        )
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (c.c_birth_country, CASE WHEN wp.wp_char_count >= 5000 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Small' END),
        (c.c_birth_country),
        ()
    )
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
base_manual AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        CASE WHEN wp.wp_char_count >= 5000 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Small' END AS page_size_category,
        'Manual' AS source_label,
        COUNT(*) AS total_pages,
        SUM(wp.wp_char_count) AS total_chars,
        AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_chars_per_page
    FROM tpcds.customer c
    JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_country NOT IN ('CHILE', 'NICARAGUA')
        AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
        AND wp.wp_char_count BETWEEN 1000 AND 4000
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (c.c_birth_country, CASE WHEN wp.wp_char_count >= 5000 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Small' END),
        (c.c_birth_country),
        ()
    )
    HAVING SUM(wp.wp_char_count) > 5000
)
SELECT
    birth_country,
    page_size_category,
    source_label,
    total_pages,
    total_chars,
    avg_chars_per_page
FROM (
    SELECT
        birth_country,
        page_size_category,
        source_label,
        total_pages,
        total_chars,
        avg_chars_per_page
    FROM base_autogen
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        birth_country,
        page_size_category,
        source_label,
        total_pages,
        total_chars,
        avg_chars_per_page
    FROM base_manual
) AS combined
ORDER BY
    birth_country ASC,
    page_size_category ASC,
    total_pages DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_date,
        d_year,
        d_quarter_name,
        d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2020-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d2.d_date_sk,
        d2.d_date,
        d2.d_year,
        d2.d_quarter_name,
        d2.d_week_seq
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d2
        ON d2.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2020-12-31'
)
SELECT
    sales_type,
    sales_year,
    quarter_name,
    order_category,
    total_net_profit,
    total_discount
FROM (
    SELECT
        'Catalog' AS sales_type,
        ds.d_year AS sales_year,
        ds.d_quarter_name AS quarter_name,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_quantity >= 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END AS order_category,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(lc.call_center_total_discount) AS total_discount
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_series ds
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(cs_l.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS call_center_total_discount
        FROM catalog_sales cs_l
        WHERE cs_l.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
          AND cs_l.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    ) lc
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (ds.d_year, ds.d_quarter_name, CASE WHEN cs.cs_quantity >= 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Web' AS sales_type,
        ds.d_year AS sales_year,
        ds.d_quarter_name AS quarter_name,
        CASE WHEN ws.ws_quantity >= 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END AS order_category,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(lw.total_ship_discount) AS total_discount
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_series ds
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(ws_l.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_ship_discount
        FROM web_sales ws_l
        WHERE ws_l.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
          AND ws_l.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    ) lw
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (ds.d_year, ds.d_quarter_name, CASE WHEN ws.ws_quantity >= 10 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END)
) AS combined
ORDER BY sales_year, quarter_name, sales_type, order_category
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE base_join AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        ca.ca_zip,
        ca.ca_location_type,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM tpcds.customer c
    JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
        ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
        ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1990
      AND hd.hd_dep_count >= 2
      AND ca.ca_location_type = 'apartment'
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound > (SELECT AVG(ib2.ib_upper_bound) FROM tpcds.income_band ib2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM base_join WHERE FALSE
),
unioned_data AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        ca_zip,
        hd_buy_potential,
        hd_dep_count,
        hd_vehicle_count,
        ib_lower_bound,
        ib_upper_bound
    FROM base_join
    WHERE hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        ca_zip,
        hd_buy_potential,
        hd_dep_count,
        hd_vehicle_count,
        ib_lower_bound,
        ib_upper_bound
    FROM base_join
    WHERE hd_buy_potential = '0-500'
),
agg_by_zip AS (
    SELECT
        ca_zip,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS num_customers,
        SUM(hd_dep_count) AS total_dependents,
        AVG(hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count,
        MIN(ib_lower_bound) AS min_income_lower,
        MAX(ib_upper_bound) AS max_income_upper
    FROM unioned_data
    GROUP BY ca_zip
)
SELECT
    ca_zip,
    num_customers,
    total_dependents,
    avg_vehicle_count,
    min_income_lower,
    max_income_upper
FROM agg_by_zip
WHERE max_income_upper > (SELECT AVG(ib3.ib_upper_bound) FROM tpcds.income_band ib3)
ORDER BY num_customers DESC, ca_zip ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH high_fee_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr_returning_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_fee > 50.00
),
filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_fee,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_type
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE
        cp.cp_catalog_number IN (1, 10, 13)
        AND cp.cp_catalog_page_number BETWEEN 10 AND 20
        AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
        AND cr.cr_fee > 5.00
        AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2452000
        AND cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = 255224
        AND cr.cr_returning_customer_sk IN (SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk FROM high_fee_customers)
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_number,
    cp_type,
    cp_catalog_page_number,
    SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(cr_fee) AS avg_fee,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
    MIN(cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
    MAX(cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr_returning_customer_sk) FROM catalog_returns WHERE cr_fee > 5.00) AS distinct_customers
FROM filtered_returns
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (cp_catalog_number, cp_type, cp_catalog_page_number),
    (cp_catalog_number, cp_type),
    (cp_catalog_number),
    ()
)
HAVING SUM(cr_return_amount) > 0
ORDER BY cp_catalog_number ASC, cp_type ASC, total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH
  -- Items that have sales matching several criteria
  sales_items AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      ss.ss_store_sk,
      ss.ss_quantity,
      ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
      ss.ss_ext_tax,
      ss.ss_coupon_amt,
      ss.ss_net_paid,
      i.i_item_sk,
      i.i_category_id,
      i.i_brand,
      i.i_class,
      i.i_color,
      i.i_container,
      i.i_product_name,
      s.s_state,
      s.s_city,
      s.s_store_name
    FROM store_sales ss
    FULL OUTER JOIN item i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE
      ss.ss_ext_tax > 20
      AND ss.ss_coupon_amt < 2000
      AND i.i_category_id IN (1, 3, 6, 8)
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  ),

  -- Items that have returns matching several criteria
  returns_items AS (
    SELECT
      cr.cr_item_sk,
      cr.cr_return_amount,
      cr.cr_fee,
      cr.cr_return_ship_cost,
      cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
      sm.sm_type,
      i.i_category_id,
      i.i_brand,
      i.i_class,
      i.i_color,
      i.i_container,
      i.i_product_name
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i
      ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
      ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE
      cr.cr_fee BETWEEN 10 AND 100
      AND cr.cr_return_ship_cost > 50
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND i.i_category_id IN (1, 3, 6, 8)
  ),

  -- Intersection of the two key sets
  intersect_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM sales_items
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cr_item_sk FROM returns_items
  ),

  -- Keys present in returns but not in discounted sales
  except_items AS (
    SELECT cr_item_sk FROM returns_items
    EXCEPT
    SELECT ss_item_sk FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_ext_discount_amt > 500
  ),

  -- Union of two simple key selections
  union_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_quantity >= 2
    UNION
    SELECT cr_item_sk FROM catalog_returns WHERE cr_fee > 20
  ),

  -- Core join of all five tables (full outer join on sales ↔ item)
  main_join AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      i.i_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
      i.i_category_id,
      i.i_brand,
      i.i_class,
      i.i_color,
      i.i_container,
      ss.ss_quantity,
      ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
      ss.ss_ext_tax,
      ss.ss_coupon_amt,
      ss.ss_net_paid,
      s.s_store_name,
      s.s_state,
      sm.sm_type,
      cr.cr_fee,
      cr.cr_return_ship_cost,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category_id ORDER BY ss.ss_net_paid DESC) AS rn_category,
      CASE WHEN cr.cr_fee > 50 THEN 'HIGH_FEE' ELSE 'LOW_FEE' END AS fee_flag,
      (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
          AND ss2.ss_ext_tax > 30
      ) AS tax_high_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    FULL OUTER JOIN item i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
      ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE
      i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM intersect_items)
      AND i.i_item_sk NOT IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM except_items)
      AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM union_items)
      AND ss.ss_ext_tax > 20
      AND cr.cr_return_amount IS NOT NULL
  ),

  -- Aggregation with HAVING filter
  aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      i_category_id,
      i_brand,
      COUNT(DISTINCT i_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
      SUM(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) AS total_wholesale,
      SUM(ss_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
      SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
      AVG(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale,
      MAX(rn_category) AS max_rn,
      SUM(CASE WHEN fee_flag = 'HIGH_FEE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fee_cnt
    FROM main_join
    GROUP BY i_category_id, i_brand
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND SUM(ss_ext_tax) > 100
  )

SELECT
  i_category_id,
  i_brand,
  distinc

WITH RECURSIVE inv_sequence AS (
    SELECT
        inv_date_sk,
        inv_item_sk,
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        inv_quantity_on_hand,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_date_sk = 2450822
      AND inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        i.inv_date_sk,
        i.inv_item_sk,
        i.inv_warehouse_sk,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        prev.lvl + 1
    FROM inv_sequence prev
    JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_item_sk = prev.inv_item_sk
       AND i.inv_date_sk = prev.inv_date_sk + 1
    WHERE i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
      AND prev.lvl < 5
),
item_details AS (
    SELECT
        s.inv_item_sk,
        s.inv_date_sk,
        s.inv_warehouse_sk,
        s.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        s.lvl,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_manager_id,
        i.i_units,
        i.i_current_price,
        calc.inventory_value
    FROM inv_sequence s
    JOIN item i
        ON s.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT s.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price AS inventory_value
    ) AS calc
    WHERE i.i_manager_id IN (18, 44, 98, 4)
      AND i.i_units IN ('Pallet', 'Bundle')
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 5000
      AND s.inv_quantity_on_hand > 200
      AND s.inv_quantity_on_hand < 800
),
brand_warehouse_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_brand,
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(inventory_value) AS total_inventory_value,
        COUNT(DISTINCT inv_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
        AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_quantity,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity
    FROM item_details
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(i_brand, inv_warehouse_sk)
)
SELECT
    i_brand,
    inv_warehouse_sk,
    total_inventory_value,
    distinct_items,
    avg_quantity,
    total_quantity,
    total_inventory_value / NULLIF(distinct_items, 0) AS avg_value_per_item
FROM brand_warehouse_agg
WHERE total_inventory_value > 10000
   OR distinct_items >= 5
   OR avg_quantity > 300
ORDER BY i_brand NULLS LAST, inv_warehouse_sk
LIMIT 100

(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cr.cr_returning_addr_sk AS returning_addr_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        d.d_year AS year,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        la.avg_net_loss_by_addr AS addr_avg_loss
    FROM catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT avg(cr2.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss_by_addr
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_returning_addr_sk = cr.cr_returning_addr_sk
    ) AS la
    WHERE cr.cr_net_loss > (
        SELECT avg(cr3.cr_net_loss)
        FROM catalog_returns cr3
    )
      AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
)
EXCEPT
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        wr.wr_returning_addr_sk AS returning_addr_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        d.d_year AS year,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        la.avg_net_loss_by_addr AS addr_avg_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT avg(wr2.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss_by_addr
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_returning_addr_sk = wr.wr_returning_addr_sk
    ) AS la
    WHERE wr.wr_net_loss > (
        SELECT avg(wr3.wr_net_loss)
        FROM web_returns wr3
    )
      AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
)
ORDER BY year DESC, net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name AS s_store_name,
        w.w_warehouse_id AS w_warehouse_id,
        d_ret.d_year AS d_year,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        wp.wp_type,
        d_ret.d_current_month,
        d_ret.d_quarter_name,
        w.w_state,
        s.s_suite_number
    FROM date_dim d_ret
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d_ret.d_current_month = 'Y'
        AND d_ret.d_quarter_name = '1903Q4'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND s.s_suite_number = 'Suite 410'
        AND wp.wp_type = 'Home'
        AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand >= 500
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_store_name,
        w_warehouse_id,
        d_year,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        AVG(wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
        SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY s_store_id, s_store_name, w_warehouse_id, d_year
)
SELECT
    a.s_store_id,
    a.s_store_name,
    a.w_warehouse_id,
    a.d_year,
    a.total_inventory_qty,
    a.total_return_amt,
    a.avg_return_amt,
    a.total_net_loss,
    a.transaction_cnt,
    SUM(a.total_return_amt) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.s_store_id
        ORDER BY a.total_return_amt DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_return_by_store,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_returns wr_corr
        JOIN date_dim d_corr ON wr_corr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_corr.d_date_sk
        WHERE d_corr.d_year = a.d_year
    ) AS total_returns_in_year
FROM aggregated a
WHERE a.total_inventory_qty > 600
HAVING a.total_return_amt > 1500
   AND a.avg_return_amt > 10
   AND a.total_net_loss < 0
ORDER BY cumulative_return_by_store DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base1 AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) > 0 THEN 'SameCustomer' ELSE 'Other' END AS return_category
    FROM
        catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cr
    JOIN customer c
        ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk
        AND c.c_birth_month = 5
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name
),
base2 AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) > 1 THEN 'MultiPage' ELSE 'SinglePage' END AS return_category
    FROM
        catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer c
        ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_page wp2
            WHERE wp2.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND wp2.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
              AND wp2.wp_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
        )
        AND c.c_last_review_date IN (
            SELECT MAX(c2.c_last_review_date)
            FROM customer c2
            WHERE c2.c_birth_day = 25
        )
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name
),
unioned AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        warehouse_sk,
        warehouse_name,
        total_return_amount,
        total_net_loss,
        return_category
    FROM base1
    UNION
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        warehouse_sk,
        warehouse_name,
        total_return_amount,
        total_net_loss,
        return_category
    FROM base2
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        warehouse_sk,
        warehouse_name,
        total_return_amount,
        total_net_loss,
        return_category
    FROM unioned
    EXCEPT
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        warehouse_sk,
        warehouse_name,
        total_return_amount,
        total_net_loss,
        return_category
    FROM unioned
    WHERE return_category = 'Other'
)
SELECT
    f.customer_id,
    f.warehouse_name,
    f.total_return_amount,
    f.total_net_loss,
    f.return_category,
    wl.avg_warehouse_net_loss,
    wl.customer_web_page_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.customer_id ORDER BY f.total_return_amount DESC) AS rn
FROM
    filtered f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        AVG(cr3.cr_net_loss) AS avg_warehouse_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS customer_web_page_cnt
    FROM
        catalog_returns cr3
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = (
            SELECT c_inner.c_customer_sk
            FROM customer c_inner
            WHERE c_inner.c_customer_id = f.customer_id
            LIMIT 1
        )
    WHERE
        cr3.cr_warehouse_sk = f.warehouse_sk
) wl
ORDER BY
    f.total_return_amount DESC,
    rn
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT nd.d_date_sk, nd.d_date, nd.d_year
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim nd ON nd.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dh.d_date)
    WHERE nd.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-10'
),
intersect_items AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk AS i_item_sk
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity > 0
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cr_item_sk
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_return_quantity > 0
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_web_pages
    FROM date_hierarchy d
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_fee > 1.0
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND i.i_brand = 'BrandA'
      AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM intersect_items)
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (d.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_category)
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 0
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    total_sales,
    total_net_profit,
    total_inventory,
    distinct_web_pages,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > (SELECT avg(ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales) THEN 'Above Avg'
        ELSE 'Below Avg'
    END AS profit_vs_avg
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY d_year, profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2020-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = dr.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dr.d_date < DATE '2020-01-31'
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    cc_lateral.cc_name,
    cc_lateral.cc_mkt_id,
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    t_dim.t_sub_shift,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    MIN(ws.ws_quantity) AS min_qty,
    MAX(ws.ws_quantity) AS max_qty
FROM
    web_sales ws
FULL OUTER JOIN
    time_dim t_dim
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_dim.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN
    date_range d_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN
    date_dim d_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN
    customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN
    customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cc.cc_name, cc.cc_mkt_id
    FROM call_center cc
    WHERE cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
      AND cc.cc_mkt_id IN (2, 3, 4)
    LIMIT 1
) AS cc_lateral
WHERE
    d_sold.d_year = 2020
    AND t_dim.t_sub_shift = 'morning'
    AND cd_bill.cd_gender = 'M'
    AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 48.00 AND 70.00
    AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
    AND ws.ws_quantity > 1
    AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cd_demo_sk
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_credit_rating = 'Excellent'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_sales ws2
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
          AND d2.d_year = d_sold.d_year
          AND ws2.ws_quantity > ws.ws_quantity
    )
GROUP BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    cc_lateral.cc_name,
    cc_lateral.cc_mkt_id,
    cd_bill.cd_gender,
    t_dim.t_sub_shift
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_brand,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        sm.sm_type,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        t.t_hour,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        wp.wp_url,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim t
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    INNER JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
       AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 150000
),
expanded AS (
    SELECT
        b.*, 
        q.qty
    FROM base b
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[b.ws_quantity, b.ws_quantity + 1]) AS t(qty)
)
SELECT
    expanded.cs_order_number,
    expanded.d_date,
    expanded.i_item_id,
    expanded.i_brand,
    expanded.cs_ext_sales_price,
    expanded.cs_net_paid,
    expanded.cs_quantity,
    expanded.ws_quantity,
    expanded.qty AS expanded_qty,
    expanded.cd_gender,
    expanded.p_promo_id,
    expanded.sm_type,
    expanded.w_warehouse_name,
    expanded.wr_return_amt,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_sales_price)
       FROM catalog_sales cs2
       WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = expanded.cs_item_sk) AS avg_item_sales_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT expanded.cs_order_number) OVER () AS distinct_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT expanded.i_item_id) OVER () AS distinct_items,
    SUM(DISTINCT expanded.cs_quantity) OVER () AS total_distinct_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY expanded.cs_net_paid DESC) AS row_num,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY expanded.cd_gender ORDER BY expanded.cs_net_paid DESC) AS gender_rank,
    SUM(expanded.cs_ext_sales_price) OVER (
        PARTITION BY expanded.d_year
        ORDER BY expanded.d_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_sum_3day_sales
FROM expanded
ORDER BY expanded.cs_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs_item_sk,
        cs_order_number,
        cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs_promo_sk,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS line_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001
    )
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk, cs_order_number, cs_catalog_page_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_warehouse_sk, cs_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    cp.cp_department,
    w_sale.w_warehouse_name,
    p_sale.p_promo_name,
    CASE WHEN d_sold.d_fy_week_seq < 10 THEN 'Early' ELSE 'Late' END AS fiscal_period,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_sales) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) AS total_refunded_cash,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cr.cr_refunded_cash > 100 THEN cr.cr_refunded_cash ELSE 0 END) AS high_refunded_cash,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_ticket_cnt,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    ) AS web_return_cnt
FROM cs_agg
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs_agg.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w_sale ON cs_agg.cs_warehouse_sk = w_sale.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p_sale ON cs_agg.cs_promo_sk = p_sale.p_promo_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs_agg.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs_agg.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs_agg.cs_item_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse w_ret ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_ret.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp2 ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp2.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN store s_store ON ss.ss_store_sk = s_store.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p_ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_ss.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_closed ON s_store.s_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
GROUP BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    cp.cp_department,
    w_sale.w_warehouse_name,
    p_sale.p_promo_name,
    CASE WHEN d_sold.d_fy_week_seq < 10 THEN 'Early' ELSE 'Late' END
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_state,
        sm.sm_type,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        wr.wr_net_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site site
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    w_warehouse_name,
    sm_type,
    cd_credit_rating,
    hd_buy_potential,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit,
    SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_web_net_profit,
    SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) - SUM(wr_net_loss) AS adjusted_net_profit
FROM base
WHERE d_year = 2001
  AND cd_credit_rating = 'High Risk'
  AND ib_lower_bound >= 50000
  AND w_state = 'CA'
  AND sm_type = 'AIR'
GROUP BY
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    w_warehouse_name,
    sm_type,
    cd_credit_rating,
    hd_buy_potential,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound
HAVING (SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) - SUM(wr_net_loss)) > (
    SELECT AVG(monthly_profit) FROM (
        SELECT
            SUM(ss2.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws2.ws_net_profit) - SUM(wr2.wr_net_loss) AS monthly_profit
        FROM store_sales ss2
        JOIN date_dim d2
            ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_sales ws2
            ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_returns wr2
            ON wr2.wr_order_number = ws2.ws_order_number
            AND wr2.wr_item_sk = ws2.ws_item_sk
        GROUP BY d2.d_year, d2.d_month_seq
    ) t
)
ORDER BY adjusted_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_path AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2000-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_path dp ON d.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dp.d_date)
    WHERE d.d_date <= DATE '2000-01-31'
),
agg_inventory AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk,
           inv_warehouse_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_item_sk, inv_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    dp.d_date,
    ss.ss_ticket_number,
    ss.ss_net_paid,
    ss.ss_net_profit,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_country,
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    sm.sm_type,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    wr.wr_return_amt,
    ai.total_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY ss.ss_net_paid DESC) AS rn_customer_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY ss.ss_net_profit DESC) AS category_profit_rank,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_sk ORDER BY dp.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales_to_date,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM store_sales ss2
     WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
       AND ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = dp.d_date_sk) AS daily_customer_txn_count
FROM date_path dp
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dp.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim td
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dp.d_date_sk
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dp.d_date_sk
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT r.r_reason_desc
    FROM reason r
    WHERE r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sm.sm_type
    FROM ship_mode sm
    WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS sm
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN agg_inventory ai
    ON ai.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ai.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE
    i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'                    -- filter 1
    AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'          -- filter 2
    AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1990  -- filter 3
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'                    -- filter 4
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH'          -- filter 5
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'       -- filter 6
    AND td.t_sub_shift = 'morning'            -- filter 7
    AND dp.d_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'       -- filter 8
    AND dp.d_date <= DATE '2000-01-31'       -- filter 9
ORDER BY ss.ss_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE item_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
    FROM item
    WHERE i_item_sk = (SELECT MIN(i_item_sk) FROM item)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name
    FROM item i
    JOIN item_hierarchy ih ON i.i_item_sk = ih.i_item_sk + 1
    WHERE i.i_item_sk <= (SELECT MIN(i_item_sk) + 9 FROM item)
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_time_sk,
        t.t_hour,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_current_price,
        i.i_category,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cs.cs_ext_ship_cost,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
        cc.cc_name,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        (SELECT AVG(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_item_promo_cost
    FROM time_dim t
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_country = 'United States'
        AND sm.sm_contract = 'Ek'
        AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND cs.cs_ext_ship_cost > 1000
        AND i.i_current_price > 20
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < 100
        AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000
        AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 1
)
SELECT
    sa.t_hour,
    sa.i_item_sk,
    sa.i_product_name,
    sa.i_category,
    sa.i_current_price,
    sa.cc_name,
    sa.sm_ship_mode_id,
    sa.w_warehouse_name,
    sa.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    sa.cs_ext_ship_cost,
    sa.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
    sa.avg_item_promo_cost,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.i_category ORDER BY sa.ss_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_category,
    AVG(sa.cs_ext_ship_cost) OVER (
        PARTITION BY sa.i_category
        ORDER BY sa.t_hour
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_ship_cost,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.i_product_name ORDER BY sa.ss_net_profit DESC) AS rn_product_profit
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN item_hierarchy ih ON sa.i_item_sk = ih.i_item_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr2
    WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = sa.i_item_sk
      AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 2
)
ORDER BY profit_rank_in_category ASC, moving_avg_ship_cost DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    d_sales.d_year,
    s.s_store_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    r_cr.r_reason_desc AS catalog_return_reason,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    AVG(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS avg_income_upper_bound
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d_sales
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sold
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ss
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ss
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
   AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cc_open
    ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cc_closed
    ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_closed.d_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w_cr
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN reason r_cr
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer c_cr_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_cr_refunded.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_cr_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_cr_returning.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_refunded.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_returning.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_cr_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_refunded.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_cr_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_returning.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_cr_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_cr_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_cr_returning
    ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_cr_returning.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
   AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws_site
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_site_open
    ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = d_ws_site_open.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_site_close
    ON ws_site.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_site_close.d_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ws
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer c_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ws_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ws_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wr_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_return.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_wr_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr_return.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r_wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer c_wr_refunded
    ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_wr_refunded.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_wr_returning
    ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c_wr_returning.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_refunded
    ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date = dh.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dh.lvl < 5
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    i.i_category,
    d.d_year,
    MAX(dh.lvl) AS hierarchy_level,
    SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amt,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.i_color = 'Red' THEN cs.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS red_item_sales,
    (SELECT max(i2.i_current_price)
     FROM item i2
     WHERE i2.i_brand = i.i_brand) AS max_brand_price,
    CASE WHEN MAX(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > (SELECT max(cs_ext_sales_price) FROM catalog_sales) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above_max_sales_flag,
    MAX(ca_avg.avg_customer_net_paid) AS avg_customer_net_paid
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t
  ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
  ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill
  ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i
  ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr
  ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_sr
  ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_sr
  ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
  ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr
  ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr
  ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr
  ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr
  ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_site ws
  ON ws.web_site_id = 'W123'
JOIN date_dim d_ws_open
  ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_ws_open.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_close
  ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_ws_close.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cp_start
  ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cp_end
  ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk
JOIN date_hierarchy dh
  ON dh.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT avg(cs3.cs_net_paid) AS avg_customer_net_paid
    FROM catalog_sales cs3
    WHERE cs3.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
) AS ca_avg
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr_excl
    WHERE sr_excl.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (c.c_customer_id, i.i_category, d.d_year)
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH intersect_orders AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number AS order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 70
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cr.cr_order_number
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 500.00
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    cc.cc_name,
    wp.wp_type,
    d_cs.d_year,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_returns_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_catalog_orders,
    AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS avg_catalog_quantity,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS total_customer_returns
FROM
    catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cs

    JOIN time_dim t_cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c

    JOIN customer_address ca

    JOIN customer_demographics cd

    JOIN web_sales ws

    JOIN web_page wp

    JOIN date_dim d_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number

    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cr

    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr

    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr

    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    JOIN intersect_orders io
        ON io.order_number = cs.cs_order_number

),
agg AS (

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        dd.d_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS catalog_discount_amt,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS web_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_discount_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_return_loss,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_return_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS total_inventory,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_order_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_order_cnt
    FROM item i
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim dd
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON r.r_reason_sk IN (cr.cr_reason_sk, sr.sr_reason_sk, wr.wr_reason_sk)
    WHERE
        dd.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
        AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
        AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1000-2000'
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        dd.d_date
)
SELECT
    sa.i_item_id,
    sa.i_product_name,
    sa.d_date,
    sa.catalog_net_paid,
    sa.web_net_paid,
    sa.store_return_loss,
    sa.catalog_return_loss,
    sa.total_inventory,
    (sa.catalog_net_paid + sa.web_net_paid - sa.store_return_loss - sa.catalog_return_loss) AS net_profit,
    SUM(sa.catalog_net_paid + sa.web_net_paid - sa.store_return_loss - sa.catalog_return_loss)
        OVER (PARTITION BY sa.i_item_id ORDER BY sa.d_date
              ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_profit,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_item_sk = sa.i_item_sk) AS promotion_count
FROM sales_agg sa
ORDER BY cumulative_net_profit DESC, sa.i_item_id
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

    sea_returns.sm_contract,
    sea_returns.total_quantity,
    sea_returns.total_amount,
    sea_returns.total_net_loss,
    sea_returns.loss_category
FROM sea_returns
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d2
    JOIN date_range dr ON d2.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2022-01-31'
),

promo_list AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM tpcds.promotion p
    WHERE p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
    LIMIT 5
),

store_metric AS (
    SELECT dr.d_date AS trans_date,
           ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS amount,
           'sales' AS metric_type
    FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN promo_list pl ON p.p_promo_sk = pl.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY dr.d_date, ss.ss_store_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dr.d_date AS trans_date,
           sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS amount,
           'returns' AS metric_type
    FROM tpcds.store_returns sr
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_net_loss > 0
    GROUP BY dr.d_date, sr.sr_store_sk
),

store_seq AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_store_sk AS store_sk
    FROM tpcds.store_sales
    ORDER BY ss_store_sk
    LIMIT 5
),

cartesian AS (
    SELECT ss.store_sk, v.val AS seq_val
    FROM store_seq ss
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[1, 2, 3]) AS v(val)
),

final AS (
    SELECT sm.trans_date,
           sm.store_sk,
           sm.amount,
           sm.metric_type,
           (
               SELECT SUM(sm2.amount)
               FROM store_metric sm2
               WHERE sm2.store_sk = sm.store_sk
           ) AS total_store_amount,
           EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM cartesian c
               WHERE c.store_sk = sm.store_sk
                 AND c.seq_val = 2
           ) AS is_seq2_present
    FROM store_metric sm
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM cartesian c
        WHERE c.store_sk = sm.store_sk
    )
)
SELECT trans_date,
       store_sk,
       amount,
       metric_type,
       total_store_amount,
       is_seq2_present
FROM final
ORDER BY trans_date DESC, amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
sales AS (
   SELECT
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS page_id,
      cp.cp_catalog_number AS catalog_number,
      d.d_year AS d_year,
      SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
      concat(cc.cc_name, ' - ', cc.cc_city) AS call_center_full,
      array[ d.d_month_seq, d.d_month_seq + 1 ] AS month_seq_array,
      substring(cp.cp_type, 1, 3) AS type_prefix,
      CAST(null AS varchar) AS reason_word
   FROM catalog_sales cs
   JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
   JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
   WHERE regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '.*action.*')
     AND cc.cc_city LIKE 'San%'
     AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
   GROUP BY
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
      cp.cp_catalog_number,
      d.d_year,
      cc.cc_name,
      cc.cc_city,
      d.d_month_seq,
      cp.cp_type
),
returns AS (
   SELECT
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS page_id,
      cp.cp_catalog_number AS catalog_number,
      d.d_year AS d_year,
      SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_sales,
      SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_profit,
      CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Gain' END AS profit_flag,
      concat(rc.r_reason_desc, ' - ', sm.sm_type) AS call_center_full,
      array[ d.d_month_seq, d.d_month_seq + 2 ] AS month_seq_array,
      substring(cp.cp_type, 1, 3) AS type_prefix,
      regexp_extract(rc.r_reason_desc, '(\\w+)') AS reason_word
   FROM catalog_returns cr
   JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
   JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
   JOIN reason rc ON cr.cr_reason_sk = rc.r_reason_sk
   WHERE regexp_like(rc.r_reason_desc, '^.*damaged.*$')
     AND sm.sm_carrier LIKE 'U%S%'
   GROUP BY
      cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
      cp.cp_catalog_number,
      d.d_year,
      cp.cp_type,
      rc.r_reason_desc,
      sm.sm_type,
      d.d_month_seq
),
unioned AS (
   SELECT
      page_id,
      catalog_number,
      d_year,
      total_sales,
      total_profit,
      profit_flag,
      call_center_full,
      month_seq_array,
      type_prefix,
      reason_word
   FROM sales
   UNION
   SELECT
      page_id,
      catalog_number,
      d_year,
      total_sales,
      total_profit,
      profit_flag,
      call_center_full,
      month_seq_array,
      type_prefix,
      reason_word
   FROM returns
),
intersected AS (
   SELECT page_id FROM unioned WHERE profit_flag = 'Profit'
   INTERSECT
   SELECT page_id FROM unioned WHERE profit_flag = 'Loss'
)
SELECT
   u.page_id,
   u.catalog_number,
   u.d_year,
   u.total_sales,
   u.total_profit,
   u.profit_flag,
   u.call_center_full,
   u.type_prefix,
   u.reason_word,
   m.month_num
FROM unioned u
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(u.month_seq_array) AS t(month_num)
WHERE u.page_id IN (SELECT page_id FROM intersected)
ORDER BY u.total_profit DESC, u.page_id
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS store_id,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS catalog_return_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS web_return_orders,
        ARRAY[cc.cc_gmt_offset, s.s_gmt_offset] AS gmt_offsets
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN reason r1
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r1.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded_cr
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded_cr.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_returning_cr
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning_cr.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN reason r2
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded_wr
        ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded_wr.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_returning_wr
        ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning_wr.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year IN (
        SELECT d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
        INTERSECT
        SELECT d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002, 2003)
    )
      AND r1.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Did not get it on time%'
      AND r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%No service location in my area%'
      AND s.s_gmt_offset >= -6.00
      AND cc.cc_employees > 50
      AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
      AND wr.wr_return_tax > 20.00
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 100.00
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        cc.cc_gmt_offset,
        s.s_gmt_offset
),
expanded_offsets AS (
    SELECT
        fd.*,
        offset_val
    FROM filtered_data fd
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(fd.gmt_offsets) AS u(offset_val)
)
SELECT
    e.store_id,
    e.store_name,
    AVG(e.total_catalog_net_loss + e.total_web_net_loss) AS avg_total_net_loss,
    MAX(e.offset_val) AS max_gmt_offset
FROM expanded_offsets e
GROUP BY
    e.store_id,
    e.store_name
HAVING AVG(e.total_catalog_net_loss + e.total_web_net_loss) > (
    SELECT AVG(total_catalog_net_loss + total_web_net_loss) FROM filtered_data
)
ORDER BY avg_total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_keys AS (
    SELECT 2450900 AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1 FROM date_keys WHERE date_sk < 2450905
)
SELECT
    i.i_category,
    i.i_class,
    cc.cc_division_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    ca.ca_state,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_current_price,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    (SELECT SUM(wr2.wr_return_amt)
       FROM web_returns wr2
      WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_web_return_amount
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN item i
  ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN call_center cc
  ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
  ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN reason r
  ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
 AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
 AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
 AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_keys dk
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dk.date_sk
WHERE i.i_category = 'Sports'
  AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
  AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
  AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
  AND i.i_rec_end_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
  AND cc.cc_sq_ft > 0
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM web_returns wr
         WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
           AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
           AND wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    )
GROUP BY
    i.i_category,
    i.i_class,
    cc.cc_division_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    ca.ca_state,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_quantity,
    cs.cs_net_paid,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    i.i_category_id,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_item_sk,
    sm.sm_type,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    cc.cc_rec_start_date,
    w.w_warehouse_id,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    cr.cr_return_quantity,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    ws.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
    ws.ws_net_paid AS ws_net_paid,
    ws.ws_net_profit AS ws_net_profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
  bd.i_category,
  bd.sm_type,
  bd.cc_name,
  SUM(bd.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
  SUM(bd.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
  SUM(bd.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bd.cs_order_number) AS order_count,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bd.i_category ORDER BY bd.cc_name) AS category_cc_rank,
  (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = bd.i_item_sk) AS avg_item_net_paid
FROM base_data bd
WHERE bd.i_category_id = 5
  AND bd.sm_type = 'OVERNIGHT'
  AND bd.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND bd.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
GROUP BY ROLLUP (bd.i_category, bd.sm_type, bd.cc_name)
ORDER BY bd.i_category, bd.sm_type, bd.cc_name
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_current_price,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity                         AS cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit                       AS cs_net_profit,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_quantity                         AS ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit                       AS ws_net_profit,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        wh.w_warehouse_name,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_contract,
        cc.cc_name      AS call_center_name,
        cc.cc_country,
        c.c_customer_id,
        cd.cd_gender,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_channel_email,
        wp.wp_url,
        site.web_name
    FROM tpcds.item i
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.warehouse wh
        ON wh.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm
        ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.call_center cc
        ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
        ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.promotion p
        ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_site site
        ON site.web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
    WHERE i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
      AND i.i_rec_end_date   <= DATE '2002-12-31'
      AND cc.cc_country = 'United States'
      AND p.p_channel_email = 'N'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        b.w_warehouse_name,
        b.sm_ship_mode_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.i_item_sk)                                      AS distinct_items_sold,
        SUM(b.cs_quantity)                                               AS total_catalog_quantity,
        SUM(b.ws_quantity)                                               AS total_web_quantity,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.cs_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(b.ws_net_profit, 0)) AS total_combined_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(COALESCE(b.cs_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(b.ws_net_profit, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Profit'
            ELSE 'Loss'
        END                                                             AS profit_indicator
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = b.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r_cr
        ON r_cr.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = b.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r_wr
        ON r_wr.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (b.w_warehouse_name, b.sm_ship_mode_id)
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
)
SELECT
    a.w_warehouse_name,
    a.sm_ship_mode_id,
    a.distinct_items_sold,
    a.total_catalog_quantity,
    a.total_web_quantity,
    a.total_combined_profit,
    a.profit_indicator,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY a.total_combined_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM agg a
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE level_cte AS (
      SELECT 1 AS lvl
      UNION ALL
      SELECT lvl + 1 FROM level_cte WHERE lvl < 5
    ),
    store_sales_agg AS (
      SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt,
        MAX(ss.ss_hdemo_sk) AS any_hdemo_sk
      FROM store_sales ss
      GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk
    ),
    store_with_sales AS (
      SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        s.s_country,
        s.s_gmt_offset,
        s.s_floor_space,
        COALESCE(ss.total_net_profit, 0) AS agg_net_profit,
        COALESCE(ss.total_net_paid, 0) AS agg_net_paid,
        COALESCE(ss.sales_txn_cnt, 0) AS agg_sales_cnt,
        ss.any_hdemo_sk
      FROM store s
      FULL OUTER JOIN store_sales_agg ss
        ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    ),
    store_ranked AS (
      SELECT
        sws.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_state ORDER BY agg_net_profit DESC) AS rn_state,
        CASE
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(s_store_name, '(?i)mall') THEN 'MALL'
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(s_store_name, '(?i)outlet') THEN 'OUTLET'
          ELSE 'OTHER'
        END AS store_type,
        CONCAT(s_city, ', ', s_state) AS location,
        (
          SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM household_demographics hd
          WHERE hd.hd_demo_sk = sws.any_hdemo_sk
        ) AS hd_demo_count
      FROM store_with_sales sws
      WHERE s_store_name LIKE '%Store%'
        AND (SELECT AVG(agg_net_profit) FROM store_with_sales) < agg_net_profit
    )
SELECT
  sr.s_store_sk,
  sr.s_store_name,
  sr.store_type,
  sr.location,
  sr.agg_net_profit,
  sr.agg_net_paid,
  sr.agg_sales_cnt,
  sr.rn_state,
  lr.lvl
FROM store_ranked sr
JOIN level_cte lr ON lr.lvl = MOD(sr.s_store_sk, 5) + 1
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM web_page wp
  WHERE REGEXP_EXTRACT(wp.wp_url, 'https?://([^/]+)/', 1) = 'www.example.com'
    AND wp.wp_type LIKE 'Home%'
)
ORDER BY sr.agg_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered AS (

        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,

        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        sm.sm_type,

        w.w_state,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_state,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,

    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d

    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s

    JOIN web_sales ws
