      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > (
          SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_sales_price)
          FROM catalog_sales cs2
          WHERE cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
      )
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    s_state,
    sm_type,
    d_year,
    ca_state,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS catalog_order_cnt,
    AVG(cs_net_profit) AS avg_catalog_profit,
    MAX(ws_net_paid) AS max_web_net_paid,
    (SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
     FROM store_sales ss2
     WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s_store_sk) AS total_store_sales_alltime
FROM filtered
GROUP BY
    s_store_name,
    s_state,
    sm_type,
    d_year,
    ca_state,
    s_store_sk
ORDER BY total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_category_id,
        i.i_manager_id,
        i.i_color,
        i.i_size,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        cc.cc_name,
        cp.cp_description,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_order_number IS NOT NULL
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category_id = 3
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND w.w_state = 'TX'
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
      AND i.i_item_sk IN (
          SELECT inv2.inv_item_sk
          FROM inventory inv2
          JOIN date_dim d2
              ON inv2.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
          WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
          GROUP BY inv2.inv_item_sk
          HAVING SUM(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand) > 0
      )
)
SELECT
    i_category_id,
    i_manager_id,
    w_state,
    CASE WHEN i_manager_id = 63 THEN 'Manager63' ELSE 'Other' END AS manager_group,
    SUM(cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr_net_loss), 0) AS total_profit,
    SUM(cs_quantity) + SUM(ss_quantity) + SUM(ws_quantity) - COALESCE(SUM(wr_return_quantity), 0) AS net_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p_promo_id) AS distinct_promos,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY w_state
        ORDER BY (SUM(cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr_net_loss), 0)) DESC
    ) AS profit_rank_state
FROM base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category_id, i_manager_id, w_state)
HAVING (SUM(cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr_net_loss), 0)) > 0
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
Goal: Summarize net revenue and profit from catalog sales by call center, ship mode and sold year, include related catalog and store return amounts, and report total catalog return count per call center. Filter to groups with substantial net paid and return the top 100 rows.
*/
WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        sm.sm_type,
        d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ret
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ret
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_ret.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN call_center cc_ret
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_ret.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sr_ret
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sr_ret
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr_ret.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c_sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
)
SELECT
    jd.cc_name,
    jd.sm_type,
    jd.sold_year,
    SUM(jd.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(jd.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT jd.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(jd.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(jd.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_call_center_sk = jd.cc_call_center_sk
    ) AS total_returns_for_cc
FROM joined_data jd
GROUP BY jd.cc_name, jd.sm_type, jd.sold_year
HAVING SUM(jd.cs_net_paid) > 500000
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE year_seq AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS yr FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT yr + 1 FROM year_seq
    WHERE yr + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    p.p_promo_id,
    sm.sm_type,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MIN(ws.ws_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
    MAX(ws.ws_sales_price) AS max_sales_price
FROM year_seq ys
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ys.yr = d_sold.d_year
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sold ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c_bill ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_return ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c_ret ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c_ret.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
WHERE
    ys.yr BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
    AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
    AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
    AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
    AND t_sold.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
    AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Customer not satisfied'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr_excl
        WHERE wr_excl.wr_returning_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
          AND wr_excl.wr_return_amt > 500
    )
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_sold.d_year, p.p_promo_id, sm.sm_type)
ORDER BY d_sold.d_year, p.p_promo_id, sm.sm_type, total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

call_center_filtered AS (

    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk

store_returns_data AS (

    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1970
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
),
web_returns_data AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        -wr.wr_net_loss AS net_amount,
        'web_return' AS source,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS promo_name,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS call_center_name,
        wp.wp_web_page_id AS web_page_id,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS web_site_name,

/* Goal: Analyze yearly sales and profit by store, incorporating promotions, returns, customer demographics and web page activity, and rank stores by sales */
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        d.d_year AS d_year,
        s.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
        s.s_state AS s_state,
        s.s_store_sk AS s_store_sk,
        c.c_customer_id AS c_customer_id,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS c_preferred_cust_flag,
        ca.ca_state AS customer_state,
        cd.cd_credit_rating AS cd_credit_rating,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk AS hd_income_band_sk,
        p.p_promo_id AS p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active AS p_discount_active,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand,
        cc.cc_call_center_id AS cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_tax_percentage AS cc_tax_percentage,
        cs.cs_order_number AS cs_order_number,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS cr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_amount AS sr_return_amount,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS sr_net_loss,
        r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc,
        wp.wp_url AS wp_url
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 2001
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
        AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
        AND cc.cc_tax_percentage < 10
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        s_store_sk,
        s_store_id,
        s_state,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'High Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d_year, s_store_sk, s_store_id, s_state),
        (d_year, s_store_sk, s_store_id),
        (d_year, s_store_sk),
        (d_year),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    s_store_id,
    s_state,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_net_profit)
       FROM store_sales ss2
       WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = agg.s_store_sk) AS max_store_profit
FROM agg
ORDER BY d_year DESC, total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE base AS (
    SELECT
        d_cs.d_year AS d_year,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        ca.ca_state AS ca_state,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax AS net_sales,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS store_net_paid,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
        p.p_discount_active AS p_discount_active,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
        cp.cp_department AS catalog_department,
        wp.wp_type AS web_page_type,
        ib.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
        ib.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
        r.r_reason_desc AS return_reason,
        t_cs.t_am_pm AS am_pm,
        cs.cs_item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number AS ss_ticket_number,
        d_cs.d_date_sk AS d_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       AND ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
       AND ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
       AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
       AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
       AND ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
       AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
       AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
       AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
       AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
       AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_cs.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
      AND ca.ca_state = 'TX'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_category,
        ca_state,
        net_sales,
        store_net_paid,
        return_amt,
        p_discount_active,
        warehouse_name,
        call_center_name,
        catalog_department,
        web_page_type,
        income_lower,
        income_upper,
        return_reason,
        am_pm,
        cs_item_sk,
        ss_ticket_number,
        d_date_sk
    FROM base
    WHERE false
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_category,
        ca_state,
        SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales,
        SUM(store_net_paid) AS total_store_net,
        SUM(return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax)
         FROM catalog_sales cs2
         JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
         WHERE d2.d_year = d_year
           AND cs2.cs_item_sk IN (SELECT i2.i_item_sk FROM item i2 WHERE i2.i_category = i_category)
        ) AS avg_net_sales_year_category
    FROM base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_year, i_category, ca_state)
    HAVING SUM(net_sales) > 0
)

WITH
profit_by_email AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        concat('Domain: ', regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$', 1)) AS group_label,
        d.d_year AS sales_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '^.+@.+\\.(com|net|org)$')
      AND c.c_first_name LIKE 'A%'
      AND ws.ws_net_profit > (SELECT avg(ws2.ws_net_profit) FROM web_sales ws2)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM web_sales ws3
          WHERE ws3.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND ws3.ws_net_profit > 5000
          LIMIT 1
      )
      AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (c.c_customer_sk, d.d_year, concat('Domain: ', regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$', 1))),
        (c.c_customer_sk, d.d_year),
        (c.c_customer_sk)
    )
),
profit_by_day AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS customer_sk,
        concat('Day: ', d.d_day_name) AS group_label,
        d.d_year AS sales_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(d.d_day_name, '^S.*')
      AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
      AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d.d_year, concat('Day: ', d.d_day_name)),
        (d.d_year),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT *
FROM profit_by_email
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM profit_by_day
ORDER BY sales_year DESC, total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
Goal: Combine store sales and store returns by store and year, aggregating net amounts, distinct tickets, ranking stores by profit (sales) or loss (returns), and attaching the maximum promotion cost. The query filters sales to years 1998‑1999 with a specific promotion channel and verifies related catalog sales, and filters returns to 1999 with defect‑related reasons. Results are de‑duplicated, ordered, and limited.
*/
WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS store_id,
        d.d_year AS year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS metric_amount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS metric_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS rank,
        promo_max.max_cost AS promo_max_cost
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(p2.p_cost) AS max_cost
        FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    ) AS promo_max
    WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
      AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_sales cs
          WHERE cs.cs_order_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
            AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
      )
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, d.d_year, promo_max.max_cost
),

returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS store_id,
        d.d_year AS year,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS metric_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS metric_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) DESC) AS rank,
        promo_max.max_cost AS promo_max_cost
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.p_cost AS max_cost
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_promo_sk = (
            SELECT ss2.ss_promo_sk
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
              AND ss2.ss_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS promo_max
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM reason r
          WHERE r.r_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
            AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%defect%'
      )
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, d.d_year, promo_max.max_cost
),

combined AS (
    SELECT store_id, year, metric_amount, metric_profit, distinct_tickets, rank, promo_max_cost
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT store_id, year, metric_amount, metric_profit, distinct_tickets, rank, promo_max_cost
    FROM returns_agg
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    store_id,
    year,
    metric_amount,
    metric_profit,
    distinct_tickets,
    rank,
    promo_max_cost
FROM combined
ORDER BY year DESC, metric_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE numbers AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM numbers WHERE n < 5
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    MAX(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS max_return_qty,
    MIN(cr.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE
    cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND cc.cc_gmt_offset > -5.00
    AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND w.w_city = 'Los Angeles'
    AND r.r_reason_desc IN ('Damaged', 'Defective')
    AND cr.cr_return_amount > (SELECT max(n) FROM numbers) * 10
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND wr2.wr_return_amt > cr.cr_return_amount
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5)
    WHERE cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 500
),
catalog_page_matched AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cp.cp_description,
        regexp_extract(cp.cp_description, '(\\w+)', 1) AS first_word,
        substring(cp.cp_description, 1, 30) AS short_desc
    FROM sampled_catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)building')
),
intersect_items AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk FROM store_sales
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cs_item_sk FROM catalog_sales
),
store_return_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        CONCAT('Store-', s.s_store_name) AS store_label,
        (
            SELECT SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)
            FROM store_sales ss
            WHERE ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        ) AS total_store_net_profit,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intersect_items
        ) AS intersect_item_count
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        WHERE cr.cr_order_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    )
      AND s.s_store_name LIKE '%Mart%'
      AND regexp_like(s.s_store_name, '^A.*')
      AND s.s_state IN ('CA', 'NY')
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, r.r_reason_desc, sr.sr_ticket_number)
)
SELECT
    sra.s_store_id,
    sra.s_store_name,
    sra.store_label,
    sra.r_reason_desc,
    sra.total_return_amount,
    sra.avg_return_qty,
    sra.return_count,
    sra.total_store_net_profit,
    sra.intersect_item_count,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_page_matched
    ) AS catalog_page_match_count,
    (
        SELECT regexp_extract(cp.cp_description, '(\\w{5,})', 1)
        FROM catalog_page cp
        WHERE cp.cp_description LIKE '%building%'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS sample_extracted_word
FROM store_return_analysis sra
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2023-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next
        ON d_next.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '2023-01-31'
)
SELECT entity_type,
       entity_id,
       attribute,
       event_date,
       count_metric,
       total_related
FROM (
    SELECT
        'Store' AS entity_type,
        s.s_store_id AS entity_id,
        s.s_state AS attribute,
        d.d_date AS event_date,
        COUNT(*) AS count_metric,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store s2 WHERE s2.s_state = s.s_state) AS total_related
    FROM store s
    JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_series ds ON d.d_date = ds.d_date
    WHERE d.d_year = 2023
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_state, d.d_date

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Customer' AS entity_type,
        c.c_customer_id AS entity_id,
        cd.cd_gender AS attribute,
        d2.d_date AS event_date,
        COUNT(*) AS count_metric,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM customer c3
         JOIN customer_demographics cd3 ON c3.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd3.cd_demo_sk
         WHERE cd3.cd_gender = cd.cd_gender) AS total_related
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_series ds2 ON d2.d_date = ds2.d_date
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2023
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, d2.d_date
) combined
ORDER BY entity_type, attribute, event_date
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
           SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_quantity > 5
      AND cs_ext_sales_price > 0
    GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
           SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
           COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM store_returns
    WHERE sr_return_quantity > 1
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_returned_date_sk
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    d.d_date,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    s.total_sales,
    s.total_profit,
    ra.total_return_amt,
    ra.return_cnt,
    re.r_reason_desc,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs_sub.cs_item_sk)
        FROM catalog_sales cs_sub
        WHERE cs_sub.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND cs_sub.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND cs_sub.cs_quantity > 3
    ) AS distinct_items_sold
FROM returns_agg ra
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ra.customer_sk
 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ra.return_date_sk
JOIN reason re
  ON sr.sr_reason_sk = re.r_reason_sk
JOIN date_dim d
  ON ra.return_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON ra.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN sales_agg s
  ON s.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
 AND s.sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2000
  AND re.r_reason_desc LIKE '%size%'
  AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
  AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 5 AND 10
  AND s.total_sales > 1000
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    d.d_date,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    s.total_sales,
    s.total_profit,
    ra.total_return_amt,
    ra.return_cnt,
    re.r_reason_desc
HAVING SUM(s.total_sales - ra.total_return_amt) > 5000
ORDER BY SUM(s.total_sales - ra.total_return_amt) DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_year,
           d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2002-12-31'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           d2.d_year,
           d2.d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON d2.d_date = dh.d_date - INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d2.d_date >= DATE '2002-01-01'
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dh.d_year AS year,
        dh.d_month_seq AS month_seq,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        NULL AS total_return_amount,
        NULL AS total_net_loss,
        NULL AS return_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (dh.d_year, dh.d_month_seq, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name)
),

returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dr.d_year AS year,
        dr.d_month_seq AS month_seq,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        NULL AS total_sales,
        NULL AS total_profit,
        NULL AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_hierarchy dr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (dr.d_year, dr.d_month_seq, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name)
),

combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns_agg
),

combined_distinct AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        year,
        month_seq,
        i_item_sk,
        i_product_name,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        distinct_customers,
        total_return_amount,
        total_net_loss,
        return_count
    FROM combined
)

SELECT
    cd.year,
    cd.month_seq,
    cd.i_item_sk,
    cd.i_product_name,
    COALESCE(cd.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(cd.total_profit, 0) AS total_profit,
    COALESCE(cd.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
    COALESCE(cd.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
    COALESCE(cd.distinct_customers, 0) AS distinct_customers,
    COALESCE(cd.return_count, 0) AS return_count,
    inv.total_on_hand,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.year, cd.month_seq ORDER BY COALESCE(cd.total_sales, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM combined_distinct cd
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(invt.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM inventory invt
    WHERE invt.inv_item_sk = cd.i_item_sk
) AS inv
WHERE cd.i_item_sk NOT IN (
    SELECT cr2.cr_item_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_return_amount > 500
)
ORDER BY cd.year DESC, cd.month_seq DESC, total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 2450192 AS date_sk, 1 AS level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1, level + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= 2450324
),
store_promos AS (
    SELECT s.s_store_sk,
           array_agg(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS promo_ids
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_brand,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ca.ca_zip,
    p.p_promo_name,
    dh.date_sk AS sale_date_sk,
    promo_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
    AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS transaction_cnt,
    MIN(ss.ss_net_paid) AS min_store_sale,
    MAX(ss.ss_net_paid) AS max_store_sale,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ws.ws_net_paid)
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450192 AND 2450324
          AND sm.sm_carrier = 'UPS'
    ) AS total_web_sales_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) OVER (
        PARTITION BY s.s_store_id
        ORDER BY dh.date_sk
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_store_sales
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c_sales ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dh.date_sk
JOIN store_promos sp ON s.s_store_sk = sp.s_store_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sp.promo_ids) AS t(promo_id)
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inventory inv
    WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
)
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count IN (1, 2, 3)
  AND hd.hd_dep_count <= 1
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
  AND ca.ca_zip = '10069'
  AND ca.ca_suite_number = 'Suite A'
  AND p.p_start_date_sk BETWEEN 2450192 AND 2450324
  AND p.p_item_sk = 207529
  AND i.i_current_price > 50
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_brand,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ca.ca_zip,
    p.p_promo_name,
    dh.date_sk,
    promo_id
ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE
    seq AS (
        SELECT 1 AS n
        UNION ALL
        SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
    ),
    inv_agg AS (
        SELECT
            inv_item_sk AS item_sk,
            inv_date_sk AS date_sk,
            SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
        FROM inventory
        WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        GROUP BY inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk
    ),
    common_orders AS (
        SELECT cs_order_number FROM catalog_sales
        INTERSECT
        SELECT ws_order_number FROM web_sales
    ),
    catalog_side AS (
        SELECT
            cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
            cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
            cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid,
            cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
            cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
            cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk,
            cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
            cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
            cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AS bill_cdemo_sk,
            cs.cs_bill_addr_sk AS bill_addr_sk,
            cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk AS ship_cdemo_sk,
            cs.cs_ship_addr_sk AS ship_addr_sk,
            cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
            cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount,
            cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
            cr.cr_returned_time_sk AS return_time_sk,
            ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk,
            cd.cd_demo_sk AS demo_sk,
            d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
            d_sold.d_month_seq AS sold_month_seq,
            t_sold.t_hour AS sold_hour,
            cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk,
            cc.cc_name AS cc_name,
            cp.cp_catalog_page_sk AS catalog_page_sk,
            cp.cp_department AS catalog_department,
            sm.sm_ship_mode_sk AS sm_sk,
            sm.sm_carrier AS ship_carrier,
            i.i_item_sk AS i_sk,
            i.i_category AS i_category,
            i.i_brand AS i_brand,
            inv_agg.total_on_hand AS inventory_on_hand,
            s.s_store_sk AS store_sk,
            s.s_store_name AS store_name,
            seq.n AS seq_n
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN catalog_returns cr
          ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
         AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        JOIN call_center cc
          ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp
          ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm
          ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN item i
          ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_sold
          ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim t_sold
          ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca
          ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
          ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN inv_agg
          ON i.i_item_sk = inv_agg.item_sk
         AND d_sold.d_date_sk = inv_agg.date_sk
        JOIN store s
          ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
        JOIN seq
          ON cs.cs_quantity = seq.n
        WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0
          AND i.i_category_id = 7
          AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
          AND sm.sm_carrier = 'AIRBORNE'
          AND d_sold.d_year = 1999
    ),
    web_side AS (

            ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,

            ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid,
            ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,

            ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk AS bill_cdemo_sk,
            ws.ws_bill_addr_sk AS bill_addr_sk,
            ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk AS ship_cdemo_sk,
            ws.ws_ship_addr_sk AS ship_addr_sk,
            wr.wr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
            wr.wr_return_amt AS return_amount,

    -- date and time dimension joins

SELECT
  cc_call_center_id AS entity_id,
  'CallCenter' AS entity_type,
  sold_year AS year,
  SUM(cs_net_profit) AS metric_sum,
  AVG(cs_sales_price) AS metric_

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM tpcds.date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2000-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_next
      ON d_next.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk - 1
    WHERE d_next.d_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
)
SELECT d_date, metric_type, amount
FROM (
    SELECT dh.d_date,
           'catalog_sales' AS metric_type,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS amount
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_net_profit > (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
        FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs2
    )
    GROUP BY dh.d_date

    UNION ALL

    SELECT dh.d_date,
           'catalog_returns' AS metric_type,
           SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS amount
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tpcds.call_center cc
        WHERE cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
          AND cc.cc_gmt_offset > 0
    )
    GROUP BY dh.d_date
) AS combined
ORDER BY d_date DESC, amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
store_ret_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_sr.d_year AS year,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d_sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i_sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i_sr.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c_sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s_sr
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s_sr.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r_sr
        ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    WHERE i_sr.i_brand = 'BrandA'
      AND d_sr.d_year = 2021
      AND d_sr.d_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND d_sr.d_date < DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND s_sr.s_state = 'CA'
      AND r_sr.r_reason_desc IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk, d_sr.d_year
),
web_ret_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_wr.d_year AS year,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d_wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i_wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i_wr.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c_wr
        ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_wr.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr
        ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN reason r_wr
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    WHERE i_wr.i_brand = 'BrandA'
      AND d_wr.d_year = 2021
      AND d_wr.d_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND d_wr.d_date < DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND c_wr.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND r_wr.r_reason_desc <> 'Defective'
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, d_wr.d_year
),
union_ret AS (
    SELECT item_sk, year, total_return_amt, cnt_returns FROM store_ret_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_sk, year, total_return_amt, cnt_returns FROM web_ret_agg
),
catalog_ret_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_cr.d_year AS year,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i_cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i_cr.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN reason r_cr
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer c_refunded
        ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refunded.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_cr.i_item_sk
       AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_item_sk = i_cr.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_p_start
        ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_p_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_p_end
        ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_p_end.d_date_sk
    WHERE sm.sm_carrier = 'USPS'
      AND i_cr.i_color = 'Red'
      AND d_cr.d_year = 2021
      AND d_cr.d_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND d_cr.d_date < DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND r_cr.r_reason_desc = 'Customer Cancel'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND d_p_start.d_date <= d_cr.d_date
      AND d_p_end.d_date >= d_cr.d_date
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, d_cr.d_year
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        u.item_sk,
        u.year,
        SUM(u.total_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt,
        SUM(u.cnt_returns) AS sum_cnt,
        COALESCE(c.total_return_amt, 0) AS catalog_return_amt
    FROM union_ret u
    LEFT JOIN catalog_ret_agg c
        ON u.item_sk = c.item_sk
       AND u.year = c.year
    GROUP BY u.item_sk, u.year, c.total_return_amt
)
SELECT
    f.item_sk,
    i.i_item_id,
    f.year,
    f.sum_return_amt,
    f.sum_cnt,
    f.catalog_return_amt,
    f.sum_return_amt / NULLIF(f.sum_cnt, 0) AS avg_return_amt,
    r_small.r_reason_sk,
    t.dummy
FROM final_agg f
JOIN item i
    ON f.item_sk = i.i_it

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (

    UNION ALL

),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,

combined AS (

WITH demo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_current_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS cust_cnt,
        AVG(c.c_birth_year) AS avg_birth_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_cust_cnt,
        SUM(COALESCE(hd.hd_vehicle_count, 0)) AS total_vehicles,
        SUM(CASE WHEN hd.hd_dep_count > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS many_dep_cnt
    FROM
        tpcds.customer c
        JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
          ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        c.c_birth_month IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)                     -- predicate 1
        AND c.c_birth_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28                         -- predicate 2
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'                          -- predicate 3
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 2000                   -- predicate 4
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 0                               -- predicate 5
        AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (2, 7, 10, 11, 18)              -- predicate 6
        AND hd.hd_demo_sk IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT c2.c_current_hdemo_sk
            FROM tpcds.customer c2
            WHERE c2.c_birth_month = 5
        )                                                         -- predicate 7 (uncorrelated subquery)
    GROUP BY
        c.c_current_hdemo_sk
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(cust_cnt) AS avg_cust_per_demo,
        SUM(total_vehicles) AS sum_vehicles_all,
        COUNT(*) AS total_demos
    FROM demo_agg
    WHERE many_dep_cnt > 0
)
SELECT
    d.hd_demo_sk,
    d.cust_cnt,
    d.avg_birth_year,
    d.preferred_cust_cnt,
    d.total_vehicles,
    d.many_dep_cnt,
    o.avg_cust_per_demo,
    o.sum_vehicles_all,
    SUM(d.cust_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN d.hd_demo_sk % 2 = 0 THEN 'even' ELSE 'odd' END) AS cust_cnt_by_parity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.cust_cnt DESC) AS cust_cnt_rank
FROM demo_agg d
CROSS JOIN overall_stats o
WHERE d.cust_cnt > 10                     -- outer filter predicate 1
  AND d.total_vehicles > 5                -- outer filter predicate 2
HAVING d.preferred_cust_cnt >= 5          -- outer having predicate
ORDER BY d.cust_cnt DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT
  c.c_customer_id,
  CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
  c.c_email_address,
  REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@(.+)$', 1) AS email_domain,
  SUBSTRING(ca.ca_city, 1, 3) AS city_prefix,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk) AS distinct_items_purchased,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax), 0)
   FROM store_returns sr
   WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS total_return_amount
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '[0-9]{3}')
  AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com'
  AND SUBSTRING(ca.ca_state, 1, 1) = 'C'
GROUP BY
  c.c_customer_id,
  c.c_first_name,
  c.c_last_name,
  c.c_email_address,
  ca.ca_city
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH item_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_catalog_return_qty,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_catalog_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_web_return_qty,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_web_return_amt,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'PROFITABLE' ELSE 'UNPROFITABLE' END AS profit_status
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost > 500
      AND ss.ss_ext_list_price BETWEEN 1000 AND 15000
      AND i.i_manager_id IN (34, 19, 11)
      AND i.i_container = 'Unknown'
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
      AND wr.wr_return_amt > 0
      AND ss.ss_net_profit > 0
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_brand, i.i_category, i.i_item_sk)
),
brand_stats AS (
    SELECT
        i_brand,
        SUM(total_sales_profit) AS brand_total_profit,
        SUM(total_sales_qty) AS brand_total_qty,
        AVG(total_sales_profit / NULLIF(total_sales_qty, 0)) AS brand_avg_profit_per_qty
    FROM item_aggregates
    WHERE i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY i_brand
)
SELECT
    ia.i_brand,
    ia.i_category,
    ia.i_item_sk,
    ia.total_sales_qty,
    ia.total_sales_amount,
    ia.total_sales_profit,
    ia.total_catalog_return_qty,
    ia.total_catalog_return_amt,
    ia.total_web_return_qty,
    ia.total_web_return_amt,
    ia.profit_status,
    ia.total_sales_profit / NULLIF(ia.total_sales_qty, 0) AS profit_per_qty,
    bs.brand_total_profit,
    bs.brand_avg_profit_per_qty,
    (
        SELECT SUM(total_sales_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(total_sales_qty), 0)
        FROM item_aggregates
        WHERE i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    ) AS overall_avg_profit_per_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ia.i_brand ORDER BY ia.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank_within_brand
FROM item_aggregates ia
JOIN brand_stats bs ON ia.i_brand = bs.i_brand
WHERE ia.total_sales_amount > 1000
  AND ia.total_sales_profit > 0
  AND ia.total_sales_qty > 0
  AND ia.profit_status = 'PROFITABLE'
  AND ia.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        ia.total_sales_profit / NULLIF(ia.total_sales_qty, 0)
      ) > (
        SELECT AVG(total_sales_profit / NULLIF(total_sales_qty, 0))
        FROM item_aggregates
        WHERE i_brand = ia.i_brand AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
      )
ORDER BY ia.i_brand ASC, ia.i_category ASC, ia.total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT DATE '2022-01-01' AS cal_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_ADD('day', 1, cal_date) FROM date_series WHERE cal_date < DATE '2022-01-31'
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name,
        CONCAT('Store ', store.s_store_name) AS store_full_name,
        customer.c_customer_id,
        regexp_extract(customer.c_email_address, '@(.+)$') AS email_domain,
        date_dim.d_date,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT store_sales.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_series ON date_dim.d_date = date_series.cal_date
    WHERE regexp_like(customer.c_email_address, '@example\\.com$')
      AND store.s_store_name LIKE '%Store%'
    GROUP BY
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name,
        CONCAT('Store ', store.s_store_name),
        customer.c_customer_id,
        regexp_extract(customer.c_email_address, '@(.+)$'),
        date_dim.d_date
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name,
        CONCAT('Store ', store.s_store_name) AS store_full_name,
        customer.c_customer_id,
        regexp_extract(customer.c_email_address, '@(.+)$') AS email_domain,
        date_dim.d_date,
        SUM(store_returns.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(store_returns.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT store_returns.sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_return_tickets,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON store_returns.sr_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer ON store_returns.sr_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN reason ON store_returns.sr_reason_sk = reason.r_reason_sk
    JOIN date_series ON date_dim.d_date = date_series.cal_date
    WHERE regexp_like(reason.r_reason_desc, '(price|service)', 'i')
      AND store.s_store_name LIKE '%Store%'
    GROUP BY
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name,
        CONCAT('Store ', store.s_store_name),
        customer.c_customer_id,
        regexp_extract(customer.c_email_address, '@(.+)$'),
        date_dim.d_date
),
union_data AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        store_full_name,
        email_domain,
        d_date,
        total_sales AS metric_amount,
        total_profit AS metric_profit,
        distinct_tickets,
        distinct_customers,
        'sales' AS metric_type
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        store_full_name,
        email_domain,
        d_date,
        total_return_amount AS metric_amount,
        total_net_loss AS metric_profit,
        distinct_return_tickets AS distinct_tickets,
        distinct_customers,
        'return' AS metric_type
    FROM returns_agg
)
SELECT
    u.s_store_id,
    u.store_full_name,
    u.email_domain,
    u.d_date,
    u.metric_type,
    u.metric_amount,
    u.metric_profit,
    u.distinct_tickets,
    u.distinct_customers,
    (SELECT SUM(s.total_sales) FROM sales_agg s WHERE s.s_store_id = u.s_store_id) AS total_store_sales_30d,
    (SELECT SUM(r.total_return_amount) FROM returns_agg r WHERE r.s_store_id = u.s_store_id) AS total_store_returns_30d
FROM union_data u
WHERE u.metric_amount > 0
ORDER BY u.metric_amount DESC, u.metric_type
LIMIT 100

-- Goal: Compute net profit after catalog and web returns for each state, month and promotion in the year 2000 for California, rank promotions by profitability.
WITH sales_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        ca.ca_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_web_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_web_net_loss,
        (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - (SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)))) AS net_profit_after_returns
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2000-12-31'
        AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
        AND ss.ss_net_profit > 0
    GROUP BY
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        ca.ca_state,
        p.p_promo_name
    HAVING
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) > 10
        AND SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 1000
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    ca_state,
    p_promo_name,
    total_sales_paid,
    total_sales_profit,
    total_catalog_return_amount,
    total_web_return_amount,
    net_profit_after_returns,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_profit_after_returns DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_returns_agg
ORDER BY net_profit_after_returns DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
    ws.ws_item_sk,
    ws.ws_web_page_sk,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws.ws_net_paid,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    d.d_year,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_product_name,
    wp.wp_url
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-01' AND DATE '1999-12-31'
    AND regexp_like(wp.wp_url, '^http://www\\.foo\\.com')
    AND i.i_product_name LIKE '%Large%'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM web_returns wr
      WHERE wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_return_amt > 0
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    sd.d_year,
    sd.i_brand,
    sd.i_category,
    url.domain,
    SUM(sd.ws_net_paid) AS total_sales,
    SUM(sd.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    (
      SELECT MAX(p.p_cost)
      FROM promotion p
      JOIN date_dim pd ON p.p_start_date_sk = pd.d_date_sk
      WHERE pd.d_year = sd.d_year
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM item i2
          WHERE i2.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk
            AND i2.i_brand = sd.i_brand
        )
    ) AS max_brand_promo_cost
  FROM sales_data sd
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT regexp_extract(sd.wp_url, 'https?://([^/]+)/', 1) AS domain
  ) AS url
  GROUP BY ROLLUP (sd.d_year, sd.i_brand, sd.i_category, url.domain)
  HAVING SUM(sd.ws_net_paid) > 1000
)
SELECT
  agg.d_year,
  agg.i_brand,
  agg.i_category,
  agg.domain,
  agg.total_sales,
  agg.total_profit,
  agg.order_cnt,
  agg.max_brand_promo_cost,
  SUM(agg.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY agg.i_brand ORDER BY agg.d_year
                             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS brand_cumulative_sales
FROM aggregated agg
ORDER BY agg.d_year DESC, agg.i_brand, agg.i_category
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)      AS total_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)    AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*)                 AS sale_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_hdemo_sk
)
SELECT
    c1.c_customer_id,
    c1.c_first_name,
    c1.c_last_name,
    hd1.hd_buy_potential,
    ib1.ib_lower_bound,
    ib1.ib_upper_bound,
    CASE
        WHEN ss_sum.total_profit > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN ss_sum.total_profit > 0    THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END                                            AS profit_category,
    SUM(ss_sum.total_paid)                        AS sum_total_paid,
    AVG(ss_sum.total_paid)                        AS avg_total_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp1.wp_url)                    AS distinct_page_urls,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hd1.hd_buy_potential)          AS distinct_buy_potentials,
    (SELECT AVG(ss_inner.ss_ext_discount_amt)
       FROM store_sales ss_inner
      WHERE ss_inner.ss_customer_sk = c1.c_customer_sk) AS avg_discount_amt
FROM
    sales_summary ss_sum
    JOIN customer c1
        ON ss_sum.ss_customer_sk = c1.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd1
        ON ss_sum.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib1
        ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp1
        ON wp1.wp_customer_sk = c1.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer c2
        ON ss_sum.ss_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2
        ON c2.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2
        ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss2
        ON ss2.ss_customer_sk = c1.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd3
        ON ss2.ss_hdemo_sk = hd3.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib3
        ON hd3.hd_income_band_sk = ib3.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp2
        ON wp2.wp_customer_sk = c2.c_customer_sk
WHERE
    NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_page wp_anti
        WHERE wp_anti.wp_customer_sk = c1.c_customer_sk
          AND wp_anti.wp_type = 'promo'
    )
    AND c1.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
GROUP BY
    c1.c_customer_id,
    c1.c_first_name,
    c1.c_last_name,
    hd1.hd_buy_potential,
    ib1.ib_lower_bound,
    ib1.ib_upper_bound,
    CASE
        WHEN ss_sum.total_profit > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN ss_sum.total_profit > 0    THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END
ORDER BY
    sum_total_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE distinct_returns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        t.t_meal_time,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_quantity
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND i.i_rec_start_date <= DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND t.t_am_pm = 'PM'
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 1
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    t_meal_time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i_brand) AS distinct_brand_count,
    SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash,
    MIN(wr_return_amt) AS min_return_amount,
    MAX(wr_return_amt) AS max_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns
FROM distinct_returns
GROUP BY i_category, t_meal_time
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH per_item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_class AS class,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode,
        ws_site.web_site_id AS site_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 1000
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1960
      AND ws_site.web_tax_percentage < 0.09
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inventory inv2
          WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand > 10
      )
    GROUP BY
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        ws_site.web_site_id
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        p.class,
        p.ship_mode,
        p.site_id,
        p.total_sales,
        p.total_quantity,
        p.avg_profit,
        p.order_cnt,
        (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_ext_discount_amt)
         FROM web_sales ws2
         WHERE ws2.ws_ship_mode_sk = (
               SELECT sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
               FROM ship_mode sm2
               WHERE sm2.sm_ship_mode_id = p.ship_mode
               LIMIT 1
         )) AS avg_discount_for_ship_mode
    FROM per_item_sales p
)
SELECT
    category,
    class,
    ship_mode,
    site_id,
    SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_sum,
    SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity_sum,
    AVG(avg_profit) AS avg_profit_avg,
    SUM(order_cnt) AS order_cnt_sum,
    AVG(avg_discount_for_ship_mode) AS avg_discount_avg,
    CASE
        WHEN GROUPING(site_id) = 0 AND GROUPING(ship_mode) = 0 AND GROUPING(class) = 0 THEN 'Detail'
        WHEN GROUPING(site_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(ship_mode) = 0 AND GROUPING(class) = 0 THEN 'Ship Mode Subtotal'
        WHEN GROUPING(site_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(ship_mode) = 1 AND GROUPING(class) = 0 THEN 'Class Subtotal'
        WHEN GROUPING(site_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(ship_mode) = 1 AND GROUPING(class) = 1 THEN 'Category Subtotal'
        ELSE 'Grand Total'
    END AS level
FROM final_agg
WHERE total_sales > 50000
GROUP BY ROLLUP(category, class, ship_mode, site_id)
HAVING SUM(total_quantity) > 1000
ORDER BY category, class, ship_mode, site_id
LIMIT 100

WITH store_return_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        i.i_category,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS store_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        s.s_store_name LIKE '%Market%'
        AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '^.*[0-9]{2}.*$')
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        i.i_category,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk
),
catalog_return_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS catalog_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '^.*[A-Z]{2}[0-9]+.*$')
    GROUP BY
        i.i_category,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk
)
SELECT
    CONCAT(sra.s_store_name, ' - ', sra.s_city) AS store_label,
    sra.i_category,
    SUBSTRING(sra.s_store_name, 1, 5) AS store_prefix,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    sra.store_net_loss + COALESCE(cra.catalog_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
    sra.store_return_amount + COALESCE(cra.catalog_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN (sra.store_net_loss + COALESCE(cra.catalog_net_loss, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Profit'
        ELSE 'Loss'
    END AS profit_flag,
    (
        SELECT regexp_extract(i2.i_item_desc, '(\\w+)', 1)
        FROM item i2
        WHERE i2.i_category = sra.i_category
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS exemplar_word,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                s2.s_store_sk,
                SUM(sr2.sr_net_loss) AS net_loss
            FROM store_returns sr2
            JOIN store s2 ON sr2.sr_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
            JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON sr2.sr_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
            WHERE hd2.hd_income_band_sk = sra.hd_income_band_sk
            GROUP BY s2.s_store_sk
        ) sub
        WHERE sub.net_loss > (sra.store_net_loss + COALESCE(cra.catalog_net_loss, 0))
    ) AS higher_loss_store_count
FROM store_return_agg sra
LEFT JOIN catalog_return_agg cra
    ON sra.i_category = cra.i_category
    AND sra.hd_income_band_sk = cra.hd_income_band_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON sra.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE LENGTH(CONCAT(sra.s_store_name, ' - ', sra.s_city)) > 10
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
OFFSET 0
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        cd.cd_gender,
        wp.wp_type,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_returns,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
        AVG(ss.ss_ext_tax) AS avg_tax,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
       AND wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT wp.wp_type, wp.wp_rec_start_date
        FROM web_page wp
        WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
          AND wp.wp_type = 'content'
          AND wp.wp_rec_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2005-12-31'
        LIMIT 1
    ) wp
    WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
      AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd.cd_dep_employed_count <= 2
      AND ss.ss_ext_tax > 10.00
      AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 100.00
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (ca.ca_state, cd.cd_gender, wp.wp_type),
        (ca.ca_state, cd.cd_gender),
        (ca.ca_state),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    cd_gender,
    wp_type,
    total_sales,
    total_returns,
    total_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE total_profit / total_sales
    END AS profit_margin,
    distinct_tickets,
    avg_tax,
    total_quantity,
    total_return_qty
FROM sales_returns_agg
WHERE total_sales IS NOT NULL
HAVING total_sales > 5000
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH first_set AS (
   SELECT i.i_category,
          ca.ca_state,
          SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
          SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales,
          COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
          CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_indicator
   FROM catalog_returns cr
   JOIN catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) cs
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
       AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_bill_addr_sk
   JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   WHERE cr.cr_return_tax > 10.00
     AND cs.cs_list_price >= 50
     AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
     AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 1
     AND ws.ws_quantity >= 2
   GROUP BY i.i_category, ca.ca_state
),
second_set AS (
   SELECT i.i_category,
          ca.ca_state,
          SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
          SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales,
          COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
          CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_indicator
   FROM catalog_returns cr
   JOIN catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) cs
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
       AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_ship_addr_sk
   JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   WHERE cr.cr_return_tax <= 10.00
     AND cs.cs_list_price < 100
     AND ca.ca_state = 'NY'
     AND sr.sr_return_quantity <= 1
     AND ws.ws_quantity < 2
   GROUP BY i.i_category, ca.ca_state
),
unioned AS (
   SELECT * FROM first_set
   UNION ALL
   SELECT * FROM second_set
)
SELECT unioned.i_category,
       unioned.ca_state,
       unioned.total_return_amount,
       unioned.total_sales,
       unioned.txn_count,
       unioned.profit_indicator,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unioned.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
       SUM(unioned.total_sales) OVER () AS grand_total_sales
FROM unioned
ORDER BY unioned.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM seq WHERE lvl < 5
),
sampled_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs_quantity,
        cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs_net_profit,
        cs_call_center_sk,
        cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs_warehouse_sk
    FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_type,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_code,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        td.t_time_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        wr.wr_reason_sk,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_link_count,
        ss.cs_quantity,
        ss.cs_net_profit,
        ss.cs_ext_sales_price,
        ss.cs_ship_date_sk,
        wr.wr_return_amt
    FROM sampled_sales ss
    JOIN call_center cc ON ss.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON ss.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ss.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ss.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON td.t_time_sk = wr.wr_returned_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
),
base_with_lateral AS (
    SELECT
        b.*, 
        lr.total_return_amt
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(wr2.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_reason_sk = b.wr_reason_sk
          AND wr2.wr_returned_time_sk = b.t_time_sk
    ) lr ON TRUE
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cc_name,
        cc_state,
        sm_type,
        sm_code,
        w_state,
        cp_type,
        r_reason_desc,
        wp_link_count,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(total_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        MAX(cs_quantity) AS max_quantity,
        MIN(cs_quantity) AS min_quantity
    FROM base_with_lateral
    GROUP BY
        cc_name,
        cc_state,
        sm_type,
        sm_code,
        w_state,
        cp_type,
        r_reason_desc,
        wp_link_count
)
SELECT
    a.cc_name,
    a.cc_state,
    a.sm_type,
    a.sm_code,
    a.w_state AS warehouse_state,
    a.cp_type AS catalog_page_type,
    a.r_reason_desc,
    a.wp_link_count,
    a.total_net_profit,
    a.total_sales,
    a.total_return_amount,
    a.txn_count,
    a.max_quantity,
    a.min_quantity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_net_profit DESC) AS net_profit_rank,
    LAG(a.total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY a.total_net_profit DESC) AS prev_net_profit,
    SUM(a.total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY a.total_net_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN a.total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status,
    s.lvl
FROM aggregated a
CROSS JOIN seq s
WHERE a.total_sales > 5000.00
  AND a.total_net_profit IS NOT NULL
  AND a.w_state = 'CA'
  AND a.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND a.sm_code IN ('AIR', 'SEA')
  AND a.wp_link_count > 5
ORDER BY a.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT MIN(cr_returned_date_sk) AS date_sk
    FROM catalog_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_series
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= (
        SELECT MAX(cr_returned_date_sk)
        FROM catalog_returns
    )
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(cr_return_amount) AS overall_avg_return
    FROM catalog_returns
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_company_name,
        w.w_state AS warehouse_state,
        CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 200 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        oa.overall_avg_return,
        state_elem
    FROM call_center cc
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY[cc.cc_state, w.w_state]) AS t(state_elem)
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
    WHERE (
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk IS NULL
        OR cr.cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_series)
    )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM reason r2
          WHERE r2.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
            AND r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%'
      )
    GROUP BY
        cc.cc_company_name,
        w.w_state,
        CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 200 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END,
        oa.overall_avg_return,
        state_elem
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 500
)
SELECT
    cc_company_name,
    warehouse_state,
    return_category,
    total_return_amount,
    return_count,
    overall_avg_return,
    state_elem
FROM base_agg
WHERE warehouse_state = 'OH'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    cc_company_name,
    warehouse_state,
    return_category,
    total_return_amount,
    return_count,
    overall_avg_return,
    state_elem
FROM base_agg
WHERE warehouse_state = 'GA'
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC

/*
Goal: Calculate aggregated sales, returns, and inventory metrics by item category and store state, exercising deep joins across all TPC‑DS tables, a recursive hierarchy CTE, a sampled inventory subquery, a CASE expression, and GROUPING SETS.
*/
WITH RECURSIVE num_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM num_hierarchy WHERE lvl < 3
),
inventory_sample AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk,
           inv_warehouse_sk,
           inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
)
SELECT
    i.i_category,
    s.s_state,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)                                   AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid)                                   AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)                                   AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)                                   AS total_catalog_return_loss,
    SUM(inv_s.inv_quantity_on_hand)                       AS sampled_inventory_qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td1.t_meal_time = 'breakfast' THEN cs.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS breakfast_catalog_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id)                       AS unique_customers,
    (SELECT AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory WHERE inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_inventory_qty
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN time_dim td1 ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td1.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w1 ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w1.w_warehouse_sk

-- catalog returns
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
                        AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim td4 ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td4.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refunded.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_returning ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_returning.c_customer_sk
JOIN warehouse w2 ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk

-- store returns
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                       AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN time_dim td2 ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td2.t_time_sk
JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk

-- web sales
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN time_dim td3 ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td3.t_time_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
JOIN warehouse w3 ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w3.w_warehouse_sk
