-- second alias for item used with sampled inventory
JOIN item i2 ON i2.i_item_sk = inv_s.inv_item_sk

-- sampled inventory (joined via its own item alias and warehouse)
JOIN inventory_sample inv_s ON inv_s.inv_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
                           AND inv_s.inv_warehouse_sk = w3.w_warehouse_sk

WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM num_hierarchy nh WHERE nh.lvl = MOD(td1.t_hour, 3) + 1
)
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (i.i_category, s.s_state),
    (i.i_category),
    (s.s_state),
    ()
)
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 0
ORDER BY total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_keys AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_keys dk ON d.d_date_sk = dk.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d.d_date_sk <= (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim)
      AND dk.d_date_sk < (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) + 30 FROM date_dim)
),
sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        t.t_hour,
        cc.cc_state,
        i.i_manufact_id,
        i.i_size,
        i.i_units,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cd.cd_gender,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        s.s_store_name,
        ws.web_name,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_keys dk ON dk.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND i.i_manufact_id IN (479, 260)
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 100000
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 1
)
SELECT
    sb.d_year,
    sb.i_manufact_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(sb.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
    AVG(
        sb.cs_ext_sales_price *
        CASE 
            WHEN sb.cr_return_quantity IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE GREATEST(0, 1 - (sb.cr_return_quantity * 1.0 / NULLIF(sb.cs_quantity, 0)))
        END
    ) AS avg_adjusted_sales_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sb.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders
FROM sales_base sb
GROUP BY sb.d_year, sb.i_manufact_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sb.cs_order_number) > 10
ORDER BY sb.d_year, sb.i_manufact_id

WITH RECURSIVE joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca.ca_state,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        i.i_item_sk,
        p.p_promo_sk,
        td.t_time_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wsite.web_site_id
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        AND wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        AND wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (10, 11, 12)
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM promotion p2
            WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
              AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *
    FROM joined_data
    WHERE FALSE
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        c_customer_id,
        ca_state,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS num_orders,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) + SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        (
            SELECT SUM(ws_inner.ws_net_paid)
            FROM web_sales ws_inner
            WHERE ws_inner.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
        ) AS total_web_sales_by_customer
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_customer_id, ca_state, hd_income_band_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs_net_paid) > 1000
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    ca_state,
    hd_income_band_sk,
    num_orders,
    total_catalog_sales,
    total_web_sales,
    total_profit,
    total_return_amount,
    total_web_sales_by_customer
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_year,
           d_month_seq,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2000-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           d2.d_year,
           d2.d_month_seq,
           dr.lvl + 1
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN date_range dr
      ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dr.d_date)
    WHERE dr.lvl < 5
),
distinct_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price > (SELECT MAX(i_current_price) FROM item) - 1000
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) ss
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 0
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        dr.d_year,
        dr.d_month_seq,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_product_name,
        ws.web_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        p.p_promo_name,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_meal_time
    FROM base_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk AND dr.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk AND dr.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cc ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_cc.d_date_sk
    WHERE i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM distinct_items)
      AND cc.cc_state = 'TX'
      AND ws.web_country = 'USA'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#34'
      AND dr.d_year = 2000
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND ss.ss_net_paid > (SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = 2451910)
      AND dr.d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_range)
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    i_category,
    i_item_id,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    web_name,
    cc_state,
    p_promo_name,
    r_reason_desc,
    total_sales,
    total_quantity,
    total_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        i_category,
        i_item_id,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        web_name,
        cc_state,
        p_promo_name,
        r_reason_desc,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d_year, d_month_seq, i_category, i_item_id, i_brand, i_product_name, web_name, cc_state, p_promo_name, r_reason_desc),
        (d_year, d_month_seq, i_category),
        ()
    )
) agg
WHERE total_sales IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d_year DESC, d_month_seq, total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        i.i_category AS category,
        p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_ext_sales_price, 0)) AS store_sales_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_ext_sales_price, 0)) AS web_sales_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS inventory_qty
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ss.ss_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site web ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = web.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_country IN ('KOREA', 'UKRAINE')
      AND cd.cd_dep_count >= 1
      AND s.s_country = 'United States'
      AND web.web_country = 'United States'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (cp.cp_department, ca.ca_state, i.i_category, p.p_promo_name)
)
SELECT
    department,
    state,
    category,
    promotion_name,
    (catalog_sales_amount + store_sales_amount + web_sales_amount - returns_amount) AS net_sales,
    inventory_qty,
    ROUND((catalog_sales_amount + store_sales_amount + web_sales_amount - returns_amount) / NULLIF(inventory_qty, 0), 2) AS sales_per_inventory
FROM sales_agg
WHERE (catalog_sales_amount + store_sales_amount + web_sales_amount - returns_amount) > 10000
ORDER BY net_sales DESC, department

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2021-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date
    FROM date_seq ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next ON d_next.d_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '2021-01-31'
),
-- Aggregate store returns per store and date
aggregated_returns AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_store_sk,
           sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
           sr.sr_return_time_sk,
           sr.sr_cdemo_sk,
           sr.sr_addr_sk,
           sr.sr_reason_sk,
           SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)   AS sum_return_amt,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)      AS sum_net_loss,
           COUNT(*)                 AS cnt_returns
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2021
    GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk,
             sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
             sr.sr_return_time_sk,
             sr.sr_cdemo_sk,
             sr.sr_addr_sk,
             sr.sr_reason_sk
),
-- Stores that appear in both returns and web‑sales (INTERSECT)
intersect_stores AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_year = 2021
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS store_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2021
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_manager,
    s.s_state,
    ds.d_date,
    ar.sum_return_amt,
    ar.sum_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN ar.sum_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'High Loss'
        WHEN ar.sum_net_loss > 0    THEN 'Loss'
        ELSE 'Profit'
    END AS loss_category,
    cc.cc_name            AS call_center_name,
    cp.cp_type            AS catalog_page_type,
    COALESCE(ws_agg.sum_sales, 0) AS total_web_sales,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ws_agg.sum_sales, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ar.sum_return_amt / ws_agg.sum_sales
    END AS return_to_sales_ratio
FROM store s
JOIN aggregated_returns ar
  ON s.s_store_sk = ar.sr_store_sk
JOIN date_seq ds
  ON ar.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
JOIN reason r
  ON ar.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ar.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON ar.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN time_dim t
  ON ar.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN call_center cc
  ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
-- Bring in web‑sales that share the same date, time, address and demographics (allowed joins only)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS sum_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
             ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
             ws.ws_sold_time_sk
) ws_agg
  ON ws_agg.ws_bill_customer_sk = ca.ca_address_sk   -- using the address key (allowed)
 AND ws_agg.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
 AND ws_agg.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'                                 -- filter 1
  AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17                         -- filter 2
  AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'                            -- filter 3
  AND s.s_store_sk IN (SELECT store_sk FROM intersect_stores)
GROUP BY s.s_store_id,
         s.s_store_name,
         s.s_manager,
         s.s_state,
         ds.d_date,
         ar.sum_return_amt,
         ar.sum_net_loss,
         cc.cc_name,
         cp.cp_type,
         ws_agg.sum_sales,
         t.t_hour,
         r.r_reason_desc,
         ca.ca_city,
         cd.cd_gender
HAVING ar.sum_return_amt > (
    SELECT AVG(total_ret)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(ar2.sum_return_amt) AS total_ret
        FROM aggregated_returns ar2
        JOIN store s2 ON ar2.sr_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
        WHERE s2.s_st

/* Goal: Summarize net paid, sales, return and inventory metrics by year, item category and store location, with promotion details, subtotals and a ranking per year. */
WITH RECURSIVE base_data (
    sales_year,
    category,
    state,
    warehouse_id,
    promo_name,
    net_paid,
    ext_sales_price,
    store_return_amt,
    web_return_amt,
    wholesale_cost,
    i_units,
    warehouse_sq_ft,
    inv_qty
) AS (
    SELECT
        d_cs_sold.d_year AS sales_year,
        i_cs.i_category AS category,
        s.s_state AS state,
        w_cs.w_warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS store_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_amt AS web_return_amt,
        i_cs.i_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost,
        i_cs.i_units AS i_units,
        w_cs.w_warehouse_sq_ft AS warehouse_sq_ft,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_qty
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_cs_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cs_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_cs_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer c_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i_cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_cs.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_cs.i_item_sk
                        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
                        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_cs_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i_cs.i_item_sk
                         AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_cs_sold.d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sales_year,
        category,
        state,
        warehouse_id,
        promo_name,
        net_paid,
        ext_sales_price,
        store_return_amt,
        web_return_amt,
        wholesale_cost,
        i_units,
        warehouse_sq_ft,
        inv_qty
    FROM base_data
    WHERE FALSE
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        sales_year,
        category,
        state,
        warehouse_id,
        promo_name,
        SUM(net_paid)               AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ext_sales_price)        AS total_sales,
        SUM(store_return_amt)       AS total_store_returns,
        SUM(web_return_amt)         AS total_web_returns,
        AVG(wholesale_cost)         AS avg_wholesale_cost,
        SUM(inv_qty)                AS total_inventory,
        COUNT(*)                    AS transaction_count
    FROM base_data
    WHERE sales_year = 2001
      AND wholesale_cost > 5.00
      AND i_units = 'Ounce'
      AND warehouse_sq_ft > 800000
      AND state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (sales_year, category, state, warehouse_id, promo_name)
    HAVING SUM(net_paid) > 0
)
SELECT
    sales_year,
    category,
    state,
    warehouse_id,
    promo_name,
    total_net_paid,
    total_sales,
    total_store_returns,
    total_web_returns,
    avg_wholesale_cost,
    total_inventory,
    transaction_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sales_year ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS rn_year
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY sales_year, category
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        d_sold.d_year,
        p.p_promo_id,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
        sm_ship.sm_carrier,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        s.s_store_name,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        wp.wp_web_page_id,
        wsite.web_site_id,
        t.t_hour,
        ca.ca_city
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ship ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
                                 AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                              AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS row_num,
    brand,
    category,
    year,
    SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(total_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS distinct_orders
FROM (
    SELECT
        bs.i_brand AS brand,
        bs.i_category AS category,
        bs.d_year AS year,
        bs.cs_quantity AS total_quantity,
        bs.cs_net_paid AS total_net_paid,
        bs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM base_sales bs
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = bs.cs_order_number
          AND cr2.cr_item_sk = bs.cs_item_sk
    )
      AND bs.p_promo_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT
        bs.i_brand AS brand,
        bs.i_category AS category,
        bs.d_year AS year,
        bs.cs_quantity AS total_quantity,
        bs.cs_net_paid AS total_net_paid,
        bs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM base_sales bs
    WHERE bs.p_promo_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bs.p_promo_id LIKE 'AAAAAAA%'
) AS unioned_sales
GROUP BY brand, category, year
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT 1999 AS yr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT yr + 1 FROM years WHERE yr < 2001
),
date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d.*
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN years y ON d.d_year = y.yr
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_returns,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_transactions,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_qty_agg,
        (
            SELECT SUM(i2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
            FROM inventory i2
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON i2.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE d2.d_year = d.d_year
        ) AS total_inventory_by_year
    FROM date_filtered d
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_store
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_store.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w
        ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM call_center cc2
        WHERE cc2.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
          AND cc2.cc_state = 'TX'
    )
    GROUP BY d.d_year, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, s.s_store_name
    UNION
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        sm2.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode,
        NULL AS store_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_returns,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_transactions,
        SUM(i2.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_qty_agg,
        (
            SELECT SUM(i3.inv_quantity_on_hand)
            FROM inventory i3
            JOIN date_dim d3 ON i3.inv_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
            WHERE d3.d_year = d.d_year
        ) AS total_inventory_by_year
    FROM date_filtered d
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t2
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm2
        ON sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk = ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w2
        ON w2.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory i2
        ON i2.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND i2.inv_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ship_mode sm_check
        WHERE sm_check.sm_ship_mode_sk = ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
          AND sm_check.sm_type = 'AIR'
    )
    GROUP BY d.d_year, sm2.sm_ship_mode_id
) AS combined
ORDER BY year DESC, total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, d.d_year
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2023-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date, d_next.d_year
    FROM date_dim d_next
    JOIN date_seq ds ON d_next.d_date = DATE_ADD('day', 1, ds.d_date)
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '2023-01-31'
),
sales_no_returns AS (
    SELECT cs_order_number
    FROM catalog_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns
),
date_promo_flag AS (
    SELECT p.p_start_date_sk AS d_date_sk, MAX(p.p_discount_active) AS max_promo_active_flag
    FROM promotion p
    GROUP BY p.p_start_date_sk
)
SELECT
    d.d_date AS sale_date,
    d.d_year,
    s.s_store_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promotion') AS promotion_name,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.cs_net_paid > 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN cs.cs_net_paid BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS sales_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_store_net_profit,
    date_promo_flag.max_promo_active_flag
FROM date_seq d
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN sales_no_returns snr ON cs.cs_order_number = snr.cs_order_number
INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_demo ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd_demo.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
INNER JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
INNER JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN date_promo_flag ON date_promo_flag.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM promotion p2
    WHERE p2.p_end_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
)
GROUP BY
    d.d_date,
    d.d_year,
    s.s_store_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promotion'),
    CASE
        WHEN cs.cs_net_paid > 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN cs.cs_net_paid BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END,
    date_promo_flag.max_promo_active_flag
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
   SELECT
      d.d_year,
      d.d_month_seq,
      i.i_category,
      i.i_brand,
      i.i_item_sk,
      c.c_customer_sk,
      cs.cs_net_paid,
      ss.ss_net_paid,
      ws.ws_net_paid,
      sr.sr_return_amt,
      inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
      p.p_discount_active,
      we.web_market_manager
   FROM catalog_sales cs
   JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
   JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
   JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
   JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                       AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
                       AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                       AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
                       AND ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                       AND ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                       AND ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                         AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
                         AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                         AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                         AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
                         AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
   JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                      AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
                      AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                      AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                      AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
                      AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
                      AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
   WHERE d.d_year = 2001
     AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
     AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
     AND we.web_market_manager = 'William Reyes'
)
SELECT
   jd.i_category,
   jd.i_brand,
   SUM(jd.cs_net_paid + jd.ss_net_paid + jd.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
   SUM(jd.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
   CASE
      WHEN SUM(jd.cs_net_paid + jd.ss_net_paid + jd.ws_net_paid) > 0 THEN 'Profit'
      ELSE 'Loss'
   END AS profit_flag,
   COUNT(DISTINCT jd.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
FROM joined_data jd
GROUP BY jd.i_category, jd.i_brand
HAVING SUM(jd.cs_net_paid + jd.ss_net_paid + jd.ws_net_paid) > (
      SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs2
   )
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

/* Goal: Compute total sales and loss metrics across store sales, store returns, catalog returns, and web returns for high‑priced items, broken down by item, call‑center and return reasons with subtotals, while also showing tickets that had a sale but no return. */
WITH high_price_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_current_price
    FROM tpcds.item
    WHERE i_current_price > 20
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    r_sr.r_reason_desc AS store_return_reason,
    r_cr.r_reason_desc AS catalog_return_reason,
    r_wr.r_reason_desc AS web_return_reason,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_sales_tickets,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_sales_price)
        FROM tpcds.store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS avg_sales_price
FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
JOIN high_price_items i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_ss
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_ss
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
    ON hd_ss.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN tpcds.reason r_sr
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.reason r_cr
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
JOIN tpcds.call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN tpcds.reason r_wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_cr_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_cr_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_ref.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_cr_ret
    ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_ret.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_cr_ret
    ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_cr_ret.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_wr_ref
    ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_wr_ref
    ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_ref.hd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd_wr_ret
    ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_ret.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd_wr_ret
    ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_ret.hd_demo_sk
WHERE ss.ss_ticket_number IN (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number FROM tpcds.store_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT sr_ticket_number FROM tpcds.store_returns
)
GROUP BY ROLLUP(
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    r_sr.r_reason_desc,
    r_cr.r_reason_desc,
    r_wr.r_reason_desc,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound
)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT
    s.s_store_name AS store_name,
    s.s_state AS store_state,
    c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
    p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
    CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax > 1000 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Small' END AS sale_size,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS total_positive_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_returns wr2 WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number) AS web_return_count
FROM
    catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_b ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_b.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_b ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_b.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd_b.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_b.cd_demo_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_b.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
WHERE
    cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND cp.cp_department = 'DEPARTMENT'
    AND c.c_birth_country = 'United States'
    AND s.s_state = 'TX'
    AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_sales_price)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_quantity > 0
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_state,
    c.c_birth_country,
    p.p_promo_name,
    CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax > 1000 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Small' END
ORDER BY
    total_net_paid DESC,
    store_name
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca.ca_state,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk AS ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        p.p_promo_id AS p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS store_ext_sales,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS store_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS web_ext_sales,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS web_net_profit,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS catalog_return_amount,
        wr.wr_return_amt AS web_return_amount,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        cc.cc_name
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 100000
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential LIKE '5001-%'
      AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
          WHERE cr2.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 0
      )
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        p_promo_id,
        ib_income_band_sk,
        SUM(store_ext_sales) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(store_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
        SUM(web_ext_sales) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(web_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
        SUM(catalog_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
        SUM(web_return_amount) AS total_web_returns,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty
    FROM base
    GROUP BY d_year, p_promo_id, ib_income_band_sk
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    p_promo_id,
    ib_income_band_sk,
    total_store_sales,
    total_web_sales,
    total_store_profit,
    total_web_profit,
    total_catalog_returns,
    total_web_returns,
    total_inventory_qty,
    (total_store_sales + total_web_sales - total_catalog_returns - total_web_returns) AS net_sales
FROM agg
WHERE total_store_sales > 5000
  AND total_web_sales > 3000
HAVING (total_store_sales + total_web_sales - total_catalog_returns - total_web_returns) > 6000
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH date_warehouse_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS web_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_sales_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_sales_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_sales_cnt,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT i.inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory i
        WHERE i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        ORDER BY i.inv_quantity_on_hand DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) inv
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND c.c_birth_country = 'United States'
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 1
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 1000
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, w.w_warehouse_name, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
)

SELECT
    dws.d_year,
    dws.w_warehouse_name,
    dws.store_net_paid,
    dws.catalog_net_paid,
    dws.web_net_paid,
    dws.store_sales_cnt,
    dws.catalog_sales_cnt,
    dws.web_sales_cnt,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        WHERE cs.cs_warehouse_sk = (
                SELECT w2.w_warehouse_sk
                FROM warehouse w2
                WHERE w2.w_warehouse_name = dws.w_warehouse_name
                LIMIT 1
              )
          AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (
                SELECT d2.d_date_sk
                FROM date_dim d2
                WHERE d2.d_year = dws.d_year
              )
    ) AS total_catalog_net_profit,
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT cc.cc_name
        FROM call_center cc
        WHERE cc.cc_call_center_sk = (
                SELECT cs2.cs_call_center_sk
                FROM catalog_sales cs2
                WHERE cs2.cs_warehouse_sk = (
                        SELECT w3.w_warehouse_sk
                        FROM warehouse w3
                        WHERE w3.w_warehouse_name = dws.w_warehouse_name
                        LIMIT 1
                      )
                  AND cs2.cs_sold_date_sk IN (
                        SELECT d3.d_date_sk
                        FROM date_dim d3
                        WHERE d3.d_year = dws.d_year
                      )
                LIMIT 1
              )
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS call_center_name
FROM date_warehouse_sales dws
ORDER BY dws.store_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_date_sk,
        t.t_hour,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_product_name,
        c.c_customer_id,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        ca.ca_zip,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS store_net_profit,
        ss.ss_quantity AS store_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS web_net_profit,
        ws.ws_quantity AS web_quantity,
        wp.wp_type,
        we.web_name AS website_name,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_return_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_category,
        s_store_name,
        cc_name,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        ib_lower_bound,
        hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(cs_net_profit + store_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MIN(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS min_discount,
        MAX(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS max_discount
    FROM base
    WHERE d_year = 2001
        AND i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND s_state = 'CA'
        AND cc_state = 'TX'
        AND ca_zip = '39431'

    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk IN (SELECT w_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse_filter)
    AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk IN (SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk FROM catalog_page_set)

    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w

    AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk

  CASE
    WHEN SUM(COALESCE(store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(web_net_profit, 0) - COALESCE(store_return_loss, 0) - COALESCE(catalog_return_loss, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Profitable'

        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_store_credit,
        CASE
            WHEN sr.sr_store_credit > 500 THEN 'Platinum'
            WHEN sr.sr_store_credit > 200 THEN 'Gold'
            ELSE 'Standard'
        END AS credit_tier
    FROM date_dim dd
    JOIN sampled_inventory i
        ON i.inv_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2001
      AND dd.d_weekend = 'N'
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    jd.w_warehouse_id,
    jd.w_warehouse_name,
    jd.d_date,
    jd.credit_tier,
    jd.sr_return_amt,
    jd.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    (
        SELECT SUM(i2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory i2
        WHERE i2.inv_warehouse_sk = jd.w_warehouse_sk
    ) AS total_inventory_for_warehouse,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY jd.w_warehouse_id ORDER BY jd.sr_return_amt DESC) AS rn_return_amt_desc,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY jd.w_warehouse_id ORDER BY jd.inv_quantity_on_hand DESC) AS rnk_quantity
FROM joined_data jd
ORDER BY jd.w_warehouse_id, rn_return_amt_desc
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH site_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wsite.web_site_id,
        i.i_category,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS sum_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS sum_quantity,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ws.ws_net_profit > 0 THEN ws.ws_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS sum_positive_profit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ws.ws_net_profit < 0 THEN -ws.ws_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS sum_negative_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE td.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND i.i_current_price > 100.00
      AND ca_bill.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND wp.wp_max_ad_count >= 2
      AND wsite.web_class = 'A'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND wp.wp_rec_end_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND i.i_rec_end_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_returns wr
          WHERE wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
            AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
            AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
      )
    GROUP BY wsite.web_site_id, i.i_category
)
SELECT
    web_site_id,
    i_category,
    order_cnt,
    sum_net_profit,
    sum_sales,
    sum_quantity,
    sum_net_profit / NULLIF(order_cnt, 0) AS avg_profit_per_order,
    CASE 
        WHEN sum_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable'
        WHEN sum_net_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss'
        ELSE 'BreakEven'
    END AS profit_category,
    (sum_net_profit / NULLIF(sum_sales, 0)) * 100 AS profit_margin_pct,
    sum_quantity / NULLIF(order_cnt, 0) AS avg_quantity_per_order
FROM site_sales
WHERE sum_quantity > 100
  AND sum_sales > 1000.00
HAVING sum_net_profit / NULLIF(order_cnt, 0) > 0
ORDER BY profit_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH intersected_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 10
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    CASE
        WHEN ib.ib_upper_bound > 150000 THEN 'Upper'
        WHEN ib.ib_lower_bound >= 80001 THEN 'Upper-Mid'
        ELSE 'Mid-Low'
    END AS income_tier,
    td.t_hour,
    COUNT(ss.ss_ticket_number) AS sales_count,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
    MIN(ss.ss_quantity) AS min_quantity,
    MAX(ss.ss_quantity) AS max_quantity,
    COALESCE(wp.wp_type, 'none') AS page_type,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_page wp2
        WHERE wp2.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS total_pages_visited,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_net_paid)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS total_customer_sales
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_sales ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_sales.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_sales ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_sales.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd_sales.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_current ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_current.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_current ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_current.hd_demo_sk
JOIN intersected_customers ic ON c.c_customer_sk = ic.c_customer_sk
WHERE
    td.t_second IN (6, 15)
    AND td.t_minute = 12
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 80001
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    CASE
        WHEN ib.ib_upper_bound > 150000 THEN 'Upper'
        WHEN ib.ib_lower_bound >= 80001 THEN 'Upper-Mid'
        ELSE 'Mid-Low'
    END,
    td.t_hour,
    wp.wp_type
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month_num + 1 FROM months WHERE month_num < 12
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_month,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_fee) AS total_fee,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low/Medium' END AS loss_category
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer c
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        wr.wr_return_amt > 10
        AND wr.wr_fee BETWEEN 20 AND 60
        AND c.c_birth_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28
        AND c.c_birth_month IN (1,2,3,4,5,6)
        AND hd.hd_dep_count >= 2
        AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (3,9,15,16)
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential NOT IN ('Unknown')
        AND c.c_customer_sk NOT IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT wr2.wr_returning_customer_sk
            FROM web_returns wr2
            WHERE wr2.wr_net_loss < 0
        )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (c.c_birth_month, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(m.month_num, a.c_birth_month) AS month_num,
    a.c_birth_month,
    a.hd_income_band_sk,
    a.hd_buy_potential,
    a.distinct_customers,
    a.total_return_amt,
    a.total_fee,
    a.total_net_loss,
    a.loss_category,
    SUM(a.total_net_loss) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.hd_income_band_sk
        ORDER BY COALESCE(m.month_num, a.c_birth_month)
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_net_loss,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.hd_income_band_sk
        ORDER BY a.total_return_amt DESC
    ) AS return_amt_rank
FROM months m
FULL OUTER JOIN aggregated a
    ON m.month_num = a.c_birth_month
ORDER BY a.total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        d_sold.d_year,
        CASE
            WHEN i.i_current_price > 100 THEN 'High'
            WHEN i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS price_bucket,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_returns_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS total_inventory_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship
      ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
      ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
      ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill
      ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship
      ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_ret
      ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ret
      ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
      ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
      AND i.i_current_price > 50
      AND ca_bill.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY
        ROLLUP(i.i_category,
               d_sold.d_year,
               CASE
                   WHEN i.i_current_price > 100 THEN 'High'
                   WHEN i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'
                   ELSE 'Low'
               END)
),

overall_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
           MAX(total_sales) AS max_total_sales
    FROM base_metrics
)

SELECT
    bm.i_category,
    bm.d_year,
    bm.price_bucket,
    bm.total_sales,
    bm.total_discount,
    bm.net_profit,
    bm.total_returns_loss,
    bm.total_inventory_qty,
    bm.distinct_orders,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bm.i_category ORDER BY bm.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    os.avg_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN bm.net_profit > os.avg_net_profit THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(total_discount) FROM base_metrics) AS avg_discount_overall,
    os.max_total_sales
FROM base_metrics bm
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE bm.price_bucket = 'High'
  AND bm.total_sales > 1000

UNION ALL

SELECT
    bm2.i_category,
    bm2.d_year,
    bm2.price_bucket,
    bm2.total_sales,
    bm2.total_discount,
    bm2.net_profit,
    bm2.total_returns_loss,
    bm2.total_inventory_qty,
    bm2.distinct_orders,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bm2.i_category ORDER BY bm2.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    os.avg_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN bm2.net_profit > os.avg_net_profit THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(total_discount) FROM base_metrics) AS avg_discount_overall,
    os.max_total_sales
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        i_category,
        d_year,
        price_bucket,
        total_sales,
        total_discount,
        net_profit,
        total_returns_loss,
        total_inventory_qty,
        distinct_orders
    FROM base_metrics
) bm2
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE bm2.price_bucket = 'Low'
  AND bm2.total_inventory_qty > 5000
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE region_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT ca_state AS state, NULL AS city
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca_state

    UNION ALL

    SELECT rh.state, ca.ca_city
    FROM region_hierarchy rh
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_state = rh.state
    WHERE rh.city IS NULL
    GROUP BY rh.state, ca.ca_city
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        rh.state,
        rh.city,
        'sale' AS trans_type,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS amount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN region_hierarchy rh
        ON ca.ca_state = rh.state
        AND ca.ca_city = rh.city
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_ext_sales_price > (
        SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        JOIN item i2
            ON ss2.ss_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
        WHERE i2.i_category = i.i_category
    )
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr2
          WHERE sr2.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
      )
),

return_data AS (
    SELECT
        rh.state,
        rh.city,
        'return' AS trans_type,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS amount
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN item i
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN region_hierarchy rh
        ON ca.ca_state = rh.state
        AND ca.ca_city = rh.city
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND sr.sr_net_loss > 0
)

SELECT
    state,
    city,
    trans_type,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM (
    SELECT state, city, trans_type, amount FROM sales_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT state, city, trans_type, amount FROM return_data
) AS combined
GROUP BY ROLLUP(state, city, trans_type)
ORDER BY state, city, trans_type
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_state,
        r_store.r_reason_desc,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_item_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim t_sr
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer cust_sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cust_sr.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r_store
        ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_store.r_reason_sk
    -- Catalog Returns
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_store.r_reason_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer cust_cr_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_cr_refund.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer cust_cr_returning
        ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cust_cr_returning.c_customer_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    -- Web Returns
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_store.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN customer cust_wr_refund
        ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cust_wr_refund.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer cust_wr_returning
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cust_wr_returning.c_customer_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer cust_wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = cust_wp.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    s_state,
    r_reason_desc,
    SUM(sr_net_loss)                         AS store_net_loss,
    SUM(catalog_net_loss)                    AS catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(web_net_loss)                        AS web_net_loss,
    SUM(sr_net_loss) + SUM(catalog_net_loss) + SUM(web_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN (SUM(sr_net_loss) + SUM(catalog_net_loss) + SUM(web_net_loss)) > 1000 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END                                      AS loss_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr_item_sk)               AS distinct_catalog_items
FROM joined_data
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (s_state, r_reason_desc),
    (s_state),
    (r_reason_desc),
    ()
)
ORDER BY loss_category ASC,
         s_state ASC NULLS LAST,
         r_reason_desc ASC NULLS LAST

WITH ss_sr AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_wholesale_cost,
        ss.ss_list_price,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
        ss.ss_ext_list_price,
        ss.ss_ext_tax,
        ss.ss_coupon_amt,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_cdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_addr_sk,
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_reason_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_tax,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_fee,
        sr.sr_return_ship_cost,
        sr.sr_refunded_cash,
        sr.sr_reversed_charge,
        sr.sr_store_credit,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_state,
    i.i_color,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss_sr.ss_ticket_number) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(ss_sr.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(ss_sr.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss,
    SUM(ss_sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS max_item_return_amount
FROM ss_sr
JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = COALESCE(ss_sr.ss_item_sk, ss_sr.sr_item_sk)
JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = COALESCE(ss_sr.ss_store_sk, ss_sr.sr_store_sk)
JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_promo_sk = ss_sr.ss_promo_sk
    AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss_sr.ss_cdemo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss_sr.ss_addr_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND w.w_suite_number = 'Suite 480'
  AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
  AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
  AND cc.cc_tax_percentage > 5.00
  AND cr.cr_return_amount > 1000.00
GROUP BY ROLLUP(s.s_state, i.i_color)
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE ws_agg AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS ws_order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    c_refund.c_customer_id,
    c_refund.c_first_name,
    c_refund.c_last_name,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_cat_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    (SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)) AS total_return_net_loss,
    ws_agg.total_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN ws_agg.total_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'PROFITABLE' ELSE 'LOW_PROFIT' END AS profit_category,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refund.c_customer_sk
          AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 100
    ) AS high_return_count
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN customer c_refund
    ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refund.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_return
    ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_return.c_customer_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_cr
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_refund.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_store
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_store.c_customer_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_refund.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ws_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_ws
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN customer c_wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_wp.c_customer_sk
JOIN ws_agg
    ON ws_agg.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_refund.c_customer_sk
WHERE wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
  AND wp.wp_image_count > 2
GROUP BY
    c_refund.c_customer_id,
    c_refund.c_first_name,
    c_refund.c_last_name,
    ws_agg.total_net_profit,
    c_refund.c_customer_sk
HAVING
    (SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)) > 500
ORDER BY total_return_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT DATE '1998-01-01' AS d
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_add('day', 1, d) FROM date_range WHERE d < DATE '1998-01-31'
),

daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_net_profit_sum,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS ws_net_profit_sum,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS sr_net_loss_sum,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date = dr.d
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 2
      AND cs.cs_net_profit > (SELECT avg(cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr_ex
            WHERE sr_ex.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND sr_ex.sr_return_amt > 500
        )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, d.d_year
),

metric_expansion AS (
    SELECT
        ds.c_customer_sk,
        ds.c_customer_id,
        ds.d_year,
        ds.cs_net_profit_sum,
        ds.ws_net_profit_sum,
        ds.sr_net_loss_sum,
        ds.total_quantity,
        ds.order_cnt,
        metric_name,
        metric_value,
        (ds.cs_net_profit_sum + ds.ws_net_profit_sum - ds.sr_net_loss_sum) AS net_total_profit
    FROM daily_sales ds
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
        ARRAY[ds.cs_net_profit_sum, ds.ws_net_profit_sum, ds.sr_net_loss_sum],
        ARRAY['cs_profit','ws_profit','sr_loss']
    ) AS u(metric_value, metric_name)
)

SELECT
    me.c_customer_id,
    me.d_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN me.metric_name = 'cs_profit' THEN me.metric_value END) AS total_cs_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN me.metric_name = 'ws_profit' THEN me.metric_value END) AS total_ws_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN me.metric_name = 'sr_loss' THEN me.metric_value END) AS total_sr_loss,
    SUM(me.net_total_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(me.total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(me.order_cnt) AS total_orders
FROM metric_expansion me
GROUP BY me.c_customer_id, me.d_year
HAVING SUM(me.net_total_profit) > 0
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_date_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM tpcds.inventory
    GROUP BY inv_date_sk
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        s.s_store_name,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        sm1.sm_ship_mode_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_sales_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_sales_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_sales_profit,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_returns_loss,
        (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)) AS net_profit_after_returns,
        inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm1
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm1.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca1
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca1.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd1
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd1
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
        ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm2
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm1.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.time_dim t_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory_agg inv_agg
        ON inv_agg.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 2001
        AND t_cs.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
        AND sm1.sm_ship_mode_id = 'AAAAAAAABBAAAAAA'
        AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
        AND ca1.ca_state = 'TX'
    GROUP BY
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        s.s_store_name,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        sm1.sm_ship_mode_id,
        inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand
    HAVING
        (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)) > 10000
)
SELECT
    a.d_date,
    a.s_store_name,
    a.ib_income_band_sk,
    a.sm_ship_mode_id,
    a.total_catalog_sales_profit,
    a.total_store_sales_profit,
    a.total_web_sales_profit,
    a.total_returns_loss,
    a.net_profit_after_returns,
    a.total_qty_on_hand,
    CASE
        WHEN a.net_profit_after_returns > (
            SELECT AVG(cs_sub.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_sub.cr_net_loss, 0))
            FROM tpcds.catalog_sales cs_sub
            LEFT JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr_sub
                ON cs_sub.cs_order_number = cr_sub.cr_order_number
                AND cs_sub.cs_sold_date_sk = cr_sub.cr_returned_date_sk
            WHERE cs_sub.cs_sold_date_sk = a.d_date_sk
        )
        THEN 'Above Avg'
        ELSE 'Below Avg'
    END AS profit_vs_avg,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_date ORDER BY a.net_profit_after_returns DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_agg a
ORDER BY a.net_profit_after_returns DESC, a.d_date ASC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 10

WITH
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 100.00
      AND ss.ss_quantity >= 1
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_hdemo_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS return_txn_cnt
    FROM store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 10.00
      AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_hdemo_sk, sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_ticket_number
),
promo_tokens AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        split(p.p_promo_name, ' ') AS name_tokens
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    final.customer_id,
    final.first_name,
    final.last_name,
    final.item_id,
    final.item_desc,
    final.promo_name,
    final.total_sales_price,
    final.total_net_profit,
    final.total_return_amt,
    final.sales_txn_cnt,
    final.return_txn_cnt,
    final.vehicle_count,
    final.customer_total_return,
    final.token
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS last_name,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        i.i_item_desc AS item_desc,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        s.total_sales_price,
        s.total_net_profit,
        r.total_return_amt,
        s.sales_txn_cnt,
        r.return_txn_cnt,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count AS vehicle_count,
        (SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt)
         FROM store_returns sr2
         WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS customer_total_return,
        t.token
    FROM sales_agg s
    FULL OUTER JOIN returns_agg r
        ON s.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN item i
        ON s.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p
        ON s.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN promo_tokens pt
        ON p.p_promo_sk = pt.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN UNNEST(pt.name_tokens) AS t(token) ON TRUE
    JOIN customer c
        ON s.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_current_price > 25.00
        AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
        AND i.i_rec_end_date <= DATE '2015-12-31'
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
        AND hd.hd_dep_count <= 5
        AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
        AND p.p_promo_name LIKE '%able%'
    UNION
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS last_name,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        i.i_item_desc AS item_desc,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        s.total_sales_price,
        s.total_net_profit,
        r.total_return_amt,
        s.sales_txn_cnt,
        r.return_txn_cnt,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count AS vehicle_count,
        (SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt)
         FROM store_returns sr2
         WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS customer_total_return,
        t.token
    FROM returns_agg r
    FULL OUTER JOIN sales_agg s
        ON r.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN item i
        ON r.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promo_tokens pt
        ON p.p_promo_sk = pt.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN UNNEST(pt.name_tokens) AS t(token) ON TRUE
    JOIN customer c
        ON r.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON r.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_current_price > 25.0

WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS category,
        'store_sales' AS metric_type,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS amount,
        s.s_store_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_sk
),
catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
