        r.r_reason_desc AS category,
        'catalog_returns' AS metric_type,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS amount,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS s_store_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
),
union_all_data AS (
    SELECT category, metric_type, amount, s_store_sk FROM store_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT category, metric_type, amount, s_store_sk FROM catalog_returns_agg
)
SELECT
    u.category,
    u.metric_type,
    u.amount,
    CASE
        WHEN u.metric_type = 'store_sales' THEN (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.d_date)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            JOIN date_dim d ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = u.s_store_sk
              AND d.d_year = 2001
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS distinct_sales_days
FROM union_all_data u
WHERE u.amount > (
    SELECT AVG(inner.amount)
    FROM union_all_data inner
    WHERE inner.metric_type = u.metric_type
)
ORDER BY u.metric_type, u.amount DESC

WITH sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss_customer_sk,
        ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss_quantity,
        ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity >= 2
      AND ss_ext_sales_price > 1000
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    d.d_year,
    t.t_hour,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    SUM(sb.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(sb.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sb.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers,
    AVG(sb.ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    MIN(sb.ss_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales,
    MAX(sb.ss_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = sb.ss_sold_date_sk
    ) AS max_daily_sales
FROM sales_base sb
JOIN date_dim d
    ON sb.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t
    ON sb.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON sb.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON sb.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON sb.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
  AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM call_center cc2
        WHERE cc2.cc_state = cc.cc_state
          AND cc2.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND cc2.cc_call_center_sk <> cc.cc_call_center_sk
    )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (cc.cc_name, d.d_year, t.t_hour, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ib.ib_lower_bound),
    (cc.cc_name, d.d_year, t.t_hour, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count),
    (cc.cc_name, d.d_year, t.t_hour),
    (cc.cc_name, d.d_year),
    (cc.cc_name),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range(date_sk) AS (
    SELECT 2450941
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1 FROM date_range WHERE date_sk < 2450948
),

sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS location,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        'sales' AS source_type
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_range)
      AND t.t_am_pm = 'PM'
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (c.c_customer_id, w.w_warehouse_name),
        (c.c_customer_id),
        (w.w_warehouse_name),
        ()
    )
),

returns_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        wp.wp_url AS location,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        'returns' AS source_type
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_range)
      AND t.t_am_pm = 'AM'
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (c.c_customer_id, wp.wp_url),
        (c.c_customer_id),
        (wp.wp_url),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    location,
    SUM(total_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    source_type
FROM (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        location,
        total_net_paid,
        total_quantity,
        source_type
    FROM sales_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        location,
        total_net_paid,
        total_quantity,
        source_type
    FROM returns_data
) u
GROUP BY ROLLUP (customer_id, location, source_type)
ORDER BY customer_id, location, source_type
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_call_center AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_city
    FROM call_center cc
    WHERE regexp_like(cc.cc_name, '.*Center$')
      AND cc.cc_state LIKE 'C%'
)

SELECT
    source_type,
    location,
    income_band_range,
    SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount,
    SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_sales) AS total_catalog_sales
FROM (
    SELECT
        'Catalog' AS source_type,
        CONCAT(cc.cc_state, '-', cc.cc_city) AS location,
        CONCAT(ib.ib_lower_bound, '-', ib.ib_upper_bound) AS income_band_range,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS net_amount,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr
          WHERE sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
            AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Web' AS source_type,
        CONCAT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(wp.wp_url, '(https?://[^/]+)/', 1), '-', CAST(ws.ws_item_sk AS VARCHAR)) AS location,
        CONCAT(ib.ib_lower_bound, '-', ib.ib_upper_bound) AS income_band_range,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS net_amount,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 0
      AND wsite.web_name LIKE '%Online%'
      AND regexp_like(wp.wp_url, '^https?://')
) AS combined
GROUP BY ROLLUP (source_type, location, income_band_range)
ORDER BY source_type, location, income_band_range
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE brand_sales(brand_id, brand_name, level, total_sales) AS (
    SELECT i.i_brand_id,
           i.i_brand,
           1 AS level,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_brand_id IN (1004002, 2004001, 7004003, 10008011)
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 1
      AND ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND ws.ws_ship_customer_sk BETWEEN 5000000 AND 8000000
    GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_brand

    UNION ALL

    SELECT brand_id,
           brand_name,
           level + 1,
           total_sales
    FROM brand_sales
    WHERE level < 3
),
brand_agg AS (
    SELECT brand_id,
           brand_name,
           SUM(total_sales) AS sum_sales,
           AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt_levels
    FROM brand_sales
    GROUP BY brand_id, brand_name
),
intersect_brands AS (
    SELECT i.i_brand_id
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_category = 'Sports'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT i2.i_brand_id
    FROM item i2
    JOIN web_sales ws2 ON ws2.ws_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws2.ws_ext_sales_price > 2000
)
SELECT ba.brand_id,
       ba.brand_name,
       ba.sum_sales,
       ba.avg_sales,
       ba.cnt_levels
FROM brand_agg ba
WHERE ba.brand_id IN (SELECT i_brand_id FROM intersect_brands)
ORDER BY ba.sum_sales DESC
OFFSET 0 ROWS
LIMIT 100

WITH
    base_sales AS (
        SELECT
            ws.ws_order_number,
            ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
            ws.ws_ship_date_sk,
            ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
            ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
            ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
            ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
            ws.ws_quantity,
            ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
            ws.ws_ext_sales_price
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_quantity >= 2
          AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax > 1000
    ),
    sold_date AS (
        SELECT
            bs.*,
            d.d_date,
            d.d_year,
            d.d_month_seq
        FROM base_sales bs
        JOIN date_dim d ON bs.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    ),
    ship_date AS (
        SELECT
            sd.*,
            d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
            d_ship.d_month_seq AS ship_month_seq
        FROM sold_date sd
        JOIN date_dim d_ship ON sd.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
        WHERE d_ship.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1200 AND 1300
    ),
    filtered_sales AS (
        SELECT
            sd.ws_order_number,
            sd.ws_sold_date_sk,
            sd.ws_ship_date_sk,
            sd.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
            sd.ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
            sd.ws_ship_mode_sk,
            sd.ws_warehouse_sk,
            sd.ws_quantity,
            sd.ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
            sd.ws_ext_sales_price,
            sd.d_date,
            sd.d_year,
            sd.d_month_seq,
            sd.ship_date,
            sd.ship_month_seq
        FROM ship_date sd
    ),
    union_sales AS (
        SELECT
            ws_order_number,
            ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
            ws_ext_sales_price,
            ws_sold_date_sk,
            ws_ship_date_sk,
            ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
            ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
            ws_ship_mode_sk,
            ws_warehouse_sk
        FROM filtered_sales
        WHERE ws_net_paid_inc_tax > 5000
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            ws_order_number,
            ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
            ws_ext_sales_price,
            ws_sold_date_sk,
            ws_ship_date_sk,
            ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
            ws_ship_cdemo_sk,
            ws_ship_mode_sk,
            ws_warehouse_sk
        FROM filtered_sales
        WHERE ws_net_paid_inc_tax < 2000
    ),
    call_center_lateral AS (
        SELECT
            us.ws_order_number,
            cc_l.cc_name AS lat_cc_name,
            cc_l.cc_state AS lat_cc_state,
            cc_l.cc_mkt_desc,
            d_ship.d_date AS cc_closed_date
        FROM union_sales us
        JOIN date_dim d_ship ON us.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT cc_name, cc_state, cc_mkt_desc
            FROM call_center cc
            WHERE cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS cc_l
    ),
    final AS (
        SELECT
            us.ws_order_number,
            d_sold.d_date AS sold_date,
            d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
            CASE 
                WHEN us.ws_net_paid_inc_tax > 5000 THEN 'High'
                WHEN us.ws_net_paid_inc_tax < 2000 THEN 'Low'
                ELSE 'Medium'
            END AS net_category,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY us.ws_net_paid_inc_tax DESC) AS rn_type,
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY us.ws_net_paid_inc_tax DESC) AS rank_overall,
            AVG(us.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY d_sold.d_year) AS avg_year_net,
            (SELECT MAX(w2.w_warehouse_sq_ft) FROM warehouse w2 WHERE w2.w_state = w.w_state) AS max_warehouse_sqft_state,
            cc_l.lat_cc_name,
            cc_l.lat_cc_state,
            sm.sm_type,
            w.w_city,
            w.w_state,
            cd_bill.cd_gender,
            cd_ship.cd_credit_rating
        FROM union_sales us
        JOIN date_dim d_sold ON us.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_ship ON us.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON us.ws_ship_mo

WITH sales_summary AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_minute,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_country,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE
        t.t_hour = 10
        AND t.t_minute = 15
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_minute,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_country
)
SELECT
    ss.s_store_id,
    ss.s_store_name,
    ss.t_hour,
    ss.t_minute,
    ss.ca_state,
    ss.ca_country,
    ss.total_sales,
    ss.total_profit,
    ss.avg_quantity,
    ss.num_transactions,
    ss.profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.profit_category ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS rank_within_category,
    SUM(ss.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.profit_category) AS sales_by_category,
    (SELECT AVG(inner_ss.ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales inner_ss) AS overall_avg_profit
FROM sales_summary ss
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss2
    JOIN time_dim t2 ON ss2.ss_sold_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk
    WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = (
        SELECT s2.s_store_sk
        FROM store s2
        WHERE s2.s_store_id = ss.s_store_id
    )
      AND t2.t_second = 19
)
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        p.p_discount_active,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost > 40
    GROUP BY
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        p.p_discount_active
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ps.p_id AS p_promo_id,
    ps.total_net_profit,
    ps.total_net_paid,
    ps.trans_cnt,
    ps.rank_by_profit,
    (SELECT AVG(ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales) AS global_avg_profit
FROM (
    SELECT
        p_id,
        total_net_profit,
        total_net_paid,
        trans_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rank_by_profit
    FROM (
        SELECT
            pa.p_promo_id AS p_id,
            pa.total_net_profit,
            pa.total_net_paid,
            pa.trans_cnt,
            pa.p_channel_tv,
            pa.p_discount_active
        FROM promo_sales pa
        WHERE pa.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
          AND pa.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            pa.p_promo_id AS p_id,
            pa.total_net_profit,
            pa.total_net_paid,
            pa.trans_cnt,
            pa.p_channel_tv,
            pa.p_discount_active
        FROM promo_sales pa
        WHERE pa.p_channel_tv = 'N'
          AND pa.p_discount_active = 'N'
    ) AS unioned
) AS ps
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_promo_sk = (
        SELECT p.p_promo_sk
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_promo_id = ps.p_id
        LIMIT 1
    )
      AND ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost > 5000
)
ORDER BY ps.rank_by_profit
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE demo_hierarchy AS (
   SELECT
      cd_demo_sk,
      cd_gender,
      1 AS level
   FROM customer_demographics
   WHERE cd_demo_sk = (SELECT MIN(cd_demo_sk) FROM customer_demographics)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT
      cd.cd_demo_sk,
      cd.cd_gender,
      dh.level + 1 AS level
   FROM customer_demographics cd
   JOIN demo_hierarchy dh
     ON cd.cd_demo_sk = dh.cd_demo_sk + 1
   WHERE dh.level < 5
),
agg_returns AS (
   SELECT
      cr_refunded_customer_sk,
      cr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
      cr_returning_customer_sk,
      cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
      cr_ship_mode_sk,
      cr_reason_sk,
      SUM(cr_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount,
      AVG(cr_store_credit) AS avg_store_credit,
      COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
   FROM catalog_returns
   WHERE cr_return_amount > 0
   GROUP BY
      cr_refunded_customer_sk,
      cr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
      cr_returning_customer_sk,
      cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
      cr_ship_mode_sk,
      cr_reason_sk
)
SELECT
   r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
   sm.sm_type AS ship_type,
   d_cur.cd_gender AS gender,
   dh.level AS demo_hierarchy_level,
   SUM(ar.sum_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
   AVG(ar.avg_store_credit) AS avg_store_credit,
   SUM(ar.return_cnt) AS total_returns,
   (SELECT AVG(cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns) AS overall_avg_return_amount
FROM agg_returns ar
JOIN customer c_ref
  ON ar.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_ref.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics d_ref
  ON ar.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = d_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer c_ret
  ON ar.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_ret.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics d_ret
  ON ar.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = d_ret.cd_demo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON ar.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN reason r
  ON ar.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN web_page wp_ref
  ON c_ref.c_customer_sk = wp_ref.wp_customer_sk
JOIN web_page wp_ret
  ON c_ret.c_customer_sk = wp_ret.wp_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics d_cur
  ON c_ref.c_current_cdemo_sk = d_cur.cd_demo_sk
JOIN demo_hierarchy dh
  ON d_cur.cd_demo_sk = dh.cd_demo_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
   SELECT 1
   FROM reason r2
   WHERE r2.r_reason_sk = ar.cr_reason_sk
     AND r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%job%'
)
GROUP BY
   r.r_reason_desc,
   sm.sm_type,
   d_cur.cd_gender,
   dh.level
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH per_customer_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cust.c_customer_sk,
    cust.c_birth_year,
    inc.ib_income_band_sk,
    SUM(wp.wp_char_count) AS total_char_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS page_count
  FROM web_page wp
  JOIN customer cust
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON cust.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band inc
    ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = inc.ib_income_band_sk
  WHERE wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
    AND wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
    AND wp.wp_rec_end_date <= DATE '2001-12-31'
    AND hd.hd_dep_count >= 2
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count <= 3
    AND inc.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
    AND cust.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
  GROUP BY cust.c_customer_sk, cust.c_birth_year, inc.ib_income_band_sk
)
SELECT
  per.ib_income_band_sk,
  AVG(per.total_char_count) AS avg_char_count,
  SUM(per.page_count) AS total_pages,
  COUNT(DISTINCT per.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM per_customer_stats per
WHERE per.c_customer_sk IN (
  SELECT wp.wp_customer_sk
  FROM web_page wp
  WHERE wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'Y'
    AND wp.wp_rec_start_date < DATE '2000-01-01'
)
GROUP BY per.ib_income_band_sk
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT per.c_customer_sk) >= 5
ORDER BY avg_char_count DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS year
    FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1
    FROM years
    WHERE year < (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
),
returns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.d_year AS year,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        'store' AS return_type,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        d.d_year AS year,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        'web' AS return_type,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id
)
SELECT 
    y.year AS return_year,
    r.c_customer_id,
    r.return_type,
    r.total_return_amt,
    r.total_return_qty,
    (
        SELECT AVG(inner_agg.total_return_amt)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt
            FROM store_returns sr2
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE d2.d_year = y.year
            GROUP BY sr2.sr_customer_sk
        ) inner_agg
    ) AS avg_store_return_amt_all_customers
FROM years y
JOIN returns r ON r.year = y.year
WHERE r.c_customer_sk IN (
    SELECT sr3.sr_customer_sk
    FROM store_returns sr3
    JOIN item i ON sr3.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_category_id = 5
)
ORDER BY y.year, r.total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
),
site_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws_web_site_sk,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
        MIN(ws_ext_list_price) AS min_list_price,
        MAX(ws_ext_list_price) AS max_list_price
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost > 30
      AND ws_wholesale_cost < 70
      AND ws_ext_discount_amt > 1200
      AND ws_ext_list_price > 8000
    GROUP BY ws_web_site_sk
),
site_detail AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ws_web_site_sk,
        ss.total_net_paid,
        ss.avg_discount,
        ss.order_cnt,
        ss.min_list_price,
        ss.max_list_price,
        ws.web_name,
        ws.web_city,
        ws.web_county,
        ws.web_street_type,
        ws.web_suite_number
    FROM site_sales AS ss
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            web_name,
            web_city,
            web_county,
            web_street_type,
            web_suite_number
        FROM web_site
        WHERE web_site_sk = ss.ws_web_site_sk
    ) AS ws
)
SELECT
    sd.ws_web_site_sk,
    sd.web_name,
    sd.web_city,
    sd.web_county,
    sd.total_net_paid,
    sd.avg_discount,
    sd.order_cnt,
    sd.min_list_price,
    sd.max_list_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.web_county ORDER BY sd.total_net_paid DESC) AS rn_by_county
FROM site_detail AS sd
WHERE sd.web_street_type = 'Road'
  AND sd.web_suite_number = 'Suite 460'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM seq s WHERE s.n = MOD(sd.order_cnt, 5)
    )
ORDER BY sd.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_costs AS (
    SELECT p_item_sk,
           SUM(p_cost) AS total_promo_cost
    FROM promotion
    GROUP BY p_item_sk
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
           i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           d.d_year AS sales_year,
           'Store' AS channel,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
           CASE WHEN i.i_current_price >= 100 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END AS price_category,
           COALESCE(pc.total_promo_cost, 0) AS promo_cost
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promo_costs pc ON i.i_item_sk = pc.p_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2020
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk,
             i.i_item_id,
             d.d_year,
             CASE WHEN i.i_current_price >= 100 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END,
             pc.total_promo_cost
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 10000
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
           i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           d.d_year AS sales_year,
           'Catalog' AS channel,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales,
           CASE WHEN i.i_current_price >= 100 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END AS price_category,
           COALESCE(pc.total_promo_cost, 0) AS promo_cost
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promo_costs pc ON i.i_item_sk = pc.p_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2020
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk,
             i.i_item_id,
             d.d_year,
             CASE WHEN i.i_current_price >= 100 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END,
             pc.total_promo_cost
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 10000
),
combined_sales AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           item_id,
           sales_year,
           channel,
           total_sales,
           price_category,
           promo_cost
    FROM store_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_sk,
           item_id,
           sales_year,
           channel,
           total_sales,
           price_category,
           promo_cost
    FROM catalog_sales_agg
)
SELECT cs.item_sk,
       cs.item_id,
       cs.sales_year,
       cs.channel,
       cs.total_sales,
       cs.price_category,
       cs.promo_cost,
       CASE WHEN cs.total_sales >= 50000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN cs.total_sales >= 20000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
       END AS sales_bracket,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax), 0)
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_dim dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = cs.item_sk
          AND dr.d_year = cs.sales_year) AS total_return_amount
FROM combined_sales cs
ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           d_week_seq,
           d_year,
           d_current_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk,
           d2.d_date,
           d2.d_week_seq,
           d2.d_year,
           d2.d_current_year
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2001-01-31'
),
distinct_cc_wh AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name
    FROM call_center cc
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE w.w_suite_number = 'Suite 90'
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_week_seq,
        dcw.cc_name,
        dcw.w_warehouse_name,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM date_series d
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN distinct_cc_wh dcw
      ON dcw.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
     AND dcw.w_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_inv.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_week_seq BETWEEN 5 AND 7
      AND cr.cr_reversed_charge > 30
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, dcw.cc_name, dcw.w_warehouse_name),
        (d.d_year, dcw.cc_name, dcw.w_warehouse_name),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_week_seq,
    cc_name,
    w_warehouse_name,
    total_net_loss,
    total_net_profit,
    total_on_hand,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM base_agg
ORDER BY d_year DESC, d_week_seq, loss_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category_id,
        i.i_color,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS num_orders
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1200 AND 1211
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'N'
      AND i.i_category_id IN (3, 6, 7)
      AND i.i_color = 'pink'
      AND (r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%price%' OR r.r_reason_desc IS NULL)
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category_id, i.i_color
),
item_sales_with_returns AS (
    SELECT
        is.cs_item_sk,
        is.i_item_id,
        is.i_product_name,
        is.i_category_id,
        is.i_color,
        is.total_quantity,
        is.total_sales,
        is.total_net_profit,
        is.num_orders,
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt), 0)
            FROM store_returns sr
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = is.cs_item_sk
              AND d2.d_year = 2000
        ) AS total_store_return_amt,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr2
            JOIN reason r2 ON cr2.cr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
            WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = is.cs_item_sk
              AND r2.r_reason_desc LIKE '%price%'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_price_reason_return,
        (
            SELECT AVG(cs3.cs_ext_sales_price)
            FROM catalog_sales cs3
            WHERE cs3.cs_item_sk = is.cs_item_sk
        ) AS avg_item_ext_sales_price,
        is.total_net_profit / NULLIF(is.total_quantity, 0) AS profit_per_unit
    FROM item_sales is
    WHERE is.total_net_profit > 0
)
SELECT
    iswr.i_category_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_items,
    AVG(iswr.total_sales) AS avg_total_sales,
    SUM(iswr.total_net_profit) AS sum_total_net_profit,
    SUM(iswr.total_store_return_amt) AS sum_store_returns,
    AVG(iswr.profit_per_unit) AS avg_profit_per_unit
FROM item_sales_with_returns iswr
GROUP BY iswr.i_category_id
HAVING SUM(iswr.total_sales) > 5000
ORDER BY avg_profit_per_unit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    refunded_reasons AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT wr_reason_sk
        FROM web_returns
        WHERE wr_refunded_hdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND wr_return_amt > 0
    ),
    returning_reasons AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT wr_reason_sk
        FROM web_returns
        WHERE wr_returning_hdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND wr_return_quantity > 1
    ),
    common_reasons AS (
        SELECT wr_reason_sk FROM refunded_reasons
        INTERSECT
        SELECT wr_reason_sk FROM returning_reasons
    ),
    base_agg AS (
        SELECT
            ib.ib_income_band_sk AS ib_income_band_sk,
            ib.ib_lower_bound,
            ib.ib_upper_bound,
            r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc,
            SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
            SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
            COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
        FROM web_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS wr
        JOIN household_demographics AS hd_ref
            ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address AS ca_ref
            ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk
        JOIN reason AS r
            ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        JOIN income_band AS ib
            ON hd_ref.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
        JOIN common_reasons AS cr
            ON wr.wr_reason_sk = cr.wr_reason_sk
        WHERE
            hd_ref.hd_vehicle_count > 0
            AND ca_ref.ca_county = 'Oldham County'
            AND wr.wr_return_amt > 0
            AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
            AND wr.wr_return_tax IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY
            ib.ib_income_band_sk,
            ib.ib_lower_bound,
            ib.ib_upper_bound,
            r.r_reason_desc
        HAVING
            SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 5000
    )
SELECT
    ib_income_band_sk,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    r_reason_desc,
    total_return_amt,
    total_net_loss,
    return_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS rn_total_return_amt,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS rank_total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS net_loss_category
FROM base_agg
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC, net_loss_category DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH intersected_dates AS (
    SELECT i.inv_date_sk
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_weekend = 'N'
      AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
    INTERSECT
    SELECT i.inv_date_sk
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_year = 1904
      AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand < 800
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_date,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.inv_item_sk,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        max_qty_l.max_qty
    FROM intersected_dates id
    JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = id.inv_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = i.inv_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(i2.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_qty
        FROM inventory i2
        WHERE i2.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) AS max_qty_l
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store s3
        WHERE s3.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND s3.s_number_employees > 200
    )
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_date,
        s_store_name,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT inv_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
        MAX(max_qty) AS max_qty_on_date
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d_year, d_date, s_store_name),
        (d_year, d_date),
        (d_year),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    a.d_year,
    a.d_date,
    COALESCE(a.s_store_name, 'ALL STORES') AS store_name,
    a.total_qty,
    a.distinct_items,
    a.max_qty_on_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_year ORDER BY a.total_qty DESC) AS rank_per_year,
    CASE
        WHEN a.d_date IS NOT NULL THEN (
            SELECT SUM(i4.inv_quantity_on_hand)
            FROM inventory i4
            JOIN date_dim d4 ON i4.inv_date_sk = d4.d_date_sk
            WHERE d4.d_year = a.d_year - 1
              AND EXTRACT(month FROM d4.d_date) = EXTRACT(month FROM a.d_date)
              AND EXTRACT(day FROM d4.d_date) = EXTRACT(day FROM a.d_date)
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS same_day_last_year_qty
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.d_year DESC, a.total_qty DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE
base_returns AS (
   SELECT
     wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
     wr.wr_returning_customer_sk,
     wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk,
     wr.wr_return_amt,
     wr.wr_return_tax,
     wr.wr_fee,
     wr.wr_account_credit,
     wr.wr_net_loss,
     d.d_date,
     cu.c_customer_id,
     wp.wp_web_page_id,
     wp.wp_autogen_flag,
     wp.wp_type
   FROM web_returns wr
   JOIN date_dim d
     ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN customer cu
     ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cu.c_customer_sk
   JOIN web_page wp
     ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
   WHERE wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
     AND wp.wp_type = 'HOME'
     AND d.d_year = 2001
     AND wr.wr_return_amt > 20.00
     AND cu.c_birth_year = 1975
     AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
         FROM web_page wp2
         WHERE wp2.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
           AND wp2.wp_char_count > 500
     )
),
return_series AS (
   SELECT
     br.wr_returned_date_sk,
     br.wr_returning_customer_sk,
     br.wr_return_amt,
     br.wr_net_loss,
     1 AS level
   FROM base_returns br
   WHERE br.wr_returned_date_sk = (SELECT MIN(wr_returned_date_sk) FROM base_returns)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT
     br2.wr_returned_date_sk,
     br2.wr_returning_customer_sk,
     br2.wr_return_amt,
     br2.wr_net_loss,
     rs.level + 1
   FROM return_series rs
   JOIN base_returns br2
     ON br2.wr_returning_customer_sk = rs.wr_returning_customer_sk
    AND br2.wr_returned_date_sk = rs.wr_returned_date_sk + 1
   WHERE rs.level < 10
),
high_val_returns AS (
   SELECT
     wr_returning_customer_sk,
     SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
     COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns,
     AVG(wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt
   FROM base_returns
   WHERE wr_return_amt >= 50.00
   GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk
),
low_val_returns AS (
   SELECT
     wr_returning_customer_sk,
     SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
     COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns,
     AVG(wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt
   FROM base_returns
   WHERE wr_return_amt < 50.00
   GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk
),
combined_returns AS (
   SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk, total_return_amt, cnt_returns, avg_return_amt
   FROM high_val_returns
   UNION ALL
   SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk, total_return_amt, cnt_returns, avg_return_amt
   FROM low_val_returns
),
customer_cumulative AS (
   SELECT
     wr_returning_customer_sk,
     SUM(wr_net_loss) AS cumulative_net_loss,
     SUM(wr_return_amt) AS cumulative_return_amt
   FROM return_series
   GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk
)
SELECT
  cr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS returning_customer_sk,
  cu.c_customer_id,
  cr.total_return_amt,
  cr.cnt_returns,
  cr.avg_return_amt,
  cc.cumulative_net_loss,
  CASE
    WHEN cr.total_return_amt >= 200 THEN 'High'
    WHEN cr.total_return_amt >= 100 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS return_amount_category
FROM combined_returns cr
JOIN customer_cumulative cc
  ON cr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cc.wr_returning_customer_sk
JOIN customer cu
  ON cr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cu.c_customer_sk
WHERE cr.cnt_returns >= 2
HAVING cr.total_return_amt > 100
ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC, cu.c_customer_id ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year, d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year, d2.d_month_seq
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = dr.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2001-12-31'
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    cat.cp_type,
    s.s_store_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
    (SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) - SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax)) AS net_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) - SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax)) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM
    date_range dr
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cat ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cat.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_cs.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ws ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE
    dr.d_year = 2001
    AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND cat.cp_type = 'Promo'
    AND r.r_reason_desc NOT LIKE '%damaged%'
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
    AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
    AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    cat.cp_type,
    s.s_store_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name
ORDER BY
    revenue_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_date,
        d_year,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2020-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d_next.d_date_sk,
        d_next.d_date,
        d_next.d_year,
        dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d_next
        ON d_next.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dh.d_date)
    WHERE dh.lvl < 10
),
orders_diff AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number
    FROM catalog_returns
    EXCEPT
    SELECT wr_order_number
    FROM web_returns
)
SELECT
    cr.cr_order_number,
    dh.d_date,
    t.t_hour,
    sm.sm_type,
    ca_refunded.ca_state AS refunded_state,
    ca_returning.ca_state AS returning_state,
    CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_amount_category,
    cr.cr_net_loss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY cr.cr_net_loss DESC) AS rn_loss_by_ship_type,
    (
        SELECT SUM(wr2.wr_return_amt)
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    ) AS total_web_return_amount_for_date,
    dh.lvl AS date_hierarchy_level
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim dwp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = dwp.d_date_sk
JOIN orders_diff od ON cr.cr_order_number = od.cr_order_number
WHERE dh.d_year = 2020
  AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
  AND ca_refunded.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND ca_returning.ca_state = 'TX'
  AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost > 100
  AND wr.wr_return_tax < 50
  AND dh.lvl >= 2
ORDER BY cr.cr_net_loss DESC, cr.cr_order_number
LIMIT 100

WITH inv_agg AS (
    SELECT
        inv.inv_date_sk,
        inv.inv_item_sk,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    GROUP BY inv.inv_date_sk, inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    i.i_category,
    d.d_year,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price)                AS total_web_sales_amount,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)                     AS total_store_returns_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)                  AS total_catalog_returns_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)                    AS total_web_returns_amount,
    SUM(ia.total_qty_on_hand)                 AS total_inventory_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number)        AS distinct_web_orders,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)               AS avg_discount,
    MIN(ws.ws_net_paid)                       AS min_net_paid,
    MAX(ws.ws_net_paid)                       AS max_net_paid,
    (SELECT MAX(ib2.ib_upper_bound) FROM income_band ib2) AS max_income_upper_bound
FROM
    date_dim d
    JOIN store_returns sr           ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s                    ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i                     ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws              ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                                   AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w               ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                                   AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                                   AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr           ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                                   AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                                   AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN inv_agg ia                ON ia.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                                   AND ia.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                                   AND ia.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp               ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca       ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib            ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2001
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
    AND w.w_state = 'TX'
    AND ca.ca_state = 'WA'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM income_band ib_sub
        WHERE ib_sub.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
          AND ib_sub.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
    )
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    i.i_category,
    d.d_year
ORDER BY total_web_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH joined AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        t.t_time_id,
        t.t_hour,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_current_price,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_brand_id,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        p.p_cost,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS cr_net_loss,
        r.r_reason_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS ws_net_profit,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS wr_net_loss,
        wp.wp_web_page_id,
        wp.wp_url
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
        AND i.i_current_price > 50.00
        AND p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND i.i_brand_id = 23
)
SELECT
    grouping_id(d_year, i_brand) AS grp_id,
    COALESCE(d_year, -1) AS year,
    COALESCE(i_brand, 'ALL') AS brand,
    SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
    SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss,
    SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(SUM(ss_net_profit)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY grouping_id(d_year, i_brand)
        ORDER BY COALESCE(d_year, -1)
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_store_profit_by_group
FROM joined
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (d_year, i_brand),
    (d_year),
    ()
)
HAVING SUM(ss_net_profit) > 10000
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH inv_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk AS item_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_item_sk
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
           SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
           SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           MIN(cs_sold_date_sk) AS first_sold_date_sk,
           MAX(cs_sold_date_sk) AS last_sold_date_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk
),
combined_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
           sr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
           sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
           sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
           'store' AS src
    FROM store_returns
    UNION
    SELECT wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
           wr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
           wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           wr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
           wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
           'web' AS src
    FROM web_returns
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           SUM(return_qty) AS total_return_qty,
           SUM(return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
           COUNT(*) AS return_events
    FROM combined_returns
    GROUP BY item_sk
),
cat_ret_sales AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
           MIN(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS earliest_return_date_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_current_price,
    inv.total_on_hand,
    s.sales_cnt,
    s.total_profit,
    r.total_return_qty,
    r.total_return_amt,
    crs.total_return_amount,
    crs.total_return_quantity,
    rs.r_reason_desc,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_sales_txns
FROM item i
JOIN inv_agg inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.item_sk
JOIN sales_agg s ON i.i_item_sk = s.item_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON i.i_item_sk = r.item_sk
LEFT JOIN cat_ret_sales crs ON i.i_item_sk = crs.item_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
LEFT JOIN reason rs ON sr.sr_reason_sk = rs.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ib2.ib_lower_bound, ib2.ib_upper_bound
    FROM income_band ib2
    WHERE ib2.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
) ib
WHERE i.i_current_price > 50
  AND i.i_brand_id IN (1, 2, 3)
  AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
  AND i.i_rec_end_date <= DATE '1999-12-31'
  AND inv.total_on_hand > 0
  AND s.last_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450730 AND 2451200
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    )
GROUP BY i.i_item_id,
         i.i_product_name,
         i.i_current_price,
         inv.total_on_hand,
         s.sales_cnt,
         s.total_profit,
         r.total_return_qty,
         r.total_return_amt,
         crs.total_return_amount,
         crs.total_return_quantity,
         rs.r_reason_desc,
         hd.hd_buy_potential,
         ib.ib_lower_bound,
         ib.ib_upper_bound
HAVING s.total_profit > 1000
ORDER BY s.total_profit DESC
OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY

WITH
  item_inventory_intersect AS (
    SELECT i1.i_item_sk
    FROM item i1
    INTERSECT
    SELECT inv2.inv_item_sk
    FROM inventory inv2
  )
SELECT
  d_ss.d_year AS year,
  i.i_category AS category,
  i.i_brand AS brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
  AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
  MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS min_date_key,
  MAX(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS max_date_key
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN date_dim d_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
INNER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
INNER JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w_inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_inv.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE
  d_ss.d_year = 2001
  AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
  AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1960
  AND c.c_customer_sk IN (
    SELECT c2.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer c2
    WHERE c2.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
  )
  AND w_ws.w_warehouse_sk IN (
    SELECT cr2.cr_warehouse_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_return_quantity > 5
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_returns wr2
    WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND wr2.wr_net_loss > 1000
  )
  AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item_inventory_intersect)
GROUP BY
  d_ss.d_year,
  i.i_category,
  i.i_brand
ORDER BY
  total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE customer_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_customer_id,
           c.c_current_hdemo_sk,
           c.c_current_addr_sk,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM customer c
    WHERE c.c_customer_sk = (SELECT min(c2.c_customer_sk) FROM customer c2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_customer_id,
           c.c_current_hdemo_sk,
           c.c_current_addr_sk,
           lvl + 1
    FROM customer_hierarchy ch
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ch.c_customer_sk + 1
    WHERE lvl < 5
),
combined_returns AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_order_number AS order_number,
           cr.cr_refunded_cash AS refunded_cash,
           cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
           'catalog' AS return_type,
           cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 500
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr.wr_order_number AS order_number,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash AS refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
           'web' AS return_type,
           wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_refunded_cash > 500
)
SELECT
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    cc.cc_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss,
    SUM(cr_comb.refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
    AVG(cs.cs_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
    MIN(ss.ss_quantity) AS min_store_quantity,
    MAX(ss.ss_quantity) AS max_store_quantity,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales ss2 WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) AS total_store_sales_transactions
FROM customer_hierarchy ch
JOIN customer c ON ch.c_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN combined_returns cr_comb ON cr_comb.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND hd.hd_income_band_sk IN (5, 11, 20)
  AND cs.cs_sales_price > 100
  AND ss.ss_quantity >= 2
  AND cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (hd.hd_income_band_sk, cc.cc_state),
    (hd.hd_income_band_sk),
    (cc.cc_state),
    ()
)
ORDER BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, cc.cc_state
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 0 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = (SELECT MIN(d_date) FROM date_dim)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, dh.lvl + 1
    FROM date_hierarchy dh
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dh.d_date)
    WHERE d2.d_date_sk <= (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim)
),
customers_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk FROM store_sales
),
customers_returns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk FROM catalog_returns
),
customers_sales_without_returns AS (
    SELECT cust_sk FROM customers_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cust_sk FROM customers_returns
),
inventory_sample AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM inventory
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        p.p_promo_id,
        ca.ca_country
    FROM date_dim d
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON t.t_time_sk = ss.ss_sold_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk

returns_agg AS (

        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,

        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS num_web_returns,
        r.r_reason_desc
    FROM date_dim d
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk OR r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003
        AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%'
        AND ws.web_state = 'CA'
        AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
        AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
        AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
sales_returns_combined AS (

        COALESCE(sa.d_date_sk, ra.d_date_sk) AS d_date_sk,
        COALESCE(sa.d_date, (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_date_sk = ra.d_date_sk)) AS d_date,
        COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount,
        COALESCE(ra.total_catalog_return_amount, 0) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        COALESCE(ra.total_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_web_return_amount,
        COALESCE(sa.num_sales, 0) AS num_sales,
        COALESCE(sa.unique_customers, 0) AS unique_customers,
        COALESCE(sa.total_discount, 0) AS total_discount,
        COALESCE(ra.r_reason_desc, 'No Return Reason') AS return_reason,
        COALESCE(sa.p_promo_id, 'No Promo') AS promo_id
    FROM sales_agg sa
    FULL OUTER JOIN returns_agg ra ON sa.d_date_sk = ra.d_date_sk
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        sr.d_date,
        sr.num_sales,
        sr.total_sales_amount,
        sr.total_catalog_return_amount,
        sr.total_web_return_amount,
        sr.unique_customers,
        sr.total_discount,
        sr.promo_id,
        sr.return_reason,
        RANK() OVER (O

WITH RECURSIVE year_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_year AS year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1
    FROM year_hierarchy
    WHERE year < 2005
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    s.s_state,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p_ws.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price * 0.9 ELSE ws.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS adjusted_web_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_order_cnt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN sm_ws.sm_code = 'AIR' THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS avg_air_shipment_sales
FROM
    store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN year_hierarchy yh ON d_sold.d_year = yh.year
    JOIN time_dim t_ss ON t_ss.t_time_sk = ss.ss_sold_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ss ON p_ss.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk AND cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON t_cs.t_time_sk = cs.cs_sold_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p_cs ON p_cs.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_return ON d_return.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sr ON t_sr.t_time_sk = sr.sr_return_time_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws ON t_ws.t_time_sk = ws.ws_sold_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk = ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_ws ON w_ws.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ws ON p_ws.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
WHERE
    d_sold.d_year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2003
    AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND cc.cc_market_manager = 'John Smith'
    AND sm.sm_code = 'AIR'
    AND wp.wp_type = 'C'
    AND p_cs.p_discount_active = 'Y'
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (d_sold.d_year, i.i_category),
    (d_sold.d_year, i.i_brand),
    (i.i_category, s.s_state),
    (d_sold.d_year),
    ()
)
ORDER BY
    d_sold.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    adjusted_web_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_cr.d_year AS year,
        s.s_state AS state,
        w_cr.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse,
        sm_cr.sm_type AS ship_mode,
        cp.cp_type AS catalog_type,
        ib.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS item_sks
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd_ref.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk AND ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_bill ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_ship ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_ship.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE d_cr.d_year = 2001
      AND d_cr.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01' AND d_cr.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
      AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (year, state, warehouse, ship_mode, catalog_type, income_lower)
),
unnested AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        state,
        warehouse,
        ship_mode,
        catalog_type,
        income_lower,
        total_catalog_return,
        total_store_return,
        total_web_sales,
        item_sk
    FROM agg
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(item_sks) AS t(item_sk)
)
SELECT
    year,
    state,
    SUM(total_catalog_return) AS sum_catalog_return,
    SUM(total_store_return) AS sum_store_return,
    SUM(total_web_sales) AS sum_web_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold
FROM unnested
WHERE year IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CUBE (year, state)
HAVING SUM(total_web_sales) > 1000
UNION
SELECT
    year,
    state,
    SUM(total_catalog_return) AS sum_catalog_return,
    SUM(total_store_return) AS sum_store_return,
    SUM(total_web_sales) AS sum_web_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold
FROM unnested
WHERE income_lower >= 150000
GROUP BY ROLLUP (year, state)
HAVING SUM(total_store_return) > 500
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_time_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(d_sales.d_year, d_promo_start.d_year) AS year,
    ws.web_city,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(sa.total_sales) AS sum_sales,
    SUM(sa.total_net_paid) AS sum_net_paid,
    SUM(sa.total_profit) AS sum_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS sum_store_return_amt,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_catalog_return_amount,
    AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_store_net_loss,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr_sub
        JOIN date_dim d_sub ON sr_sub.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sub.d_date_sk
        WHERE d_sub.d_year = COALESCE(d_sales.d_year, d_promo_start.d_year)
    ) AS total_returns_for_year
FROM sales_agg sa
RIGHT JOIN promotion p
    ON sa.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sales
    ON sa.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_promo_start
    ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t
    ON sa.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON sa.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
   AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse w
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
WHERE 
    d_promo_start.d_year = 2001
    AND p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND ws.web_state = 'CA'
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 40000
    AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
GROUP BY ROLLUP (COALESCE(d_sales.d_year, d_promo_start.d_year), ws.web_city, p.p_promo_name)
ORDER BY year, ws.web_city, p.p_promo_name
LIMIT 100

        JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk

    web_sales_data AS (

        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN web_site webs ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = webs.web_site_sk
        LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        WHERE i.i_category_id = 4
          AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'

    web_returns_data AS (
