            i.i_item_sk,
            cd.c

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM seq WHERE lvl < 5
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_rec_start_date,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        sm.sm_code,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ws.ws_ext_ship_cost,
        ss.ss_net_paid
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
),
filtered_union AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_item_sk,
        hd_buy_potential,
        ib_lower_bound,
        sm_code,
        ws_ext_ship_cost,
        ss_net_paid,
        c_customer_sk,
        t_hour,
        i_rec_start_date,
        p_discount_active
    FROM base_data
    WHERE t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
      AND i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
      AND p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND sm_code = 'AIR'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_item_sk,
        hd_buy_potential,
        ib_lower_bound,
        sm_code,
        ws_ext_ship_cost,
        ss_net_paid,
        c_customer_sk,
        t_hour,
        i_rec_start_date,
        p_discount_active
    FROM base_data
    WHERE t_hour BETWEEN 13 AND 18
      AND i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
      AND p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND sm_code = 'AIR'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        fu.i_category,
        fu.i_item_sk,
        fu.hd_buy_potential,
        fu.ib_lower_bound,
        fu.sm_code,
        fu.ws_ext_ship_cost,
        SUM(fu.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fu.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        (SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_quantity)
         FROM catalog_sales cs2
         WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = fu.i_item_sk) AS max_catalog_quantity,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM store_returns sr2
         WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = fu.i_item_sk) AS returns_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM seq s
         WHERE s.lvl <= (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fu2.c_customer_sk)
                         FROM filtered_union fu2
                         WHERE fu2.i_item_sk = fu.i_item_sk)) AS seq_count
    FROM filtered_union fu
    GROUP BY
        fu.i_category,
        fu.i_item_sk,
        fu.hd_buy_potential,
        fu.ib_lower_bound,
        fu.sm_code,
        fu.ws_ext_ship_cost
    HAVING SUM(fu.ss_net_paid) > 10000
)
SELECT
    a.i_category,
    a.i_item_sk,
    a.hd_buy_potential,
    a.ib_lower_bound,
    a.sm_code,
    a.ws_ext_ship_cost,
    a.total_net_paid,
    a.distinct_customers,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.i_category ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC) AS category_rank,
    a.max_catalog_quantity

WITH aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_quarter_name = '1901Q1'
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT asales.cs_item_sk,
           asales.total_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY asales.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM aggregated_sales asales
),
returns_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr.cr_item_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_quarter_name = '1901Q1'
)
SELECT rs.cs_item_sk,
       i.i_item_id,
       i.i_product_name,
       rs.total_sales,
       rs.sales_rank
FROM (
    SELECT cs_item_sk FROM ranked_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cr_item_sk FROM returns_items
) AS diff
JOIN ranked_sales rs ON diff.cs_item_sk = rs.cs_item_sk
JOIN item i ON rs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
ORDER BY rs.sales_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

/*
  Goal: Analyze net profit and return losses for items whose description contains the word "Portable" and are associated with holiday promotions in 2022. The query extracts numeric codes from the item description, concatenates customer name, checks for catalog returns, and compares item price against the overall average price.
*/
WITH
  sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
      i.i_item_sk,
      i.i_item_id,
      i.i_item_desc,
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(i.i_item_desc, '(\\d+)', 1) AS desc_numeric_code,
      i.i_current_price,
      p.p_promo_name,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)portable')
      AND p.p_promo_name LIKE 'Holiday%'
      AND i.i_current_price > (SELECT AVG(i2.i_current_price) FROM item i2)
    GROUP BY
      i.i_item_sk,
      i.i_item_id,
      i.i_item_desc,
      desc_numeric_code,
      i.i_current_price,
      p.p_promo_name
  ),

  catalog_return_agg AS (
    SELECT
      cr.cr_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
      SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
  ),

  web_return_agg AS (
    SELECT
      wr.wr_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
      SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
  ),

  top_customer_per_item AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      c.c_customer_id,
      c.c_first_name,
      c.c_last_name,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS customer_net_paid,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      c.c_customer_id,
      c.c_first_name,
      c.c_last_name
  )
SELECT
  s.i_item_id,
  s.i_item_desc,
  s.desc_numeric_code,
  s.p_promo_name,
  s.total_net_paid,
  s.total_net_profit,
  COALESCE(cr.total_catalog_return, 0) AS total_catalog_return,
  COALESCE(wr.total_web_return, 0) AS total_web_return,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2 WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = s.i_item_sk
  ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_catalog_return,
  CONCAT(tc.c_first_name, ' ', tc.c_last_name) AS top_customer
FROM sales_agg s
LEFT JOIN catalog_return_agg cr ON s.i_item_sk = cr.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN web_return_agg wr ON s.i_item_sk = wr.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT i_item_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name
  FROM top_customer_per_item
  WHERE rn = 1
) tc ON s.i_item_sk = tc.i_item_sk
WHERE s.i_current_price > (SELECT AVG(i2.i_current_price) FROM item i2)
ORDER BY s.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT 2001 AS year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1 FROM years WHERE year < 2002
)
SELECT
    d.d_year AS return_year,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 500 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND d.d_year IN (SELECT year FROM years)
  AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%'
GROUP BY d.d_year, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
UNION ALL
SELECT
    d.d_year AS return_year,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 500 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2002
  AND s.s_state = 'TX'
  AND d.d_year IN (SELECT year FROM years)
  AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%'
GROUP BY d.d_year, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY return_year DESC, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE month_numbers AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.d_year) AS year,
           MIN(d.d_month_seq) AS month_seq
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mn.year,
           mn.month_seq + 1
    FROM month_numbers mn
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_year = mn.year
                    AND d.d_month_seq = mn.month_seq + 1
    WHERE mn.month_seq < (
        SELECT MAX(d_month_seq)
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 1998
    )
),
sales_by_date AS (
    SELECT d.d_date,
           d.d_year,
           d.d_month_seq,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price)          AS total_sales,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)               AS total_profit,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost)       AS total_wholesale_cost,
           COUNT(*)                           AS sales_transactions
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND d.d_current_month = 'Y'
      AND d.d_dow = 1
      AND ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost > 500
      AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
),
returns_by_date AS (
    SELECT d.d_date,
           d.d_year,
           d.d_month_seq,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
           SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)      AS total_net_loss,
           COUNT(*)                AS return_transactions
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND d.d_current_month = 'Y'
      AND d.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 15
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 50
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 1
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
),
combined_metrics AS (
    SELECT d_date,
           year,
           month_seq,
           total_sales        AS metric_value,
           'sales'            AS metric_type
    FROM sales_by_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date,
           year,
           month_seq,
           total_return_amount AS metric_value,
           'returns'            AS metric_type
    FROM returns_by_date
),
ranked_metrics AS (
    SELECT cm.d_date,
           cm.year,
           cm.month_seq,
           cm.metric_type,
           cm.metric_value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cm.metric_type ORDER BY cm.metric_value DESC) AS metric_rank,
           SUM(cm.metric_value) OVER (
               PARTITION BY cm.metric_type
               ORDER BY cm.metric_value DESC
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS running_total
    FROM combined_metrics cm
)
SELECT rm.d_date,
       rm.year,
       rm.month_seq,
       rm.metric_type,
       rm.metric_value,
       rm.metric_rank,
       rm.running_total
FROM ranked_metrics rm
JOIN month_numbers mn ON rm.year = mn.year AND rm.month_seq = mn.month_seq
WHERE rm.metric_rank <= 10
ORDER BY rm.metric_type, rm.metric_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH overall_avg_profit AS (
    SELECT AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    CASE
        WHEN ib.ib_upper_bound <= 30000 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN ib.ib_upper_bound <= 60000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS income_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS num_customers,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) / (SELECT avg_net_paid_inc_tax FROM overall_avg_profit) AS profit_to_avg_ratio
FROM date_dim d
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-01' AND DATE '1999-12-31'
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 800
  AND cc.cc_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5.00 AND 0.00
  AND ss.ss_quantity > 5
GROUP BY d.d_year, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 10000
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE number_seq (factor) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT factor + 1 FROM number_seq WHERE factor < 5
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_net_paid > 1000
      AND td.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '\\d{3,}')
      AND i.i_units LIKE 'C%'
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),
return_items AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(r.r_reason_desc, '(?i)defect')
      AND regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '\\d{3,}')
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
),
common_items AS (
    SELECT item_sk FROM filtered_items INTERSECT SELECT item_sk FROM return_items
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT s.s_store_id,
           s.s_store_name,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN common_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.item_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.total_net_profit,
        s.total_sales,
        CONCAT(s.s_store_name, ' - $', CAST(round(s.total_net_profit, 2) AS VARCHAR)) AS store_label,
        SUBSTRING(s.s_store_name FROM 1 FOR 10) AS store_name_prefix
    FROM store_agg s
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM number_seq ns WHERE s.total_net_profit > ns.factor * 1000
    )
)
SELECT
    f.store_label,
    f.store_name_prefix,
    f.s_store_name,
    f.total_net_profit,
    f.total_sales,
    (SELECT MAX(CAST(regexp_extract(i.i_item_desc, '(\\d+)', 1) AS INTEGER))
     FROM item i
     WHERE i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT item_sk FROM common_items)) AS max_item_number_in_desc
FROM final f
ORDER BY f.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE quantity_range(qty) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT qty + 1 FROM quantity_range WHERE qty < 5
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_name AS w_warehouse_name,
        cp.cp_department AS cp_department,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cp.cp_type
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE w.w_county = 'Walker County'
      AND w.w_street_number = '420'
      AND r.r_reason_id = 'AAAAAAAABAAAAAA'
      AND cr.cr_store_credit > 100.00
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity IN (SELECT qty FROM quantity_range)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        w_warehouse_name,
        cp_department,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        MAX(cr_return_quantity) AS max_return_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cp_type) AS distinct_page_types,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr_return_amount) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_amount_category
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (w_warehouse_name, cp_department),
        (w_warehouse_name),
        (cp_department),
        ()
    )
    HAVING SUM(cr_return_amount) > 500
)
SELECT
    w_warehouse_name,
    cp_department,
    total_return_amount,
    avg_return_amount,
    return_count,
    max_return_quantity,
    distinct_page_types,
    return_amount_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year, d_month_seq, d_day_name, d_holiday
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
      AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 12
      AND d_day_name = 'Monday'
      AND d_holiday = 'N'
)
SELECT
    s.s_city,
    i.i_category,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MAX(i.i_current_price) AS max_price,
    MIN(i.i_current_price) AS min_price
FROM filtered_dates d
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN store s
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cr
    ON t_cr.t_time_sk = cr.cr_returned_time_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sr
    ON t_sr.t_time_sk = sr.sr_return_time_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    AND ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ws
    ON t_ws.t_time_sk = ws.ws_sold_time_sk
WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 100
  AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 600000
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
GROUP BY CUBE(s.s_city, i.i_category)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
store_item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS customers_arr
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim t_s ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_s.t_time_sk
    WHERE t_s.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),
expanded_customers AS (
    SELECT
        sis.ss_item_sk,
        c.customer_sk
    FROM store_item_sales sis
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sis.customers_arr) AS t(customer_sk)
),
intersect_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk
    FROM item i
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sales_price > 150
    INTERSECT
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damage%'
)
SELECT
    ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    sis.total_quantity,
    sis.total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ec.customer_sk) AS distinct_customers_exploded,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r_cr.r_reason_desc) AS distinct_catalog_return_reasons,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r_wr.r_reason_desc) AS distinct_web_return_reasons
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN time_dim t_s ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_s.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN store_item_sales sis ON sis.ss_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN expanded_customers ec ON ec.ss_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
WHERE i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM intersect_items)
  AND t_s.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
GROUP BY
    ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    sis.total_quantity,
    sis.total_net_paid
ORDER BY sis.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        d_sold.d_year,
        d_sold.d_holiday,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        cc.cc_state,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        t_sold.t_hour
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm2 ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk AND w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
),
item_agg AS (
    SELECT
        jd.i_item_sk,
        jd.i_product_name,
        jd.i_category,
        jd.d_year,
        SUM(jd.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(jd.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(jd.cs_net_profit + COALESCE(jd.ws_net_profit, 0)) AS total_net_profit,
        MAX(jd.cc_state) AS cc_state,
        MAX(jd.ib_upper_bound) AS ib_upper_bound,
        MAX(jd.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS inv_quantity_on_hand,
        MAX(jd.cr_return_amount) AS cr_return_amount,
        SUM(jd.cs_quantity) AS total_catalog_quantity,
        SUM(jd.ws_quantity) AS total_web_quantity
    FROM joined_data jd
    WHERE jd.d_year = 2001
      AND jd.d_holiday = 'N'
      AND jd.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND jd.cs_quantity > 5
      AND jd.cr_return_amount > 100
      AND jd.inv_quantity_on_hand > 10
      AND jd.ib_upper_bound > 50000
      AND jd.cc_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY jd.i_item_sk, jd.i_product_name, jd.i_category, jd.d_year
)
SELECT
    ia.i_item_sk,
    ia.i_product_name,
    ia.i_category,
    ia.d_year,
    ia.total_catalog_sales,
    ia.total_web_sales,
    ia.total_net_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ia.d_year ORDER BY ia.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN ia.total_net_profit > (SELECT AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) FROM catalog_sales cs) THEN 'Above Avg Profit'
        ELSE 'Below Avg Profit'
    END AS profit_category
FROM item_agg ia
ORDER BY ia.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT
        inv_item_sk,
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    GROUP BY inv_item_sk, inv_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    w.w_state,
    cc.cc_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_profit)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS avg_item_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 0
        THEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) / SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS profit_margin
FROM inventory_agg inv_agg
JOIN item i ON inv_agg.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON inv_agg.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE
    i.i_category_id = 5
    AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    AND cc.cc_country = 'United States'
    AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND cd_refunded.cd_marital_status = 'M'
GROUP BY
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    w.w_state,
    cc.cc_name,
    inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand,
    i.i_item_sk
HAVING
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 1000
ORDER BY
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range (d_date_sk, d_date) AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2000-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN date_range dr ON d2.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2000-01-07'
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_brand,
    p.p_promo_id,
    d.d_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_quantity > 1 THEN cr.cr_return_amount ELSE 0 END) AS multi_item_return_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
    MAX(CASE WHEN sr.sr_fee > 30 THEN sr.sr_fee END) AS max_high_fee,
    MIN(ws.ws_ship_date_sk) AS min_ship_date_sk,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr3
        WHERE sr3.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND sr3.sr_fee > 30
    ) AS customer_high_fee_return_count
FROM
    date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d ON dr.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
        AND p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
        AND p.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
        AND c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
        AND c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_demo_sk = ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
        AND hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
        AND hd.hd_demo_sk = ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
        AND r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
        AND r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2000
    AND i.i_formulation = '4900684033pink844758'
    AND p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
    AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT DISTINCT inv_item_sk FROM inventory WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0)
    AND c.c_customer_sk NOT IN (
        SELECT cr_refunded_customer_sk
        FROM catalog_returns
        WHERE cr_refunded_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          AND sr2.sr_fee > 50
    )
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_brand,
    p.p_promo_id,
    d.d_year
ORDER BY
    store_net_profit DESC,
    catalog_net_profit DESC,
    web_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk    AS sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk     AS sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk            AS sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk        AS sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk           AS sr_hdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_addr_sk            AS sr_addr_sk,
        sr.sr_store_sk           AS sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_return_quantity    AS sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_store_credit       AS sr_store_credit,
        sr.sr_net_loss           AS sr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk   AS cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk   AS cr_returned_time_sk,
        cr.cr_item_sk            AS cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS cr_refunded_customer_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity    AS cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount      AS cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss           AS cr_net_loss,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk       AS ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk       AS ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk            AS ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk   AS ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity           AS ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price        AS ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price    AS ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_paid           AS ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit         AS ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_order_number       AS ws_order_number,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk   AS wr_returned_date_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk   AS wr_returned_time_sk,
        wr.wr_item_sk            AS wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS wr_refunded_customer_sk,
        wr.wr_return_quantity   AS wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt         AS wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss           AS wr_net_loss,
        cc.cc_call_center_sk     AS cc_call_center_sk,
        wh.w_warehouse_sk        AS w_warehouse_sk,
        i.i_item_sk              AS i_item_sk,
        i.i_category             AS i_category,
        i.i_current_price        AS i_current_price,
        c.c_customer_sk          AS c_customer_sk,
        ca.ca_address_sk         AS ca_address_sk,
        hd.hd_demo_sk            AS hd_demo_sk,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count      AS hd_vehicle_count,
        d.d_date_sk               AS d_date_sk,
        d.d_year                  AS d_year,
        t.t_time_sk               AS t_time_sk,
        st.s_store_sk             AS s_store_sk,
        st.s_store_name           AS s_store_name,
        we.web_site_sk            AS web_site_sk,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store st ON sr.sr_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                         AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
                         AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                         AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse wh ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                     AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                     AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
                     AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
                     AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                     AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                     AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_wareh

WITH reason_words AS (
  SELECT
    r.r_reason_sk,
    r.r_reason_id,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    split(r.r_reason_desc, '\\s+') AS desc_words
  FROM reason r
),
unnested AS (
  SELECT
    rw.r_reason_sk,
    rw.r_reason_id,
    rw.r_reason_desc,
    w.word
  FROM reason_words rw
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(rw.desc_words) AS t(word)
),
store_agg AS (
  SELECT
    sr.sr_reason_sk,
    COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_inc_tax,
    AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
    MAX(sr.sr_reversed_charge) AS max_rev_charge
  FROM store_returns sr
  GROUP BY sr.sr_reason_sk
)
SELECT
  uw.r_reason_id,
  uw.r_reason_desc,
  uw.word,
  sa.return_cnt,
  sa.total_return_inc_tax,
  sa.avg_net_loss
FROM unnested uw
JOIN store_agg sa
  ON uw.r_reason_sk = sa.sr_reason_sk
WHERE
  regexp_like(uw.r_reason_desc, '(?i)product')
  AND uw.r_reason_desc LIKE '%does not work%'
  AND sa.max_rev_charge > 5
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr2
    WHERE sr2.sr_reason_sk = uw.r_reason_sk
      AND sr2.sr_return_ship_cost > 800
  )
ORDER BY sa.avg_net_loss DESC, uw.word
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog AS (
    SELECT 'catalog' AS source,
           ca.ca_state AS state,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
           CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE' ELSE 'NON_POSITIVE' END AS profit_flag
    FROM tpcds.catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS cs
    JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE p.p_response_target = 1
      AND p.p_channel_radio = 'N'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state
),
web AS (
    SELECT 'web' AS source,
           ca.ca_state AS state,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
           CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE' ELSE 'NON_POSITIVE' END AS profit_flag
    FROM tpcds.web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS ws
    JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE p.p_response_target = 1
      AND p.p_channel_radio = 'N'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state
)
SELECT source, state, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, profit_flag
FROM catalog
UNION ALL
SELECT source, state, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, profit_flag
FROM web
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT
    d.d_year,
    d.d_month_seq AS month,
    CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0 THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Full Price' END AS price_category,
    regexp_extract(p.p_promo_name, '\\w+', 1) AS promo_keyword,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_count,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    MIN(concat(p.p_promo_name, ' - ', i.i_brand)) AS promo_brand_concat,
    MIN(substring(i.i_item_desc, 1, 20)) AS item_desc_start
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE p.p_promo_name LIKE '%Discount%'
  AND regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '^[A-Z]{3}.*')
  AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0 THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Full Price' END,
        regexp_extract(p.p_promo_name, '\\w+', 1)
    ),
    (
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0 THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Full Price' END
    ),
    (
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq
    ),
    (
        d.d_year
    ),
    ()
)
ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, price_category, promo_keyword
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, d.d_year
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN date_series ds ON d.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-07'
),

sales_lunch AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date AS sold_date,
        ds.d_year AS sold_year,
        td.t_meal_time,
        d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
        d_ship.d_year AS ship_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ws.ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    INNER JOIN date_series ds ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    WHERE td.t_meal_time = 'lunch'
      AND d_ship.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-01-31'
    GROUP BY ds.d_date, ds.d_year, td.t_meal_time, d_ship.d_date, d_ship.d_year
),

sales_dinner AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_date AS sold_date,
        ds.d_year AS sold_year,
        td.t_meal_time,
        d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
        d_ship.d_year AS ship_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ws.ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    INNER JOIN date_series ds ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    WHERE td.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
      AND d_ship.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-01-31'
    GROUP BY ds.d_date, ds.d_year, td.t_meal_time, d_ship.d_date, d_ship.d_year
)
SELECT
    sold_date,
    sold_year,
    t_meal_time,
    ship_date,
    ship_year,
    total_profit,
    avg_quantity,
    order_cnt
FROM sales_lunch
UNION ALL
SELECT
    sold_date,
    sold_year,
    t_meal_time,
    ship_date,
    ship_year,
    total_profit,
    avg_quantity,
    order_cnt
FROM sales_dinner
ORDER BY sold_date DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH recent_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS d_year,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        'store' AS channel,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_qty,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_level
    FROM recent_dates d
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.p_discount_active
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND p.p_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk
          AND p.p_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk
        ORDER BY p.p_start_date_sk DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS promo
    GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_category

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        d.d_year AS d_year,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        'web' AS channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_qty,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_level
    FROM recent_dates d
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.p_discount_active
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND p.p_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk
          AND p.p_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk
        ORDER BY p.p_start_date_sk DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS promo_w
    GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_category
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_category,
    channel,
    total_net_paid,
    total_return_qty,
    sales_level
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC, d_year ASC, i_category ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH refunded_high_amount AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 300
),
returning_large_quantity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity >= 2
),
common_customers AS (
    SELECT cust_sk FROM refunded_high_amount
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cust_sk FROM returning_large_quantity
)
SELECT
    ca.ca_state,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    CASE
        WHEN wr.wr_return_amt > 500 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_amount_category,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_order_count,
    MIN(wr.wr_return_amt) AS min_return_amt,
    MAX(wr.wr_return_amt) AS max_return_amt,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    ) AS total_returns_by_customer
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN customer c
    ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    AND wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN common_customers cc
    ON c.c_customer_sk = cc.cust_sk
WHERE
    c.c_birth_month = 5
    AND ca.ca_suite_number IN ('Suite J', 'Suite N')
    AND r.r_reason_id = 'AAAAAAAANAAAAAAA'
    AND wp.wp_type = 'article'
    AND ca.ca_location_type = 'single family'
    AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2452000 AND 2453000
GROUP BY
    ca.ca_state,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    CASE
        WHEN wr.wr_return_amt > 500 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE sales_seq AS (
    SELECT
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws_item_sk,
        ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws_order_number,
        ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = (SELECT MIN(ws_sold_date_sk) FROM web_sales)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
        ss.lvl + 1
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN sales_seq ss ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ss.ws_sold_date_sk + 1
    WHERE ss.lvl < 5
)
SELECT
    ss.ws_order_number,
    ss.ws_sold_date_sk,
    td.t_meal_time,
    td.t_hour,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_item_id,
    wh.w_warehouse_name,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    ss.ws_net_paid_inc_ship,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.ws_net_paid_inc_ship > (SELECT AVG(ws_net_paid_inc_ship) FROM web_sales) THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS spend_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ws_sold_date_sk DESC) AS purchase_seq,
    SUM(ss.ws_net_paid_inc_ship) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_3
FROM sales_seq ss
JOIN time_dim td
    ON ss.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse wh
    ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE
    td.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
    AND i.i_category_id IN (7, 8, 10)
    AND wh.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 50000
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
    AND ss.ws_net_paid_inc_ship > 2000
    AND td.t_meal_time = 'breakfast'
LIMIT 100

WITH aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_brand AS brand,
        cd.cd_credit_rating AS credit_rating,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(COALESCE(rcr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0)) AS total_store_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN time_dim td
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns rcr
        ON rcr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason re
        ON rcr.cr_reason_sk = re.r_reason_sk
    WHERE
        cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
        AND i.i_current_price > 100
        AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
        AND p.p_channel_press = 'N'
    GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_brand, cd.cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT
    agg.category,
    agg.brand,
    agg.credit_rating,
    agg.total_net_paid,
    agg.total_return_amount,
    agg.total_store_net_paid,
    agg.total_net_paid / NULLIF(agg.total_quantity, 0) AS avg_price_per_item,
    SUM(agg.total_net_paid) OVER () AS overall_net_paid,
    agg.total_net_paid / SUM(agg.total_net_paid) OVER () AS share_of_total_net_paid,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store) AS total_store_count,
    (SELECT MAX(p.p_discount_active) FROM promotion p) AS max_promo_discount_active
FROM aggregated_sales agg
WHERE agg.total_net_paid > 10000
HAVING agg.total_return_amount < 5000
ORDER BY agg.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        wh.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id,
        word,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 20000 THEN 'High Sales' ELSE 'Normal Sales' END AS category,
        'sales' AS record_type
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN warehouse wh ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(site.web_name, ' ')) AS t(word)
    GROUP BY wh.w_warehouse_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, word
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 5000
),
returns AS (
    SELECT
        wh.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id,
        word,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_amount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 5000 THEN 'High Returns' ELSE 'Low Returns' END AS category,
        'returns' AS record_type
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse wh ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(site.web_name, ' ')) AS t(word)
    GROUP BY wh.w_warehouse_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, word
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 500
)
SELECT *
FROM sales
UNION
SELECT *
FROM returns
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH page_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department,
        ws.web_city,
        d.d_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) AS page_count,
        SUM(cp.cp_catalog_number) AS total_catalog_number,
        AVG(cp.cp_catalog_number) AS avg_catalog_number,
        MIN(d.d_date) AS first_date,
        MAX(d.d_date) AS last_date
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer cu
        ON cu.c_first_sales_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_catalog_number BETWEEN 5 AND 20
      AND d.d_year = 2001
      AND ws.web_city = 'Harmony'
      AND cu.c_salutation = 'Mrs.'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM web_site ws2
          WHERE ws2.web_city = ws.web_city
            AND ws2.web_state IS NOT NULL
            AND ws2.web_suite_number <> ws.web_suite_number
      )
      AND cp.cp_type IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT cp2.cp_type FROM catalog_page cp2
          WHERE cp2.cp_department = cp.cp_department
      )
    GROUP BY cp.cp_department, ws.web_city, d.d_year
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) > 10
)
SELECT
    ps.cp_department,
    ps.web_city,
    ps.d_year,
    ps.page_count,
    ps.total_catalog_number,
    ps.avg_catalog_number,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.avg_catalog_number > (SELECT AVG(cp3.cp_catalog_number) FROM catalog_page cp3) THEN 'Above Avg'
        ELSE 'Below Avg'
    END AS avg_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer cu_corr
        WHERE cu_corr.c_first_sales_date_sk = (
            SELECT d_inner.d_date_sk FROM date_dim d_inner
            WHERE d_inner.d_year = ps.d_year AND d_inner.d_month_seq = 1
        )
        AND cu_corr.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    ) AS preferred_cust_y_count
FROM page_stats ps
ORDER BY ps.total_catalog_number DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH site_sales AS (
   SELECT
      ws.ws_order_number,
      ws.ws_net_profit,
      ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
      ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost,
      ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
      ws.ws_quantity,
      ws.ws_web_site_sk,
      ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
      ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
      ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
      ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
      ws.ws_promo_sk,
      ws.ws_item_sk,
      site.web_name,
      site.web_city,
      site.web_state,
      site.web_market_manager
   FROM web_sales ws
   FULL OUTER JOIN web_site site
       ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
),
discount_profit_intersect AS (
   SELECT ws_order_number
   FROM web_sales
   WHERE ws_ext_discount_amt > 2000
   INTERSECT
   SELECT ws_order_number
   FROM web_sales
   WHERE ws_net_profit > 500
)

SELECT
   ss.web_name,
   ss.web_city,
   ss.web_state,
   ss.ws_order_number,
   SUM(ss.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
   CASE 
      WHEN SUM(ss.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' 
      ELSE 'Loss' 
   END AS profit_indicator,
   CASE 
      WHEN ss.ws_net_profit > (
            SELECT avg(ws_net_profit)
            FROM web_sales
            WHERE ws_web_site_sk = ss.ws_web_site_sk
         ) THEN 'Above Avg Site Profit'
      ELSE 'Below Avg Site Profit'
   END AS profit_vs_avg,
   COUNT(*) AS sale_count
FROM site_sales ss
WHERE ss.ws_order_number IN (SELECT ws_order_number FROM discount_profit_intersect)
  AND (ss.ws_ext_discount_amt > 2500 OR ss.ws_net_profit > 800)
GROUP BY ss.web_name, ss.web_city, ss.web_state, ss.ws_order_number, ss.ws_net_profit
UNION ALL
SELECT
   ss.web_name,
   ss.web_city,
   ss.web_state,
   ss.ws_order_number,
   SUM(ss.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
   CASE 
      WHEN SUM(ss.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' 
      ELSE 'Loss' 
   END AS profit_indicator,
   CASE 
      WHEN ss.ws_net_profit > (
            SELECT avg(ws_net_profit)
            FROM web_sales
            WHERE ws_web_site_sk = ss.ws_web_site_sk
         ) THEN 'Above Avg Site Profit'
      ELSE 'Below Avg Site Profit'
   END AS profit_vs_avg,
   COUNT(*) AS sale_count
FROM site_sales ss
WHERE ss.ws_net_profit > 1500
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_site w
        WHERE w.web_market_manager = 'James Harris'
          AND w.web_site_sk = ss.ws_web_site_sk
     )
GROUP BY ss.web_name, ss.web_city, ss.web_state, ss.ws_order_number, ss.ws_net_profit
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq(lvl) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM seq WHERE lvl < 5
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        s.c_customer_sk,
        s.c_customer_id,
        s.total_store_profit AS profit,
        'store' AS channel
    FROM store_agg s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        w.c_customer_sk,
        w.c_customer_id,
        w.total_web_profit AS profit,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_agg w
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.profit,
        c.channel,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.channel ORDER BY c.profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        (SELECT AVG(comb2.profit) FROM combined comb2 WHERE comb2.channel = c.channel) AS avg_channel_profit
    FROM combined c
    JOIN seq ON seq.lvl = 1
    WHERE c.profit > 0
      AND (
          (c.channel = 'store' AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
          ))
          OR
          (c.channel = 'web' AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM web_sales ws2
               WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND ws2.ws_ext_tax > 100
          ))
      )
)
SELECT
    r.c_customer_id,
    r.channel,
    r.profit,
    r.profit_rank,
    r.avg_channel_profit
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.profit_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.channel, r.profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq (n) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 100
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_city AS city,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        sum(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        sum(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_amount
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(ca.ca_zip, '^[0-9]{5}$')
    GROUP BY ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_city AS city,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        sum(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        sum(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_amount
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(ca.ca_city, '^[A-Z][a-z]+$')
      AND ca.ca_city LIKE '%ton%'
    GROUP BY ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state
),
joined_sales AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ca.city, wa.city) AS city,
        COALESCE(ca.state, wa.state) AS state,
        COALESCE(ca.catalog_net_profit, 0) AS catalog_net_profit,
        COALESCE(ca.catalog_sales_amount, 0) AS catalog_sales_amount,
        COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit, 0) AS web_net_profit,
        COALESCE(wa.web_sales_amount, 0) AS web_sales_amount
    FROM catalog_agg ca
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_agg wa
        ON ca.city = wa.city AND ca.state = wa.state
),
union_sales AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        state,
        catalog_net_profit,
        web_net_profit,
        (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        concat(city, ', ', state) AS city_state,
        regexp_extract(city, '([A-Z][a-z]+)', 1) AS city_name_extracted
    FROM joined_sales
    WHERE city LIKE 'A%'
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT
        city,
        state,
        catalog_net_profit,
        web_net_profit,
        (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        concat(city, ', ', state) AS city_state,
        regexp_extract(city, '([A-Z][a-z]+)', 1) AS city_name_extracted
    FROM joined_sales
    WHERE state LIKE 'C%'
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        us.*, 
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS rn
    FROM union_sales us
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        city_state,
        total_net_profit,
        catalog_net_profit,
        web_net_profit,
        city_name_extracted,
        substring(city_state FROM 1 FOR 3) AS city_state_prefix
    FROM ranked_sales rs
    JOIN seq s
        ON rs.rn = s.n
    WHERE total_net_profit > 0
)
SELECT
    city_state,
    total_net_profit,
    catalog_net_profit,
    web_net_profit,
    city_name_extracted,
    city_state_prefix
FROM final
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (42)
),
active_promo AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk, p_promo_name
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        s_sales.s_store_name,
        hd_sales.hd_buy_potential,
        promo.p_promo_name,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        (
            SELECT MAX(p_cost)
            FROM promotion p_sub
            WHERE p_sub.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
        ) AS max_promo_cost
    FROM filtered_sales ss
    JOIN household_demographics hd_sales
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_sales.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s_sales
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s_sales.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion promo
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
    JOIN promotion promo2
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = promo2.p_promo_sk
    JOIN active_promo ap
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = ap.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss_ticket
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss_ticket.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN promotion promo2a
        ON ss_ticket.ss_promo_sk = promo2a.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_returns
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_returns.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s_returns
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s_returns.s_store_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 0
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_name,
        hd_buy_potential,
        p_promo_name,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(max_promo_cost, 0)) AS total_max_promo_cost,
        (SUM(ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0))) AS net_profit
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY
        s_store_name,
        hd_buy_potential,
        p_promo_name
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    hd_buy_potential,
    p_promo_name,
    total_sales,
    total_sales_profit,
    total_return_loss,
    total_max_promo_cost,
    net_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY net_profit DESC
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE ws_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_qty,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_category,
    d_sold.d_year,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(wa.total_net_paid) AS web_net_paid,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wa.total_net_paid)) AS overall_net,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wa.total_net_paid)) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END AS net_status
FROM ws_agg wa
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON wa.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON wa.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs 
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
   AND cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer cu 
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cu.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd 
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN call_center cc 
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp 
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm 
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p 
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr 
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN inventory inv 
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
   AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s 
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws 
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
  AND d_sold.d_year = 2001
  AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_category, d_sold.d_year)
HAVING (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) + SUM(wa.total_net_paid)) > 10000
ORDER BY overall_net DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        w_sales.w_warehouse_sk,
        w_sales.w_warehouse_name,
        c_bill.c_customer_sk AS bill_customer_sk,
        c_bill.c_customer_id AS bill_customer_id,
        hd_bill.hd_demo_sk AS bill_hdemo_sk,
        hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk AS bill_income_band,
        c_ship.c_customer_sk AS ship_customer_sk,
        c_ship.c_customer_id AS ship_customer_id,
        hd_ship.hd_demo_sk AS ship_hdemo_sk,
        hd_ship.hd_income_band_sk AS ship_income_band,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_sales ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_sales.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer c_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_sales.w_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    sb.cp_department,
    sb.cp_catalog_page_number,
    sb.w_warehouse_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    sb.bill_income_band,
    SUM(sb.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(sb.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sb.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = sb.cs_order_number
    ) AS return_count
FROM sales_base sb
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = sb.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = sb.cp_catalog_page_sk
   AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = sb.w_warehouse_sk
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = sb.cs_item_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer c_refund
    ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refund.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_refund
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund.hd_demo_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refund.c_customer_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refund.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (sb.cp_department, sb.cp_catalog_page_number, sb.w_warehouse_name, r.r_reason_desc, sb.bill_income_band),
    (sb.cp_department, sb.cp_catalog_page_number, sb.w_warehouse_name, r.r_reason_desc),
    (sb.cp_department, sb.cp_catalog_page_number, sb.w_warehouse_name),
    (sb.cp_department, sb.cp_catalog_page_number),
    (sb.cp_department),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE level AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM level WHERE lvl < 3
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        promotion.p_channel_dmail,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer c_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refunded.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer c_returning ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_returning.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion ON ws.ws_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_page ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 1000
      AND cr.cr_return_tax < 200
      AND cd_refunded.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
      AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'Y'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND web_page.wp_type = 'PRODUCT'
      AND ws.ws_quantity >= 2
      AND web_page.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND web_page.wp_rec_end_date <= DATE '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (sm.sm_ship_mode_id, promotion.p_channel_dmail)
)
SELECT
    agg.sm_ship_mode_id,
    agg.p_channel_dmail,
    agg.total_return_amount,
    agg.total_sales_amount,
    agg.total_net_profit,
    agg.total_net_loss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.p_channel_dmail ORDER BY agg.total_return_amount DESC) AS rn_ship_mode_by_return,
    CASE
        WHEN agg.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS'
        WHEN agg.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS'
        ELSE 'LOW_LOSS'
    END AS loss_category,
    l.lvl
FROM aggregated agg
JOIN level l ON l.lvl = CASE WHEN agg.sm_ship_mode_id IS NULL THEN 3 ELSE 1 END
WHERE agg.total_return_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY agg.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH distinct_promos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p_promo_sk, p_promo_name
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_item_sk = 56527
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        dp.p_promo_name,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        td.t_hour,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_catalog_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_web_orders
    FROM distinct_promos dp
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = dp.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_promo_sk = dp.p_promo_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
        AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE c_bill.c_birth_day = 25
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND wsit.web_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5 AND -4
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_returns wr2
          WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
            AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 100
      )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (dp.p_promo_name, w.w_warehouse_name, td.t_hour)
)
SELECT
    p_promo_name,
    w_warehouse_name,
    t_hour,
    total_catalog_sales,
    total_web_sales,
    total_catalog_profit,
    total_web_profit,
    total_return_loss,
    distinct_catalog_orders,
    distinct_web_orders,
    (total_catalog_profit + total_web_profit) AS total_combined_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_name ORDER BY (total_catalog_profit + total_web_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wr_sub.wr_order_number)
     FROM web_returns wr_sub
     JOIN web_sales ws_sub ON wr_sub.wr_order_number = ws_sub.ws_order_number
     WHERE ws_sub.ws_promo_sk = (
         SELECT p_sub.p_promo_sk
         FROM promotion p_sub
         WHERE p_sub.p_promo_name = sales_agg.p_promo_name
         LIMIT 1
     )) AS total_returns_for_promo
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY total_combined_profit DESC, p_promo_name
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  i_ss.i_item_id AS item_id,
  i_ss.i_product_name AS product_name,
  hd_ss.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
  SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
  COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss,
  SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_quantity,
  SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_catalog_quantity,
  SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_web_quantity,
  SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
  (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_list_price)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i_ss.i_item_sk) AS avg_catalog_list_price
FROM
  store_sales ss
  JOIN item i_ss
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i_ss.i_item_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ss
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_ss.i_item_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_cs_bill
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_cs_bill.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_cs_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_cs_ship.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i_ss.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
  LEFT JOIN item i_wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i_wr.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_refund
    ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_refund.hd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_return
    ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_return.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_bill.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ws_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ws_ship.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN item i_ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i_ws.i_item_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM web_returns wr2
     WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
       AND wr2.wr_return_quantity > 0
  )
GROUP BY
  i_ss.i_item_id,
  i_ss.i_product_name,
  hd_ss.hd_income_band_sk
ORDER BY
  total_store_profit + total_catalog_profit + total_web_profit - total_return_loss DESC
LIMIT 100
