/* Goal: Compute per‑store and per‑promotion performance metrics, including sales, profit, returns, and rank stores by profit while segmenting price categories and highlighting the warehouse used. */
WITH
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        CASE
            WHEN ss.ss_sales_price >= 50 THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN ss.ss_sales_price >= 30 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS price_category,
        sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        sum(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        count(*) AS sales_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND ss.ss_sales_price > 30
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk,
             ss.ss_promo_sk,
             ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
             ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
             CASE
                 WHEN ss.ss_sales_price >= 50 THEN 'Premium'
                 WHEN ss.ss_sales_price >= 30 THEN 'Mid'
                 ELSE 'Low'
             END
),
catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
        sum(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        count(*) AS catalog_return_count
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
             cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
        sum(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_ws_sales,
        sum(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_ws_profit,
        sum(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ws_ship_cost,
        count(*) AS web_sales_count
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_ship_cost > 1000
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
             ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk
),
web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
        sum(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
        count(*) AS web_return_count
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
             wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    p.p_promo_id,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ssa.price_category,
    ssa.total_sales,
    ssa.total_profit,
    COALESCE(cr_agg.total_catalog_return_amount, 0) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    COALESCE(ws_agg.total_ws_sales, 0) AS total_ws_sales,
    COALESCE(ws_agg.total_ws_profit, 0) AS total_ws_profit,
    COALESCE(wr_agg.total_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_web_return_amount,
    w_l.w_warehouse_name,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY ssa.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN ssa.total_sales > 50000 THEN 'Top'
        ELSE 'Regular'
    END AS sales_segment
FROM store_sales_agg ssa
JOIN store s ON ssa.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ssa.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns_agg cr_agg
    ON cr_agg.cd_demo_sk = ssa.ss_cdemo_sk
   AND cr_agg.hd_demo_sk = ssa.ss_hdemo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales_agg ws_agg
    ON ws_agg.cd_demo_sk = ssa.ss_cdemo_sk
   AND ws_agg.hd_demo_sk = ssa.ss_hdemo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns_agg wr_agg
    ON wr_agg.cd_demo_sk = ssa.ss_cdemo_sk
   AND wr_agg.hd_demo_sk = ssa.ss_hdemo_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT w.w_warehouse_name
    FROM warehouse w
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = ssa.ss_cdemo_sk
      AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = ssa.ss_hdemo_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS w_l
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, profit_rank

WITH all_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_class,
        d.d_year,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        p_store.p_promo_name AS store_promo_name,
        p_store.p_discount_active AS store_discount_active,
        p_web.p_promo_name AS web_promo_name,
        p_web.p_discount_active AS web_discount_active,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        sm.sm_type,
        wp.wp_type,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS store_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS store_net_profit,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS web_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS web_net_profit
    FROM call_center cc
    JOIN date_dim d ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p_store ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_store.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
        AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
        AND d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p_web ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_web.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001                     -- filter predicate 1
      AND i.i_category = 'Sports'            -- filter predicate 2
      AND p_store.p_discount_active = 'Y'    -- filter predicate 3 (store promotion)
      AND p_web.p_discount_active = 'Y'      -- filter predicate 4 (web promotion)
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1          -- filter predicate 5
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'      -- filter predicate 6
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        i_category,
        d_year,
        SUM(store_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(web_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(store_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM all_data
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, i_category, d_year
    HAVING SUM(store_net_paid) > 1000          -- HAVING clause
),
intersect_customers AS (
    SELECT ss.c_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001)
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001)
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        ca.c_customer_id,
        ca.i_category,
        ca.d_year,
        ca.total_store_sales,
        ca.total_web_sales,
        ca.total_profit,
        ca.txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.d_year ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM customer_agg ca
    WHERE ca.c_customer_id IN (SELECT c_customer_sk FROM intersect_customers)   -- INTERSECT result
      AND NOT EXISTS (                                                     -- anti‑join
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr2
          JOIN reason r2 ON sr2.sr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
          WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = (
                SELECT c_customer_sk FROM customer WHERE c_customer_id = ca.c_customer_id
          )
            AND r2.r_reason_desc = 'Defective'
      )
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    i_category,
    d_year,
    total_store_sales,
    total_web_sales,
    total_profit,
    txn_count,
    profit_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE profit_rank <= 10
ORDER BY d_year, total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (

        NULL                                                 AS net_paid,
        wr.wr_return_quantity                                 AS return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax                             AS loss_amount,
        cc.cc_name                                           AS call_center_name,
        NULL                                                 AS department,
        i.i_product_name                                     AS product_name,
        NULL                                                 AS promo_name,
        NULL                                                 AS ship_mode_type,
        r.r_reason_desc                                      AS reason_desc,
        ds_ret.d_year                                        AS year,
        ARRAY[
            CAST(wr.wr_return_quantity AS decimal(7,2)),
            wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax
        ]                                                    AS qty_array
    FROM tpcds.web_returns wr
    JOIN date_series ds_ret
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds_ret.d_date_sk

WITH inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_date_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_date_sk
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name,
        d_sold.d_year,
        c.c_customer_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        wsit.web_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_returns_loss,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_txn_count,
        AVG(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower_bound,
        inv_agg.total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM
        store_sales ss
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN time_dim t_sold ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
        INNER JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                                 AND cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
                                 AND cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
                                 AND cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_cs_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs_sold.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
        INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_cp_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_cp_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                                 AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
                                 AND ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
                                 AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
        INNER JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_wsit_open ON wsit.web_open_date_sk = d_wsit_open.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_wsit_close ON wsit.web_close_date_sk = d_wsit_close.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                                 AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        INNER JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
        INNER JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
        INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
        LEFT JOIN inventory_agg inv_agg ON inv_agg.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_returns wr2
            WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
              AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 1000
        )
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_name,
        d_sold.d_year,
        c.c_customer_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        wsit.web_name,
        inv_agg.total_quantity_on_hand
)
SELECT
    b.s_store_name,
    b.d_year,
    b.c_customer_id,
    b.cp_department,
    b.web_name,
    b.total_store_sales,
    b.total_web_sales,
    b.total_catalog_sales,

WITH agg_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.s_store_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS store_sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.s_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_time_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    source,
    location_id,
    location,
    hour,
    am_pm,
    promo_name,
    total_net_profit,
    total_quantity,
    sales_rows,
    profit_category
FROM (
    -- Store side analysis
    SELECT
        'store' AS source,
        s.s_store_id AS location_id,
        s.s_state AS location,
        t.t_hour AS hour,
        t.t_am_pm AS am_pm,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        SUM(a.total_store_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(a.total_store_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_rows,
        CASE WHEN SUM(a.total_store_net_profit) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category
    FROM agg_store_sales a
    JOIN store s ON a.s_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON a.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON a.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        t.t_am_pm = 'PM'
        AND p.p_channel_press = 'N'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_am_pm,
        p.p_promo_name

    UNION ALL

    -- Web side analysis (including catalog activity)
    SELECT
        'web' AS source,
        wsite.web_site_id AS location_id,
        wsite.web_country AS location,
        t2.t_hour AS hour,
        t2.t_am_pm AS am_pm,
        p2.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit + cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity + cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_rows,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit + cs.cs_net_profit) > 2000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t2 ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p2 ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r2 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca2 ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca2.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    -- Join catalog sales and related dimensional tables via the same time dimension
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t2.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p3 ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p3.p_promo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_cs.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_cs ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_cs.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_cs ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_cs.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE
        t2.t_am_pm = 'PM'
        AND p2.p_channel_press = 'N'
        AND wsite.web_country = 'United States'
        AND cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        wsite.web_site_id,
        wsite.web_country,
        t2.t_hour,
        t2.t_am_pm,
        p2.p_promo_name
) final
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_promotions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_sk,
                    p.p_promo_id,
                    p.p_promo_name
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
),

aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        fp.p_promo_id,
        fp.p_promo_name,
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
        cp.cp_type AS catalog_page_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_amount,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS catalog_return_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_ext_sales_price, 0)) AS store_sales_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0)) AS store_sales_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS store_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS store_return_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS web_return_loss
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN filtered_promotions fp ON cs.cs_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
      AND sm.sm_carrier = 'DHL'
      AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 500000
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 1000
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 3
    GROUP BY
        fp.p_promo_id,
        fp.p_promo_name,
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_name,
        cp.cp_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        r.r_reason_desc
)

SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS promo_rank,
    promo_id,
    promo_name,
    call_center_id,
    call_center_name,
    catalog_page_type,
    carrier,
    warehouse_name,
    reason_desc,
    catalog_sales_amount,
    catalog_sales_profit,
    catalog_return_amount,
    catalog_return_loss,
    store_sales_amount,
    store_sales_profit,
    store_return_amount,
    store_return_loss,
    web_return_amount,
    web_return_loss,
    total_net_profit
FROM (
    SELECT
        promo_id,
        promo_name,
        call_center_id,
        call_center_name,
        catalog_page_type,
        carrier,
        warehouse_name,
        reason_desc,
        catalog_sales_amount,
        catalog_sales_profit,
        catalog_return_amount,
        catalog_return_loss,
        store_sales_amount,
        store_sales_profit,
        store_return_amount,
        store_return_loss,
        web_return_amount,
        web_return_loss,
        (catalog_sales_profit - catalog_return_loss + store_sales_profit - store_return_loss - web_return_loss) AS total_net_profit
    FROM aggregated
) t
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
Goal: Compute aggregated sales metrics for California call centers during morning shifts, focusing on specific catalog pages and high‑profit sales, and return the top groups by total net paid.
*/
SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    td.t_sub_shift,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    MIN(cs.cs_net_profit) AS min_profit,
    MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS max_profit,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    ) AS avg_profit_per_page
FROM
    catalog_sales cs
JOIN
    call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN
    catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN
    time_dim td
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
WHERE
    cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND cc.cc_gmt_offset BETWEEN -8.00 AND -5.00
    AND cp.cp_catalog_number IN (6, 14, 19)
    AND cp.cp_description LIKE '%women%'
    AND td.t_sub_shift LIKE 'morning%'
    AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 12
    AND cs.cs_net_profit > 0
    AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    td.t_sub_shift
HAVING
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 10000
ORDER BY
    total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hour_seq AS (
   -- Anchor: start at a known time (e.g., t_time = 4)
   SELECT t_time_sk,
          t_time,
          t_hour,
          t_minute,
          t_second
   FROM time_dim
   WHERE t_time = 4
   UNION ALL
   -- Recursive step: walk forward one surrogate key at a time
   SELECT td.t_time_sk,
          td.t_time,
          td.t_hour,
          td.t_minute,
          td.t_second
   FROM hour_seq h
   JOIN time_dim td ON td.t_time_sk = h.t_time_sk + 1
   WHERE td.t_time <= 16
),
base_sales AS (
   SELECT
      ws.ws_order_number,
      ws.ws_quantity,
      ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
      ws.ws_ext_ship_cost,
      sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
      sm.sm_code,
      sm.sm_contract,
      w.w_warehouse_name,
      h.t_time,
      h.t_minute,
      h.t_second
   FROM web_sales ws
   JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
   JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   JOIN hour_seq h ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = h.t_time_sk
   WHERE sm.sm_code = 'AIR'
     AND sm.sm_contract = 'I3uCelXtjP'
     AND ws.ws_ext_ship_cost > 1000
     AND ws.ws_quantity > 1
     AND h.t_minute >= 5
),
agg_per_ship AS (
   SELECT
      sm_code,
      sm_contract,
      SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(ws_ext_ship_cost)   AS total_ship_cost,
      COUNT(*)                AS order_cnt
   FROM base_sales
   GROUP BY sm_code, sm_contract
),
agg_per_warehouse AS (
   SELECT
      w_warehouse_name,
      SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
      SUM(ws_ext_ship_cost)   AS total_ship_cost,
      COUNT(*)                AS order_cnt
   FROM base_sales
   GROUP BY w_warehouse_name
),
combined AS (
   SELECT
      'ship'      AS agg_type,
      sm_code     AS group_key,
      total_sales,
      total_ship_cost,
      order_cnt
   FROM agg_per_ship
   UNION ALL
   SELECT
      'warehouse' AS agg_type,
      w_warehouse_name AS group_key,
      total_sales,
      total_ship_cost,
      order_cnt
   FROM agg_per_warehouse
),
final_ranked AS (
   SELECT
      agg_type,
      group_key,
      total_sales,
      total_ship_cost,
      order_cnt,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY agg_type ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
      AVG(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY agg_type)            AS avg_sales_by_type
   FROM combined
)
SELECT
   agg_type,
   group_key,
   total_sales,
   total_ship_cost,
   order_cnt,
   sales_rank,
   avg_sales_by_type
FROM final_ranked
WHERE sales_rank <= 5
ORDER BY agg_type, sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs_promo_sk,
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs_ship_mode_sk,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_quantity >= 2
      AND cs_net_paid > 0
      AND cs_ext_discount_amt < 500
      AND cs_ext_tax > 0
      AND cs_ship_mode_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cs_bill_addr_sk, cs_promo_sk, cs_warehouse_sk, cs_ship_mode_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs_net_paid) > 2000
),
recursive_sales AS (
    SELECT
        bs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        bs.cs_promo_sk,
        bs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        bs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        bs.total_net_paid,
        bs.total_quantity,
        bs.sales_cnt,
        1 AS recursion_level
    FROM base_sales bs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        rs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        rs.cs_promo_sk,
        rs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        rs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        rs.total_net_paid,
        rs.total_quantity,
        rs.sales_cnt,
        rs.recursion_level + 1
    FROM recursive_sales rs
    WHERE rs.recursion_level < 1
)
SELECT
    rs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_location_type,
    p.p_promo_name,
    p.p_discount_active,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_state,
    sm.sm_carrier,
    sm.sm_contract,
    rs.total_net_paid,
    rs.total_quantity,
    rs.sales_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_carrier ORDER BY rs.total_net_paid DESC) AS carrier_net_paid_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN rs.total_net_paid > 50000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN rs.total_net_paid > 20000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS net_paid_category
FROM recursive_sales rs
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON rs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON rs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON rs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON rs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE ca.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND ca.ca_location_type = 'apartment'
  AND ca.ca_street_type = 'Ave'
  AND sm.sm_carrier = 'GREAT EASTERN'
  AND w.w_state = 'NY'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
ORDER BY rs.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk,
        d_ret.d_year AS return_year,
        i1.i_category,
        i1.i_brand_id
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i1
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM item i2
        WHERE i2.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
          AND i2.i_brand_id = 1001001
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM reason r2
        WHERE r2.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
          AND r2.r_reason_desc ILIKE '%duplicate%'
    )
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    i2.i_category,
    SUM(br.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(br.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    AVG(br.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT br.cr_order_number) AS distinct_order_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_state ORDER BY SUM(br.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS state_return_rank
FROM base_returns br
INNER JOIN call_center cc
    ON br.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
INNER JOIN reason r
    ON br.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
INNER JOIN item i2
    ON br.cr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
    ON br.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret
    ON br.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
    ON br.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_ret
    ON br.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_open
    ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d_closed
    ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
WHERE d_open.d_year = 2002
  AND d_closed.d_year = 2002
  AND br.return_year = 2002
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    i2.i_category
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hour_seq AS (
    SELECT 0 AS hour
    UNION ALL
    SELECT hour + 1 FROM hour_seq WHERE hour < 23
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        s.s_city,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        td.t_hour,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        CASE 
            WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity > 0 THEN 'Store Return'
            WHEN cr.cr_return_quantity > 0 THEN 'Catalog Return'
            WHEN wr.wr_return_quantity > 0 THEN 'Web Return'
            ELSE 'No Return'
        END AS return_type
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                              AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
                                 AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                                 AND cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
                             AND wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r2 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND s.s_city = 'Los Angeles'
      AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 18
      AND cc.cc_name = 'North America Call Center'
)
SELECT
    jd.s_store_id,
    jd.s_state,
    jd.s_city,
    jd.r_reason_desc,
    jd.t_hour,
    COUNT(DISTINCT jd.return_type) AS distinct_return_types,
    SUM(jd.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_net_loss,
    SUM(jd.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(jd.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss,
    AVG(CASE WHEN jd.sr_return_quantity > 0 THEN jd.sr_return_quantity END) AS avg_store_return_qty,
    MAX(jd.sr_return_quantity) AS max_store_return_qty,
    MIN(jd.sr_return_quantity) AS min_store_return_qty
FROM joined_data jd
JOIN hour_seq hs ON jd.t_hour = hs.hour
GROUP BY jd.s_store_id, jd.s_state, jd.s_city, jd.r_reason_desc, jd.t_hour
ORDER BY total_store_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

agg AS (

SELECT
    zip,
    gender,
    ship_mode,
    year,
    total_return_loss,

    avg_quantity,
    distinct_items_sold,
    loss_category,
    max_item_net_paid,
    RANK(

WITH customer_emails AS ( SELECT c_customer_sk FROM tpcds.customer WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(c_email_address, '^.*@example\\.com$') ), filtered_reason AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.r_reason_sk FROM tpcds.web_returns wr JOIN tpcds.web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN tpcds.reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE wp.wp_url LIKE 'http://www.foo.com%' AND REGEXP_LIKE(wp.wp_url, '\\.com$') ), catalog_ret_sample AS ( SELECT * FROM tpcds.catalog_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) REPEATABLE (123) ) SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_id, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, MIN(CONCAT(sm.sm_type, '-', sm.sm_code)) AS mode_type_code, MIN(SUBSTR(sm.sm_code, 1, 3)) AS sm_code_prefix, MIN(REGEXP_EXTRACT(sm.sm_contract, '([A-Z]+)')) AS contract_prefix, (SELECT AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) FROM tpcds.web_returns wr JOIN tpcds.reason r2 ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r2.r_reason_sk WHERE r2.r_reason_desc = r.r_reason_desc) AS avg_web_net_loss FROM catalog_ret_sample cr JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN tpcds.reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_emails ce ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = ce.c_customer_sk JOIN filtered_reason fr ON r.r_reason_sk = fr.r_reason_sk WHERE sm.sm_code LIKE 'AIR%' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (sm.sm_ship_mode_id, r.r_reason_desc), (sm.sm_ship_mode_id), (r.r_reason_desc), () ) ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 100

WITH order_intersection AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_description,
        cp.cp_type,
        cp.cp_department,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        p.p_promo_name,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS profit_flag,
        regexp_extract(cp.cp_description, '(\\d+)%') AS discount_percent,
        concat(cp.cp_department, ' - ', cp.cp_type) AS dept_type_concat
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE 
        cs.cs_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM order_intersection)
        AND regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)discount|sale')
        AND cp.cp_type LIKE 'A%'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr
            WHERE cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        )
        AND cs.cs_net_paid > 0
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        p_promo_name,
        ib_lower_bound,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS orders,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN profit_flag = 1 THEN cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS profit_net_paid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN profit_flag = 0 THEN cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS loss_net_paid
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (p_promo_name, ib_lower_bound),
        (p_promo_name),
        ()
    )
    HAVING SUM(cs_net_paid) > 100000
)
SELECT
    p_promo_name,
    ib_lower_bound,
    orders,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    avg_net_paid,
    profit_net_paid,
    loss_net_paid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_name ORDER BY ib_lower_bound) AS ib_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
     WHERE cs2.cs_promo_sk = (
         SELECT p2.p_promo_sk
         FROM promotion p2
         WHERE p2.p_promo_name = agg.p_promo_name
         LIMIT 1
     )
    ) AS overall_avg_net_paid
FROM aggregated agg
ORDER BY p_promo_name, ib_lower_bound
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE years(yr) AS (
    SELECT 1998
    UNION ALL
    SELECT yr + 1 FROM years WHERE yr < 2002
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_total,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN regexp_like(i.i_item_desc, '^\\d{3}-[A-Z]+') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desc_match_flag,
        CONCAT(ca.ca_city, ', ', ca.ca_state) AS location,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_returns wr WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_returns
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN years y ON YEAR(i.i_rec_start_date) = y.yr
    GROUP BY 
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        ca.ca_city,
        ca.ca_state,
        i.i_item_desc
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_total,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN regexp_like(CAST(ws.ws_web_page_sk AS varchar), '^1[0-9]{2}$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS page_match_flag,
        CONCAT(CAST(ws.ws_web_site_sk AS varchar), '-', CAST(i.i_item_sk AS varchar)) AS site_item_concat,
        (SELECT AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) FROM web_returns wr WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_return_amt,
        SUBSTRING(wsit.web_manager FROM 1 FOR 1) AS manager_initial
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    JOIN years y ON YEAR(i.i_rec_start_date) = y.yr
    WHERE wsit.web_manager LIKE 'J%'
    GROUP BY 
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        wsit.web_manager
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        i_item_sk,
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        i_category,
        'store' AS source,
        sales_total,
        net_profit,
        txn_cnt,
        desc_match_flag AS match_flag,
        location AS extra_info
    FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        i_item_sk,
        i_item_id,
        i_product_name,
        i_category,
        'web' AS source,
        sales_total,
        net_profit,
        txn_cnt,
        page_match_flag AS match_flag,
        site_item_concat AS extra_info
    FROM web_agg
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    SUBSTRING(i_item_id FROM 1 FOR 3) AS item_id_prefix,
    i_product_name,
    i_category,
    source,
    sales_total,
    net_profit,
    txn_cnt,
    match_flag,
    extra_info,
    CASE 
        WHEN sales_total >= 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN sales_total >= 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = c.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_return_amt > 0) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS has_positive_return
FROM combined c
WHERE extra_info LIKE '%-%'
ORDER BY sales_total DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_year) AS d_year FROM date_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_year + 1 AS d_year FROM years WHERE d_year < (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim)
),
sales_raw AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        d.d_year,
        cp.cp_department
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5)
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM promotion p2
        WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
          AND p2.p_channel_email = 'Y'
    )
),
returns_raw AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        d.d_year
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
),
union_raw AS (
    SELECT
        'Sale'   AS event_type,
        d_year   AS year,
        cp_department AS department,
        cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS amount,
        1 AS txn_cnt
    FROM sales_raw
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Return' AS event_type,
        d_year   AS year,
        CAST('N/A' AS varchar) AS department,
        wr_return_amt AS amount,
        1 AS txn_cnt
    FROM returns_raw
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        event_type,
        year,
        department,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
        SUM(txn_cnt) AS transaction_count
    FROM union_raw
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (event_type, year, department),
        (event_type, year),
        (event_type),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    agg.event_type,
    agg.year,
    agg.department,
    agg.total_amount,
    agg.transaction_count,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk)
        FROM customer c
        JOIN date_dim d ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = agg.year
    ) AS customers_in_year,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.event_type ORDER BY agg.year, agg.department) AS row_num,
    SUM(agg.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY agg.event_type ORDER BY agg.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount
FROM aggregated agg
LEFT JOIN years y ON agg.year = y.d_year
ORDER BY agg.event_type, agg.year, agg.department
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    d_sales.d_date,
    ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_amount,
    ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
    COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0) AS return_amount,
    COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0) AS return_quantity,
    COALESCE(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS inventory_on_hand,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    wp.wp_type AS web_page_type,
    ws.web_name AS web_site_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000 THEN 'High'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS sales_category,
    (
      SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount)
      FROM catalog_returns cr2
      WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
    ) AS max_return_amount_for_customer
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_sales
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_store_close
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_store_close.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer c_sales
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
   AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  LEFT JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
   AND wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_ret
    ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_ret.c_customer_sk
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_page wp2
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON wp2.wp_access_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE wp2.wp_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
      AND d2.d_year = 2001
  )
    AND d_sales.d_year = 2001
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    s_store_name,
    cc_name,
    sales_category,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales,
    SUM(return_amount) AS total_returns,
    SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(inventory_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
    MAX(max_return_amount_for_customer) AS max_return_amount_customer,
    GROUPING_ID(s_store_name, cc_name, sales_category) AS grouping_id
  FROM base
  GROUP BY ROLLUP (s_store_name, cc_name, sales_category)
  HAVING SUM(sales_amount) > 0
)
SELECT
  s_store_name,
  cc_name,
  sales_category,
  transaction_count,
  total_sales,
  total_returns,
  total_net_profit,
  total_inventory_on_hand,
  max_return_amount_customer,
  SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_name ORDER BY grouping_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_sales_by_store,
  grouping_id
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY cumulative_sales_by_store DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_sales,
        'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship) AS total_sales,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id, total_sales, channel FROM catalog_sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id, total_sales, channel FROM web_sales_agg
),
customer_total AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS channels
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY c_customer_id
),
avg_sales AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_total_sales FROM customer_total
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ct.c_customer_id,
    ct.total_sales,
    ct.channels,
    CASE WHEN ct.total_sales > (SELECT avg_total_sales FROM avg_sales) THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS sales_category
FROM customer_total ct
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim dr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = (
        SELECT c.c_customer_sk
        FROM customer c
        WHERE c.c_customer_id = ct.c_customer_id
        LIMIT 1
    )
      AND dr.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
)
ORDER BY ct.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH unioned AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY hd.hd_demo_sk) AS rn,
        (SELECT MAX(hd2.hd_dep_count)
         FROM household_demographics hd2
         WHERE hd2.hd_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS max_dep_in_band
    FROM household_demographics hd
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound
        FROM income_band ib
        WHERE ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) ib
    WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential IN ('0-500', '501-1000')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY hd.hd_demo_sk) AS rn,
        (SELECT MAX(hd2.hd_dep_count)
         FROM household_demographics hd2
         WHERE hd2.hd_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS max_dep_in_band
    FROM household_demographics hd
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound
        FROM income_band ib
        WHERE ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) ib
    WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential IN ('1001-5000', '5001-10000')
)
SELECT
    hd_buy_potential,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hd_income_band_sk) AS distinct_income_bands,
    SUM(hd_dep_count) AS total_dependents,
    SUM(hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicles,
    MAX(rn) AS max_row_number,
    MAX(max_dep_in_band) AS max_dep_in_band_overall
FROM unioned
GROUP BY ROLLUP (hd_buy_potential, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound)
ORDER BY hd_buy_potential NULLS LAST, ib_lower_bound NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE warehouse_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        w_warehouse_sk,
        w_warehouse_name,
        w_street_type,
        w_county,
        1 AS level
    FROM warehouse
    WHERE w_warehouse_sk = (SELECT MIN(w_warehouse_sk) FROM warehouse)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_street_type,
        w.w_county,
        wt.level + 1
    FROM warehouse w
    JOIN warehouse_tree wt 
        ON w.w_warehouse_sk = wt.w_warehouse_sk + 1
    WHERE wt.level < 5
)

SELECT
    t.w_warehouse_name,
    t.cr_reason_sk,
    t.total_return_amount,
    t.avg_return_amount,
    t.return_cnt,
    t.min_return_amount,
    t.max_return_amount,
    t.total_refunded_cash,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.total_return_amount DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        wt.w_warehouse_name,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        MIN(cr.cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
        MAX(cr.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash
    FROM warehouse_tree wt
    JOIN catalog_returns cr 
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = wt.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c 
        ON c.c_customer_sk = cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk IN (10, 47, 60)
      AND cr.cr_refunded_cash > 500.00
      AND cr.cr_return_amount >= 100.00
      AND wt.w_street_type = 'Avenue'
      AND wt.w_county = 'Williamson County'
      AND c.c_salutation = 'Mr.'
      AND c.c_last_review_date >= 2452360
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr2
          WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
            AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 200
      )
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (wt.w_warehouse_name, cr.cr_reason_sk)
) t
ORDER BY t.total_return_amount DESC, t.w_warehouse_name
LIMIT 100

/* Goal: Identify top customers by catalog sales net profit and customers with web return amounts, applying string pattern filters, promotional name extraction, window ranking, Bernoulli sampling, and combine the two result sets. */
WITH
    sampled_sales AS (
        SELECT
            cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
            cs.cs_net_profit,
            cs.cs_order_number,
            cs.cs_promo_sk,
            cs.cs_quantity,
            cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
        FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) cs
        WHERE cs.cs_net_profit IS NOT NULL
    ),
    sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            c.c_customer_id,
            c.c_first_name,
            c.c_last_name,
            ca.ca_city AS city,
            SUM(ss.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
            COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
            MAX(p.p_promo_name) AS any_promo_name,
            REGEXP_EXTRACT(MAX(p.p_promo_name), '^([A-Za-z]+)') AS promo_first_word
        FROM sampled_sales ss
        JOIN customer c ON ss.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        WHERE ca.ca_city LIKE '%ington'
          AND REGEXP_LIKE(ca.ca_city, '^F.*')
        GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city
    ),
    sales_ranked AS (
        SELECT
            sa.*, 
            RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS city_profit_rank
        FROM sales_agg sa
    ),
    customer_returns AS (
        SELECT
            c.c_customer_id,
            c.c_first_name,
            c.c_last_name,
            ca.ca_city AS city,
            SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
            COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States'
        GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city
    ),
    sales_select AS (
        SELECT
            sr.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
            CONCAT(sr.c_first_name, ' ', sr.c_last_name) AS customer_name,
            sr.total_net_profit AS metric_value,
            'sales' AS metric_type,
            sr.promo_first_word AS promo_word,
            sr.city_profit_rank AS rank_within_city,
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM web_returns wr2
                WHERE wr2.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            ) AS total_refunds_cnt
        FROM sales_ranked sr
        JOIN customer c ON sr.c_customer_id = c.c_customer_id
        WHERE sr.total_net_profit > 1000
    ),
    returns_select AS (
        SELECT
            cr.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
            CONCAT(cr.c_first_name, ' ', cr.c_last_name) AS customer_name,
            cr.total_return_amt AS metric_value,
            'returns' AS metric_type,
            CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS promo_word,
            CAST(NULL AS bigint) AS rank_within_city,
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM web_returns wr2
                WHERE wr2.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            ) AS total_refunds_cnt
        FROM customer_returns cr
        JOIN customer c ON cr.c_customer_id = c.c_customer_id
        WHERE cr.total_return_amt > 0
    )
SELECT
    u.customer_id,
    u.customer_name,
    u.metric_value,
    u.metric_type,
    u.promo_word,
    u.rank_within_city,
    u.total_refunds_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM sales_select
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM returns_select
) u
ORDER BY u.metric_value DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_sales.d_year AS year,
        st.s_store_name AS entity,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales,
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS total_returns,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 0 THEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) / SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) ELSE NULL END AS profit_margin,
        CAST((
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss2.ss_item_sk)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
              AND d2.d_year = d_sales.d_year
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS extra_metric,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_quantity) > 100 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS revenue_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_sales ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY d_sales.d_year, st.s_store_name
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(d_sales.d_year, d_return.d_year) AS year,
        CAST(cp.cp_catalog_number AS varchar) AS entity,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_amount IS NOT NULL THEN cr.cr_return_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_returns,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 0 THEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) ELSE NULL END AS profit_margin,
        CAST((
            SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount)
            FROM catalog_returns cr2
            WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS extra_metric,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 100000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS revenue_category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sales ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY COALESCE(d_sales.d_year, d_return.d_year), cp.cp_catalog_number
),
combined AS (
    SELECT year, entity, total_sales, total_returns, profit_margin, extra_metric, revenue_category
    FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year, entity, total_sales, total_returns, profit_margin, extra_metric, revenue_category
    FROM catalog_agg
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY year DESC, total_sales DESC) AS rn,
    year,
    entity,
    total_sales,
    total_returns,
    profit_margin,
    extra_metric,
    revenue_category
FROM combined
ORDER BY rn
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE rank_levels AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM rank_levels WHERE lvl < 5
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_item_id,
        CONCAT(i.i_brand, ' ', i.i_category) AS brand_category,
        regexp_extract(i.i_item_id, '[0-9]+') AS item_id_number
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_item_desc LIKE '%Premium%'
      AND regexp_like(i.i_brand, '^A.*')
),
sales_with_info AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.brand_category,
        i.item_id_number,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_email_address,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY ss.ss_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_items i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '@.*\\.edu$')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr
          WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
            AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr2
          WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
      )
)
SELECT
    sw.s_store_id,
    sw.s_store_name,
    sw.brand_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sw.c_customer_id) AS uniq_customers,
    SUM(DISTINCT sw.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sum_distinct_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sw.i_brand) AS uniq_brands,
    AVG(sw.ss_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
    sw.profit_rank,
    rl.lvl AS profit_rank_group,
    (SELECT MAX(ib_upper_bound) FROM income_band) AS max_income_upper_bound
FROM sales_with_info sw
JOIN rank_levels rl
    ON sw.profit_rank <= rl.lvl * 10
GROUP BY
    sw.s_store_id,
    sw.s_store_name,
    sw.brand_category,
    sw.profit_rank,
    rl.lvl
ORDER BY
    sw.s_store_id,
    sw.profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series(date_sk) AS (
    SELECT MIN(sr_returned_date_sk)
    FROM store_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_series
    WHERE date_sk < (SELECT MAX(sr_returned_date_sk) FROM store_returns)
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ds.date_sk,
        'Store' AS source,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 1000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 500 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS amount_category
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ds.date_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    GROUP BY ds.date_sk
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ds.date_sk,
        'Catalog' AS source,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_qty,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 1000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 500 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS amount_category
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ds.date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    GROUP BY ds.date_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM catalog_agg
)
SELECT
    date_sk,
    source,
    total_qty,
    total_amount,
    amount_category
FROM combined
ORDER BY date_sk DESC, source

WITH RECURSIVE year_hierarchy AS (
       SELECT 1998 AS yr
       UNION ALL
       SELECT yr + 1 FROM year_hierarchy WHERE yr < 2005
   ),
   catalog_part AS (
       SELECT
           cs.cs_order_number AS order_id,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           cc.cc_name AS entity_name,
           ARRAY[CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS decimal(7,2)), cs.cs_ext_sales_price] AS metrics_arr,
           cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid,
           d.d_year,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY cs.cs_ext_sales_price DESC) AS sales_rank
       FROM catalog_sales cs
       FULL OUTER JOIN call_center cc
           ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
       LEFT JOIN date_dim d
           ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       WHERE (cc.cc_state = 'CA' OR cc.cc_state IS NULL)
   ),
   web_part AS (
       SELECT
           ws.ws_order_number AS order_id,
           ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           we.web_name AS entity_name,
           ARRAY[CAST(ws.ws_quantity AS decimal(7,2)), ws.ws_ext_sales_price] AS metrics_arr,
           ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid,
           d.d_year,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY ws.ws_ext_sales_price DESC) AS sales_rank
       FROM web_sales ws
       FULL OUTER JOIN web_site we
           ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
       LEFT JOIN date_dim d
           ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       WHERE (we.web_state = 'CA' OR we.web_state IS NULL)
   ),
   combined AS (
       SELECT
           order_id,
           date_sk,
           entity_name,
           metrics_arr,
           net_paid,
           d_year,
           sales_rank
       FROM catalog_part
       UNION ALL
       SELECT
           order_id,
           date_sk,
           entity_name,
           metrics_arr,
           net_paid,
           d_year,
           sales_rank
       FROM web_part
   ),
   expanded AS (
       SELECT
           c.order_id,
           c.date_sk,
           c.entity_name,
           c.d_year,
           c.net_paid,
           v.value AS metric_value,
           c.sales_rank
       FROM combined c
       CROSS JOIN UNNEST(c.metrics_arr) AS t (value)
   ),
   aggregated AS (
       SELECT
           d_year,
           entity_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
           SUM(metric_value) AS total_metric,
           SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           MAX(sales_rank) AS max_sales_rank
       FROM expanded
       GROUP BY d_year, entity_name
       HAVING SUM(metric_value) > 10000
   )
SELECT
   a.d_year,
   a.entity_name,
   a.order_cnt,
   a.total_metric,
   a.total_net_paid,
   a.max_sales_rank,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_metric DESC) AS overall_rank
FROM aggregated a
LEFT JOIN year_hierarchy y
   ON a.d_year = y.yr
ORDER BY a.total_metric DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS level
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, level + 1
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN date_hierarchy dh ON d2.d_date_sk = dh.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-10'
),
inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_item_sk
),
-- items sold but never returned
sold_not_returned AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM store_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT DISTINCT wr_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM web_returns
),
-- customers who both purchased and returned
customers_both AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT wr_returning_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
    FROM web_returns
),
-- base fact table with all required dimensions
sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        t.t_hour,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_product_name,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        p.p_channel_press,
        p.p_discount_active,
        cc.cc_market_manager,
        cp.cp_department,
        wp.wp_type,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        ia.total_quantity_on_hand,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk

/* goal: Analyze total return amounts and store credit by state and return reason, applying address, store‑credit, return‑amount and date filters, using a full outer join, a lateral reason lookup, distinct subquery, and grouping with CUBE */
WITH filtered_sr AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_store_credit,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_addr_sk,
        sr.sr_reason_sk,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        ca.ca_street_type,
        ca.ca_suite_number,
        ca.ca_address_sk
    FROM
        tpcds.store_returns AS sr
        FULL OUTER JOIN tpcds.customer_address AS ca
            ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE
        ca.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND ca.ca_city = 'San Francisco'
        AND ca.ca_street_type IN ('Ave', 'Pkwy', 'RD')
        AND sr.sr_store_credit > 500.00
        AND sr.sr_return_amt BETWEEN 100.00 AND 2000.00
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2451587 AND 2452406
        AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT r_reason_sk
            FROM tpcds.reason
            WHERE r_reason_desc LIKE '%Did not%'
        )
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    r_desc,
    SUM(sr_return_amt)                         AS total_return_amt,
    AVG(sr_store_credit)                       AS avg_store_credit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sr_ticket_number)           AS distinct_tickets,
    MIN(sr_return_quantity)                    AS min_qty,
    MAX(sr_return_quantity)                    AS max_qty,
    (
        SELECT AVG(sr2.sr_return_amt)
        FROM tpcds.store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_addr_sk = filtered_sr.ca_address_sk
    )                                            AS avg_return_amt_per_address
FROM
    filtered_sr
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT r_reason_desc AS r_desc
        FROM tpcds.reason r
        WHERE r.r_reason_sk = filtered_sr.sr_reason_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS r_l
GROUP BY
    CUBE (ca_state, r_desc)
HAVING
    SUM(sr_return_amt) > 1000
ORDER BY
    total_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100
