    combined.product_name,
    combined.total_quantity,
    combined.total_sales,
    combined.total_quantity_all_dates,
    combined.has_return
FROM (
    SELECT
        dr.d_date AS event_date,
        'sale' AS event_type,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        (
            SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_quantity)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        ) AS total_quantity_all_dates,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr
            WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
              AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS has_return
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 0
    GROUP BY dr.d_date, ss.ss_item_sk, i.i_product_name, dr.d_date_sk

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        dr.d_date AS event_date,
        'return' AS event_type,
        sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_sales,
        (
            SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_quantity)
            FROM store_returns sr2
            WHERE sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        ) AS total_quantity_all_dates,
        'Y' AS has_return
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    GROUP BY dr.d_date, sr.sr_item_sk, i.i_product_name, dr.d_date_sk
) combined
ORDER BY combined.event_date DESC, combined.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH cr_base AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_catalog_page_sk,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 100.00
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
)
SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    cp.cp_department,
    td.t_hour,
    cd.cd_gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr_base.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cr_base.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    AVG(cr_base.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty,
    MIN(cr_base.cr_return_tax) AS min_return_tax,
    MAX(cr_base.cr_return_tax) AS max_return_tax,
    (SELECT AVG(wr2.wr_return_amt)
     FROM web_returns wr2
     WHERE wr2.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk) AS avg_web_return_by_reason
FROM cr_base
JOIN time_dim td ON cr_base.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN call_center cc ON cr_base.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr_base.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cr_base.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN reason r ON cr_base.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr_base.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    AND wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
  AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
  AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = cr_base.cr_order_number
          AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 50.00
    )
GROUP BY
    cc.cc_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    cp.cp_department,
    td.t_hour,
    cd.cd_gender
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_color,
        i.i_manufact_id,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        cp.cp_department,
        w.w_city,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_color = 'red'
      AND w.w_city = 'Pine Grove'
      AND i.i_manufact_id = 214
)
SELECT
    agg.cs_sold_date_sk,
    agg.i_item_id,
    agg.i_product_name,
    agg.i_color,
    agg.i_manufact_id,
    agg.cc_name,
    agg.cp_department,
    agg.w_city,
    agg.ca_state,
    agg.total_sales,
    agg.avg_profit,
    agg.order_cnt,
    agg.min_sale,
    agg.max_sale,
    agg.promo_cost,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.w_city ORDER BY agg.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_city
FROM (
    SELECT
        bs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        bs.i_item_id,
        bs.i_product_name,
        bs.i_color,
        bs.i_manufact_id,
        bs.cc_name,
        bs.cp_department,
        bs.w_city,
        bs.ca_state,
        SUM(bs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(bs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        MIN(bs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS min_sale,
        MAX(bs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_sale,
        (SELECT p.p_cost
         FROM promotion p
         WHERE p.p_promo_sk = bs.cs_promo_sk
           AND p.p_item_sk = bs.cs_item_sk
           AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
         LIMIT 1) AS promo_cost
    FROM base_sales bs
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = bs.cs_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost > 30
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_promo_sk = bs.cs_promo_sk
          AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
    GROUP BY
        bs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        bs.i_item_id,
        bs.i_product_name,
        bs.i_color,
        bs.i_manufact_id,
        bs.cc_name,
        bs.cp_department,
        bs.w_city,
        bs.ca_state
) agg
ORDER BY agg.total_sales DESC, agg.cs_sold_date_sk
LIMIT 100

WITH special_pages AS (
   SELECT DISTINCT
       cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
       cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
       cp.cp_start_date_sk,
       cp.cp_description
   FROM catalog_page cp
   WHERE regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)special')
)
SELECT
   d.d_year,
   d.d_month_seq AS month_seq,
   CONCAT('Band ', ib.ib_lower_bound, '-', ib.ib_upper_bound) AS income_band,
   COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
   SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
   SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
   CASE
       WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) < 1000 THEN 'Low'
       WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
       ELSE 'High'
   END AS net_loss_category,
   COUNT(DISTINCT REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.c_email_address, '@([^@]+)$')) AS distinct_email_domains,
   COUNT(DISTINCT sp.cp_catalog_page_id) AS distinct_special_pages
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
LEFT JOIN special_pages sp ON sp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE
   d.d_year = 2001
   AND t.t_sub_shift = 'morning'
   AND c.c_last_name LIKE 'S%'
   AND regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '^[^@]+@example\\.com$')
GROUP BY
   d.d_year,
   d.d_month_seq,
   ib.ib_lower_bound,
   ib.ib_upper_bound
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        i.i_brand,
        ca.ca_state,
        w.w_city,
        w.w_state,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ARRAY[w.w_city, w.w_state] AS loc_parts
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
      AND w.w_state = 'TX'
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk IN (10, 20)
      AND ca.ca_state = 'TX'
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    w_city,
    location_part,
    CASE WHEN i_brand = 'Brand#1' THEN 'Preferred' ELSE 'Other' END AS brand_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    MIN(ss_net_paid) AS min_paid,
    MAX(ss_net_paid) AS max_paid
FROM joined_data
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(loc_parts) AS t (location_part)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (
    ca_state,
    w_city,
    location_part,
    CASE WHEN i_brand = 'Brand#1' THEN 'Preferred' ELSE 'Other' END
)
ORDER BY ca_state, w_city, location_part
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year
    FROM months m
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = m.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2022-03-31'
)
SELECT
    yr,
    mn,
    typ,
    total_amount,
    distinct_items
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.d_year AS yr,
        month(m.d_date) AS mn,
        'Web Sales' AS typ,
        sum(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_amount,
        (
            SELECT count(DISTINCT ws2.ws_item_sk)
            FROM web_sales ws2
            WHERE ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = m.d_date_sk
        ) AS distinct_items
    FROM months m
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = m.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    WHERE wsit.web_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY m.d_year, month(m.d_date), m.d_date_sk
    HAVING sum(ws.ws_net_paid) > 10000

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        m.d_year AS yr,
        month(m.d_date) AS mn,
        'Catalog Returns' AS typ,
        sum(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_amount,
        (
            SELECT count(DISTINCT cr2.cr_item_sk)
            FROM catalog_returns cr2
            WHERE cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = m.d_date_sk
        ) AS distinct_items
    FROM months m
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = m.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'TX'
    GROUP BY m.d_year, month(m.d_date), m.d_date_sk
    HAVING sum(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000
) combined
ORDER BY yr, mn, typ
LIMIT 100

WITH date_union AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_fy_quarter_seq = 14
    UNION
    SELECT inv_date_sk
    FROM inventory
    WHERE inv_warehouse_sk = 10
),

 daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_fy_quarter_seq,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS daily_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_current_week = 'N'
      AND ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost > 200
      AND (i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 300 OR i.inv_quantity_on_hand IS NULL)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM date_union du WHERE du.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk)
    GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_fy_quarter_seq, d.d_date
),

 quarterly_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ds.d_fy_quarter_seq,
        AVG(ds.daily_net_profit) AS avg_daily_net_profit,
        SUM(ds.daily_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
    FROM daily_sales ds
    GROUP BY ds.d_fy_quarter_seq
)
SELECT
    qa.d_fy_quarter_seq,
    qa.avg_daily_net_profit,
    qa.total_quantity_sold,
    (
        SELECT SUM(i2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory i2
        INNER JOIN date_dim d2
            ON i2.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_fy_quarter_seq = qa.d_fy_quarter_seq
    ) AS total_inventory_in_quarter
FROM quarterly_agg qa
WHERE qa.total_quantity_sold > 1000
ORDER BY qa.avg_daily_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class_id,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cd_ref.cd_gender,
        hd_ref.hd_income_band_sk,
        p.p_promo_name AS p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        s.s_store_name,
        w.web_name,
        inv_lat.total_on_hand,
        CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_net_profit ELSE 0 END AS profit_if_discounted
    FROM call_center cc
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_return
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site w
        ON w.web_open_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT sum(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    ) AS inv_lat
    WHERE
        d_sold.d_year = 1999
        AND i.i_class_id IN (4, 9)
        AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND w.web_country = 'USA'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        sold_year,
        sum(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        sum(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        sum(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        sum(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        count(DISTINCT p_promo_name) AS distinct_promo_count,
        sum(total_on_hand) AS total_on_hand,
        sum(profit_if_discounted) AS total_discounted_profit
    FROM base
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (i_category, sold_year),
        (i_category),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    sold_year,
    total_net_profit,
    total_net_paid,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    distinct_promo_count,
    total_on_hand,
    total_discounted_profit,
    sum(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sold_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_net_profit,
    lag(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sold_year) AS prior_year_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN GROUPING(i_category) = 1 THEN 'All Categories'
        WHEN GROUPING(sold_year) = 1 THEN concat(i_category, ' Total')
        ELSE concat(i_category, ' ', sold_year)
    END AS group_label
FROM agg
ORDER BY i_category NULLS LAST, sold_year NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  dd.d_date,
  w.w_warehouse_name,
  hd_refunded.hd_income_band_sk,
  SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
  SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
  AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
  (
    SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
      AND cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  ) AS avg_return_amount_same_warehouse_date,
  ws_open.web_name AS open_site_name,
  ws_close.web_name AS close_site_name
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN date_dim dd
  ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded
  ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_returning
  ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN income_band ib_refunded
  ON hd_refunded.hd_income_band_sk = ib_refunded.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN income_band ib_returning
  ON hd_returning.hd_income_band_sk = ib_returning.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site ws_open
  ON ws_open.web_open_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws_close
  ON ws_close.web_close_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
GROUP BY
  dd.d_date,
  w.w_warehouse_name,
  hd_refunded.hd_income_band_sk,
  ws_open.web_name,
  ws_close.web_name
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        D.d_year,
        D.d_month_seq,
        D.d_moy,
        D.d_dom,
        CP.cp_department,
        CP.cp_catalog_page_number,
        HD.hd_buy_potential,
        WS.web_name,
        WP.wp_web_page_id,
        SUM(SS.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(CR.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_returns,
        COUNT(DISTINCT SS.ss_ticket_number) AS order_count,
        CASE WHEN WS.web_open_date_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS site_status,
        (
            SELECT MAX(s3.ss_net_paid)
            FROM store_sales s3
            WHERE s3.ss_sold_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
        ) AS max_daily_net_paid
    FROM store_sales SS
    JOIN date_dim D ON SS.ss_sold_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics HD ON SS.ss_hdemo_sk = HD.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns CR ON CR.cr_returned_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page CP ON CR.cr_catalog_page_sk = CP.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page WP ON WP.wp_access_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site WS ON WS.web_open_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
    WHERE D.d_moy = 4
      AND D.d_dom = 14
      AND CP.cp_catalog_page_number IN (3, 7)
      AND WP.wp_web_page_id = 'AAAAAAAAMBAAAAAA'
      AND WS.web_state = 'CA'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_returns cr2
          WHERE cr2.cr_returned_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
            AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 0
      )
    GROUP BY
        D.d_year,
        D.d_month_seq,
        D.d_moy,
        D.d_dom,
        CP.cp_department,
        CP.cp_catalog_page_number,
        HD.hd_buy_potential,
        WS.web_name,
        WP.wp_web_page_id,
        WS.web_open_date_sk
)
SELECT
    u.d_year,
    u.d_month_seq,
    u.d_moy,
    u.d_dom,
    u.cp_department,
    u.cp_catalog_page_number,
    u.hd_buy_potential,
    u.web_name,
    u.wp_web_page_id,
    u.total_sales,
    u.total_returns,
    u.order_count,
    u.site_status,
    u.max_daily_net_paid
FROM (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        d_moy,
        d_dom,
        cp_department,
        cp_catalog_page_number,
        hd_buy_potential,
        web_name,
        wp_web_page_id,
        total_sales,
        total_returns,
        order_count,
        site_status,
        max_daily_net_paid
    FROM base
    WHERE total_sales > 1000
    UNION
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        d_moy,
        d_dom,
        cp_department,
        cp_catalog_page_number,
        hd_buy_potential,
        web_name,
        wp_web_page_id,
        total_sales,
        total_returns,
        order_count,
        site_status,
        max_daily_net_paid
    FROM base
    WHERE total_returns > 0
) AS u
ORDER BY u.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Analyze net sales and promotional costs per store for items whose product name matches a specific pattern and whose brand starts with 'A'. The query classifies stores into high‑sales or low‑sales categories, applies string processing, uses a recursive CTE, combines sales and promotion data with a UNION ALL, aggregates, filters with HAVING, and returns the top results.
*/
WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
),

sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '[A-Z][0-9]{3}')
      AND i.i_brand LIKE 'A%'
),

promo_base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        p.p_cost,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE regexp_extract(i.i_product_name, '^([A-Z]{3})', 1) = 'PRO'
      AND i.i_category LIKE '%Electronics%'
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        SUM(sb.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(sb.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM sales_base sb
    JOIN "store" s
        ON sb.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_name
),

promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        SUM(pb.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost
    FROM promo_base pb
    JOIN "store" s
        ON pb.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_name
),

combined AS (
    SELECT
        store_name,
        'sales' AS metric_type,
        total_sales AS metric_value
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        store_name,
        'promo' AS metric_type,
        total_promo_cost AS metric_value
    FROM promo_agg
)
SELECT
    c.store_name,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.metric_type = 'sales' THEN c.metric_value ELSE 0 END) > 100000 THEN 'High Sales' ELSE 'Low Sales' END AS sales_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.metric_type = 'sales' THEN c.metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.metric_type = 'promo' THEN c.metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS total_promo_cost,
    COUNT(*) AS metric_rows,
    CONCAT(
        SUBSTRING(c.store_name FROM 1 FOR 3),
        '-',
        CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.metric_type = 'sales' THEN c.metric_value ELSE 0 END) > 100000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END
    ) AS store_label
FROM combined c
WHERE c.metric_value > (SELECT MIN(n) FROM seq) * 10000
GROUP BY c.store_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN c.metric_type = 'sales' THEN c.metric_value ELSE 0 END) > 50000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc AS i_item_desc,
        i.i_brand AS i_brand,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        p.p_promo_name AS p_promo_name,
        p.p_channel_details AS p_channel_details,
        d.d_year AS d_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        CASE WHEN regexp_like(p.p_channel_details, 'common|new') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_common_new,
        regexp_extract(p.p_channel_details, '(\\w+)', 1) AS first_word,
        concat(i.i_brand, '-', i.i_category) AS brand_category,
        concat(p.p_promo_name, '-', regexp_extract(p.p_channel_details, '(\\w+)', 1)) AS promo_label
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND i.i_item_desc LIKE '%toy%'
      AND regexp_like(p.p_channel_details, 'common|new')
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_channel_details,
        d.d_year
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    s.i_item_id,
    s.i_item_desc,
    s.p_promo_name,
    s.total_net_paid,
    s.total_quantity,
    s.brand_category,
    s.promo_label,
    s.has_common_new,
    s.first_word,
    (SELECT avg(ss2.ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales ss2) AS avg_global_net_paid
FROM sales_agg s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = s.item_sk
      AND r.r_reason_desc ILIKE '%price%'
)
ORDER BY s.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax,
        AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_quantity_on_hand,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM tpcds.store_returns sr
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
        ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM tpcds.inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk IN (5, 12, 16)
          AND inv.inv_item_sk IN (2, 14, 22)
    ) inv
    WHERE sr.sr_return_tax > 5.00
      AND sr.sr_return_amt > 100.00
      AND d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY', 'WA')
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (ca.ca_state, d.d_year)
),

filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        d_year,
        total_return_amt,
        total_return_tax,
        avg_quantity_on_hand,
        return_cnt
    FROM base_returns
    WHERE return_cnt > 10
),

base_returns_2 AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_fee) AS total_fee,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM tpcds.store_returns sr
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_address ca
        ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM tpcds.inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) inv
    WHERE sr.sr_fee > 10.00
      AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 1
      AND d.d_month_seq >= 1200
      AND ca.ca_zip LIKE '9%'
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ca.ca_state, d.d_year), (ca.ca_state), (d.d_year))
),

combined AS (
    SELECT ca_state, d_year, total_return_amt, total_return_tax, avg_quantity_on_hand, return_cnt, NULL AS total_fee
    FROM filtered_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca_state, d_year, total_return_amt, NULL AS total_return_tax, NULL AS avg_quantity_on_hand, return_cnt, total_fee
    FROM base_returns_2
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    d_year,
    SUM(total_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt,
    SUM(total_return_tax) AS sum_return_tax,
    AVG(avg_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_quantity_on_hand,
    SUM(return_cnt) AS total_return_cnt,
    SUM(total_fee) AS total_fee
FROM combined
GROUP BY ROLLUP (ca_state, d_year)
HAVING SUM(total_return_cnt) > 0
ORDER BY ca_state, d_year
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE rank_levels AS (
        SELECT 1 AS rank_level
        UNION ALL
        SELECT rank_level + 1 FROM rank_levels WHERE rank_level < 5
    ),
    sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            i.i_item_id,
            ws.ws_item_sk,
            s.web_site_id,
            COALESCE(w.w_warehouse_id, 'UNKNOWN') AS warehouse_id,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
            SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
            AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
        FROM web_sales ws
        LEFT JOIN warehouse w
            ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN item i
            ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN web_site s
            ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
        WHERE s.web_company_id IN (3, 4, 6)
          AND s.web_rec_end_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-01' AND DATE '2000-12-31'
          AND i.i_current_price > 50.00
          AND w.w_country = 'United States'
          AND ws.ws_quantity > 2
          AND ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost > 500.00
        GROUP BY i.i_item_id,
                 ws.ws_item_sk,
                 s.web_site_id,
                 COALESCE(w.w_warehouse_id, 'UNKNOWN')
        HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) > 1000
    ),
    ranked_sales AS (
        SELECT
            sa.*, 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.web_site_id ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank
        FROM sales_agg sa
    )
SELECT DISTINCT
    rs.i_item_id,
    rs.web_site_id,
    rs.warehouse_id,
    rs.total_net_paid,
    rs.total_quantity,
    rs.avg_sales_price,
    rs.sales_rank,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_sales_price)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = rs.ws_item_sk
    ) AS max_sales_price,
    CASE WHEN rs.total_quantity > 100 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS quantity_category
FROM ranked_sales rs
JOIN rank_levels rl
    ON rs.sales_rank = rl.rank_level
ORDER BY rs.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_current_price,
        i.i_rec_start_date,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cp.cp_department,
        p.p_discount_active,
        sm.sm_type,
        w.w_state,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        ss.ss_quantity AS ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_ext_list_price AS ss_ext_list_price,
        ws.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        wp.wp_type,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    FROM item i
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ca_bill.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_bill_addr_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ca_ship.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_ship_addr_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
        AND cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
        AND ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
        AND ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
        AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_current_price > 50.00
        AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
        AND i.i_rec_start_date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND ca_bill.ca_state = 'TX'
        AND ca_ship.ca_state = 'TX'
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    GROUPING(i_category) AS g_category,
    GROUPING(i_brand) AS g_brand,
    SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
    SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_web_net_paid,
    AVG(i_current_price) AS avg_current_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS distinct_catalog_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS distinct_web_orders,
    MIN(cs_ext_sales_price) AS min_ext_sales_price,
    MAX(cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_ext_sales_price
FROM base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (i_category, i_brand),
    (i_category),
    (i_brand),
    ()
)
HAVING SUM(cs_net_profit) > 1000
ORDER BY i_category, i_brand
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year, d_quarter_name, d_day_name
    FROM tpcds.date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year, d2.d_quarter_name, d2.d_day_name
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date = dr.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-31'
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ss.ss_store_sk) AS store_ids_array,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_web_pages,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cc_name) AS distinct_call_centers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.web_site_id) AS distinct_web_sites
    FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON dr.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE i.i_class_id IN (6, 14, 2)
      AND i.i_units = 'Pound'
      AND d.d_day_name = 'Friday'
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, w.w_warehouse_id
),
item_filter AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM sales_agg WHERE total_quantity_sold > 1000
    INTERSECT
    SELECT i_item_sk FROM sales_agg WHERE total_net_paid > 50000
)
SELECT
    sa.i_item_sk,
    sa.i_product_name,
    sa.w_warehouse_id,
    sa.total_quantity_sold,
    sa.total_net_paid,
    sa.avg_sales_price,
    sa.total_inventory_on_hand,
    sa.total_return_amount,
    sa.total_return_tax,
    sa.distinct_web_pages,
    sa.distinct_call_centers,
    sa.distinct_web_sites,
    store_id
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN item_filter f ON sa.i_item_sk = f.i_item_sk
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sa.store_ids_array) AS t(store_id)
ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
active_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_id, c.c_customer_sk
    FROM tpcds.customer c
    JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_id, c.c_customer_sk
    FROM tpcds.customer c
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
store_ret AS (
    SELECT
        ac.c_customer_id,
        'store' AS return_source,
        ARRAY['return_amt', 'return_tax', 'return_ship_cost'] AS metric_names,
        ARRAY[
            sr.sr_return_amt,
            sr.sr_return_tax,
            sr.sr_return_ship_cost
        ] AS metric_values,
        ac.c_customer_sk,
        NULL AS call_center_name
    FROM tpcds.store_returns sr
    JOIN active_customers ac ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ac.c_customer_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 100
),
catalog_ret AS (
    SELECT
        ac.c_customer_id,
        'catalog' AS return_source,
        ARRAY['return_amount', 'return_tax', 'return_ship_cost'] AS metric_names,
        ARRAY[
            cr.cr_return_amount,
            cr.cr_return_tax,
            cr.cr_return_ship_cost
        ] AS metric_values,
        ac.c_customer_sk,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name
    FROM tpcds.catalog_returns cr
    JOIN active_customers ac ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = ac.c_customer_sk
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 100
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
),
union_ret AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        return_source,
        metric_names,
        metric_values,
        c_customer_sk,
        call_center_name
    FROM store_ret
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        return_source,
        metric_names,
        metric_values,
        c_customer_sk,
        call_center_name
    FROM catalog_ret
)
SELECT
    ur.c_customer_id,
    ur.return_source,
    m.metric AS metric,
    SUM(m.value) AS total_metric_value,
    CASE WHEN SUM(m.value) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS metric_level,
    (SELECT SUM(cr2.cr_net_loss)
        FROM tpcds.catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_refunded_customer_sk = ur.c_customer_sk) AS total_catalog_net_loss
FROM union_ret ur
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ur.metric_names, ur.metric_values) AS m(metric, value)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (ur.c_customer_id, ur.return_source, m.metric)
ORDER BY ur.c_customer_id, ur.return_source, m.metric
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM tpcds.store_sales) AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < (SELECT MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM tpcds.store_sales)
),
eligible_stores AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.s_store_sk,
           s.s_store_name,
           s.s_manager,
           CONCAT(s.s_city, ', ', s.s_state) AS store_location
    FROM tpcds.store s
    WHERE s.s_manager LIKE 'M%'
),
sales_items AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk,
           ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_quantity,
           ss.ss_net_profit,
           i.i_item_desc,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(i.i_item_desc, '(\\d{3})') AS extracted_code
    FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
    JOIN tpcds.item i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.date_sk
    WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '\\d{3}')
)
SELECT
    es.s_store_name,
    es.store_location,
    si.extracted_code,
    SUM(si.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(si.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
FROM sales_items si
JOIN eligible_stores es
  ON si.ss_store_sk = es.s_store_sk
GROUP BY
    es.s_store_name,
    es.store_location,
    si.extracted_code
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d_sales.d_date,
        d_sales.d_year,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_state,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity
    FROM tpcds.store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_sales
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_return
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.warehouse w
        ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
        AND cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.date_dim d_closed
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d_sales.d_year = 2002
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 500
        AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0
        AND d_sales.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', b.d_date) AS month,
        b.s_store_id,
        SUM(b.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(b.sr_return_amt) AS total_returns,
        SUM(b.ss_net_profit) - SUM(b.sr_return_amt) AS net_profit
    FROM base b
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(DATE_TRUNC('month', b.d_date), b.s_store_id)
    HAVING SUM(b.ss_ext_sales_price) > 10000
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    month,
    s_store_id,
    total_sales,
    total_returns,
    net_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM agg
ORDER BY month DESC, sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE rec_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year, d_month_seq, 1 AS seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year, d2.d_month_seq, r.seq + 1
    FROM rec_dates r
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = r.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE r.seq < 30
),
union_returns AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_ship_cost,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        CASE
            WHEN wr.wr_return_amt > 200 THEN 'High'
            WHEN wr.wr_return_amt > 100 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS amount_category
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN rec_dates r ON d.d_date_sk = r.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating IN ('Low Risk', 'Good')
      AND wr.wr_return_amt > 100
      AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost > 50
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM web_page wp
          WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
            AND wp.wp_type = 'Product'
      )
    UNION
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_ship_cost,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        CASE
            WHEN wr.wr_return_amt > 200 THEN 'High'
            WHEN wr.wr_return_amt > 100 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS amount_category
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN rec_dates r ON d.d_date_sk = r.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Low Risk'
      AND wr.wr_return_amt <= 100
      AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost <= 50
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'N'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM web_page wp
          WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
            AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
      )
),
agg_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ur.customer_sk,
        ur.d_year,
        ur.d_month_seq,
        SUM(ur.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(ur.wr_return_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        MIN(ur.amount_category) AS min_amount_category,
        MAX(ur.amount_category) AS max_amount_category
    FROM union_returns ur
    GROUP BY ur.customer_sk, ur.d_year, ur.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    a.customer_sk,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    a.d_year,
    a.d_month_seq,
    a.total_return_amt,
    a.total_ship_cost,
    a.return_cnt,
    a.min_amount_category,
    a.max_amount_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_year, a.d_month_seq ORDER BY a.total_return_amt DESC) AS customer_month_rank
FROM agg_returns a
JOIN customer c ON a.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE a.total_return_amt > 0
ORDER BY a.d_year, a.d_month_seq, customer_month_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH intersected_promos AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_cost < 1000
    INTERSECT
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
),
unioned_reasons AS (
    SELECT r.r_reason_sk
    FROM reason r
    WHERE r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Defect%'
    UNION
    SELECT r.r_reason_sk
    FROM reason r
    WHERE r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%Customer%'
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    i.i_brand,
    p.p_promo_name,
    CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_channel,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale_cost,
    MIN(ss.ss_net_paid) AS min_net_paid,
    MAX(ss.ss_net_paid) AS max_net_paid,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) AS item_date_sales
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
INNER JOIN call_center c
    ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN web_site w
    ON w.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
INNER JOIN reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE
    d.d_year = 2002
    AND i.i_manufact_id IN (338, 86, 220)
    AND i.i_wholesale_cost > 10
    AND p.p_cost < 5000
    AND c.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND w.web_country = 'United States'
    AND wr.wr_return_ship_cost > 100
    AND p.p_promo_sk IN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM intersected_promos)
    AND r.r_reason_sk IN (SELECT r_reason_sk FROM unioned_reasons)
    AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > (
        SELECT AVG(ss3.ss_ext_sales_price)
        FROM store_sales ss3
        WHERE ss3.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    )
GROUP BY
    d.d_year,
    i.i_brand,
    p.p_promo_name,
    CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' ELSE 'Other' END,
    r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_class AS i_class,
        w.w_state AS state,
        p.p_purpose AS purpose,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS quantity_sold,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_list_price > 100
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
      AND p.p_end_date_sk > 2450300
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_class, w.w_state, p.p_purpose
),
ws_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_class AS i_class,
        w.w_state AS state,
        p.p_purpose AS purpose,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS quantity_sold,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price > 30
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 20
      AND ws.ws_ext_ship_cost > 500
      AND wp.wp_type = 'product'
      AND p.p_end_date_sk > 2450300
    GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_class, w.w_state, p.p_purpose
),
union_sales AS (
    SELECT category,
           i_class,
           state,
           purpose,
           sales_amount,
           quantity_sold,
           profit,
           order_cnt
    FROM cs_agg
    UNION
    SELECT category,
           i_class,
           state,
           purpose,
           sales_amount,
           quantity_sold,
           profit,
           order_cnt
    FROM ws_agg
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        i_class,
        state,
        purpose,
        SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales,
        SUM(quantity_sold) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(order_cnt) AS total_orders
    FROM union_sales
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (category, i_class, state, purpose),
        (category, i_class, state),
        (category, i_class),
        (category),
        ()
    )
    HAVING SUM(profit) > 5000
)
SELECT
    fa.category,
    fa.i_class,
    fa.state,
    fa.purpose,
    fa.total_sales,
    fa.total_quantity,
    fa.total_profit,
    fa.total_orders,
    (SELECT MAX(cs.cs_list_price)
     FROM catalog_sales cs
     JOIN item i2 ON cs.cs_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
     WHERE i2.i_category = fa.category
       AND i2.i_class = fa.i_class) AS max_item_list_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fa.category ORDER BY fa.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM final_agg fa
ORDER BY fa.total_profit DESC, profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_base AS (
  SELECT
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_quantity,
    cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
    cs.cs_net_paid,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    cc.cc_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_product_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
    d_sold.d_month_seq,
    d_ship.d_year AS ship_year,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_market_id,
    t.t_hour,
    wr.wr_return_amt,
    wr.wr_fee,
    wsite.web_name,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active_flag,
    promo_l.discount_active
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN time_dim t
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
  JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
  JOIN store s
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ret
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_site wsite
    ON wsite.web_open_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p2.p_discount_active
    FROM promotion p2
    WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND p2.p_start_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS promo_l (discount_active)
)
SELECT
  sold_year,
  d_month_seq,
  s_market_id,
  i_brand,
  i_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS num_orders,
  SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
  SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
  SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
  SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 1 END) AS profit_order_cnt,
  AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_hand,
  MAX(discount_active) AS latest_promo_discount_active,
  CASE WHEN SUM(cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Overall Profit' ELSE 'Overall Loss' END AS overall_profit_status,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs_net_paid) DESC) AS rn
FROM sales_base
GROUP BY sold_year, d_month_seq, s_market_id, i_brand, i_category
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sampled_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number        AS order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0
),

catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(ss.cs_net_paid)            AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ss.cs_net_profit)          AS avg_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.order_number) AS num_orders
    FROM sampled_sales ss
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
),

web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid)            AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ws.ws_net_profit)          AS avg_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS num_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
),

full_sales AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ca.c_customer_sk, wa.c_customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(ca.c_first_name, wa.c_first_name)   AS first_name,
        COALESCE(ca.c_last_name, wa.c_last_name)    AS last_name,
        ca.total_net_paid                           AS catalog_total,
        wa.total_net_paid                           AS web_total,
        ca.num_orders                               AS catalog_orders,
        wa.num_orders                               AS web_orders
    FROM catalog_agg ca
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_agg wa
        ON ca.c_customer_sk = wa.c_customer_sk
),

high_catalog AS (
    SELECT
        f.customer_sk,
        f.first_name,
        f.last_name,
        f.catalog_total,
        f.catalog_orders
    FROM full_sales f
    WHERE f.catalog_total > 10000
),

high_web AS (
    SELECT
        f.customer_sk,
        f.first_name,
        f.last_name,
        f.web_total      AS catalog_total,
        f.web_orders     AS catalog_orders
    FROM full_sales f
    WHERE f.web_total > 10000
),

high_any AS (
    SELECT customer_sk, first_name, last_name, catalog_total, catalog_orders
    FROM high_catalog
    UNION
    SELECT customer_sk, first_name, last_name, catalog_total, catalog_orders
    FROM high_web
),

store_return_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 20
),

web_return_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 20
),

all_return_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_sk FROM store_return_customers
    UNION
    SELECT customer_sk FROM web_return_customers
),

final_customers AS (
    SELECT ha.customer_sk, ha.first_name, ha.last_name, ha.catalog_total, ha.catalog_orders
    FROM high_any ha
    EXCEPT
    SELECT rc.customer_sk FROM all_return_customers rc
),

final_result AS (
    SELECT
        fc.customer_sk,
        fc.first_name,
        fc.last_name,
        fc.catalog_total,
        fc.catalog_orders,
        la.last_order_date,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_promo_sk)
         FROM catalog_sales cs
         WHERE cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = fc.customer_sk) AS promo_count
    FROM final_customers fc
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(sold_date_sk) AS last_order_date
        FROM (
            SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk
            FROM catalog_sales cs
            WHERE cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = fc.customer_sk
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk
            FROM web_sales ws
            WHERE ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = fc.cust

WITH sales_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sales.d_year AS sales_year,
    COALESCE(SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_store_return_loss,
    COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS total_catalog_return_loss,
    COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS total_web_return_loss
  FROM
    store_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ss
    JOIN date_dim d_sales ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
         AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
      ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
  WHERE
    d_sales.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01'
    AND d_sales.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
    AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (
      SELECT r_reason_sk
      FROM reason
      WHERE r_reason_desc LIKE '%Damaged%'
    )
  GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sales.d_year
)
SELECT
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name,
  sales_year,
  total_sales,
  total_store_return_loss,
  total_catalog_return_loss,
  total_web_return_loss,
  (total_sales - total_store_return_loss - total_catalog_return_loss - total_web_return_loss) AS net_amount,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY sales_year
    ORDER BY (total_sales - total_store_return_loss - total_catalog_return_loss - total_web_return_loss) DESC
  ) AS sales_rank
FROM sales_aggregates
ORDER BY sales_year, sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH detailed_sales AS (
    SELECT
        C.c_customer_sk,
        C.c_customer_id,
        C.c_first_name,
        C.c_last_name,
        ST.s_store_name,
        ST.s_state,
        CP.cp_department,
        D.d_year,
        SUM(SS.ss_net_profit) AS sales_profit,
        COALESCE(SUM(SR.sr_net_loss), 0) AS returns_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(CR.cr_net_loss), 0) AS catalog_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(I.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS total_inventory_qty
    FROM store_sales SS
    JOIN date_dim D
        ON SS.ss_sold_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer C
        ON SS.ss_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address CA
        ON SS.ss_addr_sk = CA.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store ST
        ON SS.ss_store_sk = ST.s_store_sk
        AND ST.s_closed_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns SR
        ON SR.sr_ticket_number = SS.ss_ticket_number
        AND SR.sr_item_sk = SS.ss_item_sk
        AND SR.sr_returned_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
        AND SR.sr_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
        AND SR.sr_addr_sk = CA.ca_address_sk
        AND SR.sr_store_sk = ST.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns CR
        ON CR.cr_returned_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
        AND CR.cr_refunded_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
        AND CR.cr_refunded_addr_sk = CA.ca_address_sk
        AND CR.cr_returning_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
        AND CR.cr_returning_addr_sk = CA.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page CP
        ON CR.cr_catalog_page_sk = CP.cp_catalog_page_sk
        AND CP.cp_start_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse W
        ON CR.cr_warehouse_sk = W.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory I
        ON I.inv_date_sk = D.d_date_sk
        AND I.inv_warehouse_sk = W.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        D.d_year = 2001
        AND ST.s_state = 'CA'
        AND C.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1955 AND 1965
        AND CP.cp_department = 'Electronics'
        AND I.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND SS.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000
        AND SR.sr_reason_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        C.c_customer_sk,
        C.c_customer_id,
        C.c_first_name,
        C.c_last_name,
        ST.s_store_name,
        ST.s_state,
        CP.cp_department,
        D.d_year
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.c_customer_id,
    d.c_first_name,
    d.c_last_name,
    d.s_store_name,
    d.cp_department,
    d.d_year,
    (d.sales_profit - d.returns_loss - d.catalog_loss) AS net_total_profit,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (d.sales_profit - d.returns_loss - d.catalog_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM detailed_sales d
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_detail AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d_sold.d_year AS year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_cs_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_cs_qty
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
        ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, d_sold.d_year
),
ss_detail AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d_sold_ss.d_year AS year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_ss_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_ss_qty
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_sold_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sold_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c_ss
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ss
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, d_sold_ss.d_year
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        cs.customer_sk,
        cs.year,
        cs.total_cs_profit,
        ss.total_ss_profit,
        cs.total_cs_profit + ss.total_ss_profit AS combined_profit,
        cs.total_cs_qty + ss.total_ss_qty AS combined_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.year ORDER BY cs.total_cs_profit + ss.total_ss_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM cs_detail cs
    JOIN ss_detail ss
        ON cs.customer_sk = ss.customer_sk
        AND cs.year = ss.year
    WHERE cs.customer_sk IN (
        SELECT cs2.customer_sk FROM cs_detail cs2
        INTERSECT
        SELECT ss2.customer_sk FROM ss_detail ss2
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM household_demographics hd_ex
        WHERE hd_ex.hd_demo_sk = (
            SELECT c_ex.c_current_hdemo_sk FROM customer c_ex
            WHERE c_ex.c_customer_sk = cs.customer_sk
        )
        AND hd_ex.hd_vehicle_count > 3
    )
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    cd.year,
    cd.combined_profit,
    cd.combined_qty,
    cd.profit_rank
FROM combined cd
JOIN customer c
    ON cd.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE cd.year = 2001
ORDER BY cd.combined_profit DESC, cd.profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        d_sold.d_year AS d_year,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM
        store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
        JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                               AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_return ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
        JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_cs_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs_sold.d_date_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_cs_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_cs_ship.d_date_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
        JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr.cd_demo_sk
        LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr.hd_demo_sk
        LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr.ca_address_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_page wp_wr ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp_wr.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        d_sold.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
        AND i.i_brand_id IN (10, 20)
        AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
        AND cp.cp_type = 'Catalog'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        d_sold.d_year
)

SELECT
    a.c_customer_id,
    a.d_year,
    a.total_sales,
    a.total_profit,
    (
        SELECT MAX(cs_sub.cs_net_paid)
        FROM catalog_sales cs_sub
        WHERE cs_sub.cs_bill_customer_sk = a.c_customer_sk
    ) AS max_catalog_net_paid,
    l.customer_total_store_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_year ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    SUM(a.total_sales) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.d_year
        ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_sales_year
FROM aggregated_sales a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(ss_sub.ss_net_paid) AS customer_total_store_sales
    FROM store_sales ss_sub
    WHERE ss_sub.ss_customer_sk = a.c_customer_sk
) AS l
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_returns wr_chk
    WHERE wr_chk.wr_refunded_customer_sk = a.c_customer_sk
      AND wr_chk.wr_return_amt > 0
)
ORDER BY a.d_year, sales_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_division,
    cc.cc_sq_ft,
    cc.cc_rec_start_date,
    cp.cp_department,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_current_price,
    i.i_product_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_gmt_offset,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    td.t_hour,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    wr.wr_net_loss,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    ib.ib_upper_bound
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
  JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
                     AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                     AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
                     AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
                           AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                           AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                           AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE cc.cc_division IN (1, 3)
    AND cc.cc_sq_ft > 0
    AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship > 1000
    AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
    AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    AND ib.ib_upper_bound < 100000
    AND w.w_gmt_offset > 0
    AND ws.ws_quantity >= 2
    AND cc.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
),
agg_data AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN i_current_price < 100 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN i_current_price < 150 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'High'
    END AS price_category,
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_profit,
    SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit,
    SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(cs_net_profit + ws_net_profit - IFNULL(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_profit
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN i_current_price < 100 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN i_current_price < 150 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'High'
    END,
    i_category,
    i_brand
)
SELECT
  price_category,
  i_category,
  i_brand,
  total_catalog_profit,
  total_web_profit,
  total_return_loss,
  total_profit,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM agg_data
ORDER BY profit_rank, i_category, i_brand

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT d.d_date AS current_date
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_ADD('day', 1, current_date)
    FROM date_series
    WHERE current_date < DATE '1998-01-31'
),
unique_promotions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS c_customer_id,
        d_cs.d_year AS d_year,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS w_warehouse_name,
        up.p_promo_name AS p_promo_name,
        sm.sm_carrier AS sm_carrier,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_cs_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_ws_net_profit,
        inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_series ds ON d_cs.d_date = ds.current_date
    JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN promotion p_cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
    JOIN unique_promotions up ON cs.cs_promo_sk = up.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
        FROM inventory i
        WHERE i.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
          AND i.inv_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
          AND i.inv_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    ) AS inv_agg ON TRUE
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cs_ws ON d_cs.d_date = d_ws.d_date
    JOIN promotion p_ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM promotion p_check
        WHERE p_check.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
          AND p_check.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        d_cs.d_year,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        up.p_promo_name,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        inv_agg.total_qty_on_hand
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    d_year,
    w_warehouse_name,
    p_promo_name,
    sm_carrier,
    total_cs_net_profit,
    total_ws_net_profit,
    total_qty_on_hand,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_name ORDER BY total_cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY total_cs_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM seq_hierarchy WHERE lvl < 3
),
agg_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss_store_sk,
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_ticket_number,
        ss_promo_sk,
        ss_sold_time_sk,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity > 5
    GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_promo_sk, ss_sold_time_sk
),
intersect_promo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.p_promo_id
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN agg_store_sales a ON p.p_promo_sk = a.ss_promo_sk
    WHERE a.total_store_net_paid > 50000
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT p2.p_promo_id
    FROM promotion p2
    JOIN (
        SELECT cs_promo_sk, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_cat_sales_price
        FROM catalog_sales
        WHERE cs_coupon_amt > 500.00
        GROUP BY cs_promo_sk
    ) b ON p2.p_promo_sk = b.cs_promo_sk
    WHERE b.total_cat_sales_price > 80000
),
base_join AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        ts.t_hour,
        ts.t_am_pm,
        wp.wp_url,
        ss.total_store_net_paid,
        ss.total_store_net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        sr.sr_return_quantity
    FROM
        agg_store_sales ss
        JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN time_dim ts ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        JOIN time_dim tr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = tr.t_time_sk
        JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN time_dim tc ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = tc.t_time_sk
        JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        JOIN time_dim cr_t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = cr_t.t_time_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN time_dim wt ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = wt.t_time_sk
        JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
        AND ts.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND tr.t_am_pm = 'PM'
        AND wp.wp_link_count BETWEEN 5 AND 30
        AND wp.wp_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 2
        AND cr_t.t_hour = 12
        AND tc.t_meal_time = 'Lunch'
        AND wt.t_shift = 'Evening'
        AND p.p_promo_id IN (SELECT p_id FROM intersect_promo)
        AND (SELECT MAX(lvl) FROM seq_hierarchy) = 3
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        p_promo_id,
        p_promo_name,
        t_hour,
        t_am_pm,
        wp_url,
        SUM(total_store_net_paid) AS sum_store_net_paid,
        SUM(total_store_net_profit) AS sum_store_net_profit,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_catalog_sales_price,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS sum_web_sales_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr_return_quantity) AS distinct_return_qty
    FROM base_join
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (p_promo_id, p_promo_name, t_hour, t_am_pm, wp_url)
    HAVING SUM(total_store_net_paid) > 10000
)
SELECT
    p_promo_id,
    p_promo_name,
    t_hour,
    t_am_pm,
    wp_url,
    sum_store_net_paid,
    sum_store_net_profit,
    sum_catalog_sales_price,
    sum_web_sales_net_paid,
    distinct_return_qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_id ORDER BY sum_store_net_paid DESC) AS store_paid_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_paid) FROM web_sales ws2 WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = (SELECT p3.p_promo_sk FROM promotion p3 WHERE p3.p_promo_id = grouped.p_promo_id)) AS avg_ws_net_paid_per_promo,
    (SELECT MAX(lvl) FROM seq_hierarchy) AS max_hierarchy_level
FROM grouped
ORDER BY p_promo_id, t_hour NULLS LAST, wp_url
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.c_customer_id,
        'catalog' AS channel,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        (
            SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid)
            FROM catalog_sales cs2
            JOIN item i2 ON cs2.cs_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
            WHERE i2.i_manufact_id = 169
        ) AS avg_manufacturer_net_paid
    FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_manufact_id = 169
      AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr
          WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND sr.sr_net_loss > 50
      )
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.c_customer_id,
        'web' AS channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        (
            SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_paid)
            FROM web_sales ws2
            JOIN item i2 ON ws2.ws_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
            WHERE i2.i_manufact_id = 169
        ) AS avg_manufacturer_net_paid
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_manufact_id = 169
      AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '1999-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id
) AS combined
LIMIT 100

WITH first_part AS (
    SELECT
        ws_wb.web_name AS website_name,
        td.t_meal_time AS meal_time,
        SUM(ws_ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws_ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws_ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws_ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_wb ON ws_ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_wb.web_site_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws_ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM promotion p2
            WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = ws_ws.ws_promo_sk
              AND p2.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
        )
      AND td.t_meal_time = 'breakfast'
    GROUP BY ws_wb.web_name, td.t_meal_time
),
second_part AS (
    SELECT
        ws_wb.web_name AS website_name,
        td.t_meal_time AS meal_time,
        SUM(ws_ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws_ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5) AS ws_ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws_ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_wb ON ws_ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_wb.web_site_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws_ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
      AND td.t_meal_time = 'dinner'
    GROUP BY ws_wb.web_name, td.t_meal_time
)
SELECT website_name, meal_time, total_net_profit, total_quantity
FROM first_part
UNION
SELECT website_name, meal_time, total_net_profit, total_quantity
FROM second_part
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC, website_name

SELECT
  d.d_year AS year,
  i.i_category AS category,
  'store' AS source,
  SUM(ss_outer.ss_net_profit) AS amount,
  COUNT(*) AS transactions,
  CASE WHEN SUM(ss_outer.ss_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS level,
  CAST(
    (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit)
     FROM store_sales ss2
     WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS DECIMAL(7,2)
  ) AS avg_item_value
FROM store_sales ss_outer
JOIN date_dim d ON ss_outer.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ss_outer.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND p.p_start_date_sk <= ss_outer.ss_sold_date_sk
      AND p.p_end_date_sk >= ss_outer.ss_sold_date_sk
  )
GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_category

UNION ALL

SELECT
  d.d_year AS year,
  i.i_category AS category,
  'catalog' AS source,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS amount,
  COUNT(*) AS transactions,
  CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 80000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS level,
  CAST(
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
     WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS DECIMAL(7,2)
  ) AS avg_item_value
FROM catalog_sales cs
