JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022
  AND i.i_brand_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT i2.i_brand_id
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN item i2 ON p.p_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
  )
GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_category

ORDER BY year DESC, amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE last_months (month_seq, month_offset) AS (
   SELECT MAX(d_month_seq) AS month_seq, 0 AS month_offset
   FROM date_dim
   UNION ALL
   SELECT month_seq - 1, month_offset + 1
   FROM last_months
   WHERE month_offset < 11
),
return_events AS (
   SELECT
       d.d_date AS event_date,
       c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
       cr.cr_return_amount AS amount,
       cr.cr_return_tax AS tax,
       cr.cr_fee AS fee,
       'catalog_return' AS source,
       c.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
       d.d_year,
       d.d_month_seq
   FROM catalog_returns cr
   JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
   JOIN last_months lm ON d.d_month_seq = lm.month_seq
   WHERE d.d_year = 2020
),
web_events AS (
   SELECT
       d.d_date AS event_date,
       c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
       CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS tax,
       CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS fee,
       'web_page' AS source,
       c.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
       d.d_year,
       d.d_month_seq
   FROM web_page wp
   JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   JOIN last_months lm ON d.d_month_seq = lm.month_seq
   WHERE d.d_year = 2020
     AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
),
union_events AS (
   SELECT event_date, customer_id, amount, tax, fee, source, customer_sk, d_year, d_month_seq
   FROM return_events
   UNION ALL
   SELECT event_date, customer_id, amount, tax, fee, source, customer_sk, d_year, d_month_seq
   FROM web_events
)
SELECT
    ue.event_date,
    ue.customer_id,
    ue.amount,
    ue.tax,
    ue.fee,
    ue.source,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_returns cr3
        JOIN date_dim d3 ON cr3.cr_returned_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
        WHERE cr3.cr_refunded_customer_sk = ue.customer_sk
          AND d3.d_year = ue.d_year
          AND d3.d_month_seq = ue.d_month_seq
    ) AS monthly_return_count,
    CASE metric.pos
        WHEN 1 THEN 'return_amount'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'return_tax'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'return_fee'
    END AS metric_name,
    metric.val AS metric_value
FROM union_events ue
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
        ARRAY[
            COALESCE(ue.amount, CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2))),
            COALESCE(ue.tax, CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2))),
            COALESCE(ue.fee, CAST(0 AS decimal(7,2)))
        ]
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS metric(val, pos)
ORDER BY ue.event_date DESC, ue.customer_id
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hour_hierarchy (hour, level) AS (
    SELECT 0, 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT hour + 1, level + 1
    FROM hour_hierarchy
    WHERE hour < 23
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'sales' AS period_type,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_amount,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_discount_amt)
         FROM catalog_sales cs2
         JOIN time_dim td2 ON cs2.cs_sold_time_sk = td2.t_time_sk
         WHERE td2.t_hour = td.t_hour) AS avg_discount_for_hour,
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS avg_return_amount_for_hour
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 1000
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (td.t_hour, cd.cd_gender),
        (td.t_hour),
        ()
    )
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'return' AS period_type,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        cd.cd_gender AS gender,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS avg_discount_for_hour,
        (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amt_inc_tax)
         FROM catalog_returns cr2
         JOIN time_dim td2 ON cr2.cr_returned_time_sk = td2.t_time_sk
         WHERE td2.t_hour = td.t_hour) AS avg_return_amount_for_hour
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 100
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (td.t_hour, cd.cd_gender),
        (td.t_hour),
        ()
    )
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns_agg
)
SELECT
    c.period_type,
    COALESCE(hh.hour, c.hour) AS hour,
    c.gender,
    c.total_amount,
    c.total_quantity,
    c.order_cnt,
    c.avg_discount_for_hour,
    c.avg_return_amount_for_hour,
    hh.level AS hour_level
FROM combined c
LEFT JOIN hour_hierarchy hh ON c.hour = hh.hour
WHERE (c.hour IS NULL) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM time_dim td_check
    WHERE td_check.t_hour = c.hour
      AND td_check.t_meal_time = 'BREAKFAST'
)
ORDER BY c.period_type, hour, gender
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS return_year,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity,
        CONCAT(i.i_color, '-', i.i_size) AS color_size,
        SUBSTR(i.i_product_name FROM 1 FOR 10) AS product_prefix,
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(r.r_reason_desc, '(damaged|defective)', 1) AS extracted_reason,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        d.d_date
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31'
        AND REGEXP_LIKE(r.r_reason_desc, '(?i)damage|defect')
        AND s.s_store_name LIKE '%Market%'
        AND SUBSTR(s.s_city FROM 1 FOR 2) = 'NY'
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
              AND d2.d_year = d.d_year
        )
)
SELECT
    return_year,
    store_name,
    SUM(return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT color_size) AS color_variants,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT product_prefix) AS product_prefixes,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT extracted_reason) AS extracted_reasons
FROM filtered_returns
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((return_year, store_name), (return_year))
ORDER BY return_year DESC, store_name
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (
    SELECT MIN(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS date_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_series
    WHERE date_sk + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) FROM catalog_returns cr)
),

base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
        i.i_category AS category,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
        MAX(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_current_price > 100
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (cr.cr_returned_date_sk, i.i_category, ca.ca_state, hd.hd_income_band_sk)
),

filtered_agg AS (
    SELECT
        return_date_sk,
        category,
        state,
        income_band,
        total_catalog_return,
        total_store_return,
        distinct_items,
        max_quantity_on_hand
    FROM base_agg
    WHERE total_catalog_return > 1000
      AND total_store_return > 500
      AND distinct_items >= 10
),

high_quantity AS (
    SELECT
        return_date_sk,
        category,
        state,
        income_band,
        total_catalog_return,
        total_store_return,
        distinct_items,
        max_quantity_on_hand
    FROM base_agg
    WHERE max_quantity_on_hand > 5000
)

SELECT
    f.return_date_sk,
    f.category,
    f.state,
    f.income_band,
    f.total_catalog_return,
    f.total_store_return,
    f.distinct_items,
    (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = (
         SELECT i2.i_item_sk
         FROM item i2
         WHERE i2.i_category = f.category
         LIMIT 1
     )
    ) AS avg_return_amount_for_category
FROM (
    SELECT
        return_date_sk,
        category,
        state,
        income_band,
        total_catalog_return,
        total_store_return,
        distinct_items,
        max_quantity_on_hand
    FROM filtered_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        return_date_sk,
        category,
        state,
        income_band,
        total_catalog_return,
        total_store_return,
        distinct_items,
        max_quantity_on_hand
    FROM high_quantity
) AS f
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inventory inv2
    WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = (
        SELECT i3.i_item_sk
        FROM item i3
        WHERE i3.i_category = f.category
        LIMIT 1
    )
      AND inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
)
  AND f.return_date_sk IN (
      SELECT ds.date_sk
      FROM date_series ds
      WHERE ds.date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100
  )
ORDER BY f.total_catalog_return DESC
OFFSET 0
FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

WITH RECURSIVE profit_buckets AS (
    SELECT 0 AS bucket_start
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bucket_start + 1000 FROM profit_buckets WHERE bucket_start < 5000
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_id,
    w.w_city,
    w.w_state,
    concat(w.w_city, ', ', w.w_state) AS location,
    w.w_street_number,
    substring(w.w_city, 1, 3) AS city_prefix,
    regexp_extract(w.w_street_number, '\\d+', 0) AS street_number_digits,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    sm.sm_type,
    p.p_promo_name,
    pb.bucket_start,
    sum(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    sum(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    count(distinct ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    (SELECT avg(ws2.ws_net_profit)
     FROM web_sales ws2
     JOIN warehouse w2 ON ws2.ws_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
     WHERE w2.w_warehouse_id = w.w_warehouse_id) AS avg_warehouse_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '(?i)discount|sale') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_discount_promo
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN profit_buckets pb ON ws.ws_net_profit >= pb.bucket_start AND ws.ws_net_profit < pb.bucket_start + 1000
WHERE w.w_city LIKE '%York%'
  AND regexp_like(p.p_promo_name, '^.*202[0-9].*$')
GROUP BY ROLLUP (w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_city, w.w_state, w.w_street_number, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, p.p_promo_name, pb.bucket_start)
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 10
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_date_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_product_name,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca.ca_state,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        sm.sm_type,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_discount_active,
        wp.wp_type,
        d_sold.d_year,
        d_sold.d_date,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr_return ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_return.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
      AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 5 AND 10
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND wp.wp_type = 'Home'
),

customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        i_category,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_hand,
        MAX(
            CASE 
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
                    WHERE wr2.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
                      AND wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk
                ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS has_web_return,
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p_promo_id) > 0 THEN 'Promoted'
            ELSE 'Not Promoted'
        END AS promotion_status
    FROM sales_agg
    GROUP BY
        c_customer_sk,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        i_category
),

ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        i_category,
        total_net_profit,
        total_quantity_sold,
        total_return_amount,
        avg_inventory_on_hand,
        promotion_status,
        has_web_return,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC) AS quantity_rank,
        SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
                                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit
    FROM customer_metrics
),

top_category_sales AS (
    SELECT i.i_category AS i_category, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_i

WITH RECURSIVE time_seq AS (
    SELECT t.t_time_sk,
           t.t_time,
           t.t_hour,
           t.t_minute
    FROM time_dim t
    WHERE t.t_time = 2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t2.t_time_sk,
           t2.t_time,
           t2.t_hour,
           t2.t_minute
    FROM time_seq ts
    JOIN time_dim t2
        ON t2.t_time = ts.t_time + 1
    WHERE ts.t_time < 6
),
base_catalog AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_returned_time_sk AS time_sk,
           cr.cr_item_sk,
           cr.cr_return_amount,
           cr.cr_net_loss,
           cr.cr_reason_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN time_seq ts
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 30.00
),
base_store AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_return_time_sk AS time_sk,
           sr.sr_item_sk,
           sr.sr_return_amt,
           sr.sr_net_loss,
           sr.sr_reason_sk,
           sr.sr_fee
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_seq ts
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_fee < 35.00
),
full_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.time_sk,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk AS store_item_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_reason_sk AS store_reason_sk,
        sr.sr_fee
    FROM base_catalog cr
    FULL OUTER JOIN base_store sr
        ON cr.time_sk = sr.time_sk
        AND cr.cr_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
),
web_ret_sample AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk,
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_tax,
        wr.wr_reason_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    WHERE wr.wr_return_tax BETWEEN 10 AND 100
),
web_join AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk,
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_tax,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        td.t_hour
    FROM web_ret_sample wr
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN reason r
        ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim td
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        fr.time_sk,
        COALESCE(fr.cr_item_sk, fr.store_item_sk) AS item_sk,
        fr.cr_return_amount,
        fr.sr_return_amt,
        fr.cr_net_loss,
        fr.sr_net_loss,
        fr.sr_fee,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        CASE
            WHEN fr.cr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Catalog Loss'
            WHEN fr.sr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Store Loss'
            ELSE 'No Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_return_time_sk = fr.time_sk) AS store_returns_cnt,
        ws_agg.total_web_sales,
        ws_agg.total_web_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_reason_desc ORDER BY COALESCE(fr.cr_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(fr.sr_return_amt, 0) DESC) AS rn
    FROM full_returns fr
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON fr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        OR fr.store_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
            SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_profit
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = COALESCE(fr.cr_item_sk, fr.store_item_sk)
    ) AS ws_agg
    LEFT JOIN web_join wj
        ON wj.wr_returned_time_sk = fr.time_sk
    WHERE r.r_reason_desc IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    item_sk,
    loss_category,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS avg_net_loss,
    MIN(COALESCE(sr_fee, 0)) AS min_fee,
    MAX(total_web_sales) AS max_total_web_sales,
    SUM(total_web_profit) AS total_web_profit,
    MAX(rn) AS max_row_number
FROM fi

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        d_ss.d_year AS d_year,
        d_ss.d_date AS d_date,
        i.i_brand AS i_brand,
        ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax AS ss_net_paid_inc_tax,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS cs_net_paid_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS sr_return_amt,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS cr_return_amount,
        wr.wr_return_amt AS wr_return_amt,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ss.ss_quantity AS ss_quantity,
        c.c_customer_id AS c_customer_id,
        p_ss.p_channel_dmail AS p_channel_dmail
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_ss.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cs_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cs_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_cs_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p_cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cp_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cp_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c_wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_wp.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_cur ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_cur.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_cur ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca_cur.ca_address_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cust_first_ship ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_cust_first_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cust_first_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_cust_first_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cust_last_review ON c.c_last_review_date_sk = d_cust_last_review.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_promo_start ON p_ss.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_promo_end ON p_ss.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_ss.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31'
      AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
      AND p_ss.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    SUM(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns,
    SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns,
    SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
    AVG(ss_quantity) AS avg_store_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM sales_data
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_year, i_brand)
ORDER BY d_year ASC NULLS LAST, i_brand ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    d_ws.d_year AS sales_year,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) - SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)) > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE' ELSE 'NON_POSITIVE' END AS profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_ext_discount_amt) FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_catalog_item_discount,
    top_reason.top_reason_desc AS top_store_return_reason,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) - SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM
    item i
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN customer c_ws_bill ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cs ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c_cs_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_cs_bill.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_cs_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_cs_bill.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT r.r_reason_desc AS top_reason_desc
        FROM store_returns sr2
        JOIN reason r ON sr2.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
        ORDER BY SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS top_reason
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    d_ws.d_year,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    top_reason.top_reason_desc
ORDER BY
    profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        st.s_store_name,
        st.s_state,
        ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_tax,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        rs.r_reason_desc,
        rs.r_reason_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_ship_cost,
        cr.cr_fee,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_state AS warehouse_state,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_tax,
        wr.wr_return_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason rs ON cr.cr_reason_sk = rs.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        AND wr.wr_reason_sk = rs.r_reason_sk
    WHERE st.s_state = 'CA'
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND rs.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
      AND cc.cc_state = 'TX'
      AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND ss.ss_ext_tax > 50
      AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = 2458850
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM warehouse w2
          WHERE w2.w_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
            AND w2.w_city = 'Chicago'
      )
)
SELECT
    base.s_store_name,
    base.cc_name,
    base.r_reason_desc,
    base.cd_gender,
    base.cp_department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base.ss_store_sk) AS store_count,
    SUM(base.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(base.ss_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
    SUM(CASE WHEN base.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000 THEN base.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales,
    SUM(base.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(base.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    MIN(base.ss_ext_sales_price) AS min_sale_price,
    MAX(base.ss_ext_sales_price) AS max_sale_price,
    (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_reason_sk = base.r_reason_sk) AS avg_return_amount_by_reason,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM web_returns wr2
     WHERE wr2.wr_reason_sk = base.r_reason_sk) AS total_web_returns_for_reason
FROM base
GROUP BY
    base.s_store_name,
    base.cc_name,
    base.r_reason_desc,
    base.cd_gender,
    base.cp_department,
    base.r_reason_sk
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cust.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cust.c_first_name AS first_name,
        cust.c_last_name AS last_name,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
        ib.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS catalog_sales,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS web_sales,
        COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0) AS return_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim t_sold
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer cust
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ss
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_ss.p_promo_sk
    -- Reuse dimensions under different aliases for current customer attributes
    JOIN household_demographics hd_current
        ON cust.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_current.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_current
        ON cust.c_current_addr_sk = ca_current.ca_address_sk
    -- Catalog sales (joined on the same time and billing customer)
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ca
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_ca.p_promo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ca
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_ca.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_warehouse
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
    -- Web sales (joined on the same time and billing customer)
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p_ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_ws
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_site we
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    -- Optional link to returns
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_return
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_warehouse_sk IN (
        SELECT w_warehouse_sk
        FROM warehouse
        WHERE w_city = 'Seattle'
    )
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_site ws2
        WHERE ws2.web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
          AND ws2.web_rec_start_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
      )
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        state,
        income_band_sk,
        income_lower,
        income_upper,
        SUM(catalog_sales) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(web_sales) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(return_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(catalog_sales + web_sales - return_loss) AS net_sales
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY
        customer_sk,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        state,
        income_band_sk,
        income_lower,
        income_upper
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    state,
    income_lower,
    income_upper,
    total_catalog_sales,
    total_web_sales,
    total_return_loss,
    net_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY income_band_sk ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank_in_income_band
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE date_range (d_date, d_date_sk) AS (
    SELECT d_date, d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_add('day', 1, dr.d_date) AS d_date, dd.d_date_sk
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim dd ON dd.d_date = date_add('day', 1, dr.d_date)
    WHERE dr.d_date < DATE '2022-01-31'
),
catalog_daily AS (
    SELECT dr.d_date,
           'catalog' AS sales_channel,
           COALESCE(cat_agg.net_paid, 0) AS net_paid,
           COALESCE(cat_agg.distinct_items, 0) AS distinct_items
    FROM date_range dr
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid,
               COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    ) AS cat_agg
),
web_daily AS (
    SELECT dr.d_date,
           'web' AS sales_channel,
           COALESCE(web_agg.net_paid, 0) AS net_paid,
           COALESCE(web_agg.distinct_items, 0) AS distinct_items
    FROM date_range dr
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS net_paid,
               COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    ) AS web_agg
)
SELECT DISTINCT d_date, sales_channel, net_paid, distinct_items
FROM (
    SELECT d_date, sales_channel, net_paid, distinct_items FROM catalog_daily
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date, sales_channel, net_paid, distinct_items FROM web_daily
) AS combined
ORDER BY d_date, sales_channel

WITH high_income_customers AS (
   SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk
   FROM household_demographics hd
   JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
   WHERE ib.ib_lower_bound >= 100000
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT 'store' AS sales_channel,
           i.i_category,
           d.d_year,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS orders,
           (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales ss2 WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_item_net_paid
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31'
      AND i.i_category IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM high_income_customers hic WHERE ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hic.hd_demo_sk)
      AND p.p_purpose = 'Discount'
    GROUP BY i.i_category, d.d_year

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'catalog' AS sales_channel,
           i.i_category,
           d.d_year,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS orders,
           (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_paid) FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_item_net_paid
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31'
      AND i.i_category IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM high_income_customers hic WHERE cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hic.hd_demo_sk)
      AND p.p_purpose = 'Discount'
    GROUP BY i.i_category, d.d_year
) combined
ORDER BY sales_channel, i_category, d_year
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id AS call_center_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number AS catalog_page_number,
        wsite.web_name AS web_name,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS num_orders,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon,
        (
            SELECT SUM(cs2.cs_ext_sales_price)
            FROM catalog_sales cs2
            WHERE cs2.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        ) AS total_sales_call_center,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_amt,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_store_return_amt,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_web_return_amt
    FROM
        call_center cc
        JOIN catalog_sales cs
            ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp
            ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm
            ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN time_dim td
            ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
            ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws
            ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        JOIN web_site wsite
            ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
        LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
            ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
               AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
               AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
            ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
               AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
            ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
               AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
               AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
               AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        LEFT JOIN reason r
            ON r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
               OR r.r_reason_sk = sr.sr_reason_sk
               OR r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    WHERE
        cc.cc_call_center_id = 'CC_001' AND
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number IN (5, 11, 13) AND
        sm.sm_type = 'AIR' AND
        r.r_reason_desc = 'Customer changed mind' AND
        td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17 AND
        wsite.web_name = 'Online Store' AND
        cc.cc_rec_start_date <= DATE '2022-01-01' AND
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_returns wr2
            WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
              AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 100
              AND wr2.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        ) AND
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM catalog_returns cr2
            WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
              AND cr2.cr_return_amt > 0
        )
    GROUP BY
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        wsite.web_name,
        sm.sm_type,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        td.t_hour
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id AS call_center_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number AS catalog_page_number,
        wsite.web_name AS web_name,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        td.t_hour AS hour,
        0 AS num_orders,
        0.0 AS total_sales,
        0.0 AS net_paid,
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(7,2)) AS avg_coupon,
        (
            SELECT SUM(cs3.cs_ext_sales_price)
            FROM catalog_sales cs3
            WHERE cs3.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        ) AS total_sales_call_center,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_amt,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_store_return_amt,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_web_return_amt
    FROM
        call_cen

WITH RECURSIVE agg_base AS (
    SELECT 
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax + ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit + ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost > 20
      AND cs.cs_coupon_amt < 1500
      AND cd.cd_dep_employed_count >= 2
      AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Advanced Degree')
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, cd.cd_education_status
    UNION ALL
    SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
    WHERE FALSE
)
SELECT
    ab.w_warehouse_id,
    ab.cd_education_status,
    ab.total_net_paid,
    ab.total_profit,
    ab.order_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ab.cd_education_status ORDER BY ab.total_net_paid DESC) AS edu_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(total_net_paid) FROM agg_base) AS avg_total_net_paid
FROM agg_base ab
WHERE ab.total_net_paid > (SELECT AVG(total_net_paid) FROM agg_base)
  AND ab.total_profit > 0
  AND ab.order_cnt >= 5
  AND ab.w_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ab.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE numbers(num) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT num + 1 FROM numbers WHERE num < 20
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cd.cd_gender                         AS cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status                 AS cd_marital_status,
        w.w_warehouse_sq_ft                  AS w_warehouse_sq_ft,
        i.inv_item_sk                        AS inv_item_sk,
        i.inv_warehouse_sk                   AS inv_warehouse_sk,
        i.inv_date_sk                        AS inv_date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity                AS cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount                  AS cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss                       AS cr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity                AS sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt                     AS sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_fee                            AS sr_fee,
        sr.sr_net_loss                       AS sr_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE i.inv_item_sk IN (22, 25)
      AND i.inv_date_sk = 2451088
      AND sr.sr_fee > 30.00
      AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft BETWEEN 800000 AND 950000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM numbers n WHERE n.num = i.inv_warehouse_sk
      )
)
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    w_warehouse_sq_ft,
    inv_item_sk,
    COUNT(*)                                            AS cnt_returns,
    SUM(cr_return_quantity + sr_return_quantity)        AS total_return_quantity,
    SUM(cr_return_amount + sr_return_amt)               AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(sr_fee)                                          AS avg_store_fee,
    MAX(GREATEST(cr_net_loss, sr_net_loss))             AS max_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cr_return_amount + sr_return_amt) > (SELECT AVG(cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns)
        THEN 'Above Avg'
        ELSE 'Below Avg'
    END                                                AS return_amount_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM numbers)                      AS total_numbers_generated
FROM joined_data
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, w_warehouse_sq_ft, inv_item_sk
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    -- Sample 10% of catalog_sales using Bernoulli sampling
    sampled_sales AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM catalog_sales
        TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) REPEATABLE (12345)
    ),

    -- Join sampled sales with all related dimension tables
    sales_joined AS (
        SELECT
            cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
            cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
            cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
            cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
            cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
            cs.cs_item_sk,
            cs.cs_quantity,
            cs.cs_net_paid,
            cs.cs_net_profit,
            cs.cs_coupon_amt,
            cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost,
            cs.cs_ext_list_price,
            i.i_item_desc,
            i.i_current_price,
            w.w_warehouse_name,
            w.w_state,
            t.t_hour,
            t.t_meal_time,
            c.c_customer_id,
            ca.ca_state        AS cust_state,
            ca.ca_country      AS cust_country
        FROM sampled_sales cs
        JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    ),

    -- Lateral subquery to split the item description into words and unnest them
    sales_words AS (
        SELECT
            sj.*,                    -- all columns from sales_joined
            w.word
        FROM sales_joined sj
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT split(sj.i_item_desc, ' ') AS words
        ) AS d
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(d.words) AS w(word)
    ),

    -- Count distinct words per item (demonstrates UNNEST usage)
    word_counts AS (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk,
            COUNT(DISTINCT word) AS distinct_word_count
        FROM sales_words
        GROUP BY i_item_sk
    ),

    -- Aggregate sales metrics per item and warehouse
    sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk,
            w_warehouse_name,
            w_state,
            SUM(cs_quantity)               AS total_quantity,
            SUM(cs_net_paid)               AS total_net_paid,
            AVG(cs_coupon_amt)             AS avg_coupon_amt,
            MIN(cs_net_profit)             AS min_net_profit,
            MAX(cs_net_profit)             AS max_net_profit,
            COUNT(*)                       AS sales_transactions
        FROM sales_joined
        WHERE cs_coupon_amt > 500               -- selective filter 1
          AND i_current_price > 100             -- selective filter 2
          AND t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 14          -- selective filter 3 (afternoon sales)
        GROUP BY i_item_sk, w_warehouse_name, w_state
    ),

    -- Join returns with their dimension tables
    returns_joined AS (
        SELECT
            sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
            sr.sr_return_time_sk,
            sr.sr_item_sk,
            sr.sr_customer_sk,
            sr.sr_addr_sk,
            sr.sr_return_quantity,
            sr.sr_return_amt,
            sr.sr_refunded_cash,
            sr.sr_return_tax,
            sr.sr_net_loss,
            i.i_item_desc,
            i.i_current_price,
            t.t_hour,
            t.t_meal_time,
            c.c_customer_id,
            ca.ca_state        AS cust_state,
            ca.ca_country      AS cust_country
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    ),

    -- Aggregate return metrics per item
    returns_agg AS (
        SELECT
            sr_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
            SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
            SUM(sr_refunded_cash)   AS total_refunded_cash,
            AVG(sr_return_amt)      AS avg_return_amt,

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_channel_dmail,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        i.inv_item_sk,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        cd.cd_credit_rating
    FROM call_center cc
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
      AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
      AND cd.cd_credit_rating = 'High Risk'
      AND d.d_year = 2002
      AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND i.inv_item_sk IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT inv_item_sk
          FROM inventory
          WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      )
),
item_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_id,
        p_promo_name,
        d_year,
        inv_item_sk,
        SUM(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr_return_quantity) AS distinct_return_qty,
        (SELECT AVG(i2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
         FROM inventory i2
         WHERE i2.inv_item_sk = base.inv_item_sk) AS avg_qty_per_item
    FROM base
    GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, p_promo_name, d_year, inv_item_sk
),
promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_id,
        p_promo_name,
        d_year,
        SUM(total_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt,
        AVG(avg_qty_per_item) AS avg_item_qty
    FROM item_agg
    GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, p_promo_name, d_year
)
SELECT
    pa.cc_call_center_id,
    pa.p_promo_name,
    pa.d_year,
    pa.sum_return_amt,
    pa.avg_item_qty,
    CASE WHEN pa.avg_item_qty > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS quantity_category
FROM promo_agg pa
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM promotion p2
    WHERE p2.p_promo_name = pa.p_promo_name
      AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND p2.p_start_date_sk = (
          SELECT d2.d_date_sk
          FROM date_dim d2
          WHERE d2.d_year = pa.d_year
          LIMIT 1
      )
)
ORDER BY pa.sum_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH left_joined AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_address_sk,
        ca.ca_address_id,
        ca.ca_city,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_street_name,
        ca.ca_street_number,
        sr.sr_return_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_tax,
        sr.sr_return_ship_cost,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM customer_address ca
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
      AND (sr.sr_return_tax > 30 OR sr.sr_return_tax IS NULL)
      AND (sr.sr_return_ship_cost < 50 OR sr.sr_return_ship_cost IS NULL)
      AND ca.ca_city LIKE '%Washington%'
),
intersected_customers AS (
    SELECT sr_customer_sk FROM store_returns WHERE sr_return_tax > 100
    INTERSECT
    SELECT sr_customer_sk FROM store_returns WHERE sr_return_ship_cost > 20
)
SELECT
    ca_address_id,
    ca_city,
    ca_state,
    ca_street_name,
    ca_street_number,
    sr_return_amt,
    sr_return_tax,
    sr_return_ship_cost,
    sr_net_loss,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY sr_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_by_state,
    SUM(sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY sr_return_amt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amt,
    CASE WHEN sr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Gain' END AS net_loss_flag,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_returns sr2 WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = lj.sr_customer_sk) AS customer_return_count,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_returns sr3 WHERE sr3.sr_customer_sk = lj.sr_customer_sk AND sr3.sr_return_tax > 200) AS has_high_tax_return
FROM left_joined lj
WHERE lj.sr_customer_sk IN (SELECT sr_customer_sk FROM intersected_customers)
ORDER BY ca_state, net_loss_rank_by_state
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'catalog' AS source,
        cp.cp_department AS category,
        d.d_year AS year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0) AS avg_discount
    FROM catalog_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS cs
    JOIN catalog_page AS cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse AS w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cp.cp_type = 'C'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns AS sr
          WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
            AND sr.sr_net_loss > 0
      )
    GROUP BY cp.cp_department, d.d_year
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 10000
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'web' AS source,
        wp.wp_type AS category,
        d.d_year AS year,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ws.ws_quantity), 0) AS avg_discount
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    JOIN web_page AS wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse AS w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND wp.wp_type = 'product'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns AS sr
          WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
            AND sr.sr_net_loss > 0
      )
    GROUP BY wp.wp_type, d.d_year
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 5000
),
combined AS (
    SELECT source, category, year, net_profit, avg_discount
    FROM catalog_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source, category, year, net_profit, avg_discount
    FROM web_agg
)
SELECT
    combined.source,
    combined.category,
    combined.year,
    combined.net_profit,
    combined.avg_discount,
    SUM(combined.net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY combined.source) AS total_profit_source,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY combined.source ORDER BY combined.net_profit DESC) AS rank_in_source,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_year = combined.year
    ) AS returns_cnt
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined.net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss_store_sk,
        ss_cdemo_sk,
        ss_hdemo_sk,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM tpcds.store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_state,
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    a.total_sales,
    a.total_profit,
    a.total_quantity,
    sr.sr_net_loss,
    CASE WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Gain' END AS return_status,
    CASE WHEN cd.cd_dep_employed_count > cd.cd_dep_count THEN 'AllDepEmployed' ELSE 'NotAll' END AS employee_flag,
    (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
     FROM tpcds.store_sales ss2
     WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk) AS avg_sales_price,
    SUM(a.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk) AS store_total_sales,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk) DESC) AS store_rank
FROM agg_sales a
JOIN tpcds.store s
    ON a.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
    ON a.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
    ON a.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.reason r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   AND wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE
    s.s_hours = '8AM-12AM'
    AND cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 6000
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
ORDER BY
    store_rank,
    a.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 5
),
item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_manufact,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_size,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_brand ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS brand_rank
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE
        cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost > 2000.00
        AND cs.cs_quantity >= 5
        AND i.i_rec_start_date <= DATE '2005-12-31'
        AND i.i_size IN ('economy', 'small', 'petite')
    GROUP BY
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_manufact,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_size
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i_brand,
        i_manufact,
        i_category,
        i_size,
        total_sales,
        order_count
    FROM item_sales
    WHERE brand_rank <= (SELECT MAX(n) FROM seq)
)
SELECT entity,
       AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales,
       SUM(total_sales) AS sum_sales
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT i_brand AS entity, total_sales
    FROM filtered_sales
    WHERE i_size = 'economy'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT i_manufact AS entity, total_sales
    FROM filtered_sales
    WHERE i_size = 'small'
) AS combined
GROUP BY entity
HAVING AVG(total_sales) > 5000
ORDER BY avg_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH ws_with_array AS (
    SELECT
        ws.*,
        ARRAY[ws_quantity, ws_list_price] AS qty_price_arr
    FROM web_sales ws
)
SELECT
    td.t_hour AS hour_of_day,
    w.w_state,
    site.web_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
    AVG(qp.qty_or_price) AS avg_qty_or_price,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_net_profit)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    ) AS max_warehouse_profit,
    COALESCE(i.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS inventory_quantity_on_hand
FROM time_dim td
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN ws_with_array ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk
   AND w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site site
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory i
    ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
   AND i.inv_warehouse_sk = 11
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ws.qty_price_arr) AS qp(qty_or_price)
WHERE td.t_sub_shift = 'morning'
  AND td.t_time BETWEEN 8 AND 14
  AND sr.sr_return_ship_cost > 100.00
  AND ws.ws_quantity >= 5
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
  AND site.web_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
          AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 10
    )
GROUP BY
    td.t_hour,
    w.w_state,
    site.web_name,
    i.inv_quantity_on_hand
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 10000
ORDER BY total_sales_price DESC
OFFSET 200
LIMIT 100

WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS date,
        'Store' AS channel,
        promo.p_promo_name AS promotion,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM date_filtered d
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.p_promo_name
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS promo
    GROUP BY d.d_date, promo.p_promo_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS date,
        'Web' AS channel,
        promo.p_promo_name AS promotion,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM date_filtered d
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.p_promo_name
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS promo
    GROUP BY d.d_date, promo.p_promo_name
) AS combined
ORDER BY date DESC, total_sales DESC
OFFSET 0
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        d.d_week_seq,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_class,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_current_price,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_type,
        wp.wp_url,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_return_tax,
        wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        wr.wr_fee,
        wr.wr_return_ship_cost,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash,
        wr.wr_reversed_charge,
        wr.wr_account_credit,
        wr.wr_net_loss
    FROM
        web_returns wr
        TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
        JOIN date_dim d
            ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN item i
            ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN inventory inv
            ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN web_page wp
            ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN reason r
            ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 2001
        AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1200 AND 1220
        AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
        AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 100
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
        AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Customer Not Satisfied'
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    wp_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
    AVG(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amt_inc_tax,
    MIN(wr_return_tax) AS min_return_tax,
    MAX(wr_return_tax) AS max_return_tax,
    SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
FROM joined_data
GROUP BY
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    i_category,
    i_brand,
    wp_type
ORDER BY
    total_return_amt DESC,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  cc.cc_name,
  sm.sm_type,
  d_sold.d_year,
  d_sold.d_month_seq,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales,
  SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_returns,
  SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
  AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_order_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sm.sm_type = 'EXPRESS' THEN cs.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS express_sales,
  (SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
     FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk) AS avg_profit_per_call_center
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_sold
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
  ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN call_center cc
  ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p
  ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
 AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN reason r
  ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return
  ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2001
  AND sm.sm_carrier = 'DHL'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND cs.cs_quantity > 5
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr
          JOIN store s
            ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
         WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
           AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      )
GROUP BY
  cc.cc_name,
  sm.sm_type,
  d_sold.d_year,
  d_sold.d_month_seq
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Compare the total inventory stock value for items that match promotional description patterns with the total web return amount for the same items, using regex and LIKE filters, lateral extraction of identifiers, correlated sub‑queries, a sampled inventory source, and finally union the two perspectives, rank them, and paginate the results.
*/
WITH catalog_stock AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id                                   AS item_id,
        i.i_product_name                              AS product_name,
        w.w_warehouse_name                            AS location,
        'catalog'                                     AS source,
        SUM(i.i_current_price * inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS metric1,
        COUNT(p.p_promo_sk)                           AS metric2,
        CAST((SELECT AVG(cr.cr_return_amount)
               FROM catalog_returns cr
               WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS double) AS extra_metric,
        CONCAT(i.i_item_id, '-', id_l.numeric_part)  AS key
    FROM
        item i
        JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN (
            SELECT * FROM inventory TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (20)
        ) inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_extract(i.i_item_id, '\\d+$') AS numeric_part
        ) AS id_l
    WHERE
        (REGEXP_LIKE(i.i_item_desc, '(?i)pack|box')
         OR i.i_product_name LIKE '%Deluxe%')
        AND p.p_channel_event = 'N'
        AND i.i_brand_id IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT i2.i_brand_id
            FROM item i2
            WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(i2.i_item_desc, '(?i)size')
        )
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) > 0
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        id_l.numeric_part
),
web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id                                   AS item_id,
        i.i_product_name                              AS product_name,
        wp.wp_type                                    AS location,
        'web'                                         AS source,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amount)                     AS metric1,
        COUNT(*)                                      AS metric2,
        CAST((SELECT MAX(cr.cr_return_amount)
               FROM catalog_returns cr
               WHERE cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS double) AS extra_metric,
        CONCAT(i.i_item_id, '-', url_l.domain)       AS key
    FROM
        web_returns wr
        JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
        JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_extract(wp.wp_url, '://([^/]+)/') AS domain
        ) AS url_l
    WHERE
        wp.wp_url LIKE 'http%'
        AND REGEXP_LIKE(wp.wp_type, '^(order|feedback)$')
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM promotion p2
            WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        )
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        wp.wp_type,
        url_l.domain
)
SELECT
    item_id,
    product_name,
    location,
    source,
    metric1,
    metric2,
    extra_metric,
    key
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM catalog_stock
    UNION
    SELECT * FROM web_returns_agg
) AS combined
ORDER BY metric1 DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 10

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_net_paid,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS catalog_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS web_orders
    FROM
        catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 2001
        AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
        AND s.s_state = 'TN'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    b.i_product_name,
    b.d_year,
    b.d_month_seq,
    b.total_catalog_net_paid,
    b.total_web_net_paid,
    b.total_store_return_amt,
    b.total_web_return_amt,
    (b.total_catalog_net_paid + b.total_web_net_paid - b.total_store_return_amt - b.total_web_return_amt) AS net_revenue,
    b.catalog_orders,
    b.web_orders,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_paid)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_item_sk = b.i_item_sk
          AND ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = (
                SELECT d2.d_date_sk
                FROM date_dim d2
                WHERE d2.d_year = b.d_year
                  AND d2.d_month_seq = b.d_month_seq
                ORDER BY d2.d_date_sk
                LIMIT 1
          )
    ) AS avg_monthly_web_net_paid
FROM base b
WHERE (b.total_catalog_net_paid + b.total_web_net_paid - b.total_store_return_amt - b.total_web_return_amt) > 0
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk AS store_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        d_year.d_year AS sales_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS store_sales_net,
        COALESCE(SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax), 0) AS web_sales_net,
        COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS returns_net_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_store_customers,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS total_coupons
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_year
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_year.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_year.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_year.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE
        d_year.d_year = 2001
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax > 1000
        AND ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax > 500
        AND w.w_gmt_offset >= -5.0
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_store_name, p.p_promo_name, d_year.d_year)
)
SELECT
    agg.store_name,
    agg.promo_name,
    agg.sales_year,
    agg.store_sales_net,
    agg.web_sales_net,
    agg.returns_net_loss,
    agg.distinct_store_customers,
    agg.total_coupons,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.promo_name ORDER BY agg.store_sales_net DESC) AS sales_rank,
    SUM(agg.store_sales_net) OVER (PARTITION BY agg.promo_name ORDER BY agg.sales_year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_sales_to_year,
    CASE
        WHEN agg.store_sales_net > 5000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN agg.store_sales_net > 2000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS sales_volume_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales ss2 WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = agg.store_sk) AS total_transactions_for_store
FROM aggregated agg
ORDER BY agg.promo_name, sales_rank, agg.store_name

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS seq_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT seq_num + 1 FROM seq WHERE seq_num < 5
)
SELECT
    s.seq_num,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    ss.ss_ticket_number,
    ss.ss_net_paid,
    p1.p_purpose AS catalog_purpose,
    p2.p_purpose AS web_purpose,
    p3.p_purpose AS store_purpose,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_type,
    w_main.w_city AS warehouse_city,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    (SELECT MAX(p_cost) FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_radio = 'N') AS max_radio_promo_cost,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold
FROM seq s
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON ((cs.cs_sold_date_sk % 5) + 1) = s.seq_num
JOIN customer c
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN promotion p1
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p1.p_promo_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_main
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_main.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN call_center cc_ret
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_ret.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp_ret
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp_ret.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_ret
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_ret.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ret
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_ret.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN promotion p2
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_ws
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ws
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site wsite
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN promotion p3
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p3.p_promo_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
      AND cr2.cr_return_quantity > 0
)
  AND p1.p_channel_radio = 'N'
GROUP BY
    s.seq_num,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    ss.ss_ticket_number,
    ss.ss_net_paid,
    p1.p_purpose,
    p2.p_purpose,
    p3.p_purpose,
    cc.cc_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    sm.sm_type,
    w_main.w_city,
    inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    (SELECT MAX(p_cost) FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_radio = 'N')
ORDER BY s.seq_num, cs.cs_order_number
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        p.p_promo_name,
        w.w_city,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS sum_store_sales_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sum_catalog_sales_net_paid,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS sum_inventory_qty,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS sum_store_returns_net_loss
    FROM tpcds.date_dim d
    JOIN tpcds.promotion p ON p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer c ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN tpcds.warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    JOIN tpcds.inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN tpcds.time_dim t ON t.t_time_sk = ss.ss_sold_time_sk
    JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 1998
        AND d.d_quarter_name = '1901Q1'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND w.w_city = 'Liberty'
        AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
        AND cp.cp_type = 'A'
        AND wp.wp_type = 'A'
    GROUP BY
        d.d_year,
        p.p_promo_name,
        w.w_city
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM agg_data WHERE false
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    p_promo_name,
    w_city,
    distinct_customers,
    sum_store_sales_net_paid,
    sum_catalog_sales_net_paid,
    sum_inventory_qty,
    sum_store_returns_net_loss,
    sum_store_sales_net_paid / NULLIF(sum_inventory_qty, 0) AS sales_per_inventory
FROM agg_data
WHERE sum_store_sales_net_paid > 1000
ORDER BY d_year, sum_store_sales_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 0 AS mod_val
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mod_val + 1 FROM seq WHERE mod_val < 9
)
SELECT
    cs.cs_order_number,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
    p.p_promo_name,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    cp.cp_department,
    ss.ss_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY cs.cs_ext_sales_price DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number) AS avg_return_amount
FROM
    seq
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON (cs.cs_sold_time_sk % 10) = seq.mod_val
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
