    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN time_dim td
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
   AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
WHERE
    cs.cs_wholesale_cost > 20
    AND cs.cs_sales_price > 100
    AND p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
    AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%color%'
    AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
    AND w.w_state = 'TX'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
          AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 0
    )
ORDER BY cs.cs_ext_sales_price DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_channels AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        TRIM(channel) AS channel
    FROM promotion p
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(p.p_channel_details, ',')) AS t(channel)
)
SELECT
    d1.d_year,
    i.i_category,
    sm.sm_type,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales_amount,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_amount,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_amount,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit + ss.ss_net_profit + ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS store_return_cnt,
    COUNT(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_return_cnt,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit + ss.ss_net_profit + ws.ws_net_profit) > 500000 THEN 'HIGH'
        ELSE 'MEDIUM'
    END AS profit_category,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM promotion p_sub
        JOIN date_dim d_start ON p_sub.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk
        JOIN date_dim d_end   ON p_sub.p_end_date_sk   = d_end.d_date_sk
        JOIN item i_sub       ON p_sub.p_item_sk      = i_sub.i_item_sk
        WHERE i_sub.i_category = i.i_category
          AND d_start.d_year <= d1.d_year
          AND d_end.d_year   >= d1.d_year
    ) AS active_promo_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.channel) AS distinct_channel_cnt
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d1 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN promo_channels pc ON cs.cs_promo_sk = pc.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
-- Store sales
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
-- Store returns
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                     AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d3 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
-- Web sales
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d4 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d4.d_date_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site webs ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = webs.web_site_sk
-- Web returns
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                    AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d5 ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d5.d_date_sk
JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refund.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_return  ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_page wp_wr ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp_wr.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE
    d1.d_year = 2000
    AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND ca_bill.ca_state = 'CA'
    AND pc.p_discount_active = 'Y'
GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (d1.d_year, i.i_category, sm.sm_type)
HAVING
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit + ss.ss_net_profit + ws.ws_net_profit) > 100000
ORDER BY
    profit_category DESC,
    total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH sales_union AS (
  SELECT
    store.s_state AS state,
    time_dim.t_hour AS hour,
    income_band.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
    income_band.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
    SUM(COALESCE(store_sales.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(catalog_sales.cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(web_sales.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(catalog_returns.cr_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(web_returns.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_returns,
    SUM(inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
    (
      SELECT SUM(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
      FROM inventory inv2
      WHERE inv2.inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
    ) AS warehouse_inventory
  FROM store
  JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  JOIN time_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
  JOIN household_demographics ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ON household_demographics.hd_income_band_sk = income_band.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    AND catalog_sales.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN warehouse ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_returns.cr_returned_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    AND catalog_returns.cr_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
    AND catalog_returns.cr_order_number = catalog_sales.cs_order_number
    AND catalog_returns.cr_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
    AND catalog_returns.cr_reason_sk = reason.r_reason_sk
    AND catalog_returns.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    AND catalog_returns.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN reason ON catalog_returns.cr_reason_sk = reason.r_reason_sk
  JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    AND web_sales.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    AND web_sales.ws_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_page ON web_sales.ws_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
  JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
  JOIN web_returns ON web_returns.wr_returned_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    AND web_returns.wr_item_sk = web_sales.ws_item_sk
    AND web_returns.wr_order_number = web_sales.ws_order_number
    AND web_returns.wr_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
    AND web_returns.wr_reason_sk = reason.r_reason_sk
    AND web_returns.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    AND web_returns.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN inventory ON inventory.inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE store.s_state = 'CA'
    AND reason.r_reason_desc = 'Package was damaged'
    AND time_dim.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 12
    AND income_band.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
    AND inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
  GROUP BY ROLLUP (store.s_state, time_dim.t_hour, income_band.ib_lower_bound, income_band.ib_upper_bound)

  UNION

  SELECT
    store.s_state AS state,
    time_dim.t_hour AS hour,
    income_band.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
    income_band.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
    SUM(COALESCE(store_sales.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(catalog_sales.cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(web_sales.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(catalog_returns.cr_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(web_returns.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_returns,
    SUM(inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory,
    (
      SELECT SUM(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand)
      FROM inventory inv2
      WHERE inv2.inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
    ) AS warehouse_inventory
  FROM store
  JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  JOIN time_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
  JOIN household_demographics ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ON household_demographics.hd_income_band_sk = income_band.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN catalog_sales ON cat

WITH call_center_hours AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        hour
    FROM call_center cc
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(cc.cc_hours, ',')) AS t(hour)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_city AS warehouse_city,
        d.d_year,
        CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = '1000-1500' THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS purchase_potential_category,
        cch.hour,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS num_orders,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity > 0 THEN sr.sr_return_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_store_returns_quantity,
        (
            SELECT MAX(p2.p_promo_id)
            FROM promotion p2
            WHERE p2.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        ) AS max_promo_id
    FROM
        call_center_hours cch
        JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cch.cc_call_center_sk
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
            AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
            AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
            AND ws_site.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
            AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_year = 2001
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1000-1500'
        AND cch.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_returns wr_excl
            WHERE wr_excl.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        )
    GROUP BY
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_city,
        d.d_year,
        purchase_potential_category,
        cch.hour
)
SELECT
    a.w_warehouse_id,
    a.warehouse_city,
    a.d_year,
    a.purchase_potential_category,
    a.hour,
    a.num_orders,
    a.total_catalog_sales,
    a.total_web_sales,
    a.total_discount_amount,
    a.total_inventory_on_hand,
    a.total_store_returns_quantity,
    a.max_promo_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.w_warehouse_id ORDER BY a.total_catalog_sales DESC) AS warehouse_sales_rank
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.total_catalog_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE item_seq AS (
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(i_item_sk) FROM item) AS i_item_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i_item_sk + 1
    FROM item_seq
    WHERE i_item_sk < (SELECT MIN(i_item_sk) FROM item) + 99
),
sales_store AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity AS quantity,
        ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ss.ss_sales_price AS sales_price,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        p.p_discount_active,
        i.i_current_price,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN item_seq iseq ON i.i_item_sk = iseq.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 1
      AND ss.ss_sales_price > 20
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 500
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
),
sales_web AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity AS quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ws.ws_sales_price AS sales_price,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        p.p_discount_active,
        i.i_current_price,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN item_seq iseq ON i.i_item_sk = iseq.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 1
      AND ws.ws_sales_price > 20
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 500
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND wsit.web_mkt_id IN (1, 2, 3)
      AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 15000
),
sales_catalog AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs.cs_sales_price AS sales_price,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        p.p_discount_active,
        i.i_current_price,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN item_seq iseq ON i.i_item_sk = iseq.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 1
      AND cs.cs_sales_price > 20
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 500
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cp.cp_department = 'Home'
      AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 10000
),
sales_union AS (
    SELECT item_sk, quantity, net_profit, sales_price,
           cd_gender, hd_vehicle_count, p_discount_active,
           i_current_price, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound
    FROM sales_store
    UNION
    SELECT item_sk, quantity, net_profit, sales_price,
           cd_gender, hd_vehicle_count

WITH aggregated_returns AS (
    SELECT
        i_cr.i_item_sk,
        i_cr.i_item_id,
        i_cr.i_product_name,
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount
    FROM
        catalog_sales cs
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
        JOIN item i_cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_cs.i_item_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
        JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
        JOIN item i_cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i_cr.i_item_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp_cr ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp_cr.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i_cr.i_item_sk
        JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
        JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
        JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
        JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i_cr.i_item_sk
        JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
        JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_refunded.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_refunded.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca_wr_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr_refunded.ca_address_sk
        JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_returning ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_returning.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_returning ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_returning.hd_demo_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca_wr_returning ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_wr_returning.ca_address_sk
    WHERE
        i_cs.i_brand = 'BrandA'
        AND cp.cp_department = 'Books'
        AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
        AND t_wr.t_am_pm = 'PM'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY
        i_cr.i_item_sk,
        i_cr.i_item_id,
        i_cr.i_product_name,
        cp.cp_department
)

SELECT
    ar.i_item_id,
    ar.i_product_name,
    ar.cp_department,
    ar.total_catalog_return_amount,
    ar.total_store_return_amount,
    ar.total_web_return_amount,
    (ar.total_catalog_return_amount + ar.total_store_return_amount + ar.total_web_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ar.total_catalog_return_amount + ar.total_store_return_amount + ar.total_web_return_amount) DESC) AS return_rank,

WITH joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_credit,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS cs_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        i.i_category_id,
        d_sr.d_year,
        cc.cc_state,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        -- columns required only for join validation
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        p_cs.p_discount_active,
        cp.cp_department,
        p_ws.p_promo_id AS ws_promo_id,
        wp_wr.wp_web_page_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c_sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd_sr.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p_cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c_cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_cs.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_cs ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_cs.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_cs ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_cs.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p_ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c_ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ws.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ws ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_ws ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    INNER JOIN web_page wp_wr ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp_wr.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE d_sr.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_category_id = 4
      AND p_cs.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND sr.sr_store_credit > 500.00
      AND ws.ws_quantity >= 2
      AND hd_sr.hd_dep_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM web_page wp
          WHERE wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
            AND wp.wp_type = 'Article'
      )
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_category_id,
        d_year,
        cc_state,
        ib_lower_bound,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY
        i_category_id,
        d_year,
        cc_state,
        ib_lower_bound
)
SELECT
    a.i_category_id,
    a.d_year,
    a.cc_state,
    CASE WHEN a.ib_lower_bound < 30000 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END AS income_group,
    a.total_catalog_sales,
    a.total_web_sales,
    a.total_store_returns,
    a.total_web_returns,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.i_category_id ORDER BY (a.total_catalog_sales + a.total_web_sales) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM agg a
ORDER BY a.total_catalog_sales DESC, a.total_web_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
cs_agg AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk,
           cs_order_number,
           SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
           SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk, cs_order_number
),
wr_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk,
           ws_order_number,
           SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_ws_quantity,
           SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk, ws_order_number
),
returns_union AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number AS order_number, cr_return_amount AS return_amt
    FROM catalog_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr_order_number, wr_return_amt
    FROM web_returns
),
inc_stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(ib_lower_bound) AS min_income,
           MAX(ib_upper_bound) AS max_income
    FROM income_band
)
SELECT
    d_sales.d_year,
    cc.cc_name,
    wsite.web_site_id,
    wp.wp_url,
    ca.ca_state,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    CASE WHEN SUM(cs_agg.total_net_profit) + SUM(wr_agg.total_ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_indicator,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_quantity) AS total_catalog_quantity,
    SUM(wr_agg.total_ws_quantity) AS total_web_quantity,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_net_paid) + SUM(wr_agg.total_ws_net_paid) AS combined_net_paid,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_net_profit) + SUM(wr_agg.total_ws_net_profit) AS combined_net_profit,
    SUM(rs.return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    (SELECT MIN(ib_lower_bound) FROM income_band) AS min_income_scalar,
    inc_stats.min_income,
    inc_stats.max_income
FROM cs_agg
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = cs_agg.cs_item_sk
   AND cs.cs_order_number = cs_agg.cs_order_number
JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sales
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib
    ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site wsite
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cr
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_union rs
    ON rs.order_number = cs.cs_order_number
CROSS JOIN inc_stats
WHERE d_sales.d_year = 2001
GROUP BY
    d_sales.d_year,
    cc.cc_name,
    wsite.web_site_id,
    wp.wp_url,
    ca.ca_state,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    inc_stats.min_income,
    inc_stats.max_income
ORDER BY combined_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_time_sk,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_current_price,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        t.t_time,
        t.t_hour,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_zip,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        s.s_city,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_employees,
        cc.cc_tax_percentage,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND i.i_brand_id = 10
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id AS store_id,
        d_date AS sale_date,
        i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(cs_net_paid, 0)) AS total_catalog_sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_store_returns_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_catalog_returns_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(inv_quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS total_inventory_on_hand
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY s_store_id, d_date, i_item_id
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        store_id,
        sale_date,
        item_id,
        total_store_sales,
        total_catalog_sales,
        (total_store_sales + total_catalog_sales) AS combined_sales,
        SUM(total_store_sales + total_catalog_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY store_id
            ORDER BY sale_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_sales
    FROM agg_sales
),
top_sales AS (
    SELECT store_id, sale_date, item_id, combined_sales, cumulative_sales
    FROM final_agg
    WHERE cumulative_sales > 500000
    ORDER BY cumulative_sales DESC
    FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS WITH TIES
),
low_sales AS (
    SELECT store_id, sale_date, item_id, combined_sales, cumulative_sales
    FROM final_agg
    WHERE cumulative_sales <= 500000
    ORDER BY cumulative_sales ASC
    FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS WITH TIES
)
SELECT DISTINCT store_id, sale_date, item_id, combined_sales, cumulative_sales
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM top_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM low_sales
) u
ORDER BY cumulative_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

/*
  Goal: Compute net profit, discounts, and sales metrics per year and item category by combining web sales, catalog returns, store returns, and inventory, while indicating promotion activity and average item price for each category.
*/
WITH RECURSIVE base_union AS (
    -- Web sales (anchor 1)
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_date_sk AS date_sk,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_sales_amount,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amount,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS profit_amount,
        ws.ws_order_number AS order_id,
        1 AS source_flag,
        CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active_flag
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_current_price > 20
      AND p.p_cost < 500
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
      AND we.web_country = 'United States'

    UNION

    -- Catalog returns (anchor 2)
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_date_sk AS date_sk,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        -cr.cr_return_amount AS net_sales_amount,
        -cr.cr_return_tax AS discount_amount,
        -cr.cr_net_loss AS profit_amount,
        cr.cr_order_number AS order_id,
        2 AS source_flag,
        CASE WHEN sm.sm_type = 'AIR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active_flag
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 0
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity <= 5
      AND i.i_current_price > 30
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND cr.cr_fee < 100

    UNION ALL

    -- Store returns
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_date_sk AS date_sk,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        -sr.sr_return_amt AS net_sales_amount,
        -sr.sr_return_tax AS discount_amount,
        -sr.sr_net_loss AS profit_amount,
        sr.sr_ticket_number AS order_id,
        3 AS source_flag,
        CASE WHEN s.s_market_desc LIKE '%Local%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active_flag
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0
      AND i.i_current_price >= 25
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
      AND sr.sr_return_quantity <= 10
      AND sr.sr_return_tax > 0

    UNION ALL

    -- Inventory (FULL OUTER JOIN with date_dim)
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        d.d_date_sk AS date_sk,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(15,2)) AS net_sales_amount,
        CAST(0 AS decimal(15,2)) AS discount_amount,
        CAST(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS decimal(15,2)) AS profit_amount,
        CAST(NULL AS integer) AS order_id,
        4 AS source_flag,
        CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active_flag
    FROM inventory inv
    FULL OUTER JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand IS NOT NULL
      AND i.i_current_price < 100
      AND i.i_brand_id IN (1,2,3)
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0

    UN

/*
  goal: Analyze web returns for customers with example.com email addresses, showing the number of returns, total return amount, latest return date, a URL prefix, and rank customers by return amount.
*/
WITH customer_returns AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        concat(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
        regexp_extract(c.c_email_address, '@(.*)$', 1) AS email_domain,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        d.d_date,
        wp.wp_url
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE regexp_like(c.c_email_address, '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@example\\.com$')
      AND wp.wp_url LIKE 'http://www.%'
), per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        full_name,
        email_domain,
        COUNT(*) AS num_returns,
        SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        MAX(d_date) AS last_return_date,
        substring(wp_url, 1, 30) AS url_prefix
    FROM customer_returns
    GROUP BY
        c_customer_sk,
        full_name,
        email_domain,
        url_prefix
)
SELECT
    c_customer_sk,
    full_name,
    email_domain,
    num_returns,
    total_return_amount,
    last_return_date,
    url_prefix,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank
FROM per_customer
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) AS time_sk,
           MAX(t_time_sk) AS max_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_sk + 1, max_time_sk
    FROM date_range
    WHERE time_sk < max_time_sk
),
filtered_promotions AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_event = 'N'
      AND p_channel_radio = 'N'
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           i.i_item_desc AS item_desc,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
           'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_range dr ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = dr.time_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_promotions fp ON cs.cs_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           i.i_item_desc AS item_desc,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
           'store' AS source
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = dr.time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_promotions fp ON ss.ss_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           i.i_item_desc AS item_desc,
           SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_sales,
           'return' AS source
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_range dr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = dr.time_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
                           AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_promotions fp ON cs.cs_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc
),
combined AS (
    SELECT item_id, item_desc, total_sales, source FROM catalog_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_id, item_desc, total_sales, source FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_id, item_desc, total_sales, source FROM returns_agg
)
SELECT item_id,
       item_desc,
       source,
       total_sales
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH ws_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws_item_sk,
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
        SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_ws_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS ws_sales_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451910 AND 2452000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost > 5.00
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk
),
ss_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_ss_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS ss_sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity > 3
      AND ss_net_paid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    ca.ca_state,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    d_cs.d_year,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sum_catalog_net_paid,
    SUM(ws_agg.total_ws_net_paid) AS sum_web_net_paid,
    SUM(ss_agg.total_ss_net_paid) AS sum_store_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    MAX(i.i_current_price) AS max_item_price,
    MIN(i.i_current_price) AS min_item_price,
    AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    ) AS catalog_sales_cnt_for_item_date,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wp2.wp_type)
        FROM web_page wp2
        WHERE wp2.wp_creation_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
    ) AS distinct_page_types_on_date
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d_cs
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t
    ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN item i
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN ws_agg
    ON ws_agg.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ws_agg.ws_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
JOIN ss_agg
    ON ss_agg.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ss_agg.ss_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site wsite
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
WHERE d_cs.d_year = 1999
  AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
  AND i.i_category_id IN (3, 9)
  AND i.i_manufact = 'barableable'
  AND wp.wp_image_count > 3
  AND wp.wp_link_count BETWEEN 5 AND 20
  AND wsite.web_country = 'United States'
  AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
GROUP BY
    ca.ca_state,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    d_cs.d_year
ORDER BY sum_catalog_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

Goal: Identify distinct items that were sold and returned in 2001 with formulation codes containing digits and colors starting with 're', compute their total sales profit and return loss, and rank them by net gain.

Query:
WITH
    sales_items AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_item_id,
            i.i_color,
            i.i_formulation,
            cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
            cs.cs_net_profit,
            CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'NonPositive' END AS profit_flag,
            regexp_extract(i.i_formulation, '([0-9]{4})', 1) AS formulation_code,
            CONCAT(cp.cp_type, '-', i.i_color) AS type_color
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
          AND i.i_color LIKE 're%'
          AND regexp_like(i.i_formulation, '[0-9]{3,}')
    ),
    returned_items AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_item_id,
            i.i_color,
            i.i_formulation,
            cr.cr_return_amount,
            cr.cr_net_loss,
            CASE WHEN cr.cr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'NoLoss' END AS loss_flag,
            regexp_extract(i.i_formulation, '([0-9]{4})', 1) AS formulation_code,
            CONCAT(cp.cp_type, '-', i.i_color) AS type_color
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
          AND i.i_color LIKE 're%'
          AND regexp_like(i.i_formulation, '[0-9]{3,}')
    ),
    intersect_items AS (
        SELECT i_item_sk FROM sales_items
        INTERSECT
        SELECT i_item_sk FROM returned_items
    ),
    sales_agg AS (
        SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
               SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
        GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
    ),
    returns_agg AS (
        SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
               SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2001
        GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
    )
SELECT
    ii.i_item_sk,
    i.i_item_id,
    SUBSTRING(i.i_item_id, 1, 5) AS item_id_prefix,
    i.i_color,
    i.i_formulation,
    i.i_current_price,
    COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) AS total_sales_profit,
    COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
    (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) AS net_gain
FROM intersect_items ii
JOIN item i ON ii.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON s.i_item_sk = ii.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON r.i_item_sk = ii.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_color LIKE 're%'
ORDER BY net_gain DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_sales_sub AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS net_spent
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01' AND d.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
),
catalog_sales_sub AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS net_spent
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01' AND d.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
),
combined_sales AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, net_spent FROM store_sales_sub
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, net_spent FROM catalog_sales_sub
)
SELECT
    cs.c_customer_id,
    cs.c_first_name,
    cs.c_last_name,
    SUM(cs.net_spent) AS total_net_spent,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT promo_sk) FROM (
            SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk
            FROM store_sales ss
            JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = cs.c_customer_sk
              AND d.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01' AND d.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
            UNION
            SELECT cs2.cs_promo_sk
            FROM catalog_sales cs2
            JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs2.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
            WHERE cs2.cs_bill_customer_sk = cs.c_customer_sk
              AND d2.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01' AND d2.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
        ) promo_union
    ) AS distinct_promo_count,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN date_dim d3 ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
        WHERE wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = cs.c_customer_sk
          AND d3.d_date >= DATE '2001-01-01' AND d3.d_date < DATE '2002-01-01'
    ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_web_return
FROM combined_sales cs
GROUP BY cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY total_net_spent DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 2
    GROUP BY
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number
)
SELECT
    td.t_hour,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    cc.cc_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    wp.wp_type,
    SUM(sa.total_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amt,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_ticket_cnt,
    AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
    MIN(i.i_current_price) AS min_item_price,
    MAX(i.i_current_price) AS max_item_price,
    (SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS max_item_return_amount
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN time_dim td
    ON sa.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN item i
    ON sa.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON sa.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = sa.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN reason r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state
    FROM call_center cc
    WHERE cc.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
    LIMIT 1
) AS cc
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE
    td.t_hour = 9
    AND td.t_minute = 12
    AND i.i_brand = 'BrandA'
    AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    AND hd.hd_income_band_sk = 20
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
    AND r.r_reason_desc LIKE '%damaged%'
    AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
    AND wp.wp_type = 'HOME'
GROUP BY
    td.t_hour,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    cc.cc_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    wp.wp_type
ORDER BY total_sales_price DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_date,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2000-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           dr.lvl + 1
    FROM date_dim d_next
    JOIN date_range dr
      ON d_next.d_date = dr.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dr.lvl < 5
),
catalog_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number AS order_key
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_range dr
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
),
store_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number AS order_key
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_range dr
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
),
common_orders AS (
    SELECT order_key FROM catalog_orders
    INTERSECT
    SELECT order_key FROM store_orders
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_net_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc = 'Wrong size' THEN cr.cr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS total_wrong_size_loss,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ws.web_name = 'Main Site' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS main_site_flag_count
FROM date_range dr
JOIN catalog_sales cs
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN store_sales ss
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN promotion p
  ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
  AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
  AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
  ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws
  ON ws.web_open_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN reason r
  ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE
    EXTRACT(year FROM dr.d_date) = 2000
    AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Did not like the model'
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
    AND cs.cs_order_number IN (SELECT order_key FROM common_orders)
    AND ss.ss_ticket_number IN (SELECT order_key FROM common_orders)
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (s.s_store_name, r.r_reason_desc),
    (s.s_store_name),
    (r.r_reason_desc),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_store_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, 1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2020-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk, d_next.d_date, ds.lvl + 1
    FROM date_seq ds
    JOIN date_dim d_next ON d_next.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE ds.lvl < 5
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_quarter_name,
        i.i_category,
        cd.cd_gender,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        cr.cr_order_number,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_amt
    FROM date_seq ds
    JOIN date_dim d ON ds.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    JOIN item i2 ON i2.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = sr.sr_cdemo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON hd2.hd_demo_sk = sr.sr_hdemo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON t.t_time_sk = cr.cr_returned_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim t2 ON t2.t_time_sk = sr.sr_return_time_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM item i3
        WHERE i3.i_category = i.i_category
          AND i3.i_current_price > 100
    )
),
agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_quarter_name,
        i_category,
        cd_gender,
        hd_buy_potential,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr_order_number) AS catalog_return_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr_ticket_number) AS store_return_tickets,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
        SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_store_net_loss,
        AVG(cr_return_amount) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
        AVG(sr_return_amt) AS avg_store_return_amt
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d_year, d_quarter_name, i_category, cd_gender, hd_buy_potential),
        (d_year, d_quarter_name, i_category, cd_gender),
        (d_year, d_quarter_name, i_category),
        (d_year, d_quarter_name),
        (d_year),
        ()
    )
    HAVING SUM(sr_net_loss) > 0
)
SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_store_net_loss DESC) AS rn_yearly_store_loss_rank
FROM agg_data
ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_name, i_category, cd_gender, hd_buy_potential

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT level + 1 FROM seq WHERE level < 5
),
base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_wholesale_cost,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_state,
        cp.cp_department,
        ca.ca_state,
        hd.hd_demo_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    WHERE
        cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost > 30
        AND (cr.cr_refunded_cash > 1000 OR cr.cr_refunded_cash IS NULL)
),
intersect_order_numbers AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 2
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cr.cr_order_number
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 500
),
distinct_returning_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_refunded_cash > 0
),
page_return_full AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_department,
        cr.cr_order_number,
        cr.cr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_page cp
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
),
max_net_paid_per_cc AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        t.max_net_paid
    FROM call_center cc
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_net_paid) AS max_net_paid
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    ) t
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        seq.level,
        bs.cc_state,
        bs.ca_state,
        bs.cp_department,
        SUM(bs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(bs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        MIN(bs.cs_net_paid) AS min_net_paid,
        MAX(bs.cs_net_paid) AS max_net_paid,
        MAX(mnp.max_net_paid) AS max_center_net_paid
    FROM seq
    CROSS JOIN base_sales bs
    LEFT JOIN max_net_paid_per_cc mnp
        ON bs.cs_call_center_sk = mnp.cc_call_center_sk
    WHERE bs.cs_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM intersect_order_numbers)
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (seq.level, bs.cc_state, bs.ca_state, bs.cp_department)
)
SELECT
    a.level,
    a.cc_state,
    a.ca_state,
    a.cp_department,
    a.total_net_paid,
    a.avg_net_paid,
    a.distinct_orders,
    a.min_net_paid,
    a.max_net_paid,
    a.max_center_net_paid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.cc_state ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC) AS state_rank,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_returns cr_total WHERE cr_total.cr_refunded_cash > 0) AS total_refunded_returns,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distinct_returning_customers) AS distinct_returning_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM page_return_full prf WHERE prf.cp_department = a.cp_department) AS page_return_rows
FROM agg_sales a
ORDER BY a.level, a.cc_state, a.ca_state, a.cp_department, state_rank
OFFSET 0
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    d_ss.d_year AS year,
    COALESCE(r_store.r_reason_desc, r_catalog.r_reason_desc, r_web.r_reason_desc) AS return_reason,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_store_return_net_loss,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_catalog_net_profit,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_return_net_loss,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_web_net_profit,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_net_loss,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_quantity
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ss ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sclosed ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sclosed.d_date_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r_store ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_store.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_sr ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_sr.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s2 ON sr.sr_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    AND cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    AND cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
    AND cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_cs.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r_catalog ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_catalog.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_refund ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_cr_refund ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_cr_refund.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_cr_return ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_cr_return.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_cr_return ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_cr_return.ca_address_sk
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    AND ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
    AND ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ss.ca_address_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    AND ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r_web ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_web.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_wr_refund.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_return ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_return.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_wr_return ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_wr_return.ca_address_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_ss.d_year, COALESCE(r_store.r_reason_desc, r_catalog.r_reason_desc, r_web.r_reason_desc))
ORDER BY d_ss.d_year DESC NULLS LAST,
    COALESCE(r_store.r_reason_desc, r_catalog.r_reason_desc, r_web.r_reason_desc)
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT 2451545 AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < 2451555
),
base_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        i.i_category,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        ca_refund.ca_county AS refund_county,
        ca_return.ca_state AS return_state
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refund.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_return
        ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
    JOIN date_range dr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.date_sk
    WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND ca_refund.ca_county IN ('Kit Carson County', 'Marshall County')
      AND ca_return.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND cp.cp_catalog_number IN (3, 17, 20)
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2451555
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cp_catalog_page_id,
        i_category,
        SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM base_returns
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id, i_category
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        cp_catalog_page_id,
        i_category,
        total_return_amount,
        total_return_quantity,
        total_net_loss,
        return_count,
        AVG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category) AS avg_return_amount_by_category,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank
    FROM aggregated
    WHERE total_return_quantity >= 10
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    i_category,
    total_return_amount,
    total_return_quantity,
    total_net_loss,
    return_count,
    avg_return_amount_by_category,
    net_loss_rank
FROM final
WHERE net_loss_rank <= 5
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC

WITH full_join AS (
  SELECT
    d.d_year,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_net_profit,
    cr.cr_return_amount,
    sr.sr_net_loss,
    ws.web_market_manager,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    sm.sm_type
  FROM tpcds.date_dim d
  JOIN tpcds.store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN tpcds.customer_demographics cd
    ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN tpcds.household_demographics hd
    ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN tpcds.income_band ib
    ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN tpcds.promotion p
    ON p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN tpcds.catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN tpcds.catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
  JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm
    ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN tpcds.web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN tpcds.web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2001
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 20000
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND ws.web_state = 'CA'
),
intersect_orders AS (
  SELECT cs_order_number
  FROM full_join
  WHERE cs_net_profit > 5000
    AND cr_return_amount < 100
  INTERSECT
  SELECT cs_order_number
  FROM full_join
  WHERE sr_net_loss > 2000
    AND web_market_manager = 'Kelvin Lynch'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    d_year,
    p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS num_orders
  FROM full_join fj
  JOIN intersect_orders io
    ON fj.cs_order_number = io.cs_order_number
  GROUP BY d_year, p_promo_name
  HAVING SUM(cs_net_profit) > 10000
)
SELECT
  d_year,
  p_promo_name,
  total_net_profit,
  total_return_amount,
  num_orders
FROM agg
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    sm.sm_carrier,
    ws_site.web_name,
    d_sold.d_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MIN(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales,
    MAX(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ws2.ws_ext_sales_price)
        FROM   web_sales ws2
        WHERE  ws2.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    ) AS ship_mode_total_sales
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer c_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN web_site ws_site
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_open
    ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_close
    ON ws_site.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk
WHERE 
    inv.inv_date_sk = 2450815
    AND sm.sm_carrier = 'DHL'
    AND ws_site.web_country = 'United States'
    AND d_sold.d_year = 2001
    AND c_bill.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (sm.sm_carrier, ws_site.web_name, d_sold.d_year),
    (sm.sm_carrier, ws_site.web_name),
    (sm.sm_carrier),
    (ws_site.web_name),
    ()
)
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM seq WHERE lvl < 5
),
sales_with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_ext_ship_cost,
        ws.ws_ext_tax,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_dep_count,
        w.web_name,
        w.web_tax_percentage,
        w.web_street_type
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_ship_cost > 200
      AND ws.ws_ext_tax < 500
      AND ws.ws_quantity >= 2
      AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1985
      AND cd.cd_dep_count >= 3
      AND w.web_tax_percentage >= 0.05
      AND w.web_street_type IN ('Ave', 'Ln')
      AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
)
SELECT
    swd.c_customer_id,
    swd.c_first_name,
    swd.c_last_name,
    swd.c_birth_year,
    swd.cd_gender,
    swd.web_name,
    swd.web_street_type,
    swd.ws_quantity,
    swd.ws_ext_ship_cost,
    swd.ws_ext_tax,
    swd.ws_net_profit,
    ROUND(swd.ws_net_profit / NULLIF(swd.ws_ext_ship_cost, 0), 2) AS profit_per_ship_cost,
    CASE
        WHEN swd.ws_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY swd.web_name ORDER BY swd.ws_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY swd.c_customer_id ORDER BY swd.ws_sold_date_sk DESC) AS recent_txn_seq,
    (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_profit)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_web_site_sk = swd.ws_web_site_sk) AS site_avg_net_profit,
    seq.lvl
FROM sales_with_dims swd
JOIN seq ON seq.lvl = ((swd.ws_quantity % 5) + 1)
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM web_sales ws3
    WHERE ws3.ws_bill_customer_sk = swd.ws_bill_customer_sk
      AND ws3.ws_net_profit > swd.ws_net_profit
      AND ws3.ws_sold_date_sk > swd.ws_sold_date_sk
)
ORDER BY swd.ws_net_profit DESC, swd.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE hour_seq AS (
    SELECT 0 AS hour_val
    UNION ALL
    SELECT hour_val + 1 FROM hour_seq WHERE hour_val < 23
),
sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        h.hour_val,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'NoLoss' END AS store_loss_flag
    FROM hour_seq h
    JOIN time_dim t ON t.t_hour = h.hour_val
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE s.s_store_name LIKE '%Store%'
      AND (r.r_reason_desc IS NULL OR regexp_like(r.r_reason_desc, 'damaged|lost'))
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, h.hour_val
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        sd.s_store_id,
        sd.s_store_name,
        sd.hour_val,
        sd.total_net_paid,
        sd.total_quantity,
        sd.distinct_customers,
        sd.total_return_qty,
        sd.total_net_loss,
        sd.store_loss_flag,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.hour_val ORDER BY sd.total_net_paid DESC) AS rank_by_sales,
        substring(sd.s_store_name, 1, 6) AS store_name_prefix,
        concat(sd.s_store_name, ' (Hour ', CAST(sd.hour_val AS varchar), ')') AS store_hour_label,
        regexp_extract(sd.s_store_name, '^([^ ]+)', 1) AS store_name_first_word,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM catalog_returns cr_sub
            JOIN time_dim t_sub ON cr_sub.cr_returned_time_sk = t_sub.t_time_sk
            JOIN store_sales ss_sub ON ss_sub.ss_sold_time_sk = t_sub.t_time_sk
            WHERE ss_sub.ss_store_sk = (
                SELECT s_int.s_store_sk
                FROM store s_int
                WHERE s_int.s_store_id = sd.s_store_id
            )
        ) AS total_returns_for_store,
        (
            SELECT avg(cr_avg.cr_net_loss)
            FROM catalog_returns cr_avg
            JOIN time_dim t_avg ON cr_avg.cr_returned_time_sk = t_avg.t_time_sk
            JOIN store_sales ss_avg ON ss_avg.ss_sold_time_sk = t_avg.t_time_sk
            WHERE ss_avg.ss_store_sk = (
                SELECT s_int2.s_store_sk
                FROM store s_int2
                WHERE s_int2.s_store_id = sd.s_store_id
            )
        ) AS avg_store_loss
    FROM sales_data sd
)
SELECT
    f.s_store_id,
    f.s_store_name,
    f.hour_val,
    f.total_net_paid,
    f.total_quantity,
    f.distinct_customers,
    f.total_return_qty,
    f.total_net_loss,
    f.store_loss_flag,
    f.rank_by_sales,
    f.store_name_prefix,
    f.store_hour_label,
    f.store_name_first_word,
    f.total_returns_for_store,
    f.avg_store_loss
FROM final f
WHERE f.rank_by_sales <= 10
ORDER BY f.hour_val, f.rank_by_sales
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_gmt_offset,
        cp.cp_type,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        p.p_discount_active,
        p.p_cost
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450820 AND 2450840
      AND cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost > 1000
      AND cc.cc_state IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX')
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND cp.cp_type IS NOT NULL
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_sk,
        cc_call_center_id,
        cc_state,
        cp_type,
        hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM base_sales
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (cc_call_center_id, cp_type, hd_buy_potential), cc_call_center_sk, cc_state
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_sk,
        cc_call_center_id,
        cc_state,
        cp_type,
        hd_buy_potential,
        total_net_profit,
        sales_cnt,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY cp_type ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_profit_by_cp,
        (SELECT MAX(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2) AS max_promo_cost
    FROM agg_sales
)
SELECT
    cc_call_center_id,
    cc_state,
    cp_type,
    hd_buy_potential,
    total_net_profit,
    sales_cnt,
    profit_rank,
    cum_profit_by_cp,
    max_promo_cost
FROM (
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_id,
        cc_state,
        cp_type,
        hd_buy_potential,
        total_net_profit,
        sales_cnt,
        profit_rank,
        cum_profit_by_cp,
        max_promo_cost
    FROM ranked_sales r
    WHERE total_net_profit > (
        SELECT AVG(cs2.cs_net_profit)
        FROM catalog_sales cs2
        WHERE cs2.cs_call_center_sk = r.cc_call_center_sk
    )
      AND hd_buy_potential IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT hd_buy_potential
        FROM household_demographics
        WHERE hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
      )
    UNION
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_id,
        cc_state,
        cp_type,
        hd_buy_potential,
        total_net_profit,
        sales_cnt,
        profit_rank,
        cum_profit_by_cp,
        max_promo_cost
    FROM ranked_sales r
    WHERE r.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM call_center cc2
        WHERE cc2.cc_call_center_sk = r.cc_call_center_sk
          AND cc2.cc_gmt_offset > -8
      )
      AND r.cp_type = 'Web'
) final_union
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH
sr_date AS (
  SELECT
    sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
    sr.sr_return_time_sk,
    sr.sr_item_sk,
    sr.sr_return_quantity,
    sr.sr_return_amt,
    sr.sr_net_loss,
    d.d_date,
    d.d_year,
    d.d_month_seq,
    d.d_day_name
  FROM store_returns sr
  FULL OUTER JOIN date_dim d
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
),
ws_base AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
    ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
    ws.ws_ship_date_sk,
    ws.ws_item_sk,
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    ws.ws_sales_price,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    ws.ws_promo_sk,
    ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
    d_sold.d_date AS sold_date,
    d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
    t_sold.t_hour AS sold_hour,
    p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
    sm_ws.sm_code AS ship_mode_code
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN time_dim t_sold

/*
Goal: Analyze net profit versus loss per warehouse and catalog page department, combining catalog sales and returns with full outer join, filtering pages of type starting with 'A', extracting information from page descriptions using regex and string functions, and comparing with web sales activity.
*/
WITH full_sales_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_net_loss
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.cp_description IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)electronic')
            THEN 'Electronic'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS page_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(fs.cs_order_number, fs.cr_order_number)) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(COALESCE(fs.cs_net_profit, 0) - COALESCE(fs.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS net_gain_loss,
    AVG(COALESCE(fs.cs_quantity, 0)) AS avg_quantity_sold,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
        FROM catalog_returns cr2
        WHERE cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    ) AS avg_return_amount_warehouse,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(COALESCE(fs.cs_quantity, 0)) > 0
            THEN SUM(COALESCE(fs.cr_return_quantity, 0)) / SUM(COALESCE(fs.cs_quantity, 0))
        ELSE 0
    END AS return_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_sales ws
            WHERE ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
              AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fs.cs_sold_date_sk
              AND ws.ws_sales_price > 100
        ) THEN 'High Web Sales'
        ELSE 'Low/No Web Sales'
    END AS web_sales_flag,
    cp.cp_type,
    cp.cp_description,
    substring(cp.cp_description, 1, 10) AS short_desc,
    regexp_extract(cp.cp_description, '(\\d{4})') AS extracted_year,
    cp.cp_type || '_' || cp.cp_department AS type_dept_concat
FROM full_sales_returns fs
LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON fs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse w
    ON COALESCE(fs.cs_warehouse_sk, fs.cr_warehouse_sk) = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE cp.cp_type LIKE 'A%'
  AND cp.cp_description IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.cp_description IS NOT NULL AND regexp_like(cp.cp_description, '(?i)electronic')
            THEN 'Electronic'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END,
    cp.cp_type,
    cp.cp_description,
    substring(cp.cp_description, 1, 10),
    regexp_extract(cp.cp_description, '(\\d{4})'),
    cp.cp_type || '_' || cp.cp_department
ORDER BY net_gain_loss DESC
OFFSET 0
LIMIT 100

WITH date_2001 AS (

    WHERE d_year = 2001
)
SELECT
    source_type,

    total_returns
FROM (

        CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS total_returns
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.p_discount_active

        WHERE p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS promo(p_discount_active)
    WHERE promo.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'warehouse' AS source_type,
        w.w_warehouse_id AS entity_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(
            (SELECT COUNT(*)
             FROM catalog_returns cr
             WHERE cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number)
        ) AS total_returns
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_2001 d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id
) AS combined
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
