/* Goal: Compare total sales and total return amounts for each gender and credit rating, and compute a running cumulative amount across the combined metric rows. */
WITH RECURSIVE
    sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            cd.cd_gender,
            cd.cd_credit_rating,
            SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
            COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
            ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        WHERE cs.cs_list_price > 100.00
        GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating
    ),
    returns_agg AS (
        SELECT
            cd.cd_gender,
            cd.cd_credit_rating,
            SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_returns,
            COUNT(*) AS return_txn_cnt
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN customer_demographics cd
            ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        WHERE cr.cr_store_credit > 100.00
        GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating
    ),
    combined_metrics AS (
        SELECT
            cd_gender,
            cd_credit_rating,
            total_sales AS total_amount,
            sales_txn_cnt AS txn_cnt,
            'Sale' AS metric_type
        FROM sales_agg
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            cd_gender,
            cd_credit_rating,
            total_returns AS total_amount,
            return_txn_cnt AS txn_cnt,
            'Return' AS metric_type
        FROM returns_agg
    ),
    ranked_metrics AS (
        SELECT
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn,
            metric_type,
            cd_gender,
            cd_credit_rating,
            total_amount,
            txn_cnt
        FROM combined_metrics
    ),
    cumulative AS (
        SELECT
            rn,
            metric_type,
            cd_gender,
            cd_credit_rating,
            total_amount,
            txn_cnt,
            total_amount AS cumulative_amount
        FROM ranked_metrics
        WHERE rn = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            rm.rn,
            rm.metric_type,
            rm.cd_gender,
            rm.cd_credit_rating,
            rm.total_amount,
            rm.txn_cnt,
            c.cumulative_amount + rm.total_amount
        FROM cumulative c
        JOIN ranked_metrics rm ON rm.rn = c.rn + 1
    )
SELECT
    rn,
    metric_type,
    cd_gender,
    cd_credit_rating,
    total_amount,
    txn_cnt,
    cumulative_amount
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY rn
LIMIT 100

WITH per_addr_time AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_zip,
        t.t_sub_shift,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_tax,
        sr.sr_refunded_cash,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
    FULL OUTER JOIN time_dim AS t
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN customer_address AS ca
        ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_return_tax > 5
      AND sr.sr_refunded_cash BETWEEN 50 AND 200
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY', 'FL')
      AND t.t_am_pm = 'PM'
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        ca_zip,
        t_sub_shift,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr_ticket_number) AS ticket_cnt,
        SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty,
        SUM(sr_return_tax) AS total_tax,
        AVG(sr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded,
        SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM per_addr_time
    GROUP BY ca_state, ca_zip, t_sub_shift
    HAVING SUM(sr_return_quantity) > 100
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT sr_ticket_number) >= 10
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    COUNT(*) AS num_groups,
    SUM(total_qty) AS grand_total_qty,
    AVG(avg_refunded) AS avg_of_avg_refunded,
    MAX(total_net_loss) AS max_total_net_loss
FROM aggregated
GROUP BY ca_state
ORDER BY max_total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE sales_facts AS (
    SELECT

        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,

)
SELECT

    (
        SELECT MAX(i_price.i_current_price)
        FROM tpcds.item i_price
        WHERE i_price.i_category = i_main.i_category
    ) AS max_price_in_category,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT sm_distinct.sm_ship_mode_id
            FROM tpcds.ship_mode sm_distinct
        ) uniq_modes
    ) AS total_distinct_ship_modes
FROM sales_facts ws
JOIN tpcds.item i_main

JOIN tpcds.item i_detail
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i_detail.i_item_sk
JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm_ship
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm_carrier
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_carrier.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm_contract
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_contract.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN tpcds.ship_mode sm_extra
    ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_extra.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN tpcds.web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk

GROUP BY ROLLUP (hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count, i_main.i_category, sm_carrier.sm_carrier)
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0
ORDER BY total_profit DESC

WITH RECURSIVE
    date_series AS (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT dd.d_date_sk, dd.d_date
        FROM date_series ds
        JOIN date_dim dd ON dd.d_date = ds.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
        WHERE dd.d_date <= DATE '2022-01-31'
    ),
    sales_data AS (
        SELECT
            ca.ca_state AS state,
            'sales' AS source,
            SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_amount,
            COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
            max_agg.max_net_paid AS max_metric
        FROM date_series ds
        JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT MAX(cs2.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS max_net_paid
            FROM catalog_sales cs2
            JOIN customer_address ca2 ON cs2.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca2.ca_address_sk
            WHERE ca2.ca_state = ca.ca_state
        ) max_agg
        GROUP BY ca.ca_state, max_agg.max_net_paid
    ),
    returns_data AS (
        SELECT
            ca.ca_state AS state,
            'returns' AS source,
            SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_amount,
            COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
            max_agg.max_return_amt AS max_metric
        FROM date_series ds
        JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT MAX(wr2.wr_return_amt) AS max_return_amt
            FROM web_returns wr2
            JOIN customer_address ca2 ON wr2.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca2.ca_address_sk
            WHERE ca2.ca_state = ca.ca_state
        ) max_agg
        GROUP BY ca.ca_state, max_agg.max_return_amt
    ),
    combined AS (
        SELECT state, source, total_amount, transaction_count, max_metric
        FROM sales_data
        UNION ALL
        SELECT state, source, total_amount, transaction_count, max_metric
        FROM returns_data
    )
SELECT
    c.state,
    c.source,
    c.total_amount,
    c.transaction_count,
    c.max_metric,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cc.total_amount)
        FROM combined cc
        WHERE cc.state = c.state
    ) AS state_total_amount
FROM combined c
ORDER BY c.state, c.source
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs_item_sk,
        cs_order_number,
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_ship_date_sk,
        cs_call_center_sk,
        cs_ship_mode_sk,
        cs_promo_sk,
        cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs_ship_cdemo_sk,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk,
             cs_order_number,
             cs_sold_date_sk,
             cs_ship_date_sk,
             cs_call_center_sk,
             cs_ship_mode_sk,
             cs_promo_sk,
             cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
             cs_ship_cdemo_sk
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_year AS sold_year,
    d_ship.d_year AS ship_year,
    cc.cc_name,
    sm.sm_type,
    p.p_promo_name,
    rp.r_reason_desc,
    s.s_store_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs_agg.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
    (SELECT MAX(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_promo_sk = cs_agg.cs_promo_sk) AS max_promo_cost
FROM cs_agg
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs_agg.cs_item_sk
   AND cr.cr_order_number = cs_agg.cs_order_number
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cs_agg.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cs_agg.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p
    ON cs_agg.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON cs_agg.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship
    ON cs_agg.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN reason rp
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = rp.r_reason_sk
JOIN store s
    ON d_return.d_date_sk = s.s_closed_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_cc_closed
    ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_closed.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_start
    ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_promo_start.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_promo_end
    ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_promo_end.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill
    ON cs_agg.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship
    ON cs_agg.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_refund
    ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refund.cd_demo_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = cs_agg.cs_order_number
JOIN web_page wp
    ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation
    ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_access
    ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
JOIN reason wr_reason
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = wr_reason.r_reason_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wr_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_return.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_date = DATE '2001-01-01'
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2
      WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = cs_agg.cs_order_number
        AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 0
  )
GROUP BY d_sold.d_year,
         d_ship.d_year,
         cc.cc_name,
         sm.sm_type,

    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_net_paid_inc_ship > 1000
      AND ws_ext_wholesale_cost < 3000

      AND ws_ship_mode_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk,
             ws_warehouse_sk,
             ws_promo_sk,
             ws_bill_customer_sk,
             ws_bill_cdemo_sk,
             ws_ship_customer_sk,
             ws_ship_cdemo_sk
)

    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws_agg.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_refunded_cash,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_discount_active,
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_state,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_department,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_street_name,
        i.inv_warehouse_sk,
        i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_am_pm
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND c.c_birth_year >= 1970
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 500
        AND ss.ss_net_paid >= 100
),

sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk      AS store_sk,
        p.p_promo_sk        AS promo_sk,
        'sales'             AS metric_type,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)      AS total_amount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)    AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category
    FROM base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (ss.ss_store_sk, p.p_promo_sk)
),

returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk      AS store_sk,
        p.p_promo_sk        AS promo_sk,
        'returns'           AS metric_type,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)           AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 500 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category
    FROM base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (ss.ss_store_sk, p.p_promo_sk)
)
SELECT
    store_sk,
    promo_sk,
    metric_type,
    total_amount,
    total_profit,
    profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY metric_type ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS amount_rank,
    RANK()        OVER (PARTITION BY metric_type ORDER BY total_profit DESC NULLS LAST) AS profit_rank
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns_agg
) combined
ORDER BY metric_type, amount_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH intersect_items AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS i_item_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td1 ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td1.t_time_sk
    WHERE td1.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS i_item_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td2 ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td2.t_time_sk
    WHERE td2.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
),
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer c
    WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
      AND c.c_birth_country = 'United States'
)
SELECT
    agg.c_customer_id,
    agg.s_store_name,
    agg.i_product_name,
    agg.total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN agg.total_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN agg.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY agg.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_product_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit + COALESCE(cs.cs_net_profit, 0) + ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM intersect_items ii
    JOIN item i ON ii.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td_ws.t_time_sk
    WHERE
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT c_customer_sk FROM filtered_customers)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_returns sr
            WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_returns wr
            WHERE wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        )
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_product_name
) agg
ORDER BY agg.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

JOIN item_recursive ir ON i.i_item_sk = ir.i_item_sk

JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk

    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 100001 AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 150000
    AND ws.ws_ext_ship_cost > 500
    AND ss.ss_item_sk IN (SELECT cr_item_sk FROM catalog_returns WHERE cr_return_quantity > 0)

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,

        s.s_store_name,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_net_paid AS store_net_paid,
        ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS store_discount,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS web_net_paid,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS web_discount,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS catalog_net_paid,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS catalog_discount,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS store_return_loss,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS web_return_loss
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p_ss
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_ss.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p_ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p_cs
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ss
        ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cs
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_cs.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_cs
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_ws
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE t_ss.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 18
)
SELECT
    s_store_name,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    SUM(COALESCE(store_net_paid, 0)) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(web_net_paid, 0)) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(catalog_net_paid, 0)) AS total_catalog_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(store_return_loss, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(web_return_loss, 0)) AS net_return_diff,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_paid)
     FROM store_sales ss2
     WHERE ss2.ss_store_sk = sales.s_store_sk) AS avg_store_sales_per_store,
    (SELECT AVG(p2.p_cost)
     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p2.p_cost
           FROM promotion p2
           WHERE p2.p_discount_active = 'Y') p2) AS avg_active_promo_cost
FROM sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP(s_store_name, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound)
ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_exclusive AS (
    SELECT p.p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion p
    WHERE p.p_promo_sk IN (SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk FROM store_sales ss)
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk FROM catalog_sales cs
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_ss.d_year,
        p.p_promo_name,
        ib.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower,
        ib.ib_upper_bound AS income_upper,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_catalog_quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss,0))) > 1000000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) + SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss,0))) BETWEEN 100000 AND 1000000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category,
        (SELECT AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk) AS avg_catalog_discount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_date_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd_ss.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs 
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_ss.d_date_sk
        AND cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr 
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_ss.d_date_sk
        AND wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE d_date_ss.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
      AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
      AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 200000
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND (w.w_country = 'United States' OR w.w_warehouse_sk IS NULL)
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM web_returns wr2
          WHERE wr2.wr_return_quantity > 5
            AND wr2.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
            AND wr2.wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_ss.d_date_sk
      )
      AND p.p_promo_sk IN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promo_exclusive)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d_date_ss.d_year, p.p_promo_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound),
        (d_date_ss.d_year, p.p_promo_name),
        (d_date_ss.d_year),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT 
    d_year,
    p_promo_name,
    income_lower,
    income_upper,
    store_net_profit,
    catalog_net_profit,
    total_return_loss,
    total_store_quantity,
    total_catalog_quantity,
    profit_category,
    avg_catalog_discount
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY d_year DESC, p_promo_name ASC, profit_category DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    store_return_agg AS (
        SELECT
            sr.sr_store_sk,
            sr.sr_item_sk,
            sr.sr_customer_sk,
            SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)        AS store_return_amt,
            SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)          AS store_net_loss,
            COUNT(*)                     AS store_return_cnt
        FROM store_returns sr
        GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_customer_sk
    ),
    catalog_return_agg AS (
        SELECT
            cr.cr_item_sk,
            cr.cr_call_center_sk,
            cr.cr_catalog_page_sk,
            SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)    AS catalog_return_amt,
            SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)         AS catalog_net_loss,
            COUNT(*)                    AS catalog_return_cnt
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
    ),
    web_return_agg AS (
        SELECT
            wr.wr_item_sk,
            wr.wr_order_number,
            SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)       AS web_return_amt,
            SUM(wr.wr_net_loss)        AS web_net_loss,
            COUNT(*)                    AS web_return_cnt
        FROM web_returns wr
        GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_order_number
    ),
    web_sales_agg AS (
        SELECT
            ws.ws_item_sk,
            ws.ws_order_number,
            ws.ws_web_site_sk,
            ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
            ws.ws_net_profit,
            ws.ws_sold_date_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2451175
    )
SELECT
    agg.store_state,
    agg.website_state,
    agg.i_category,
    agg.total_store_return,
    agg.total_catalog_return,
    agg.total_web_return,
    agg.total_return_amount,
    agg.return_rows,
    agg.avg_discount,
    agg.avg_site_discount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.store_state ORDER BY agg.total_return_amount DESC) AS state_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.s_state                                   AS store_state,
        we.web_state                               AS website_state,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(sra.store_return_amt)                  AS total_store_return,
        SUM(cra.catalog_return_amt)                AS total_catalog_return,
        SUM(wra.web_return_amt)                    AS total_web_return,
        SUM(COALESCE(sra.store_return_amt, 0) + COALESCE(cra.catalog_return_amt, 0) + COALESCE(wra.web_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*)                                   AS return_rows,
        AVG(wsa.ws_ext_discount_amt)               AS avg_discount,
        (SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_ext_discount_amt)
         FROM web_sales ws2
         WHERE ws2.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk) AS avg_site_discount
    FROM store_return_agg sra
    JOIN store s               ON s.s_store_sk = sra.sr_store_sk
    JOIN item i                ON i.i_item_sk = sra.sr_item_sk
    JOIN catalog_return_agg cra ON cra.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center cc        ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cra.cr_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp        ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cra.cr_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN web_return_agg wra    ON wra.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales_agg wsa     ON wsa.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
                                 AND wsa.ws_order_number = wra.wr_order_number
    JOIN web_site we           ON we.web_site_sk = wsa.ws_web_site_sk
    JOIN customer c            ON c.c_customer_sk = sra.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
        AND i.i_rec_end_date <= DATE '2002-12-31'
        AND s.s_city = 'San Francisco'
        AND we.web_country = 'United States'
        AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
        AND hd.hd_income_band_sk = 15
        AND cp.cp_catalog_number IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_state, we.web_state, i.i_category)
) agg
ORDER BY agg.total_return_amount DESC
OFFSET 0 LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE levels AS (
    SELECT 1 AS lvl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM levels WHERE lvl < 5
),
full_join AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_current_price,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        p.p_discount_active,
        ca.ca_state,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        w.w_city,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    WHERE
        cr.cr_return_quantity > 1
        AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 500
        AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 100 AND 500
        AND w.w_city = 'Los Angeles'
        AND td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT inv_item_sk FROM inventory WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        cr_returned_date_sk,
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        t_hour,
        i_item_sk,
        i_current_price,
        ss_net_profit,
        ss_net_paid,
        ws_net_paid,
        p_discount_active,
        ca_state,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        ib_upper_bound,
        w_city,
        inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY ss_net_paid DESC) AS rn,
        CASE WHEN ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
        lvl
    FROM full_join
    JOIN levels ON levels.lvl = (cs_sold_date_sk % 5) + 1
    WHERE ss_net_profit > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cr_returned_date_sk,
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        t_hour,
        i_item_sk,
        i_current_price,
        ss_net_profit,
        ss_net_paid,
        ws_net_paid,
        p_discount_active,
        ca_state,
        hd_income_band_sk,
        ib_upper_bound,
        w_city,
        inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY ss_net_paid ASC) AS rn,
        CASE WHEN ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
        lvl
    FROM full_join
    JOIN levels ON levels.lvl = ((cs_sold_date_sk + 2) % 5) + 1
    WHERE ss_net_profit <= 0
) AS combined
ORDER BY rn
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk,
           d.d_date,
           1 AS lvl
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_date = DATE '2002-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_next.d_date_sk,
           d_next.d_date,
           dr.lvl + 1
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d_next ON d_next.d_date = dr.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE dr.lvl < 30
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d.d_year,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    ca.ca_state,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_ext_sales,
    (
        SELECT SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price)
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
        WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND cp.cp_type = 'RECENT'
    ) AS catalog_sales_total,
    (
        SELECT SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price)
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    ) AS web_sales_total,
    (
        SELECT w.w_warehouse_name
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        ORDER BY cs.cs_order_number DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS recent_warehouse_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) DESC) AS store_rank
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON dr.d_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2002
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND hd.hd_income_band_sk = 12
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d.d_year,
    d.d_date_sk,
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    ca.ca_state
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 100000
ORDER BY store_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
   SELECT
       i.i_category AS i_category,
       p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
       cp.cp_catalog_page_number AS catalog_page_number,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
       SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_quantity_sold,
       SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
       SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_quantity_sold,
       COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0) AS total_return_amount,
       COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_quantity,
       (SELECT SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS total_inventory
   FROM
       catalog_sales cs
       JOIN catalog_page cp
         ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
       JOIN item i
         ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       JOIN promotion p
         ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
       LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
         ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
         AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
       JOIN web_sales ws
         ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
         AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
       JOIN web_page wp
         ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
       JOIN customer_demographics cd
         ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   WHERE
       i.i_category = 'Electronics'
       AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
       AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
       AND wp.wp_image_count >= 2
       AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450860 AND 2451170
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM inventory inv
           WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
             AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
       )
   GROUP BY
       ROLLUP (i.i_category, p.p_promo_name, cp.cp_catalog_page_number)
)
SELECT
    i_category,
    promo_name,
    catalog_page_number,
    (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    (catalog_quantity_sold + web_quantity_sold) AS total_quantity_sold,
    total_return_amount,
    total_return_quantity,
    total_inventory,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM
    sales_agg
WHERE
    i_category IS NOT NULL
HAVING
    (catalog_net_profit + web_net_profit) > 10000
ORDER BY
    i_category,
    profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH item_return_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    ws.ws_order_number,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    d_sold.d_date AS sold_date,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
    ws.ws_net_paid,
    irs.total_return_qty,
    irs.total_return_amount,
    irs.total_net_loss,
    sm_ws.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    w_ws.w_warehouse_name,
    p.p_promo_id AS promo_id,
    latest_promo.p_promo_id AS latest_promo_id,
    wp.wp_url,
    ws_site.web_name AS web_site_name,
    cd_bill.cd_gender AS bill_customer_gender,
    cp.cp_type AS catalog_page_type,
    store.s_store_name,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY ws.ws_ext_sales_price DESC) AS category_sales_rank,
    LAG(ws.ws_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_sk ORDER BY d_sold.d_date) AS prev_net_paid,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_sk ORDER BY d_sold.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sales_amount,
    (SELECT AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount)
       FROM catalog_returns cr2
      WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS avg_return_amount
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN warehouse w_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w_cr.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
JOIN store ON store.s_closed_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_store ON store.s_closed_date_sk = d_store.d_date_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p2.p_promo_id
      FROM promotion p2
     WHERE p2.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
       AND p2.p_start_date_sk <= d_sold.d_date_sk
       AND p2.p_end_date_sk >= d_sold.d_date_sk
     ORDER BY p2.p_end_date_sk DESC
     LIMIT 1
) AS latest_promo(p_promo_id)
JOIN item_return_summary irs ON irs.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2002
  AND i.i_brand = 'BrandA'
  AND sm_ws.sm_type = 'AIR'
  AND store.s_state = 'CA'
  AND cp.cp_type = 'monthly'
  AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
ORDER BY category_sales_rank ASC, running_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
  SELECT
    d_ss.d_year AS year,
    sm1.sm_carrier AS ship_carrier,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'POS'
      WHEN ss.ss_net_profit = 0 THEN 'ZERO'
      ELSE 'NEG'
    END AS profit_sign,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_store_returns,
    SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_web_returns,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_catalog_returns,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales ss2 WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk) AS cust_store_sales_count
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d_ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_ss.d_date_sk
  JOIN time_dim t_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
  JOIN customer c_ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_ss.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk

  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk

  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
   AND cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
  LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm1 ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm1.sm_ship_mode_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_cc_open.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cc_closed ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_cc_closed.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cp_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cp_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk

  LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
  LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm2 ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk

  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
   AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr.t_time_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_wr_refund.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_wr_refund.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_wr_refund ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr_refund.hd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_page wp_wr ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp_wr.wp_web_page_sk

  WHERE d_ss.d_year = 2001
  GROUP BY
    d_ss.d_year,
    sm1.sm_carrier,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN 'POS'
      WHEN ss.ss_net_profit = 0 THEN 'ZERO'
      ELSE 'NEG'
    END
)

SELECT
  year,
  ship_carrier,
  profit_sign,
  total_store_sales,
  total_store_returns,
  total_web_sales,
  total_web_returns,
  total_catalog_returns,
  cust_store_sales_count
FROM sales_agg
WHERE total_store_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_store_sales) FROM sales_agg)
ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE order_numbers AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk AS bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk AS ship_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_addr_sk AS ship_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_addr_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        o.lvl + 1
    FROM order_numbers o
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_order_number = o.order_number
    WHERE o.lvl < 2
)
SELECT
    i.i_category AS item_category,
    ca_bill.ca_state AS customer_state,
    SUM(o.net_profit) AS total_catalog_sales_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0)) AS total_store_sales_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_profit, 0)) AS total_web_sales_profit,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_catalog_returns_loss,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_store_returns_loss,
    SUM(
        COALESCE(o.net_profit, 0) +
        COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0) +
        COALESCE(ws.ws_net_profit, 0) -
        COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0) -
        COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)
    ) AS net_total,
    (SELECT AVG(i2.i_current_price) FROM item i2) AS avg_item_price_all,
    (SELECT MAX(cr3.cr_refunded_cash) FROM catalog_returns cr3 WHERE cr3.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) AS max_refunded_cash_for_item
FROM order_numbers o
JOIN item i
    ON o.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sold
    ON o.sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN customer c_bill
    ON o.bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
    ON o.bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON o.bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer c_ship
    ON o.ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
    ON o.ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ship
    ON o.ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = o.order_number
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_return
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refunded.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_refunded
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t_ss.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr
    ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site web
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = web.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c_wp
    ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_wp.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY i.i_category, ca_bill.ca_state
ORDER BY net_total DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_sales_price,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_call_center_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
        cs.cs_bill_addr_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim td_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td_cs.t_time_sk
    WHERE td_cs.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 1
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    we.web_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    AVG(ws.ws_net_paid) AS avg_web_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS earliest_sold_date_sk,
    MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS latest_sold_date_sk,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_returns cr_sub WHERE cr_sub.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number) AS returns_per_order,
    (SELECT AVG(cr_sub2.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr_sub2 WHERE cr_sub2.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number) AS avg_return_amount_per_order
FROM filtered_sales cs
-- Core dimensions
JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
-- Catalog returns
JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
                     AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
JOIN time_dim td_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td_cr.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
JOIN call_center cc2 ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc2.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN warehouse w2 ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
-- Web sales
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN time_dim td_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td_ws.t_time_sk
JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
JOIN promotion p_ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ws ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_ws.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ws ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ws.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ws ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_ws.hd_demo_sk
-- Store returns (linked via shared dimensions)
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
                      AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
                      AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN time_dim td_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td_sr.t_time_sk
JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
-- Inventory
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND we.web_market_manager = 'John Sheppard'
  AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
  AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
  AND r_cr.r_reason_desc = 'Customer Not Satisfied'
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    cc.cc_name,
    p.p_promo_name,
    we.web_name
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.s_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_addr_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.s_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_hdemo_sk, ss.ss_addr_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk
),
word_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        i.i_item_sk,
        word,
        COUNT(*) AS word_cnt
    FROM item i
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(i.i_item_desc, ' ')) AS t(word)
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, word
),
store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS store_returns_cnt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amt,
        MIN(sr.sr_reason_sk) AS store_return_reason_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_item_sk
),
web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS web_returns_cnt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amt,
        MIN(wr.wr_reason_sk) AS web_return_reason_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_item_sk
),
joined AS (
    SELECT 
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_state,
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_year,
        pi.i_category,
        cp_l.cp_type,
        wc.word,
        wc.word_cnt,
        SUM(sa.total_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
        SUM(sa.total_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(COALESCE(sra.store_returns_cnt, 0)) AS total_store_returns,
        SUM(COALESCE(wra.web_returns_cnt, 0)) AS total_web_returns
    FROM sales_agg sa
    JOIN store s ON sa.s_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON sa.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            p.p_promo_sk,
            p.p_item_sk,
            p.p_discount_active,
            i.i_item_sk,
            i.i_category,
            i.i_brand
        FROM promotion p
        FULL OUTER JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) pi ON (pi.p_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk OR pi.p_promo_sk = sa.ss_promo_sk)
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON sa.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sa.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns_agg sra 
        ON sra.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
       AND sra.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND sra.sr_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sra.store_return_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns_agg wra 
        ON wra.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
       AND wra.wr_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wra.web_return_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cp.cp_type
        FROM catalog_page cp
        WHERE cp.cp_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS cp_l
    LEFT JOIN word_counts wc ON wc.i_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk
    WHERE 
        d.d_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
        AND d.d_date < DATE '2022-01-01'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND pi.i_brand = 'Brand#12'
        AND pi.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP(s.s_store_name, s.s_state, d.d_year, pi.i_category, cp_l.cp_type, wc.word, d.d_date_sk, s.s_store_sk)
    HAVING SUM(sa.total_quantity) > 100
)
SELECT 
    j.s_store_name,
    j.s_state,
    j.d_year,
    j.i_category,
    j.cp_type,
    j.word,
    j.word_cnt,
    j.total_sales,
    j.total_quantity,
    j.total_store_returns,
    j.total_web_returns,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY j.d_year ORDER BY j.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM store_returns sr2 
        WHERE sr2.sr_store_sk = j.s_store_sk 
          AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = j.d_date_sk) AS returns_on_date
FROM joined j
ORDER BY

SELECT
    i.i_brand,
    ca.ca_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_transactions,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MIN(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS min_coupon,
    MAX(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_inventory_qty,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
        FROM store_sales ss2
        WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    ) AS max_sales_price_per_item
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE
    i.i_brand = 'exportischolar #2'
    AND i.i_class_id IN (5, 7, 10)
    AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
    AND ca.ca_city = 'San Francisco'
    AND ss.ss_ext_sales_price > 1000.00
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= 50
GROUP BY i.i_brand, ca.ca_state
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 5000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH RECURSIVE number_series AS (
    SELECT 1 AS metric
    UNION ALL
    SELECT metric + 1
    FROM number_series
    WHERE metric < 5
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cr.cr_fee,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        d_sold.d_year,
        d_ret.d_year AS return_year,
        hd_bill.hd_demo_sk,
        hd_bill.hd_buy_potential,
        ca.ca_state,
        wp.wp_type,
        wr.wr_net_loss
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2000
      AND hd_bill.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND cs.cs_net_profit > 0
      AND cr.cr_fee > 30
      AND wp.wp_type = 'Content'
      AND (wr.wr_net_loss IS NULL OR wr.wr_net_loss < 100)
)
SELECT
    bd.d_year,
    bd.return_year,
    bd.hd_demo_sk,
    bd.hd_buy_potential,
    bd.ca_state,
    bd.cs_order_number,
    bd.cs_net_profit,
    bd.cr_net_loss,
    CASE WHEN bd.cs_net_profit > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bd.hd_demo_sk ORDER BY bd.cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(cs_sub.cs_net_profit)
     FROM catalog_sales cs_sub
     WHERE cs_sub.cs_sold_date_sk = bd.cs_sold_date_sk) AS avg_profit_by_sold_date,
    ns.metric
FROM base_data bd
CROSS JOIN number_series ns
ORDER BY bd.d_year DESC, profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss.ss_ext_tax,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_current_price,
        i.i_manager_id,
        i.i_category,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM
        store_sales ss
            TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (5)
        JOIN item i
            ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN customer c
            ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        JOIN promotion p
            ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
            AND p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
            ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
            AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
            AND sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
            ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN inventory inv
            ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450835 AND 2451270
        AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 200
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= 10
        AND i.i_brand_id IN (6, 19, 27)
),

agg_data AS (
    SELECT
        bd.i_item_sk,
        bd.i_brand,
        bd.c_customer_sk,
        SUM(bd.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(bd.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt,
        SUM(COALESCE(bd.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(COALESCE(bd.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_amt
    FROM
        base_data bd
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (bd.i_item_sk, bd.i_brand, bd.c_customer_sk),
        (bd.i_item_sk, bd.i_brand),
        (bd.c_customer_sk)
    )
)

SELECT
    ad.i_item_sk,
    ad.i_brand,
    ad.c_customer_sk,
    ad.total_sales,
    ad.avg_sales_price,
    ad.trans_cnt,
    ad.total_return_amt,
    ad.total_catalog_return_amt,
    (SELECT SUM(sr2.sr_return_amt)
     FROM store_returns sr2
     WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = ad.i_item_sk) AS overall_item_return_amt,
    (SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount)
     FROM catalog_returns cr2
     WHERE cr2.cr_item_sk = ad.i_item_sk) AS max_catalog_return_amt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.i_brand ORDER BY ad.total_sales DESC) AS brand_sales_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN GROUPING(ad.c_customer_sk) = 0 AND GROUPING(ad.i_brand) = 0 THEN 'Detailed'
        WHEN GROUPING(ad.c_customer_sk) = 1 AND GROUPING(ad.i_brand) = 0 THEN 'BrandOnly'
        WHEN GROUPING(ad.c_customer_sk) = 0 AND GROUPING(ad.i_brand) = 1 THEN 'CustomerOnly'
        ELSE 'GrandTotal'
    END AS grouping_level
FROM
    agg_data ad
ORDER BY
    ad.total_sales DESC,
    brand_sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_date,
        d_holiday,
        d_fy_quarter_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '1998-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        d_next.d_date_sk,
        d_next.d_date,
        d_next.d_holiday,
        d_next.d_fy_quarter_seq
    FROM date_range dr
    JOIN date_dim d_next
        ON d_next.d_date = dr.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d_next.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-07'
),

sampled_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_store_sk,
        ss_ticket_number,
        ss_quantity,
        ss_sales_price,
        ss_ext_sales_price,
        ss_wholesale_cost,
        ss_net_paid,
        ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    WHERE ss_quantity > 0
)

SELECT
    d.d_date,
    s.s_store_name,
    i.i_brand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_holiday = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS holiday_store_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.s_tax_percentage > 5 THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS high_tax_store_sales,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ss.ss_quantity > 0 THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS avg_store_price,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_ext_sales_price)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        JOIN item i2 ON ws2.ws_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
        WHERE i2.i_brand = i.i_brand
    ) AS max_web_price_for_brand,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_web_sales_price
FROM date_range d
JOIN sampled_store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_site we
    ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
JOIN date_dim d_wp_creation
    ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_creation.d_date_sk
WHERE
    d.d_holiday = 'N'
    AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
    AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    AND we.web_manager = 'Adam Stonge'
    AND wp.wp_type = 'content'
    AND ws.ws_sales_price > 20
GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (s.s_store_name, i.i_brand, d.d_date)
ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE levels(lvl) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lvl + 1 FROM levels WHERE lvl < 3
),
joined_all AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_net_loss,
        wr.wr_reason_sk,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_category_id,
        i.i_manager_id,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_warehouse_sq_ft,
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        r.r_reason_id,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        td.t_time,
        td.t_hour,
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_url,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
        AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE
        i.i_category_id = 3
        AND w.w_warehouse_sq_ft > 800000
        AND i.i_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
        AND i.i_rec_end_date < DATE '2003-01-01'
),
unnested_data AS (
    SELECT
        ja.*,
        word
    FROM joined_all ja
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(ja.i_product_name, ' ')) AS t(word)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        w_warehouse_name,
        i_category,
        MIN(cs_order_number) AS sample_order_number,
        SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_cs_net_paid,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_cr_loss,
        SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_wr_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
    FROM unnested_data
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (c_customer_id, w_warehouse_name, i_category),
        (c_customer_id, w_warehouse_name),
        (c_customer_id),
        (w_warehouse_name),
        ()
    )
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY total_cs_net_paid DESC) AS rn,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_returns cr_sub WHERE cr_sub.cr_order_number = a.sample_order_number) AS returns_for_sample_order
    FROM aggregated a
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reason r_check)
)
SELECT
    f.c_customer_id,
    f.w_warehouse_name,
    f.i_category,
    f.total_cs_net_paid,
    f.total_ws_net_paid,
    f.total_cr_loss,
    f.total_wr_loss,
    f.txn_cnt,
    f.rn,
    f.returns_for_sample_order,
    lvl.lvl
FROM final f
JOIN levels lvl ON lvl.lvl <= 3
WHERE f.rn = 1
ORDER BY f.total_cs_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_series AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) AS t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ts.t_time_sk + 1
    FROM time_series ts
    WHERE ts.t_time_sk < (SELECT MAX(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim)
),
union_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        'store' AS channel,
        sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_time_sk AS return_time_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        'web' AS channel,
        wr.wr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
        wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        wr.wr_returned_time_sk AS return_time_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
       AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_current_price, i.i_formulation, i.i_size, i.i_category
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 1.00 AND 10.00
      AND i.i_size = 'large'
      AND i.i_formulation LIKE '%rosy%'
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
)
SELECT
    f.i_item_id,
    f.i_product_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    (SELECT s.s_store_name
       FROM store s
       JOIN store_returns sr
         ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
       WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = f.i_item_sk
         AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
       LIMIT 1) AS store_name,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    (SELECT wp.wp_type
       FROM web_page wp
       JOIN web_sales ws
         ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
       WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = f.i_item_sk
         AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
       LIMIT 1) AS web_page_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS catalog_return_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 100 THEN cr.cr_return_amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_catalog_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss,
    SUM(ur.net_loss) AS total_other_returns_net_loss,
    (SELECT SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship)
       FROM web_sales ws
       WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = f.i_item_sk
         AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk) AS total_web_sales,
    (SELECT MAX(i2.i_current_price)
       FROM item i2
       WHERE i2.i_brand = 'BrandX') AS max_price_brandX,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(ur.net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'HighLoss'
        ELSE 'LowLoss'
    END AS loss_category
FROM filtered_items f
JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_item_sk = f.i_item_sk
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN time_dim t
  ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN union_returns ur
  ON ur.item_sk = f.i_item_sk
JOIN time_series ts
  ON ts.t_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_returns sr
    WHERE sr.sr_item_sk = f.i_item_sk
      AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_item_sk = f.i_item_sk
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 10
      AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
)
GROUP BY
    f.i_item_sk,
    f.i_item_id,
    f.i_product_name,
    cp.cp_department,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    t.t_time_sk
ORDER BY total_other_returns_net_loss DESC, f.i_item_id
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT DATE '1998-01-01' AS d
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_add('day', 1, d) FROM date_range WHERE d < DATE '1998-01-10'
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_state,
        d1.d_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS store_sales_txn,
        COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS store_returns_net_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price), 0) AS catalog_sales_ext_sales,
        COALESCE(SUM(ws.ws_net_paid), 0) AS web_sales_net_paid,
        COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS web_returns_net_loss,
        AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_cnt,
        MIN(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS min_income_lower,
        MAX(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS max_income_upper
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t1 ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t1.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sr_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sr_ret.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sr_ret ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr_ret.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_wr_ret.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_wr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_wr_ret.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON d1.d_date = dr.d
    WHERE
        d1.d_date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
        AND d1.d_date <= DATE '1998-01-10'
        AND i.i_brand = 'Brand#24'
        AND s.s_state = 'CA'
        AND t1.t_meal_time = 'breakfast'
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
        AND r_sr.r_reason_desc IS NOT NULL AND r_sr.r_reason_desc LIKE '%defective%'
        AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
        AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2 WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr2.wr_return_quantity > 0)
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_state,
        d1.d_year
),
brand_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i_brand,
        SUM(store_sales_net_paid) AS total_store_sales_net_paid,
        SUM(store_sales_net_profit) AS total_store_sales_net_profit,
        SUM(store_returns_net_loss) AS total_store_returns_net_loss,
        SUM(web_returns_net_loss) AS total_web_returns_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS num_groups
    FROM base_agg
    GROUP BY i_brand
    HAVING (SUM(store_sales_net_profit) - SUM(store_returns_net_loss) - SUM(web_returns_net_loss)) / NULLIF(SUM(store_sales_net_paid), 0) > 0.05
)
SELECT
    ba.i_brand,
    ba.total_store_sales_net_paid,
    ba.total_store_sales_net_profit,
    ba.total_store_returns_net_loss,
    ba.total_web_returns_net_loss,
    (ba.total_store_sales_net_profit - ba.total_store_returns_net_loss - ba.total_web_returns_net_loss) / NULLIF(ba.total_store_sales_net_paid, 0) AS net_margin_ratio,
    ba.num_groups
FROM brand_agg ba
ORDER BY ba.total_store_sales_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
  item_words AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_sk,
           i.i_item_id,
           i.i_category,
           w.word
    FROM item i
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(i.i_item_desc, ' ')) AS t(word)
    
  ),
  union_sales AS (
    -- Store sales aggregation
    SELECT d.d_year AS sale_year,
           ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           i.i_category AS category,
           i.i_units AS descriptor,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY d.d_year,
             ss.ss_item_sk,
             i.i_item_id,
             i.i_category,
             i.i_units
    UNION ALL
    -- Catalog sales aggregation with expanded item description words
    SELECT d.d_year AS sale_year,
           cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
           i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           i.i_category AS category,
           w.word AS descriptor,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN item_words w ON i.i_item_sk = w.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY d.d_year,
             cs.cs_item_sk,
             i.i_item_id,
             i.i_category,
             w.word
  )
SELECT us.sale_year,
       us.item_sk,
       us.item_id,
       us.category,
       us.descriptor,
       us.total_net_paid,
       us.transaction_count,
       (
         SELECT SUM(ss2.ss_net_paid)
         FROM store_sales ss2
         WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = us.item_sk
       ) AS overall_store_net_paid
FROM union_sales us
ORDER BY us.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d_sold.d_year AS year,
        d_sold.d_month_seq AS month_seq,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
        cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
        p.p_channel_tv AS promo_channel_tv,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE' ELSE 'NEGATIVE' END AS profit_category,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_page_char_count,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sold
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t_ret
        ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wp_create
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_wp_create.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_wp_access
        ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d_sold.d_year = 2001
        AND w.w_state = 'CA'
        AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        AND cc.cc_country = 'United States'
        AND wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
        AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000
        AND cs.cs_quantity >= 2
        AND cs.cs_net_paid >= 100
    GROUP BY
        d_sold.d_year,
        d_sold.d_month_seq,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        cc.cc_name,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE' ELSE 'NEGATIVE' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *
    FROM base_sales
    WHERE FALSE
)
SELECT
    year,
    month_seq,
    warehouse_name,
    call_center_name,
    promo_channel_tv,
    profit_category,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) AS sum_total_sales_amount,
    SUM(total_profit) AS sum_total_profit,
    SUM(order_cnt) AS sum_order_cnt,
    SUM(total_return_amount) AS sum_total_return_amount,
    AVG(avg_page_char_count) AS avg_page_char_count_overall,
    SUM(total_inventory_qty) AS sum_total_inventory_qty,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_profit) > 0 THEN 'OVERALL_GOOD' ELSE 'OVERALL_BAD' END AS overall_profit_flag
FROM base_sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP (year, month_seq, warehouse_name, call_center_name, promo_channel_tv, profit_category)
HAVING SUM(total_sales_amount) > 5000
ORDER BY sum_total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_cs_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_cs_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_cs_orders
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 2
      AND cs.cs_ext_sales_price > 100.0
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_sk,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_category,
    ib.ib_income_band_sk,
    ib.ib_lower_bound,
    ib.ib_upper_bound,
    hd.hd_dep_count,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_cs_sales) AS total_cs_sales,
    SUM(cs_agg.total_cs_quantity) AS total_cs_quantity,
    SUM(cs_agg.distinct_cs_orders) AS total_distinct_orders,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_store_tickets,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk) AS distinct_refunded_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_reason_sk) AS distinct_return_reasons,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand,
    lateral_max.max_cs_ext_sales_price
FROM cs_agg
JOIN item i ON cs_agg.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
JOIN income_band ib ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
