JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MAX(cs3.cs_ext_sales_price) AS max_cs_ext_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs3
    WHERE cs3.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
) AS lateral_max
WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200
  AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 100000
  AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 160000
  AND hd.hd_dep_count <= 4
  AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 0
  AND ss.ss_quantity > 1
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 10
  AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_sales cs_check
        WHERE cs_check.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND cs_check.cs_sales_price > 150.0
      )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_vehicle_count, lateral_max.max_cs_ext_sales_price),
    (i.i_category, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound),
    ()
)
ORDER BY i.i_category ASC, total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH RECURSIVE recursive_sales (item_sk, category, item_class, total_sales, level) AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_class AS item_class,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) + SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        1 AS level
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_cs ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_cs ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_ws ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_cs ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_cs.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd_cs.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td_cs.t_time_sk
    JOIN time_dim td_ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_ss.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN time_dim td_wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td_wr.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_wr.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE i.i_class_id IN (15, 16)
      AND i.i_category_id = 9
      AND i.i_formulation LIKE '%goldenrod%'
      AND hd_cs.hd_buy_potential = '501-1000'
      AND hd_cs.hd_vehicle_count >= 0
      AND td_cs.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 18
      AND cs.cs_ext_ship_cost > 500
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_category, i.i_class
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        item_sk,
        category,
        item_class,
        total_sales,
        level + 1
    FROM recursive_sales
    WHERE level < 3
),
cat_sales AS (
    SELECT i.i_category AS category,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_category
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT i.i_category AS category,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_category
),
union_sales AS (
    SELECT category, total_sales FROM cat_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT category, total_sales FROM web_sales_agg
)
SELECT
    rs.level,
    rs.item_sk,
    rs.category,
    rs.item_class,
    SUM(rs.total_sales) AS agg_total_sales,
    us.total_sales AS category_total_sales,
    (SELECT MAX(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_ext_ship_cost > 0) AS max_ship_cost,
    (SELECT AVG(inv2.inv_quantity_on_hand) FROM inventory inv2 WHERE inv2.inv_item_sk = rs.item_sk) AS avg_inventory_per_item
FROM recursive_sales rs
JOIN union_sales us ON us.category = rs.category
GROUP BY rs.level, rs.item_sk, rs.category, rs.item_class, us.total_sales
HAVING SUM(rs.total_sales) > 1000
ORDER BY agg_total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
intersect_items AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_item_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 2000
    INTERSECT
    SELECT i.i_item_sk
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_wholesale_cost < 1
),
agg_returns AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promo') AS promo_name,
        CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_return_quantity) AS decimal(10,2)) AS metric_a,
        SUM(DISTINCT cr.cr_return_amount) AS metric_b,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN promotion p
        ON i.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT cr_item_sk FROM intersect_items)
      AND i.i_wholesale_cost < 5
      AND (p.p_channel_demo = 'N' OR p.p_channel_demo IS NULL)
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, p.p_promo_name
),
agg_promos AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promo') AS promo_name,
        CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS decimal(10,2)) AS metric_a,
        CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS decimal(10,2)) AS metric_b,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_return_amount
    FROM item i
    FULL OUTER JOIN promotion p
        ON i.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE p.p_channel_demo = 'N'
      AND i.i_wholesale_cost > 0
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, p.p_promo_name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        item_sk,
        product_name,
        promo_name,
        metric_a,
        metric_b,
        total_return_amount,
        'Returns' AS source
    FROM agg_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        item_sk,
        product_name,
        promo_name,
        metric_a,
        metric_b,
        total_return_amount,
        'Promos' AS source
    FROM agg_promos
)
SELECT
    c.item_sk,
    c.product_name,
    c.promo_name,
    c.metric_a,
    c.metric_b,
    c.total_return_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.item_sk ORDER BY c.total_return_amount DESC) AS rank,
    (SELECT AVG(cr3.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr3) AS overall_avg_return,
    c.source
FROM combined c
ORDER BY c.total_return_amount DESC, c.item_sk
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 2000)
      AND s.s_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, d.d_year
)

SELECT
    it.i_item_id,
    it.i_product_name,
    it.d_year,
    it.total_sales,
    it.total_quantity,
    it.avg_price
FROM item_sales it
WHERE it.total_sales > (
    SELECT AVG(total_sales)
    FROM item_sales
    WHERE d_year = it.d_year
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
    it2.i_item_id,
    it2.i_product_name,
    it2.d_year,
    it2.total_sales,
    it2.total_quantity,
    it2.avg_price
FROM item_sales it2
WHERE it2.total_quantity >= (
    SELECT MAX(total_quantity)
    FROM item_sales
    WHERE d_year = it2.d_year
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss2
    JOIN store s2
        ON ss2.ss_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
        ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = (
        SELECT i.i_item_sk
        FROM item i
        WHERE i.i_item_id = it2.i_item_id
        LIMIT 1
    )
      AND s2.s_state = 'CA'
      AND d2.d_year = it2.d_year
      AND d2.d_month_seq = 12
)
ORDER BY d_year DESC, total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_data AS (
    SELECT
        'Catalog' AS sales_channel,
        d.d_date AS sale_date,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
        inv.latest_qty AS inventory_on_hand
    FROM
        catalog_sales cs
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT inv_quantity_on_hand AS latest_qty
            FROM inventory
            WHERE inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS inv
    GROUP BY
        d.d_date,
        i.i_item_id,
        inv.latest_qty
    HAVING
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 1000
),
web_data AS (
    SELECT
        'Web' AS sales_channel,
        d.d_date AS sale_date,
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_flag,
        inv.latest_qty AS inventory_on_hand
    FROM
        web_sales ws
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT inv_quantity_on_hand AS latest_qty
            FROM inventory
            WHERE inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
              AND inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS inv
    GROUP BY
        d.d_date,
        i.i_item_id,
        inv.latest_qty
    HAVING
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 1000
)
SELECT
    sales_channel,
    sale_date,
    item_id,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    profit_flag,
    inventory_on_hand
FROM catalog_data
UNION ALL
SELECT
    sales_channel,
    sale_date,
    item_id,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    profit_flag,
    inventory_on_hand
FROM web_data
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
OFFSET 0
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 3
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_quarter_name,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_quarter_name ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inventory inv
          WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
            AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
            AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      )
    GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name, ss.ss_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 1000
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_quarter_name,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_quarter_name ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inventory inv
          WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
            AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
            AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand = 0
      )
    GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name, ws.ws_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 500
),
combined AS (
    SELECT d_quarter_name,
           ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           total_sales,
           sales_rank,
           'store' AS source
    FROM store_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_quarter_name,
           ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           total_sales,
           sales_rank,
           'web' AS source
    FROM web_agg
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT c.d_quarter_name,
           c.item_sk,
           c.total_sales,
           c.sales_rank,
           c.source
    FROM combined c
    JOIN seq s ON c.sales_rank = s.n
)
SELECT d_quarter_name,
       item_sk,
       total_sales,
       sales_rank,
       source
FROM filtered
ORDER BY d_quarter_name,
         total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        p.p_promo_id               AS promo_id,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id         AS ship_mode_id,
        wsit.web_site_id           AS web_site_id,
        st.s_store_id              AS store_id,
        d_sold.d_date              AS sold_date,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)      AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost)   AS total_ship_cost,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity)        AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    JOIN store st
        ON st.s_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN date_dim d_return
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_sold.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2000-12-31'
      AND sm.sm_carrier = 'FEDEX'
      AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND ws.ws_list_price > 50
      AND ws.ws_ext_ship_cost < 1000
      AND st.s_country = 'USA'
      AND wsit.web_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        p.p_promo_id,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        wsit.web_site_id,
        st.s_store_id,
        d_sold.d_date
),
promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        promo_id,
        ship_mode_id,
        SUM(total_sales)  AS sum_total_sales,
        SUM(total_profit) AS sum_total_profit,
        COUNT(*)          AS num_customers,
        AVG(total_sales)  AS avg_total_sales,
        MAX(order_cnt)    AS max_orders_per_customer
    FROM sales_agg
    GROUP BY promo_id, ship_mode_id
)
SELECT
    pa.promo_id,
    pa.ship_mode_id,
    pa.sum_total_sales,
    pa.sum_total_profit,
    pa.num_customers,
    pa.avg_total_sales,
    pa.max_orders_per_customer,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.promo_id ORDER BY pa.sum_total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(sum_total_profit) FROM promo_agg) AS overall_avg_profit,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = (
            SELECT p2.p_promo_sk
            FROM promotion p2
            WHERE p2.p_promo_id = pa.promo_id
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS total_ws_orders_for_promo
FROM promo_agg pa
WHERE pa.avg_total_sales > 1000
  AND pa.sum_total_profit > 0
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM promotion p3
        WHERE p3.p_promo_id = pa.promo_id
          AND p3.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    )
ORDER BY pa.avg_total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    store_agg AS (
        SELECT
            r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc,
            COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS return_cnt,
            SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
            AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss
        FROM
            store_returns TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS sr
            JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
            JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
        WHERE
            ca.ca_city = 'Pine Oak'
            AND i.i_container <> 'Unknown'
            AND i.i_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
            AND sr.sr_return_quantity > 0
        GROUP BY
            r.r_reason_desc
    ),
    catalog_agg AS (
        SELECT
            r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc,
            COUNT(cr.cr_order_number) AS return_cnt,
            SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
            AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss
        FROM
            catalog_returns cr
            JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
            JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
            JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
            JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        WHERE
            sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
            AND w.w_state = 'CA'
            AND i.i_container <> 'Unknown'
            AND i.i_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
            AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
        GROUP BY
            r.r_reason_desc
    ),
    combined AS (
        SELECT
            'store' AS return_source,
            r_reason_desc,
            return_cnt,
            total_net_loss,
            avg_net_loss
        FROM store_agg
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            'catalog' AS return_source,
            r_reason_desc,
            return_cnt,
            total_net_loss,
            avg_net_loss
        FROM catalog_agg
    )
SELECT
    return_source,
    r_reason_desc,
    return_cnt,
    total_net_loss,
    avg_net_loss,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY r_reason_desc) AS cumulative_net_loss_by_reason,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS rank_by_total_net_loss
FROM combined
WHERE total_net_loss > (
    SELECT AVG(total_net_loss) FROM combined
)
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        ws.web_state,
        ws.web_class,
        ws.web_name,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_ext_tax,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1200 AND 1211
      AND ss.ss_ext_tax > 20.00
      AND ws.web_street_type = 'Pkwy'
), agg_tech AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        web_state,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
        (
            SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_net_paid)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = bs.d_date_sk
        ) AS max_net_paid_for_date
    FROM base_sales bs
    WHERE bs.web_class = 'Technology'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_year, web_state)
), agg_sports AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        web_state,
        SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
        (
            SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_net_paid)
            FROM store_sales ss2
            WHERE ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = bs.d_date_sk
        ) AS max_net_paid_for_date
    FROM base_sales bs
    WHERE bs.web_class = 'Sports'
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (d_year, web_state)
), combined AS (
    SELECT d_year, web_state, total_net_paid, avg_ext_tax, distinct_items, max_net_paid_for_date
    FROM agg_tech
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_year, web_state, total_net_paid, avg_ext_tax, distinct_items, max_net_paid_for_date
    FROM agg_sports
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    web_state,
    total_net_paid,
    avg_ext_tax,
    distinct_items,
    max_net_paid_for_date,
    SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (
        PARTITION BY web_state
        ORDER BY d_year
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cum_state_net_paid,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY web_state
        ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
    ) AS state_rank_by_net
FROM combined
ORDER BY d_year DESC, web_state, cum_state_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

-- Goal: Aggregate total store and web sales, returns loss, inventory levels and distinct customer count by product category, year, store and shipping mode.
SELECT
    i_sales.i_category AS product_category,
    d_sales.d_year AS sales_year,
    s.s_store_name AS store_name,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_store_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_web_sales,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_returns_loss,
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM store_sales ss
-- date for the sale
JOIN date_dim d_sales
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
-- product information
JOIN item i_sales
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
-- customer and address for the sale
JOIN customer c
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_addr
  ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_addr.ca_address_sk
-- store where the sale occurred
JOIN store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
-- promotion applied to the sale
JOIN promotion p
  ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
-- inventory related to the product
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d_inv
  ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
-- warehouse that holds the inventory (also used for web sales)
JOIN warehouse w
  ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
-- web sales of the same product
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
     AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_addr.ca_address_sk
     AND ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
     AND ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_addr.ca_address_sk
     AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
-- dates for web sale and shipment
JOIN date_dim d_ws_sold
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship
  ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
-- shipping mode for the web order
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
-- web site where the order was placed
JOIN web_site webs
  ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = webs.web_site_sk
-- promotion used in the web sale (second alias of promotion)
JOIN promotion p2
  ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
-- catalog page linked by the sale date (start date)
JOIN catalog_page cp
  ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
-- catalog page end date (second alias of date_dim)
JOIN date_dim d_cp_end
  ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_cp_end.d_date_sk
-- store return information linked by ticket number
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
     AND sr.sr_item_sk = i_sales.i_item_sk
     AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
     AND sr.sr_addr_sk = ca_addr.ca_address_sk
     AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
-- return date
JOIN date_dim d_ret
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
-- store closed date (date_dim alias)
JOIN date_dim d_store_closed
  ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_store_closed.d_date_sk
-- customer first ship‑to date (date_dim alias)
JOIN date_dim d_c_first_ship
  ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_c_first_ship.d_date_sk
-- customer first sales date (date_dim alias)
JOIN date_dim d_c_first_sales
  ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_c_first_sales.d_date_sk
-- customer last review date (date_dim alias)
JOIN date_dim d_c_last_review
  ON c.c_last_review_date_sk = d_c_last_review.d_date_sk
-- promotion start and end dates (date_dim aliases)
JOIN date_dim d_p_start
  ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_p_start.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_p_end
  ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_p_end.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sales.d_year = 2001
GROUP BY
    i_sales.i_category,
    d_sales.d_year,
    s.s_store_name,
    sm.sm_type
ORDER BY total_store_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_promo_sk) AS distinct_store_promo_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),
catalog_item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_promo_sk) AS distinct_catalog_promo_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
),
latest_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        inv.inv_item_sk AS i_item_sk,
        MAX(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_inventory_quantity
    FROM inventory inv
    GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand || '_' || i.i_category AS brand_category,
    regexp_extract(i.i_product_name, '([A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3})', 1) AS product_code_extracted,
    substr(i.i_product_name, 1, 5) AS product_name_prefix,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(si.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ci.catalog_net_profit, 0)) > 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (COALESCE(si.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ci.catalog_net_profit, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    COALESCE(si.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ci.catalog_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
    COALESCE(si.store_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(ci.catalog_quantity, 0) AS total_quantity_sold,
    li.max_inventory_quantity,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT promo_sk) FROM (
            SELECT ss2.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk FROM store_sales ss2 WHERE ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            UNION
            SELECT cs2.cs_promo_sk FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs2.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        ) subp
    ) AS total_distinct_promos
FROM item i
LEFT JOIN store_item_sales si ON si.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_item_sales ci ON ci.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN latest_inventory li ON li.i_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE
    regexp_like(i.i_product_name, '[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3}')
    AND i.i_brand LIKE 'Brand%'
    AND li.max_inventory_quantity > 500
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_date_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_list_price,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ARRAY[ws.ws_list_price, ws.ws_sales_price, ws.ws_ext_sales_price] AS price_array
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = 1911
    )
),
unnested_sales AS (
    SELECT
        sd.ws_order_number,
        sd.ws_sold_date_sk,
        sd.ws_ship_date_sk,
        sd.ws_web_site_sk,
        sd.ws_ship_mode_sk,
        sd.ws_net_profit,
        p.price AS price_value,
        sm.sm_code,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        d.d_year
    FROM sales_data sd
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON sd.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON sd.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sd.price_array) AS t(price)
)
SELECT
    ship_code,
    year,
    web_site_sk,
    carrier,
    SUM(total_profit) AS sum_profit,
    SUM(sales_cnt) AS total_sales,
    AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
    max_price_for_code
FROM (
    SELECT
        us.sm_code AS ship_code,
        us.d_year AS year,
        us.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
        us.sm_carrier AS carrier,
        SUM(us.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
        AVG(us.price_value) AS avg_price,
        (SELECT MAX(u2.price_value) FROM unnested_sales u2 WHERE u2.sm_code = us.sm_code) AS max_price_for_code
    FROM unnested_sales us
    WHERE us.sm_code = 'AIR'
    GROUP BY us.sm_code, us.d_year, us.ws_web_site_sk, us.sm_carrier

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        us.sm_code AS ship_code,
        us.d_year AS year,
        us.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
        us.sm_carrier AS carrier,
        SUM(us.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
        AVG(us.price_value) AS avg_price,
        (SELECT MAX(u2.price_value) FROM unnested_sales u2 WHERE u2.sm_code = us.sm_code) AS max_price_for_code
    FROM unnested_sales us
    WHERE us.sm_code = 'SEA'
    GROUP BY us.sm_code, us.d_year, us.ws_web_site_sk, us.sm_carrier
) AS unioned
GROUP BY ship_code, year, web_site_sk, carrier, max_price_for_code
ORDER BY sum_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
    AND r.r_reason_desc <> 'Damaged'
  GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk
),
store_agg AS (
  SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN reason r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
    AND r.r_reason_desc <> 'Damaged'
  GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk
),
combined AS (
  SELECT customer_sk, total_return_amount FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_sk, total_return_amount FROM store_agg
),
customer_total AS (
  SELECT customer_sk,
         SUM(total_return_amount) AS total_return_amount
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY customer_sk
  HAVING SUM(total_return_amount) > (
    SELECT 1.5 * AVG(cr2.cr_return_amt_inc_tax)
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20001231
  )
)
SELECT ct.customer_sk,
       ct.total_return_amount
FROM customer_total ct
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = ct.customer_sk
    AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
  UNION
  SELECT 1
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN reason r
    ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk = ct.customer_sk
    AND r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged'
)
ORDER BY ct.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    store_items AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_item_sk
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        WHERE i.i_brand = 'BrandA'
    ),
    web_items AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        WHERE i.i_brand = 'BrandA'
    ),
    common_items AS (
        SELECT ss_item_sk FROM store_items
        INTERSECT
        SELECT ws_item_sk FROM web_items
    )
SELECT
    s.s_state,
    CASE
        WHEN i.i_category = 'Electronics' THEN 'ELEC'
        WHEN i.i_category = 'Furniture' THEN 'FURN'
        ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS category_group,
    SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS total_net_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold,
    AVG(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS avg_net_paid,
    MIN(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS min_net_paid,
    MAX(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) AS max_net_paid
FROM item i
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site wsite ON wsite.web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM common_items)
  AND s.s_state = 'CA'
  AND s.s_number_employees > 250
  AND s.s_hours = '8AM-8AM'
  AND t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
  AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk IN (13, 15)
  AND wsite.web_tax_percentage > 5.00
  AND s.s_rec_end_date > DATE '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY ROLLUP (
    s.s_state,
    CASE
        WHEN i.i_category = 'Electronics' THEN 'ELEC'
        WHEN i.i_category = 'Furniture' THEN 'FURN'
        ELSE 'OTHER'
    END
)
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0)) > 10000
ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT DATE '2001-01-01' AS d_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_range
    WHERE d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY <= DATE '2001-01-31'
)
SELECT
    sales_channel,
    d_year,
    location_name,
    item_sk,
    total_net_profit,
    profit_category
FROM (
    SELECT
        'store' AS sales_channel,
        dd.d_year,
        s.s_store_name AS location_name,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > (SELECT AVG(cs_net_paid_inc_ship) FROM catalog_sales) THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON dd.d_date = dr.d_date
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inventory i
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON i.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE i.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
          AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand < 10
          AND d2.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-01-31'
    )
    GROUP BY dd.d_year, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_item_sk

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'web' AS sales_channel,
        dd.d_year,
        w.web_name AS location_name,
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > (SELECT AVG(cs_net_paid_inc_ship) FROM catalog_sales) THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON dd.d_date = dr.d_date
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inventory i
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON i.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE i.inv_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
          AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand < 10
          AND d2.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-01-31'
    )
    GROUP BY dd.d_year, w.web_name, ws.ws_item_sk
) combined
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE month_series AS (
    SELECT DATE '2022-01-01' AS month_start
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_add('month', 1, month_start)
    FROM month_series
    WHERE month_start < DATE '2022-12-01'
),
returns_union AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        d.d_date AS return_date,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        d.d_date AS return_date,
        r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31'
),
monthly_agg AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(date_trunc('month', return_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT date_sk) AS distinct_returns,
        SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM returns_union
    GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', return_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT
    ms.month_start,
    COALESCE(ma.total_net_loss, 0) AS month_net_loss,
    COALESCE(ma.distinct_returns, 0) AS distinct_returns,
    SUM(COALESCE(ma.total_net_loss, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ms.month_start) AS cumulative_net_loss
FROM month_series ms
LEFT JOIN monthly_agg ma ON ms.month_start = ma.month_start
ORDER BY ms.month_start
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_base AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_state,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_store_name,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND regexp_like(s.s_store_name, '^A.*')
      AND s.s_city LIKE '%York%'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr
          JOIN date_dim dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
          WHERE dr.d_year = 1999
            AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
      )
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sb.s_store_id,
        sb.s_state,
        sb.s_city,
        SUM(sb.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(sb.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(sb.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(sb.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        nl.name_prefix,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sb.s_state ORDER BY SUM(sb.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS rank_by_state
    FROM (
        SELECT
            sb.*,
            nl.name_prefix
        FROM sales_base sb
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_extract(sb.s_store_name, '^([A-Za-z]+)') AS name_prefix
        ) AS nl
    )
    GROUP BY sb.s_store_id, sb.s_state, sb.s_city, nl.name_prefix
),
catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        CAST('CATALOG' AS varchar) AS s_store_id,
        cd.cd_gender AS s_state,
        cd.cd_marital_status AS s_city,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        regexp_extract(cd.cd_credit_rating, '([A-Z]+)') AS name_prefix,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS rank_by_state
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 1999
      AND lower(cd.cd_credit_rating) LIKE '%a%'
    GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT
    sq.s_store_id,
    sq.s_state,
    sq.s_city,
    sq.total_net_paid,
    sq.total_net_profit,
    sq.total_quantity,
    sq.total_sales,
    sq.name_prefix,
    sq.rank_by_state,
    (SELECT AVG(s_tax_percentage) FROM store s2 WHERE s2.s_state = sq.s_state) AS avg_state_tax
FROM (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_state,
        s_city,
        total_net_paid,
        total_net_profit,
        total_quantity,
        total_sales,
        name_prefix,
        rank_by_state
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_state,
        s_city,
        total_net_paid,
        total_net_profit,
        total_quantity,
        total_sales,
        name_prefix,
        rank_by_state
    FROM catalog_agg
) AS sq
ORDER BY sq.total_net_profit DESC, sq.s_state ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_info AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk,
        hs.hd_buy_potential,
        wsite.web_name,
        wh.w_state,
        wh.w_city,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_type,
        wr.wr_return_quantity,
        wr.wr_return_amt,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash,
        r.r_reason_desc
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_site wsite ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    JOIN warehouse wh ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hs ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hs.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
)
SELECT
    si.web_name,
    si.w_state,
    CASE
        WHEN si.hd_buy_potential LIKE '>%10000%' THEN 'High'
        WHEN si.hd_buy_potential LIKE '5001-10000' THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS buy_potential_category,
    regexp_extract(si.wp_url, 'https?://([^/]+)/', 1) AS domain,
    MAX(concat(si.web_name, '-', si.w_state)) AS site_state_combo,
    MAX(substr(si.wp_type, 1, 3)) AS page_type_prefix,
    COUNT(DISTINCT si.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(si.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(si.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(si.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    (
        SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_ext_sales_price)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        WHERE ws2.ws_web_site_sk = si.ws_web_site_sk
    ) AS max_sales_per_site,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(si.ws_ext_sales_price) > 100000 THEN 'Big'
        ELSE 'Regular'
    END AS sales_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT regexp_extract(si.wp_url, 'https?://([^/]+)/', 1)) AS distinct_domains
FROM sales_info si
WHERE si.wp_url LIKE 'http%://%'
  AND (regexp_like(si.wp_type, '^.*(A|B).*$') OR si.wp_type LIKE '%C%')
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (si.web_name, si.w_state,
     CASE
        WHEN si.hd_buy_potential LIKE '>%10000%' THEN 'High'
        WHEN si.hd_buy_potential LIKE '5001-10000' THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
     END,
     regexp_extract(si.wp_url, 'https?://([^/]+)/', 1)),
    (si.web_name, si.w_state,
     CASE
        WHEN si.hd_buy_potential LIKE '>%10000%' THEN 'High'
        WHEN si.hd_buy_potential LIKE '5001-10000' THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
     END),
    (si.web_name, si.w_state),
    (si.web_name),
    ()
)
HAVING SUM(si.ws_ext_sales_price) > 50000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
  cr_customers AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
  ),
  wr_customers AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk, wr.wr_return_amount AS return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
  ),
  union_customers AS (
    SELECT cust_sk FROM cr_customers
    UNION
    SELECT cust_sk FROM wr_customers
  ),
  intersect_customers AS (
    SELECT cust_sk FROM cr_customers
    INTERSECT
    SELECT cust_sk FROM wr_customers
  ),
  avg_store_return_per_item AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, avg(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt
    FROM store_returns sr
    GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk
  )
SELECT
  cc.cc_state,
  cp.cp_department,
  sm.sm_type,
  wp.wp_type AS web_page_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i1.i_item_id) AS distinct_item_count,
  SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
  SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_return_amount,
  SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amount,
  COALESCE(ar.avg_return_amt, 0) AS avg_store_return_amount_per_item,
  email_part
FROM
  catalog_returns cr
  INNER JOIN item i1 ON cr.cr_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN customer c_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refunded.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN customer c_returning ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c_returning.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN income_band ib_refunded ON hd_refunded.hd_income_band_sk = ib_refunded.ib_income_band_sk
  INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  INNER JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN item i2 ON sr.sr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd_sr.hd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN customer c_wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c_wp.c_customer_sk
  LEFT JOIN avg_store_return_per_item ar ON ar.item_sk = i1.i_item_sk
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(c_refunded.c_email_address, '@')) AS t (email_part)
WHERE
  c_refunded.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT cust_sk FROM intersect_customers)
GROUP BY
  cc.cc_state,
  cp.cp_department,
  sm.sm_type,
  wp.wp_type,
  email_part,
  ar.avg_return_amt
ORDER BY
  total_catalog_return_amount DESC,
  cc.cc_state
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date_sk = 2450801
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN date_range dr ON d2.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk + 1
    WHERE d2.d_date_sk <= 2450805
),
intersect_orders AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number AS order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 2
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number AS order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_list_price > 70
),
union_sales AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number AS order_number, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity BETWEEN 2 AND 5
    UNION
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number AS order_number, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 5
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number,
           ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
           ws.ws_item_sk,
           ws.ws_quantity,
           ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
           ws.ws_net_profit,
           ws.ws_web_page_sk,
           ws.ws_list_price
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 1
      AND ws.ws_list_price > 50
)
SELECT
    d_sold.d_date AS sales_date,
    wp.wp_url,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(fs.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(fs.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    AVG(fs.ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    MIN(fs.ws_ext_sales_price) AS min_sales_price,
    MAX(fs.ws_ext_sales_price) AS max_sales_price,
    (
        SELECT SUM(wr_corr.wr_return_amt)
        FROM web_returns wr_corr
        WHERE wr_corr.wr_order_number = fs.ws_order_number
    ) AS total_return_amt,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ws_all.ws_net_profit)
        FROM web_sales ws_all
    ) AS overall_avg_profit
FROM filtered_sales fs
JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON fs.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_sold
    ON fs.ws_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk
JOIN web_page wp
    ON fs.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON fs.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
   AND fs.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN date_dim d_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t_return
    ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk
JOIN date_range dr
    ON d_sold.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2000
  AND t_sold.t_sub_shift = 'morning'
  AND t_sold.t_meal_time = 'breakfast'
  AND wp.wp_link_count >= 8
  AND wp.wp_max_ad_count = 3
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_returns wr2
        WHERE wr2.wr_order_number = fs.ws_order_number
          AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 10
    )
  AND fs.ws_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM intersect_orders)
  AND fs.ws_order_number IN (SELECT order_number FROM union_sales)
GROUP BY d_sold.d_date, wp.wp_url
HAVING SUM(fs.ws_ext_sales_price) > 1000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_seq AS (
    -- generate a small consecutive range of time_dim keys (max 30 rows)
    SELECT td.t_time_sk, td.t_time
    FROM time_dim td
    ORDER BY td.t_time_sk
    LIMIT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT td2.t_time_sk, td2.t_time
    FROM time_seq ts
    JOIN time_dim td2
      ON td2.t_time_sk = ts.t_time_sk + 1
    WHERE ts.t_time_sk < (SELECT MAX(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim)
      AND ts.t_time_sk < (SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) + 30 FROM time_dim)
),

sales_sub AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price)                     AS total_amount,
        COUNT(1)                                         AS transaction_cnt,
        SUM(top_promo.p_cost)                           AS total_top_promo_cost,
        'sale'                                           AS event_type
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
      ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
      ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    -- pull the most expensive active TV promotion for the item (allowed join rule via p_item_sk)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_cost
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N'
        ORDER BY p.p_cost DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS top_promo
    WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2450948
      AND i.i_current_price > 20
      AND s.s_state = 'KY'
      AND td.t_time_sk IN (SELECT t_time_sk FROM time_seq)
    GROUP BY
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name
),

returns_sub AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS integer)                         AS ss_store_sk,
        CAST(NULL AS varchar)                         AS s_store_name,
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt)                         AS total_amount,
        COUNT(1)                                       AS transaction_cnt,
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(15,2))                  AS total_top_promo_cost,
        'return'                                       AS event_type
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i
      ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
      ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
      ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
      ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2450948
      AND i.i_current_price > 20
      AND wr.wr_return_amt > 5
      AND td.t_time_sk IN (SELECT t_time_sk FROM time_seq)
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name
),

combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM sales_sub
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns_sub
)
SELECT
    c.*,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY total_amount DESC)                 AS event_rank,
    SUM(total_amount) OVER (
        PARTITION BY event_type
        ORDER BY total_amount DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )                                                                               AS cumulative_amount
FROM combined c
ORDER BY event_type, total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE numbers AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM numbers WHERE n < 10
),
union_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk AS store_sk FROM store WHERE s_state = 'CA'
    UNION
    SELECT s_store_sk AS store_sk FROM store WHERE s_state = 'TX'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_hdemo_sk,
        sr.sr_addr_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ca.ca_suite_number,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        s.s_state,
        s.s_county,
        s.s_market_desc,
        s.s_gmt_offset,
        s.s_tax_percentage,
        n.n AS seq_num
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN numbers n ON n.n = MOD(sr.sr_return_quantity, 10) + 1
    WHERE
        s.s_county IN ('Jackson County','Mobile County')
        AND c.c_birth_country IN ('CHILE','KOREA')
        AND ca.ca_suite_number = 'Suite 100'
        AND s.s_market_desc LIKE '%Local%'
        AND s.s_gmt_offset > 0
        AND s.s_tax_percentage BETWEEN 5 AND 10
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2
        AND sr.sr_store_sk IN (SELECT store_sk FROM union_stores)
        AND n.n BETWEEN 2 AND 9
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        s_state,
        c_birth_country,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
    FROM base
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (s_state, c_birth_country)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s_state,
        c_birth_country,
        total_return_amount,
        avg_return_qty,
        distinct_tickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS rn,
        (SELECT AVG(sr_return_amt) FROM store_returns) AS overall_avg_return_amt
    FROM agg
)
SELECT
    rn,
    s_state,
    c_birth_country,
    total_return_amount,
    avg_return_qty,
    distinct_tickets,
    overall_avg_return_amt,
    CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'Top' ELSE 'Other' END AS rank_label
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 100
ORDER BY rn
LIMIT 100
