WITH joined AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        d_ret.d_year,
        ca_refund.ca_state,
        sm.sm_type,
        r.r_reason_desc
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ret
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_refund
        ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refund.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_return
        ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret
        ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
       AND ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk
       AND ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
       AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
       AND ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
       AND ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_refund.ca_address_sk
       AND ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
       AND ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_return.ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_ret.d_year = 1914
      AND sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
      AND ca_refund.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND ws.ws_sales_price > 50.0
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        ca_state,
        sm_type,
        r_reason_desc,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_return_net_loss,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_net_profit,
        AVG(ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        MIN(cr_return_amount) AS min_return_amount,
        MAX(cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY d_year, ca_state, sm_type, r_reason_desc
)
SELECT
    a.d_year,
    a.ca_state,
    a.sm_type,
    a.r_reason_desc,
    a.total_return_net_loss,
    a.total_sales_net_profit,
    a.avg_sales_price,
    a.distinct_orders,
    a.return_cnt,
    a.min_return_amount,
    a.max_return_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_year ORDER BY a.total_sales_net_profit DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ws2.ws_net_profit)
        FROM web_sales ws2
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        WHERE d2.d_year = a.d_year
    ) AS avg_profit_year,
    lr.max_return_amount_reason
FROM agg a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MAX(cr2.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount_reason
    FROM catalog_returns cr2
    WHERE cr2.cr_reason_sk = (
        SELECT r2.r_reason_sk
        FROM reason r2
        WHERE r2.r_reason_desc = a.r_reason_desc
    )
) AS lr
ORDER BY a.total_sales_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
    sampled_item AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM item
        TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10)
    ),
    avg_discount AS (
        SELECT AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_disc
        FROM catalog_sales
        WHERE cs_sold_time_sk IN (
            SELECT t_time_sk FROM time_dim WHERE t_hour IN (13, 14, 19)
        )
    )
SELECT
    time_dim.t_hour,
    store.s_state,
    reason_store.r_reason_desc,
    CASE WHEN store_sales.ss_quantity > 5 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Regular' END AS sales_type,
    SUM(store_sales.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_net_paid,
    SUM(COALESCE(store_returns.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_store_return_amt,
    SUM(catalog_sales.cs_net_paid) AS total_catalog_net_paid,
    SUM(COALESCE(catalog_returns.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_catalog_return_amt,
    SUM(COALESCE(web_returns.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_web_return_amt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    CASE 
        WHEN avg_discount.avg_disc IS NOT NULL AND avg_discount.avg_disc <> 0 
        THEN SUM(catalog_sales.cs_ext_discount_amt) / avg_discount.avg_disc 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS discount_ratio_sum
FROM
    store_sales
    JOIN time_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    JOIN sampled_item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = sampled_item.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns 
        ON store_returns.sr_ticket_number = store_sales.ss_ticket_number
        AND store_returns.sr_item_sk = sampled_item.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason AS reason_store 
        ON store_returns.sr_reason_sk = reason_store.r_reason_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales 
        ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = sampled_item.i_item_sk
        AND catalog_sales.cs_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns 
        ON catalog_returns.cr_order_number = catalog_sales.cs_order_number
        AND catalog_returns.cr_item_sk = sampled_item.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason AS reason_cat 
        ON catalog_returns.cr_reason_sk = reason_cat.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode 
        ON catalog_sales.cs_ship_mode_sk = ship_mode.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse 
        ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center 
        ON catalog_sales.cs_call_center_sk = call_center.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns 
        ON web_returns.wr_item_sk = sampled_item.i_item_sk
        AND web_returns.wr_returned_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason AS reason_web 
        ON web_returns.wr_reason_sk = reason_web.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page 
        ON web_returns.wr_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer AS web_customer 
        ON web_page.wp_customer_sk = web_customer.c_customer_sk
    CROSS JOIN avg_discount
WHERE
    time_dim.t_hour IN (13, 14, 19)
    AND store.s_state = 'CA'
    AND sampled_item.i_brand = 'Brand#21'
    AND ship_mode.sm_carrier = 'UPS'
    AND reason_store.r_reason_desc = 'Customer Not Satisfied'
    AND web_returns.wr_reversed_charge > 300
    AND call_center.cc_company_name = 'CompanyXYZ'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_returns cr2 WHERE cr2.cr_order_number = catalog_sales.cs_order_number
    )
GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (
        time_dim.t_hour,
        store.s_state,
        reason_store.r_reason_desc,
        CASE WHEN store_sales.ss_quantity > 5 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Regular' END
    )
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE recent_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2022-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date, d2.d_year
    FROM date_dim d2
    JOIN recent_dates rd ON d2.d_date = rd.d_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    WHERE d2.d_date <= DATE '2022-12-31'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        rd.d_year,
        i_cs.i_brand,
        i_cs.i_category,
        sm_cs.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        p_cs.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ws.ws_net_paid,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        ARRAY[i_cs.i_brand, i_cs.i_category] AS brand_category_arr
    FROM recent_dates rd
    -- catalog_sales and its dimensions
    LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_cs_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_cs_ship.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_bill ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_ship ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_cs ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_cs.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w_cs.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i_cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_cs.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p_cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p_cs.p_promo_sk
    -- store_sales and its dimensions
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i_ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i_ss.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p_ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p_ss.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_ss.c_customer_sk
    -- web_sales and its dimensions
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_ws_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ws_ship.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i_ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i_ws.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p_ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p_ws.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w_ws.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    -- store_returns and its dimensions (including link to store_sales via ticket number)
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i_sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i_sr.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c_sr.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss_return ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss_return.ss_ticket_number
    -- inventory and its dimensions
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i_inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i_inv.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w_inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w_inv.w_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    rd_year,
    attribute,
    ship_mode_type,
    promo_name,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales,
    SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(returns) AS total_returns,
    SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
FROM (
    SELECT
        d_year AS rd_year,
        attribute,
        ship_mode_type,
        promo_name,
        COALESCE(cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ss_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws_net_paid, 0) AS sales,
        COALESCE(cs_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ws_net_profit, 0) AS profit,
        COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0) AS returns,
        COALESCE(inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS quantity_on_hand
    FROM joined
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(brand_category_arr) AS u (attribute)
) sub
GROUP BY rd_year, attribute, ship_mode_type, promo_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH
cc_expanded AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc.cc_city,
        cc.cc_street_type,
        comp AS cc_component,
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_gmt_offset
    FROM call_center cc
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(concat(cc.cc_street_type, ',', cc.cc_city), ',')) AS t(comp)
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND cc.cc_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5.00 AND -4.00
),
returning_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 500.00
),
purchasing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax > 1000.00
),
customers_no_purchase AS (
    SELECT rc.customer_sk
    FROM returning_customers rc
    EXCEPT
    SELECT pc.customer_sk FROM purchasing_customers pc
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc_expanded.cc_call_center_sk,
        cc_expanded.cc_component,
        d_ws.d_year AS d_year,
        i.i_brand AS i_brand,
        i.i_category AS i_category,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS w_warehouse_name,
        ib.ib_upper_bound AS ib_upper_bound,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_return_amount AS sr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS cr_return_amount,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand,
        c.c_customer_id AS c_customer_id,
        cd.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count AS hd_vehicle_count,
        i.i_current_price AS i_current_price,
        t_ws.t_hour AS t_hour,
        c.c_birth_month AS c_birth_month
    FROM cc_expanded
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cc_expanded.cc_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
           AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_ws
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib
        ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
           AND sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
           AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
           AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
           AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
           AND sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_ws.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
           AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
           AND inv.inv_date_sk = d_ws.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d_ws.d_year = 2001
        AND i.i_current_price > 100.00
        AND ib.ib_upper_bound >= 100000
        AND t_ws.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
        AND c.c_birth_month = 5
        AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT customer_sk FROM customers_no_purchase)
)
SELECT
    cc_call_center_sk,
    cc_component,
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    w_warehouse_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_store_returns,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS total_catalog_returns,
    AVG(i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
    MAX(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_inventory_on_hand,
    MIN(ib_upper_bound) AS min_income_upper_bound
FROM joined_data
GROUP BY
    cc_call_center_sk,
    cc_component,
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    w_warehouse_name
ORDER BY
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base_join AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk,
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_fee,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_catalog_number,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        cd_refunded.cd_credit_rating,
        d_cr.d_year,
        d_cr.d_date_sk,
        t_cr.t_hour AS cr_return_hour,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand,
        sr.sr_return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_tax,
        wp.wp_url,
        ARRAY[cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_fee, cr.cr_net_loss] AS return_vals
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d_cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_cr ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_cr.t_time_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_cp_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_cp_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t_sr ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd_sr.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_cr.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_wp_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_wp_access.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_cr.d_year = 2001
      AND cd_refunded.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 100
),
exploded AS (
    SELECT bj.*, t.metric_val
    FROM base_join bj
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(bj.return_vals) AS t(metric_val)
),
agg1 AS (
    SELECT
        ex.d_date_sk,
        ex.d_year,
        ex.cp_department,
        ex.cd_credit_rating,
        ex.w_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(ex.cr_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount,
        SUM(ex.cr_fee) AS sum_fee,
        SUM(ex.cr_net_loss) AS sum_net_loss,
        SUM(ex.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS sum_inventory_qty,
        SUM(ex.sr_return_amount) AS sum_store_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns,
        AVG(ex.metric_val) AS avg_metric_val
    FROM exploded ex
    GROUP BY
        ex.d_date_sk,
        ex.d_year,
        ex.cp_department,
        ex.cd_credit_rating,
        ex.w_warehouse_sk
),
agg2 AS (
    SELECT
        a1.d_date_sk,
        a1.d_year,
        a1.cd_credit_rating,
        SUM(a1.sum_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(a1.sum_fee) AS total_fee,
        SUM(a1.sum_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(a1.cnt_returns) AS total_returns,
        SUM(a1.sum_inventory_qty) AS total_inventory_qty,
        AVG(a1.avg_metric_val) AS overall_avg_metric_val
    FROM agg1 a1
    GROUP BY
        a1.d_date_sk,
        a1.d_year,
        a1.cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT
    a2.d_date_sk,
    a2.d_year,
    a2.cd_credit_rating,
    a2.total_return_amount,
    a2.total_fee,
    a2.total_net_loss,
    a2.total_returns,
    a2.total_inventory_qty,
    a2.overall_avg_metric_val,
    (
        SELECT SUM(inv_sub.inv_quantity_on_hand)
        FROM inventory inv_sub
        WHERE inv_sub.inv_date_sk = a2.d_date_sk
    ) AS inventory_sum_for_date
FROM agg2 a2
WHERE a2.total_net_loss > 5000
ORDER BY a2.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs_item_sk,
        cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs_call_center_sk,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cat_sales_amount,
        SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS cat_discount_amount
    FROM catalog_sales
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_call_center_sk
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        S.s_store_id,
        S.s_store_name,
        WBS.web_site_id,
        D_ss.d_year AS sale_year,
        I.i_item_id,
        I.i_product_name,
        SUM(SS.ss_net_paid) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(WS.ws_net_paid) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(CS_AGG.cat_sales_amount) AS total_catalog_sales,
        promo_agg.total_promo_cost,
        SUM(SS.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit
    FROM store_sales SS
    JOIN date_dim D_ss ON SS.ss_sold_date_sk = D_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim T_ss ON SS.ss_sold_time_sk = T_ss.t_time_sk
    JOIN store S ON SS.ss_store_sk = S.s_store_sk
    JOIN promotion P ON SS.ss_promo_sk = P.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics CD_ss ON SS.ss_cdemo_sk = CD_ss.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN item I ON SS.ss_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
    JOIN cs_agg CS_AGG ON CS_AGG.cs_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
                         AND CS_AGG.cs_sold_date_sk = D_ss.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center CC ON CC.cc_call_center_sk = CS_AGG.cs_call_center_sk
    JOIN web_sales WS ON WS.ws_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim D_ws ON WS.ws_sold_date_sk = D_ws.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim T_ws ON WS.ws_sold_time_sk = T_ws.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode SM ON WS.ws_ship_mode_sk = SM.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN promotion P_ws ON WS.ws_promo_sk = P_ws.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_page WP ON WS.ws_web_page_sk = WP.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_site WBS ON WS.ws_web_site_sk = WBS.web_site_sk
    JOIN web_returns WR ON WR.wr_order_number = WS.ws_order_number
    JOIN date_dim D_wr ON WR.wr_returned_date_sk = D_wr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim T_wr ON WR.wr_returned_time_sk = T_wr.t_time_sk
    JOIN store_returns SR ON SR.sr_ticket_number = SS.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN date_dim D_sr ON SR.sr_returned_date_sk = D_sr.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim T_sr ON SR.sr_return_time_sk = T_sr.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics CD_sr ON SR.sr_cdemo_sk = CD_sr.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost
        FROM promotion p
        WHERE p.p_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
          AND p.p_start_date_sk <= D_ss.d_date_sk
          AND p.p_end_date_sk >= D_ss.d_date_sk
    ) AS promo_agg ON TRUE
    WHERE D_ss.d_year = 2001
      AND I.i_color = 'Red'
      AND CD_ss.cd_credit_rating = 'Good'
      AND P.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM promotion p2
          WHERE p2.p_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
            AND p2.p_start_date_sk <= D_ss.d_date_sk
            AND p2.p_end_date_sk >= D_ss.d_date_sk
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM store_returns sr2
          WHERE sr2.sr_item_sk = SS.ss_item_sk
            AND sr2.sr_return_quantity > 10
      )
    GROUP BY
        S.s_store_id,
        S.s_store_name,
        WBS.web_site_id,
        D_ss.d_year,
        I.i_item_id,
        I.i_product_name,
        promo_agg.total_promo_cost
    HAVING SUM(SS.ss_net_paid) > 0
)
SELECT
    b.s_store_id,
    b.s_store_name,
    b.web_site_id,
    b.sale_year,
    b.i_item_id,
    b.i_product_name,
    b.total_store_sales,
    b.total_web_sales,
    b.total_catalog_sales,
    b.total_promo_cost,
    CASE
        WHEN b.total_store_profit > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN b.total_store_profit > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.s_store_id ORDER BY b.total_store_sales DESC) AS store_sales_rank
FROM base b
ORDER BY b.total_store_sales DESC, profit_category ASC, store_sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE daily_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS return_date,
        sm.sm_code,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty,
        COUNT(*) AS returns_count,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 1000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS amount_category
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN inventory i
        ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 200.00
      AND sm.sm_code IN ('AIR', 'SEA')
      AND i.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY d.d_date, sm.sm_code
),
mode_summary AS (
    SELECT
        sm_code,
        AVG(total_return_amount) AS avg_daily_return_amount,
        SUM(total_return_quantity) AS sum_return_quantity,
        SUM(total_inventory_qty) AS sum_inventory_qty,
        COUNT(*) AS day_count,
        CASE
            WHEN AVG(total_return_amount) > 1500 THEN 'Very High'
            ELSE 'Normal'
        END AS avg_amount_category
    FROM daily_agg
    GROUP BY sm_code
    HAVING AVG(total_return_amount) > 500
)
SELECT
    sm_code,
    avg_daily_return_amount,
    sum_return_quantity,
    sum_inventory_qty,
    avg_amount_category,
    day_count
FROM mode_summary
ORDER BY avg_daily_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH active_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wsite.web_site_id,
        p.p_promo_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        'Active' AS promo_status
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
      AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-01' AND DATE '1999-12-31'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM household_demographics hd
          WHERE hd.hd_demo_sk = ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk
            AND hd.hd_dep_count >= 3
      )
    GROUP BY wsite.web_site_id, p.p_promo_id
),
inactive_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wsite.web_site_id,
        p.p_promo_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        'Inactive' AS promo_status
    FROM web_sales TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (10) AS ws
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN web_site wsite
        ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'N'
      AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-01' AND DATE '1999-12-31'
      AND wsite.web_county = 'San Miguel County'
    GROUP BY wsite.web_site_id, p.p_promo_id
),
unioned_sales AS (
    SELECT * FROM active_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM inactive_sales
)
SELECT
    us.web_site_id,
    us.p_promo_id,
    us.total_sales,
    us.promo_status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY us.promo_status ORDER BY us.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    (SELECT AVG(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2) AS avg_promo_cost
FROM unioned_sales us
ORDER BY us.total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

-- Goal: compute, per call center, the average daily return amount and total return count for returns
-- from two distinct state groups (CA and NY) after a distinct UNION, filter on high activity
-- and show the maximum warehouse size in the same state as the call center.
WITH unioned AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    FROM tpcds.catalog_returns cr
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_state = 'CA'
      AND w.w_state = 'CA'
      AND cc.cc_employees > 30
      AND cr.cr_return_amount > 10

    UNION

    SELECT
        cr2.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr2.cr_warehouse_sk,
        cr2.cr_return_amount,
        cr2.cr_return_quantity,
        cr2.cr_returned_date_sk
    FROM tpcds.catalog_returns cr2
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc2 ON cr2.cr_call_center_sk = cc2.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.warehouse w2 ON cr2.cr_warehouse_sk = w2.w_warehouse_sk
    WHERE cc2.cc_state = 'NY'
      AND w2.w_state = 'NY'
      AND cc2.cc_employees > 30
      AND cr2.cr_return_amount > 20
),
agg1 AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_call_center_id,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        u.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
        SUM(u.cr_return_amount) AS sum_ret_amt,
        SUM(u.cr_return_quantity) AS sum_ret_qty,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM unioned u
    JOIN tpcds.call_center cc ON u.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN tpcds.warehouse w ON u.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, w.w_warehouse_id, u.cr_returned_date_sk
    HAVING SUM(u.cr_return_amount) > 500
),
final_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cc_call_center_id,
        AVG(sum_ret_amt) AS avg_daily_return_amount,
        SUM(cnt) AS total_returns
    FROM agg1
    GROUP BY cc_call_center_id
    HAVING AVG(sum_ret_amt) > 200
)
SELECT
    f.cc_call_center_id,
    f.avg_daily_return_amount,
    f.total_returns,
    (
        SELECT MAX(w2.w_warehouse_sq_ft)
        FROM tpcds.warehouse w2
        WHERE w2.w_state = (
            SELECT cc2.cc_state
            FROM tpcds.call_center cc2
            WHERE cc2.cc_call_center_id = f.cc_call_center_id
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS max_warehouse_sq_ft_in_state
FROM final_agg f
ORDER BY f.avg_daily_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE ship_seq AS (
    SELECT
        sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm_ship_mode_id,
        1 AS lvl
    FROM ship_mode
    WHERE sm_ship_mode_sk = (SELECT MIN(sm_ship_mode_sk) FROM ship_mode)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        seq.lvl + 1
    FROM ship_mode sm
    JOIN ship_seq seq
        ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = seq.sm_ship_mode_sk + 1
    WHERE sm.sm_ship_mode_sk <= (SELECT MAX(sm_ship_mode_sk) FROM ship_mode)
)
SELECT
    s.sm_ship_mode_id,
    agg.record_date_sk,
    agg.total_amount,
    CASE WHEN agg.total_amount >= 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS amount_category
FROM (
    SELECT
        ss.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS record_date_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_amount
    FROM ship_seq ss
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = ss.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ss.sm_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ss.sm_ship_mode_sk,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS record_date_sk,
        -SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_amount
    FROM ship_seq ss
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = ss.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ss.sm_ship_mode_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk
) agg
JOIN ship_seq s
    ON agg.sm_ship_mode_sk = s.sm_ship_mode_sk
ORDER BY agg.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

/* Goal: Calculate per‑customer and per‑item net sales and average sales per order, applying multiple filters on company, product, inventory, date, URL and return attributes, and return the top 100 customers by net sales. */
WITH sales_summary AS (
    SELECT
        C.c_customer_id,
        I.i_item_id,
        I.i_category,
        SUM(SS.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_store_sales,
        SUM(WS.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
        SUM(SR.sr_return_amt) AS total_store_returns,
        SUM(WR.wr_return_amt) AS total_web_returns,
        COUNT(DISTINCT SS.ss_ticket_number) AS store_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT WS.ws_order_number) AS web_orders,
        SUM(CR.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_returns,
        SUM(CC.cc_tax_percentage) AS total_tax_percentage
    FROM store_sales SS
    JOIN item I
      ON SS.ss_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer C
      ON SS.ss_customer_sk = C.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics CD
      ON SS.ss_cdemo_sk = CD.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address CA
      ON SS.ss_addr_sk = CA.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store_returns SR
      ON SR.sr_ticket_number = SS.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN inventory Inv
      ON Inv.inv_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_sales WS
      ON WS.ws_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_page WP
      ON WS.ws_web_page_sk = WP.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns WR
      ON WR.wr_order_number = WS.ws_order_number
    JOIN catalog_returns CR
      ON CR.cr_item_sk = I.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center CC
      ON CR.cr_call_center_sk = CC.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN catalog_page CP
      ON CR.cr_catalog_page_sk = CP.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE
        CC.cc_company_name = 'cally'
        AND CP.cp_type = 'Digital'
        AND C.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
        AND I.i_brand = 'Brand#45'
        AND Inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 100
        AND CC.cc_rec_start_date >= DATE '2000-01-01'
        AND WP.wp_url LIKE '%foo.com%'
        AND CR.cr_return_amount > 0
    GROUP BY
        C.c_customer_id,
        I.i_item_id,
        I.i_category
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ss.c_customer_id,
    ss.i_category,
    ss.total_store_sales,
    ss.total_web_sales,
    ss.total_store_returns,
    ss.total_web_returns,
    ss.total_catalog_returns,
    ss.store_orders,
    ss.web_orders,
    ROUND(ss.total_store_sales + ss.total_web_sales - ss.total_store_returns - ss.total_web_returns - ss.total_catalog_returns, 2) AS net_sales,
    (ss.total_store_sales + ss.total_web_sales) / NULLIF(ss.store_orders + ss.web_orders, 0) AS avg_sales_per_order
FROM sales_summary ss
WHERE
    (ss.total_store_sales + ss.total_web_sales - ss.total_store_returns - ss.total_web_returns - ss.total_catalog_returns) > (
        SELECT AVG(total_store_sales + total_web_sales)
        FROM sales_summary
        WHERE total_store_sales IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_returns sr2
        WHERE sr2.sr_customer_sk = (
            SELECT c_customer_sk
            FROM customer
            WHERE c_customer_id = ss.c_customer_id
        )
        AND sr2.sr_return_amt > 0
    )
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_manager_id,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_country,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_paid,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amt,
        cc.cc_name,
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        inv_l.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    LEFT JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT inv.inv_quantity_on_hand AS inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory inv
        WHERE inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
          AND inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
          AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS inv_l
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_manager_id IN (27, 26, 3)
      AND ca.ca_state = 'CA'
      AND ss.ss_quantity > 0
      AND ss.ss_net_paid > 0
      AND ss.ss_net_profit > 0
      AND w.w_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
      AND i.i_category = 'Electronics'
),
unioned AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_category,
        i_manager_id,
        ca_state,
        ss_quantity AS qty,
        ss_net_paid AS amount,
        ss_net_profit AS profit,
        w_warehouse_id,
        inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM base
    WHERE ss_quantity > 5
    UNION
    SELECT
        d_year,
        i_category,
        i_manager_id,
        ca_state,
        sr_return_quantity AS qty,
        sr_return_amt AS amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS profit,
        w_warehouse_id,
        inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM base
    WHERE sr_return_quantity > 2
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    i_category,
    SUM(qty) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
    SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w_warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count,
    AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_hand
FROM unioned
GROUP BY d_year, i_category
HAVING SUM(amount) > 5000
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 20

/*
Goal: Summarize net profit by store, item category and year for 2001, assign profit tiers, compute store‑level ranking and cumulative profit, compare each store's profit to the overall average, and show promotion activity. Only keep stores that have at least one email‑channel promotion.
*/
WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_category,
        d_sold.d_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) >= 100000 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) >= 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS profit_level
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_sold
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d_ship
        ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    WHERE
        d_sold.d_year = 2001
        AND i.i_category = 'Sports'
        AND s.s_country = 'United States'
        AND w.w_country = 'United States'
        AND hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 1
        AND p.p_purpose = 'Unknown'
        AND cp.cp_type = 'W'
    GROUP BY
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        i.i_category,
        d_sold.d_year
)
SELECT
    a.s_store_id,
    a.s_store_name,
    a.i_category,
    a.d_year,
    a.total_profit,
    a.order_cnt,
    a.profit_level,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_year ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_year,
    SUM(a.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY a.s_store_id ORDER BY a.d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit_by_store,
    a.total_profit / (SELECT AVG(total_profit) FROM agg) AS profit_vs_avg,
    promo_summary.promo_cnt,
    promo_summary.active_email_promo_flag
FROM agg a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT p2.p_promo_sk) AS promo_cnt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN p2.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_email_promo_flag
    FROM web_sales ws2
    INNER JOIN promotion p2
        ON ws2.ws_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN item i2
        ON ws2.ws_item_sk = i2.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = (
            SELECT d2.d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim d2
            WHERE d2.d_year = a.d_year
            LIMIT 1
        )
        AND i2.i_category = a.i_category
        AND ws2.ws_warehouse_sk = (
            SELECT w3.w_warehouse_sk
            FROM warehouse w3
            WHERE w3.w_country = 'United States'
            LIMIT 1
        )
) AS promo_summary
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM promotion p_exists
    WHERE p_exists.p_promo_sk = (
        SELECT ws3.ws_promo_sk
        FROM web_sales ws3
        WHERE ws3.ws_sold_date_sk = (
                SELECT d3.d_date_sk
                FROM date_dim d3
                WHERE d3.d_year = a.d_year
                LIMIT 1
            )
          AND ws3.ws_item_sk = (
                SELECT i3.i_item_sk
                FROM item i3
                WHERE i3.i_category = a.i_category
                LIMIT 1
            )
        LIMIT 1
    )
      AND p_exists.p_channel_email = 'Y'
)
ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE time_seq(t_time_sk) AS (
    SELECT MIN(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t_time_sk + 1 FROM time_seq WHERE t_time_sk + 1 <= (SELECT MAX(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim)
)
SELECT
    td.t_hour,
    td.t_meal_time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS num_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_returns,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc IS NOT NULL THEN r.r_reason_desc END) AS top_return_reason,
    (SELECT SUM(wr2.wr_return_amt)
       FROM web_returns wr2
      WHERE wr2.wr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk) AS item_total_returns,
    (SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price)
       FROM store_sales ss2
      WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk) AS max_customer_sale
FROM
    time_seq ts
    JOIN time_dim td ON ts.t_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer c_sales ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_sales ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_sales.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_sales ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_sales.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_sales ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca_sales.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN item i_wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i_wr.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_refunded.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c_returning ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c_returning.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_refunded.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd_returning ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_returning.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_refunded.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_returning ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_returning.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_refunded ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_refunded.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_returning ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_returning.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_current ON c_sales.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_current.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_current ON c_sales.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_current.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_current ON c_sales.c_current_addr_sk = ca_current.ca_address_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd_current.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr2
     WHERE wr2.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_sales.c_customer_sk
       AND wr2.wr_return_amt > 100
)
GROUP BY
    td.t_hour,
    td.t_meal_time
ORDER BY
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    cd.cd_gender AS gender,
    p.p_channel_event AS promo_event,
    cc.cc_state AS call_center_state,
    cp.cp_department AS catalog_department,
    we.web_state AS web_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS order_count,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_channel_event = p.p_channel_event) AS avg_promo_cost,
    (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_sales ws2 WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND ws2.ws_quantity > 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_heavy_web_sales
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm_cr.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse wh_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = wh_cr.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r_cr.r_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm_ws ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ws.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN warehouse wh_ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wh_ws.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN web_site we ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = we.web_site_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_wr ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r_wr.r_reason_sk
WHERE p.p_channel_event = 'N'
  AND p.p_purpose = 'Unknown'
  AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
  AND cc.cc_state = 'CA'
  AND cp.cp_department = 'Electronics'
  AND we.web_state = 'CA'
  AND ss.ss_quantity > 1
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    p.p_channel_event,
    cc.cc_state,
    cp.cp_department,
    we.web_state

UNION

SELECT
    cd.cd_gender AS gender,
    p.p_channel_event AS promo_event,
    cc.cc_state AS call_center_state,
    cp.cp_department AS catalog_department,
    we.web_state AS web_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS order_count,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_catalog_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_category,
    (SELECT AVG(p2.p_cost) FROM promotion p2 WHERE p2.p_channel_event = p.p_channel_event) AS avg_promo_cost,
    (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_sales ws2 WHERE ws2.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND ws2.ws_quantity > 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_heavy_web_sales
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN reason r_sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r_sr.r_reason_sk

LEFT JOIN warehouse wh_cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = wh_cr.w_warehouse_sk

LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk AND ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT (SELECT MIN(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales) AS date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk + 1
    FROM date_range
    WHERE date_sk < (SELECT MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales)
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           s.s_store_name AS store_name,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS sales_amount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_brand = 'Brand#23'
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, s.s_store_name
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           s.s_store_name AS store_name,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS returns_amount
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_brand = 'Brand#23'
    GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, s.s_store_name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT date_sk,
           store_name,
           sales_amount AS amount,
           'sale' AS trans_type
    FROM sales_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date_sk,
           store_name,
           returns_amount AS amount,
           'return' AS trans_type
    FROM returns_agg
),
final AS (
    SELECT dr.date_sk,
           c.store_name,
           CASE WHEN c.trans_type = 'sale' THEN c.amount
                WHEN c.trans_type = 'return' THEN -c.amount
                ELSE 0 END AS net_amount,
           c.trans_type
    FROM date_range dr
    LEFT JOIN combined c ON dr.date_sk = c.date_sk
    WHERE c.store_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT date_sk,
                store_name,
                net_amount,
                trans_type
FROM final
ORDER BY date_sk, store_name

plan_feedback.mechanism: validity-gated lever curriculum (Thompson per-depth gates) + Vendi-aligned 3-gram reward
plan_feedback.depth_policy: sequential hazard: continue k->k+1 with Thompson(validity@k+1) * diversity_brake
